messages.content: Show an example of sending server-side addon data to the client in Garry's Mod Lua.

Server
```lua
util.AddNetworkString("MyAddon_SyncCoins")

hook.Add("PlayerInitialSpawn", "MyAddon_SendCoins", function(ply)
local coins = 100
net.Start("MyAddon_SyncCoins")
net.WriteUInt(coins, 16)
net.Send(ply)
end)
```

Client
```lua
local myCoins = 0

net.Receive("MyAddon_SyncCoins", function()
myCoins = net.ReadUInt(16)
end)

hook.Add("HUDPaint", "MyAddon_DrawCoins", function()
draw.SimpleText("Coins: " .. myCoins, "Trebuchet24", 20, 50, color_white)
end)
```

The server owns the real value. The client only receives a copy for display.

function CUTTALEVEL:PlayerAccountID(ply)
return tostring(ply:AccountID())
end

function CUTTALEVEL:init_playerload_data(ply)
if not ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA] then ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA] = {} end
if !file.Exists(CUTTALEVEL_SAVEFOLDERNAME,"DATA") then
file.CreateDir(CUTTALEVEL_SAVEFOLDERNAME)
file.CreateDir(CUTTALEVEL_SAVEFOLDERNAME.."/players")
end
if !file.Exists(CUTTALEVEL_SAVEFOLDERNAME.."/players","DATA") then
file.CreateDir(CUTTALEVEL_SAVEFOLDERNAME.."/players")
end
if file.Exists(CUTTALEVEL_SAVEFOLDERNAME.."/players/"..tostring(ply:SteamID64())..".txt","DATA") then
ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA] = util.JSONToTable( file.Read(CUTTALEVEL_SAVEFOLDERNAME.."/players/"..tostring(ply:SteamID64())..".txt","DATA") )
else
ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["skillpoints"] = 0
ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["skills"] = {}
ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["level"] = 1
ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["exp"] = 0
ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["totalexp"] = 0
end

ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA] = CUTTALEVEL:NormalizePlayerDataTable(ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA])
end

function CUTTALEVEL:playerload_data(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end

local lastLoad = tonumber(ply.CUTTALEVEL_LastFullLoadAt or 0) or 0
if lastLoad > 0 and (CurTime() - lastLoad) < 3 then
return
end

CUTTALEVEL:init_playerload_data(ply)

CUTTALEVEL:playerdata_transfer(ply)
ply.CUTTALEVEL_LastFullLoadAt = CurTime()
timer.Simple(5,function()
if ply:IsValid() then
CUTTALEVEL:SkillActionSpawn(ply)
end
end)

end

function CUTTALEVEL:Hud_Visibility(ply,amountofxp)
if not ply:GetNWBool("cutta_level_v2_hud_visbil",false) then
ply:SetNWBool("cutta_level_v2_hud_visbil",true)
ply.runningxp = amountofxp
ply:SetNWInt("cutta_level_v2_lastearnedxp", ply.runningxp)
else
ply.runningxp = ply.runningxp + amountofxp
ply:SetNWInt("cutta_level_v2_lastearnedxp", ply.runningxp)
if timer.Exists(ply:Nick().."cutta_level_v2_huddelayshow") then
timer.Remove(ply:Nick().."cutta_level_v2_huddelayshow")
end
end
if timer.Exists(ply:Nick().."cutta_level_v2_huddelayshow") then return end
timer.Create(ply:Nick().."cutta_level_v2_huddelayshow",5,1,function()
if ply:IsValid() then
ply:SetNWBool("cutta_level_v2_hud_visbil",false)
ply.runningxp = 0
end
end)
end

function CUTTALEVEL:playersave_data(ply)
ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA] = CUTTALEVEL:GetPlayerDataTable(ply)
file.Write( CUTTALEVEL_SAVEFOLDERNAME.."/players/"..tostring(ply:SteamID64())..".txt", util.TableToJSON(ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]))
CUTTALEVEL:playerdata_transfer(ply)
end

function CUTTALEVEL:playerdata_transfer(ply)
local pdata = CUTTALEVEL:GetPlayerDataTable(ply)
net.Start(CUTTALEVEL_NETNAME.."playerload")
net.WriteTable(pdata)
net.Send(ply)
end

-- Player Kill Will Give XP

function CUTTALEVEL:PlayerDeath(victim,inflictor,attacker)
if !CUTTALEVEL_CONFIG.Enabled then return end
if !attacker:IsPlayer() then return end
if victim == attacker then return end
CUTTALEVEL:player_givexp(attacker, CUTTALEVEL_CONFIG.PlayerKillXP)
end

function CUTTALEVEL:PlayerButtonDown(ply,button)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end
if not CUTTALEVEL_CONFIG.Enabled then return end
if button ~= CUTTALEVEL_CONFIG.OpenMenuButton then return end

CUTTALEVEL:RequestOpenSkillsMenu(ply)
end

function CUTTALEVEL:RequestOpenSkillsMenu(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end
if not CUTTALEVEL_CONFIG.Enabled then return end

local lastOpen = tonumber(ply.CUTTALEVEL_LastSkillsMenuOpenAt or 0) or 0
if lastOpen > 0 and (CurTime() - lastOpen) < 0.1 then return end

ply.CUTTALEVEL_LastSkillsMenuOpenAt = CurTime()

net.Start(CUTTALEVEL_NETNAME.."openskillsmenu")
net.Send(ply)
end

local skill = {}

skill.name = "Speed Up"
skill.desc = "Increase Your Movement Speed"
skill.skillid = "speedup"
skill.max = 10
skill.action = function(ply)
local upgpoints = ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["skills"][skill.skillid]
if upgpoints then
timer.Simple(0,function()
if !ply:IsValid() then return end
if not skill[ply:Nick()] then skill[ply:Nick()] = {ply:GetWalkSpeed(),ply:GetRunSpeed()} end
local newwalkspeed = skill[ply:Nick()][1] + (upgpoints*5)
local newrunspeed = skill[ply:Nick()][2] + (upgpoints*5)
ply:SetWalkSpeed(newwalkspeed)
ply:SetRunSpeed(newrunspeed)
end)
end
end
skill.spawn = function(ply)
skill.action(ply)
end
skill.disconnect = function(ply)
end
skill.death = function(ply)

end

CUTTALEVEL:ImportSkill(skill)

What are the arguments, return values, and realm details for bit.bnot in Garry's Mod Lua?

Realms
- Shared and Menu

Arguments
- value: number. The value to be inverted.

Returns
- value: number. The result of bitwise not. 0101 becomes 1010, etc.
In Garry's Mod Lua, what does achievements.Count do?

Returns the amount of achievements currently in Garry's Mod.

Realms
- Client and Menu

Returns
- value: number. The amount of achievements available.

local function CQS_DialogueSound_IsURL(soundPath)
if not isstring(soundPath) then return false end
soundPath = string.Trim(soundPath)
if soundPath == "" then return false end
return string.StartWith(soundPath, "http://") or string.StartWith(soundPath, "https://")
end

local function CQS_DialogueSound_NormalizeLocalPath(soundPath)
if not isstring(soundPath) then return nil end
soundPath = string.Trim(soundPath)
if soundPath == "" then return nil end
if string.StartWith(soundPath, "sound/") then
soundPath = string.sub(soundPath, 7)
end
return soundPath
end

function cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Stop()
if not IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then return end

if timer.Exists("CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundTimer") then
timer.Remove("CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundTimer")
end

local channel = LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue
if channel then
if channel.IsPlaying and channel:IsPlaying() and channel.Stop then
channel:Stop()
elseif channel.Stop then
channel:Stop()
end
end
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue = nil
end

function cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Play(soundPath)
if not IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then return end
if not isstring(soundPath) then return end
soundPath = string.Trim(soundPath)
if soundPath == "" then return end

cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Stop()

if CQS_DialogueSound_IsURL(soundPath) then
sound.PlayURL(tostring(soundPath), "", function(station)
if IsValid(station) then
station:SetPos(LocalPlayer():GetPos())
station:Play()
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue = station
end
end)
return
end

local normalized = CQS_DialogueSound_NormalizeLocalPath(soundPath)
if not normalized then return end

LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue = CreateSound(LocalPlayer(), normalized)
if LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue then
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue:Play()
end

local dur = SoundDuration(normalized)
if isnumber(dur) and dur > 0 then
timer.Create("CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundTimer", dur, 1, function()
if IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then
cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Stop()
end
end)
end
end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Dialogue_DiaNPC_Commencing(dialoguetable)
LocalPlayer().temp_CUTTAQS_DialogueNumber = 1
LocalPlayer().temp_CUTTAQS_DialogueTable = dialoguetable
if dialoguetable.rnddialogue then
local randomnum = math.random(1,#dialoguetable.dialogue)
LocalPlayer().temp_CUTTAQS_DialogueNumber = randomnum
end
if cutta_quest_system:Quests_DialogueExists(cutta_quest_system:Objective_Dialogue_DIaNPC_DiaCheck(dialoguetable)) then
cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_DiaNPC_CanCreateDialogBox(false,cutta_quest_system:Objective_Dialogue_DIaNPC_DiaCheck(dialoguetable))
else
cutta_quest_system:Objective_Dialogue_CameraView_TurnOff()
cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_CL_EndQuestAction()
end
end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Dialogue_DIaNPC_DiaCheck(dialoguetable)
local dianpc_diaid
for k,v in pairs(dialoguetable) do
if k == "dialogue" then
for l,p in pairs(v) do
if l == LocalPlayer().temp_CUTTAQS_DialogueNumber then
dianpc_diaid = p
end
end
end
end
return dianpc_diaid
end

function cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_DiaNPC_OpenDialogBox(dialogText,options,singledialogue,dialogueid)
dialogText = tostring(dialogText or "")
if isstring(dialogueid) and dialogueid ~= "" then
local dia = cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_GetByID(dialogueid)
if istable(dia) then
local snd = dia.sound or dia.Sound or dia.soundcue or dia.SoundCue
if isstring(snd) and string.Trim(snd) ~= "" then
cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Play(snd)
end
end
end

Example

Simple function to draw rotated and/or scaled text.
```lua
local vector_one = Vector( 1, 1, 1 )
function draw.RotatedText( text, font, x, y, color, ang, scale )
render.PushFilterMag( TEXFILTER.ANISOTROPIC )
render.PushFilterMin( TEXFILTER.ANISOTROPIC )

local m = Matrix()
m:Translate( Vector( x, y, 0 ) )
m:Rotate( Angle( 0, ang, 0 ) )
m:Scale( vector_one * ( scale or 1 ) )

surface.SetFont( font )
local w, h = surface.GetTextSize( text )

m:Translate( Vector( -w / 2, -h / 2, 0 ) )

cam.PushModelMatrix( m, true )
draw.DrawText( text, font, 0, 0, color )
cam.PopModelMatrix()

render.PopFilterMag()
render.PopFilterMin()
end

end)
```

```lua
concommand.Add("test_matrix", function()
local menu = vgui.Create( "DFrame" )
menu:SetSize( 200, 200 )
menu:SetTitle("Matrix rotation example")
menu:SetPos( 200, 200 )

local panel = menu:Add( "DPanel" )
panel:SetSize( 100, 100 )
panel:Center()

local grin = Material("icon16/emoticon_evilgrin.png", "smooth noclamp")
local angle = 0
function panel:Paint(w, h)
draw.RoundedBox( 8, 0, 0, w, h, color_white )

local m = Matrix()

local x, y = self:LocalToScreen( w / 2, h / 2 )
local center = Vector( x, y, 0 )

m:Translate( center )
m:Rotate( Angle( 0, angle, 0 ) )
m:Translate( -center )

angle = angle + FrameTime() * 60

-- push a filter mag to take away the crispiness

render.PushFilterMin( TEXFILTER.ANISOTROPIC )

cam.PushModelMatrix( m )

surface.SetDrawColor( 255, 255, 255, 255 )
surface.SetMaterial( grin )
```

function cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_CreateDialogue(dialoguetable)
if not istable(dialoguetable) then return end
local dialogueid
local validdialogue = false
for k,v in pairs(dialoguetable) do
if k == "DialogueID" then
if not cutta_quest_system:Quests_DialogueExists(v) then
validdialogue = true
dialogueid = v
end
end
end
if not validdialogue then return end
if dialogueid then
table.insert(cutta_quest_system["Dialogues"],dialoguetable)
cutta_quest_system._CQS_DialogueIndexDirty = true
if cutta_quest_system.Dialogues_RebuildIndex then
cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_RebuildIndex()
end
cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_Transfer()
cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_ListUpdate()
cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_Save(dialogueid)
end

function cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_DeleteDialogue(dialogueid)
if cutta_quest_system:Quests_DialogueExists(dialogueid) then
for k,v in pairs(cutta_quest_system["Dialogues"]) do
if v.DialogueID == dialogueid then
cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_FileRemove(dialogueid)
table.remove(cutta_quest_system["Dialogues"],k)
for l,p in pairs(cutta_quest_system["DialogueNPCs"]) do
if p.NPC_Dialogues then
for z,ee in pairs(p.NPC_Dialogues) do
if ee == dialogueid then
table.remove(p.NPC_Dialogues,z)
end
end
end
end
end
end
end
for k,v in pairs(cutta_quest_system["Dialogues"]) do
if istable(v.Actions) then
if table.Count(v.Actions) > 0 then
for l,p in pairs(v.Actions) do
if p.NextDialogue == dialogueid then
p.NextDialogue = nil
end
end
end
end
end

cutta_quest_system:DialogueNPCs_Transfer()
cutta_quest_system._CQS_DialogueIndexDirty = true

cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_RebuildIndex()
end
cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_Transfer()
cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_ListUpdate()
cutta_quest_system:Quests_RemoveDialogueFromQuestObj(dialogueid)
end

function cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_ChangeDialogue(olddialogueid,newdialogueid,newdialogueid_table)
if not istable(newdialogueid_table) then return end
for k,v in pairs(cutta_quest_system["Dialogues"]) do
if v.DialogueID == olddialogueid then
cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_FileRemove(olddialogueid)
table.remove(cutta_quest_system["Dialogues"],k)
end
end
table.insert(cutta_quest_system["Dialogues"],newdialogueid_table)
for k,v in pairs(cutta_quest_system["Dialogues"]) do
if istable(v.Actions) then
if table.Count(v.Actions) > 0 then
for l,p in pairs(v.Actions) do
if p.NextDialogue == olddialogueid then
p.NextDialogue = newdialogueid
end
end
end
end
end
for l,p in pairs(cutta_quest_system["DialogueNPCs"]) do
if p.NPC_Dialogues then
for z,ee in pairs(p.NPC_Dialogues) do
if ee == olddialogueid then
table.remove(p.NPC_Dialogues,z)
table.insert(p.NPC_Dialogues,newdialogueid)
end
end
end
end

cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_RemoveOldDialogue(olddialogueid)
cutta_quest_system._CQS_DialogueIndexDirty = true

cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_RebuildIndex()
end
cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_Transfer()
cutta_quest_system:Quests_ChangeDialogueFromQuestObj(olddialogueid,newdialogueid)

cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_Save(newdialogueid)

end

function cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_DuplicateDialogue(dialoguetable)
if not istable(dialoguetable) then return end
if not isstring(dialoguetable.DialogueID) or dialoguetable.DialogueID == "" then return end
local newdialoguetable = table.Copy(dialoguetable)
newdialoguetable.DialogueID = newdialoguetable.DialogueID.."_copy"
table.insert(cutta_quest_system["Dialogues"],newdialoguetable)
cutta_quest_system._CQS_DialogueIndexDirty = true
if cutta_quest_system.Dialogues_RebuildIndex then
cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_RebuildIndex()
end
cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_Transfer()
cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_ListUpdate()
cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_Save(newdialoguetable.DialogueID)
end

local dialoguepath = "cutta_quest_system/dialogues/"..dialogueid..".txt"
if file.Exists(dialoguepath,"DATA") then
file.Delete(dialoguepath)
end
end

function cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsValidQuestData(questData)
if not istable(questData) then return false end

local hasKnownQuestData = false

if questData.Objectives ~= nil then
if not istable(questData.Objectives) then return false end
hasKnownQuestData = true
end

if questData.Reward ~= nil then
if not istable(questData.Reward) then return false end
hasKnownQuestData = true
end

if questData.Required ~= nil then
if not istable(questData.Required) then return false end
hasKnownQuestData = true
end

if questData.Restrictions ~= nil then
if not istable(questData.Restrictions) then return false end
hasKnownQuestData = true
end

if questData.Repeatable ~= nil then
hasKnownQuestData = true
end

if questData.IsColddown ~= nil then
hasKnownQuestData = true
end

if questData.ColddownTime ~= nil then
hasKnownQuestData = true
end

return hasKnownQuestData
end

function cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsValidQuestContainer(questContainer)
if not istable(questContainer) then return false end

local keyCount = 0
for questName, questData in pairs(questContainer) do
keyCount = keyCount + 1
if keyCount > 1 then
return false
end

if not (isstring(questName) or isnumber(questName)) then
return false
end

local trimmedQuestName = string.Trim(tostring(questName))
if trimmedQuestName == "" then
return false
end

if not cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsValidQuestData(questData) then
return false
end
end

return keyCount == 1
end

function cutta_quest_system:Quests_RebuildIndex()
cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndex = {}
cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndexLower = {}
cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndexDirty = false
if not istable(cutta_quest_system["Quests"]) then return end

for _, questContainer in ipairs(cutta_quest_system["Quests"]) do
if cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsValidQuestContainer(questContainer) then
for questName, questData in pairs(questContainer) do
local trimmedQuestName = string.Trim(tostring(questName))
cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndex[trimmedQuestName] = questData
cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndexLower[string.lower(trimmedQuestName)] = questData
end
end
end
end

function cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname)
if not (isstring(questname) or isnumber(questname)) then return nil end
questname = string.Trim(tostring(questname))
if questname == "" then return nil end
if not istable(cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndex) or cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndexDirty then
cutta_quest_system:Quests_RebuildIndex()
end
local questData = cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndex and cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndex[questname] or nil
if questData ~= nil then
return questData
end

local lowerName = string.lower(questname)
local questDataLower = cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndexLower and cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndexLower[lowerName] or nil
if questDataLower ~= nil then
return questDataLower
end

-- If the underlying quests table changed without marking dirty,
-- rebuild once and try again.
cutta_quest_system:Quests_RebuildIndex()
questData = cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndex and cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndex[questname] or nil
if questData ~= nil then
return questData
end
return cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndexLower and cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndexLower[lowerName] or nil
end

function cutta_quest_system:Quests_QuestExists(questname)
return cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname) ~= nil
end

function cutta_quest_system:Quests_QuestRestrictionsCheck(questname)
local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname)
if not questData or not istable(questData.Restrictions) then return false end

for _, restrictionGroup in pairs(questData.Restrictions) do
if istable(restrictionGroup) then
for restrictionKey, _ in pairs(restrictionGroup) do
if restrictionKey then
return true
end
end
end
end
return false
end

function cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerQuestRestrictionsTable(ply,questname)
local restrictionsrequired = {}
local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname)
if not questData or not istable(questData.Restrictions) then return restrictionsrequired end

for _, restrictionGroup in pairs(questData.Restrictions) do
if istable(restrictionGroup) then
for restrictionType, restrictionValue in pairs(restrictionGroup) do
if not restrictionsrequired[restrictionType] then restrictionsrequired[restrictionType] = {} end
table.insert(restrictionsrequired[restrictionType], restrictionValue)
end
end
end
return restrictionsrequired
end

/*
Quest Requirements
*/
function cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerNeedQuestsRequired(ply,questname)
local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname)
if not questData or not istable(questData.Required) then return false end
return table.Count(questData.Required) > 0
end

function cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerQuestsRequired(ply,questname)
local questrequired = {}
local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname)
if not questData or not istable(questData.Required) then return questrequired end

for _, requiredQuestName in ipairs(questData.Required) do
questrequired[requiredQuestName] = true
end
return questrequired
end

/*
Quest Colddown/Repeatable
*/

function cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsRepeatable(questname,ply)
local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname)
return questData and questData.Repeatable == true or false
end

function cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsColddown(questname)
local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname)
return questData and questData.IsColddown == true or false
end

Replace Certain NPC with another

function cutta_quest_system:Quests_NPC_Class_Replace(searchedclass,replacementclass) -- Replace certain Kill NPC Class Name in All quests
if not istable(cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndex) or cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndexDirty then
cutta_quest_system:Quests_RebuildIndex()
end
for _, questData in pairs(cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndex or {}) do
if istable(questData) and istable(questData.Objectives) then
for _, obj in ipairs(questData.Objectives) do
if istable(obj) and obj.Obj_Name == "kill" and istable(obj.entities) then
for _, entInfo in ipairs(obj.entities) do
if istable(entInfo) and entInfo.class == searchedclass then
entInfo.class = replacementclass
end
end
end
end
end
end
if CLIENT then
net.Start("CQS_Quests_NPC_Class_Replace")
net.WriteString(searchedclass)
net.WriteString(replacementclass)
net.SendToServer()
else
cutta_quest_system._CQS_QuestIndexDirty = true
cutta_quest_system:Quests_Transfer()
end
end
if SERVER then
util.AddNetworkString("CQS_Quests_NPC_Class_Replace")
net.Receive("CQS_Quests_NPC_Class_Replace",function(len,ply)
local searchedclass = net.ReadString()
local replacementclass = net.ReadString()
cutta_quest_system:Quests_NPC_Class_Replace(searchedclass,replacementclass)
end)
else
concommand.Add("cqs_npc_replace",function(ply,cmd,args)
if cutta_quest_system:PlayerUserGroupAllowed(ply) then
local searchedclass = args[1]
local replacementclass = args[2]
cutta_quest_system:Quests_NPC_Class_Replace(searchedclass,replacementclass)
end
end)
end

local function LoadFiles()
local allFiles = file.Find("cutta_inventory_system/*.lua", "LUA")
local sv_files = {}
local cl_files = {}
local shared_files = {}

local known_shared_files = {
"shared_config.lua",
"shared_hooks.lua",
"shared_functions.lua"
}
local shared_file_set = {}
for _, filename in ipairs(known_shared_files) do
shared_file_set[filename] = true
end

for _, d in ipairs(allFiles) do
if shared_file_set[d] then
shared_files[#shared_files + 1] = d
else
local first3 = string.sub(d, 1, 3)
if first3 == "sv_" then
sv_files[#sv_files + 1] = d
elseif first3 == "cl_" then
cl_files[#cl_files + 1] = d
end
end
end

table.sort(shared_files)
table.sort(cl_files)

local filePath = "cutta_inventory_system/" .. filename
if file.Exists(filePath, "LUA") then
if SERVER then
AddCSLuaFile(filePath)
end
include(filePath)
print("Cutta Inventory Shared Loaded: " .. filename)
end
end

How is an addon-style SWEP usually split between shared, server, and client files in Garry's Mod Lua?

Typical SWEP layout
- shared.lua defines the weapon table, ammo, hold type, and shared behavior.
- init.lua keeps server-only logic such as authoritative spawning, damage side effects, and AddCSLuaFile calls.
- cl_init.lua keeps client-only drawing, crosshair, HUD, and presentation tweaks.

Common pattern
- Put SWEP metadata and SetupDataTables in shared.lua.
- Keep gameplay authority on the server even if PrimaryAttack is predicted.
- Put viewmodel, HUD, and client effects on the client.
- Use net messages or networked vars when the client needs to display server-owned weapon state.

This keeps weapon code compatible with addon-style file splitting while still matching Garry's Mod realm rules.

How should I structure a larger Garry's Mod gamemode or complex addon system?

Treat a gamemode or large addon like a set of subsystems instead of one huge file.

Useful layers
- Bootstrapping: file loading and realm setup.
- Config: constants, enums, tunables, permissions.
- Domain systems: inventory, jobs, economy, quests, crafting, housing, or combat.
- Entities: scripted entities, weapons, effects, NPC helpers.
- Transport: net messages and state synchronization.
- Persistence: save/load, migrations, and shutdown handling.
- UI: menus, HUD, context panels, notifications.

Keep each subsystem narrow. A good rule is that UI should ask systems for state, systems should ask persistence layers to save, and only the server should be allowed to mutate the authoritative state.

local function getJobLevelsAddon()
if not istable(CUTTADARKRPJOBLEVELS) then
return nil
end

if not isfunction(CUTTADARKRPJOBLEVELS.AddJobXP) then
return nil
end

return CUTTADARKRPJOBLEVELS
end

local function normalizeJobLevelsJobCommand(jobLevelsAddon, jobCommand)
if jobLevelsAddon and isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.NormalizeJobCommand) then
return jobLevelsAddon:NormalizeJobCommand(jobCommand)
end

if not isstring(jobCommand) then
return ""
end

return string.lower(string.Trim(jobCommand))
end

local function getJobLevelsCurrentJobCommand(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity)
if not IsValid(playerEntity) or not playerEntity:IsPlayer() then
return ""
end

local candidateCommands = {}
if jobLevelsAddon and isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.GetPlayerJobCommand) then
candidateCommands[#candidateCommands + 1] = jobLevelsAddon:GetPlayerJobCommand(playerEntity)
end

if istable(RPExtraTeams) then
local jobTable = RPExtraTeams[playerEntity:Team()]
if istable(jobTable) then
candidateCommands[#candidateCommands + 1] = jobTable.command
end
end

if jobLevelsAddon and istable(jobLevelsAddon.NWKeys) then
candidateCommands[#candidateCommands + 1] = playerEntity:GetNWString(jobLevelsAddon.NWKeys.CurrentCommand, "")
end

candidateCommands[#candidateCommands + 1] = playerEntity:GetNWString("cutta_darkrp_job_levels_command", "")

for _, candidateCommand in ipairs(candidateCommands) do
local normalizedCommand = normalizeJobLevelsJobCommand(jobLevelsAddon, candidateCommand)
if normalizedCommand ~= "" then
return normalizedCommand
end
end

return ""
end

local function getJobLevelsCurrentJobName(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity, jobCommand)
if not IsValid(playerEntity) or not playerEntity:IsPlayer() then
return jobCommand or ""
end

local candidateNames = {}
if jobLevelsAddon and isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.GetPlayerJobName) then
candidateNames[#candidateNames + 1] = jobLevelsAddon:GetPlayerJobName(playerEntity)
end

if team and team.GetName then
candidateNames[#candidateNames + 1] = team.GetName(playerEntity:Team())
end

if jobLevelsAddon and istable(jobLevelsAddon.NWKeys) then
candidateNames[#candidateNames + 1] = playerEntity:GetNWString(jobLevelsAddon.NWKeys.CurrentJobName, "")
end

if jobCommand ~= "" and jobLevelsAddon and isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.GetJobNameFromCommand) then
candidateNames[#candidateNames + 1] = jobLevelsAddon:GetJobNameFromCommand(jobCommand)
end

for _, candidateName in ipairs(candidateNames) do
local normalizedName = string.Trim(tostring(candidateName or ""))
if normalizedName ~= "" then
return normalizedName
end
end

return jobCommand or ""
end

local function prepareJobLevelsEntry(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity, jobCommand)
if not jobLevelsAddon or jobCommand == "" then
return nil
end

local entry = nil
if isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.GetJobEntry) then
entry = jobLevelsAddon:GetJobEntry(playerEntity, jobCommand, true)
end

if not istable(entry) and isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.TouchCurrentJobEntry) then
entry = jobLevelsAddon:TouchCurrentJobEntry(playerEntity)
end

if istable(entry) then
local jobName = getJobLevelsCurrentJobName(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity, jobCommand)
if jobName ~= "" then
entry.name = jobName
end
end

return entry
end

local function finishDirectJobLevelsAward(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity, jobCommand, xpAmount, reason, entry, levelsGained)
if isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.UpdateNetworkedState) then
jobLevelsAddon:UpdateNetworkedState(playerEntity)
end

if isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.SendXPGainNotification) then
jobLevelsAddon:SendXPGainNotification(playerEntity, xpAmount, entry, jobCommand)
end

if isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.SavePlayerData) then
jobLevelsAddon:SavePlayerData(playerEntity)
end

if levelsGained <= 0 then
return true
end

local jobName = tostring(entry and entry.name or "")
if jobName == "" and isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.GetJobNameFromCommand) then
jobName = tostring(jobLevelsAddon:GetJobNameFromCommand(jobCommand) or jobCommand)
end

playerEntity:PrintMessage(
HUD_PRINTTALK,
"[Job Levels] " .. tostring(jobName ~= "" and jobName or jobCommand) .. " is now level " .. tostring(entry.level)
)

hook.Run("CuttaDarkRPJobLevels_LevelUp", playerEntity, jobCommand, entry.level, levelsGained, reason)
return true
end

local function awardCropHarvestJobXPNow(playerEntity, totalXP, reason)
if not IsValid(playerEntity) or not playerEntity:IsPlayer() then
return false
end

local jobLevelsAddon = getJobLevelsAddon()
if not jobLevelsAddon then
return false
end

local jobCommand = getJobLevelsCurrentJobCommand(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity)
if jobCommand == "" then
return false
end

prepareJobLevelsEntry(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity, jobCommand)

if isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.AddJobXP) then
local grantedXP = jobLevelsAddon:AddJobXP(playerEntity, totalXP, reason, jobCommand)
if grantedXP then
return true
end
end

local entry = prepareJobLevelsEntry(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity, jobCommand)
if not istable(entry) then
return false
end

entry.level = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(entry.level) or 1))
entry.xp = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(entry.xp) or 0)) + totalXP
entry.totalxp = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(entry.totalxp) or 0)) + totalXP

if not isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.GetXPToLevel) then
return false
end

local levelsGained = 0
while entry.xp >= jobLevelsAddon:GetXPToLevel(entry.level) do
entry.xp = entry.xp - jobLevelsAddon:GetXPToLevel(entry.level)
entry.level = entry.level + 1
levelsGained = levelsGained + 1
end

return finishDirectJobLevelsAward(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity, jobCommand, totalXP, reason, entry, levelsGained)
end

local function queueCropHarvestJobXP(playerEntity, totalXP, reason, attempt)
attempt = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(attempt) or 0), 0)
if attempt >= FS_Utils.CropHarvestXPAwardRetryCount then
return false
end

timer.Simple(FS_Utils.CropHarvestXPAwardRetryDelay, function()
if not IsValid(playerEntity) or not playerEntity:IsPlayer() then
return
end

if awardCropHarvestJobXPNow(playerEntity, totalXP, reason) then
return
end

queueCropHarvestJobXP(playerEntity, totalXP, reason, attempt + 1)
end)

return true
end

if not IsValid(playerEntity) or not playerEntity:IsPlayer() then

local normalizedHarvestCount = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(harvestCount) or 0))
if normalizedHarvestCount <= 0 then
return false
end

hook.Run("FS_CropHarvested", playerEntity, seed, options or {}, normalizedHarvestCount)
return true
end

local ownerIdentifier = isstring(ownerOrIdentifier) and ownerOrIdentifier or getPlayerIdentifier(ownerOrIdentifier)
if ownerIdentifier == "" then
return {}
end

local ownedPatches = ownedDirtPatchesByOwnerId[ownerIdentifier]
if not ownedPatches then
return {}
end

local patches = {}
for entityIndex, entity in pairs(ownedPatches) do
if IsValid(entity) then
patches[#patches + 1] = entity
else
ownedPatches[entityIndex] = nil
end
end

if (maxValue - minValue) <= (surfaceSampleInset * 2) then

end

local function traceSeedSurfacePoint(seed, localPoint)
if not IsValid(seed) then
return nil
end

local startPosition = seed:LocalToWorld(localPoint + Vector(0, 0, surfaceTraceStartOffset))
local endPosition = startPosition + Vector(0, 0, -surfaceTraceDepth)

return util.TraceLine({
start = startPosition,
endpos = endPosition,
filter = seed,
mask = seedGroundTraceMask
})
end

local function traceSeedSurfaceHull(seed)
if not IsValid(seed) then
return nil
end

local collisionMins, collisionMaxs = seed:GetCollisionBounds()
local minX, maxX = getInsetAxisRange(collisionMins.x, collisionMaxs.x)
local minY, maxY = getInsetAxisRange(collisionMins.y, collisionMaxs.y)
local hullTopZ = math.min(collisionMins.z + surfaceHullHeight, collisionMaxs.z)
local startPosition = seed:GetPos() + Vector(0, 0, surfaceTraceStartOffset)
local endPosition = startPosition + Vector(0, 0, -surfaceTraceDepth)

return util.TraceHull({
start = startPosition,
endpos = endPosition,
mins = Vector(minX, minY, collisionMins.z),
maxs = Vector(maxX, maxY, hullTopZ),
filter = seed,
mask = seedGroundTraceMask
})
end

local function getSeedSurfaceSamplePoints(seed)
local collisionMins, collisionMaxs = seed:GetCollisionBounds()
local minX, maxX = getInsetAxisRange(collisionMins.x, collisionMaxs.x)
local minY, maxY = getInsetAxisRange(collisionMins.y, collisionMaxs.y)
local bottomZ = collisionMins.z

return {
Vector(0, 0, bottomZ),
Vector(minX, minY, bottomZ),
Vector(minX, maxY, bottomZ),
Vector(maxX, minY, bottomZ),
Vector(maxX, maxY, bottomZ)
}
end

local function getSeedGroundTrace(seed)
local fallbackTrace = nil
local hullTrace = traceSeedSurfaceHull(seed)
if hullTrace and hullTrace.Hit then
fallbackTrace = hullTrace
if FS_Utils.IsPlantableTrace(hullTrace) then
return hullTrace
end
end

for _, localPoint in ipairs(getSeedSurfaceSamplePoints(seed)) do
local trace = traceSeedSurfacePoint(seed, localPoint)
if trace and trace.Hit then
fallbackTrace = fallbackTrace or trace
if FS_Utils.IsPlantableTrace(trace) then
return trace
end
end
end

return fallbackTrace
end

local function canPlayerSeeUsePoint(player, entity, usePoint)
if not IsValid(player) or not IsValid(entity) or not isvector(usePoint) then
return false
end

local traceFilter = {player, entity}
local parentEntity = entity:GetParent()
if IsValid(parentEntity) then
table.insert(traceFilter, parentEntity)
end

local dirtPatch = entity.fsDirtPatch
if IsValid(dirtPatch) and dirtPatch ~= parentEntity then
table.insert(traceFilter, dirtPatch)
end

local visibilityTrace = util.TraceLine({
start = player:EyePos(),
endpos = usePoint,
filter = traceFilter,
mask = MASK_SOLID
})

if not visibilityTrace.Hit then
return true
end

return visibilityTrace.HitPos:DistToSqr(usePoint) <= (manualUseVisibilityTolerance * manualUseVisibilityTolerance)
end

local function getPlayerFarmUseTarget(player)
if not IsValid(player) or not player:IsPlayer() then
return nil, false, nil
end

local eyeTrace = getPlayerUseTrace(player)
local useDistance = math.max(tonumber(FS_Use_Distance) or 0, 24)
local useDistanceSqr = useDistance * useDistance
local eyePos = player:EyePos()
local aimVector = player:GetAimVector()
local bestEntity = nil
local bestScore = nil

local function considerEntity(entity, prioritizeEyeTrace)
if not isFarmUseCandidate(entity) then
return
end

if player:GetPos():DistToSqr(entity:GetPos()) > useDistanceSqr then
return
end

local entityAnchor = getEntityUseAnchor(entity)
if not isvector(entityAnchor) then
return
end

local alongAim = (entityAnchor - eyePos):Dot(aimVector)
if alongAim < 0 or alongAim > useDistance then
return
end

local closestAimPoint = eyePos + (aimVector * alongAim)
local usePoint = getEntityUsePoint(entity, closestAimPoint)
if not isvector(usePoint) then
return
end

local useTolerance = math.max(tonumber(entity.fsUseNearestPointTolerance) or 24, 24) + manualUseLineTolerancePadding
local lineDistanceSqr = usePoint:DistToSqr(closestAimPoint)
if lineDistanceSqr > (useTolerance * useTolerance) then
return
end

if not canPlayerSeeUsePoint(player, entity, usePoint) then
return
end

local score = lineDistanceSqr + alongAim
if prioritizeEyeTrace then
score = score - (useDistance * useDistance)
end

if not bestScore or score < bestScore then
bestEntity = entity
bestScore = score
end
end

if eyeTrace and IsValid(eyeTrace.Entity) then
considerEntity(eyeTrace.Entity, true)
end

for _, entity in ipairs(ents.FindInSphere(player:GetPos(), useDistance + manualUseFallbackSearchPadding)) do
if not (eyeTrace and entity == eyeTrace.Entity) then
considerEntity(entity, false)
end
end

return bestEntity, eyeTrace and bestEntity == eyeTrace.Entity or false, eyeTrace
end

if variationPercent <= 0 then

end

local variationAmount = roundedBaseTime * variationPercent
local randomizedTime = math.Round(math.Rand(roundedBaseTime - variationAmount, roundedBaseTime + variationAmount))
return math.max(randomizedTime, 1)
end

end

local function normalizeFertilizerTarget(entity)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return nil
end

local className = entity:GetClass() or ""
if className == "fs_dirt_patch" then
return entity
end

if string.StartWith(className, "fs_") and string.EndsWith(className, "_seeds") then
if IsValid(entity.fsDirtPatch) then
return entity.fsDirtPatch
end

return entity
end

return nil
end

local function getFertilizerTargetScore(origin, entity)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return nil
end

local nearestPoint = entity.NearestPoint and entity:NearestPoint(origin) or entity:GetPos()
local offset = nearestPoint - origin
local horizontalDistanceSqr = (offset.x * offset.x) + (offset.y * offset.y)
if horizontalDistanceSqr > (FS_Utils.FertilizerSearchRadius * FS_Utils.FertilizerSearchRadius) then
return nil
end

if math.abs(offset.z) > FS_Utils.FertilizerVerticalTolerance then
return nil
end

return horizontalDistanceSqr + (offset.z * offset.z)
end

function FS_Utils.GetFertilizerTarget(fertilizer)
if not IsValid(fertilizer) then
return nil
end

local origin = fertilizer:GetPos()
local trace = util.TraceLine({
start = origin,
endpos = origin + Vector(0, 0, -FS_Utils.FertilizerTraceDepth),
filter = fertilizer,
mask = MASK_SOLID
})

local traceTarget = normalizeFertilizerTarget(trace.Entity)
if IsValid(traceTarget) then
return traceTarget
end

local bestTarget = nil
local bestScore = nil
local seenTargets = {}

for _, entity in ipairs(ents.FindInSphere(origin, FS_Utils.FertilizerSearchRadius)) do
if entity == fertilizer then
continue
end

local normalizedTarget = normalizeFertilizerTarget(entity)
if not IsValid(normalizedTarget) then
continue
end

local targetIndex = normalizedTarget:EntIndex()
if seenTargets[targetIndex] then
continue
end
seenTargets[targetIndex] = true

local targetScore = getFertilizerTargetScore(origin, normalizedTarget)
if targetScore and (not bestScore or targetScore < bestScore) then
bestTarget = normalizedTarget
bestScore = targetScore
end
end

return bestTarget
end

function FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizerToSeed(seed)
if not FS_Utils.IsSeedEntity(seed) then
return 4
end

if seed:GetDTBool(4) then
return 3
end

local state = seed:GetDTInt(1)
if state ~= 1 then
return 2
end

local remainingTime = math.max(seed:GetDTInt(2), 1)
seed:SetDTInt(2, math.max(math.ceil(remainingTime * 0.5), 1))
seed:SetDTBool(4, true)
seed.fsNextStageUpdate = CurTime() + FS_Utils.SlowThinkInterval
return 1
end

function FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizerToDirtPatch(dirtPatch)
if not FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(dirtPatch) then
return 4
end

local eligibleSeeds = {}
local hasSeed = false
local hasUnfertilizedSeed = false

for _, seed in pairs(dirtPatch.fsSeedSlots or {}) do
if IsValid(seed) and seed.fsDirtPatch == dirtPatch then
hasSeed = true
if not seed:GetDTBool(4) then
hasUnfertilizedSeed = true
end

local state = seed:GetDTInt(1)
if not seed:GetDTBool(4) and state == 1 then
table.insert(eligibleSeeds, seed)
end
end
end

if #eligibleSeeds > 0 then
for _, seed in ipairs(eligibleSeeds) do
FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizerToSeed(seed)
end
return 1, #eligibleSeeds
end

if hasSeed and hasUnfertilizedSeed then
return 2, 0
end

if hasSeed then
return 3, 0
end

return 4, 0
end

function FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizer(target)
if FS_Utils.IsSeedEntity(target) then
local result = FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizerToSeed(target)
return result, result == 1 and 1 or 0
end

if FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(target) then
return FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizerToDirtPatch(target)
end

return 4, 0
end

function FS_Utils.HarvestSeed(seed, activator, options)
local config = FS_Utils.GetSeedLifecycleConfig(seed)
if not config or seed:GetDTInt(1) ~= 2 then
return false
end

options = options or {}
local dirtPatch = seed.fsDirtPatch

local harvestCount = FS_Utils.GetSeedHarvestAmount(seed)
if harvestCount <= 0 then
return false
end

local basePosition = select(1, FS_Utils.GetSeedWorldTransform(seed)) or seed:GetPos()
local spawnOrigin = basePosition + Vector(0, 0, 24)
local groundDropBudget = math.max(FS_Utils.MaxGroundHarvestDrops - FS_Utils.CountGroundHarvestDrops(), 0)
local forceAutoCollect = options.forceAutoCollect == true

for index = 1, harvestCount do
local childSpawnPosition = spawnOrigin + Vector(math.Rand(-8, 8), math.Rand(-8, 8), index * 2)
local childAngles = config.produceAngles and config.produceAngles(seed, index) or Angle(0, math.random(0, 360), 0)
if forceAutoCollect and config.autoHarvest and config.autoHarvest(seed, activator, index, childSpawnPosition, childAngles, options) then
continue
end

if forceAutoCollect and config.produceClass and FS_Utils.TryAutoCollectHarvestItem(activator, config.produceClass) then
continue
end

if config.produceClass and groundDropBudget <= 0 and FS_Utils.TryAutoCollectHarvestItem(activator, config.produceClass) then
continue
end

local itemDefinition = config.produceClass and getHarvestInventoryItemData(config.produceClass) or nil
local worldDropClass = itemDefinition and itemDefinition.worldDropClass or config.produceClass
local shouldUseInventoryDrop = not (itemDefinition and itemDefinition.spawnWorldEntity == true)
local child = config.produceSpawner and config.produceSpawner(seed, childSpawnPosition, index, activator)
if not IsValid(child) and config.produceClass and shouldUseInventoryDrop then
child = FS_Utils.SpawnHarvestInventoryDrop(config.produceClass, childSpawnPosition, childAngles)
end
if not IsValid(child) and worldDropClass then
child = ents.Create(worldDropClass)
end
if IsValid(child) then
child:SetAngles(childAngles)
if not config.produceSpawner and child:GetClass() != "cis_inv_item" then
child:SetPos(childSpawnPosition)
child:Spawn()
applyHarvestDropAppearance(child, config.produceClass)
end
registerGroundHarvestDrop(child)
if child:GetClass() == "cis_inv_item" then
groundDropBudget = math.max(groundDropBudget - 1, 0)
elseif harvestInventoryItems[child:GetClass()] then
groundDropBudget = math.max(groundDropBudget - 1, 0)
end
FS_Utils.SetPhysicsMotion(child, true, (seed:GetUp() * math.random(18, 36)) + (VectorRand() * 18) + ((IsValid(activator) and activator:GetForward() or zeroVector) * math.random(8, 18)))
end
end

awardCropHarvestJobXP(activator, seed, harvestCount, options)
FS_Utils.CreateShake(seed:GetPos())
seed:EmitSound("physics/body/body_medium_impact_hard" .. math.random(1, 6) .. ".wav")
seed:SetDTBool(4, false)
seed:Remove()
if IsValid(dirtPatch) then
FS_Utils.WakeOwnedAutoFarms(dirtPatch:GetNWString("FSOwnerSteamID64", ""), dirtPatch:GetPos())
end
return true
end

function FS_Utils.HandleSeedUse(seed, activator)
if not IsValid(seed) or not IsValid(activator) then
return false
end

local currentTime = CurTime()
if seed.nextUse and currentTime < seed.nextUse then
return false
end

if not FS_Utils.CanPlayerUseEntity(activator, seed) then
return false
end

local state = seed:GetDTInt(1)
local handled = false
if state == 0 and seed:GetDTBool(3) then
handled = FS_Utils.StartSeedGrowth(seed)
elseif state == 2 then
handled = FS_Utils.HarvestSeed(seed, activator)
end

if handled then
seed.nextUse = currentTime + 0.5
end

return handled
end

function FS_Utils.RunSeedLifecycle(seed)
local state = seed:GetDTInt(1)

if state == 0 then
seed:SetDTBool(3, FS_Utils.IsSeedPlantable(seed))
else
seed:SetDTBool(3, false)
end

if not IsValid(seed.fsDirtPatch)
and not (seed.IsPlayerHolding and seed:IsPlayerHolding())
and (state == 0 or state == 1) then
FS_Utils.WakeNearbyDirtPatches(seed:GetPos())
end

if state ~= 0 and (not seed.fsNextStageUpdate or CurTime() >= seed.fsNextStageUpdate) then
if state == 1 then
if seed:GetDTInt(2) > 0 then
seed:SetDTInt(2, seed:GetDTInt(2) - 1)
elseif seed:GetDTInt(2) == 0 then
FS_Utils.MakeSeedReadyToHarvest(seed)
end
end

seed.fsNextStageUpdate = CurTime() + FS_Utils.SlowThinkInterval
end

seed:NextThink(CurTime() + FS_Utils.GetSeedThinkDelay(seed:GetDTInt(1)))
return true
end

function FS_Utils.IsPlantableEntity(entity)
return isPlantableEntity(entity)
end

function FS_Utils.IsPlantableTrace(trace, seed)
if not trace or not trace.Hit or trace.HitSky or trace.HitNormal.z < 0.55 then
return false
end

local hitEntity = trace.Entity
if isPlantableEntity(hitEntity) then
if not IsValid(seed) or not hitEntity.CanAcceptSeed then
return true
end

return hitEntity:CanAcceptSeed(seed)
end

if IsValid(hitEntity) and not trace.HitWorld then
return false
end

if trace.HitNoDraw then
return false
end

if isPlantableTextureName(trace.HitTexture) then
return true
end

if isPlantableTextureName(getTraceSurfacePropName(trace)) then
return true
end

if plantableMaterialTypes[trace.MatType] then
return true
end

return false
end

function FS_Utils.GetTouchingWorldTexture(seed)
local trace = getSeedGroundTrace(seed)
if not trace then
return "", nil
end

local textureName = trace.HitTexture or ""
if textureName == "" and isPlantableEntity(trace.Entity) then
textureName = trace.Entity:GetClass()
end
if textureName == "" then
textureName = getTraceSurfacePropName(trace)
end

return textureName, trace
end

function FS_Utils.IsSeedPlantable(seed)
if not IsValid(seed) then
return false
end

local _, trace = FS_Utils.GetTouchingWorldTexture(seed)
if not trace then
return false
end

return FS_Utils.IsPlantableTrace(trace, seed)
end

function FS_Utils.GetSeedThinkDelay(state)
if state == 0 then
return FS_Utils.SeedGroundCheckInterval
end

return FS_Utils.SlowThinkInterval
end

function FS_Utils.WakeNearbyDirtPatches(origin, radius)
if not isvector(origin) then
return 0
end
local wakeRadius = math.max(tonumber(radius) or FS_Utils.DirtPatchWakeRadius or 144, 1)
local wokenPatchCount = 0
for _, entity in ipairs(ents.FindInSphere(origin, wakeRadius)) do
if FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) and entity.RequestManagementCheck then
entity:RequestManagementCheck(true)
wokenPatchCount = wokenPatchCount + 1
end
end

return wokenPatchCount
end

function FS_Utils.WakeOwnedAutoFarms(ownerOrIdentifier, origin, radius)
local ownerIdentifier = isstring(ownerOrIdentifier) and ownerOrIdentifier or getPlayerIdentifier(ownerOrIdentifier)
if ownerIdentifier == "" then
return 0
end

local ownedAutoFarms = ownedAutoFarmsByOwnerId[ownerIdentifier]
if not ownedAutoFarms then
for _, entity in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("fs_auto_farm")) do
if IsValid(entity) and entity:GetNWString("FSOwnerSteamID64", "") == ownerIdentifier then
registerOwnedAutoFarm(entity, ownerIdentifier)
end
end
ownedAutoFarms = ownedAutoFarmsByOwnerId[ownerIdentifier]
if not ownedAutoFarms then
return 0
end
end

local wakeRadius = math.max(tonumber(radius) or tonumber(FS_AutoFarm_LinkRange) or 384, 1)
local wakeRadiusSqr = wakeRadius * wakeRadius
local shouldCheckDistance = isvector(origin)
local wokenAutoFarmCount = 0
for entityIndex, entity in pairs(ownedAutoFarms) do
if IsValid(entity) then
if entity.RequestAutomationCheck and (not shouldCheckDistance or entity:GetPos():DistToSqr(origin) <= wakeRadiusSqr) then
registerOwnedAutoFarm(entity, ownerIdentifier)
entity:RequestAutomationCheck(true)
wokenAutoFarmCount = wokenAutoFarmCount + 1
end
else
ownedAutoFarms[entityIndex] = nil
end
end

if not next(ownedAutoFarms) then
ownedAutoFarmsByOwnerId[ownerIdentifier] = nil
end

return wokenAutoFarmCount
end

function FS_Utils.ProcessOwnedAutoFarmsForPatch(dirtPatch)
if not FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(dirtPatch) then
return 0
end

local ownerIdentifier = dirtPatch:GetNWString("FSOwnerSteamID64", "")
if ownerIdentifier == "" then
return 0
end

local autoFarmCandidates = FS_Utils.GetOwnedAutoFarms(ownerIdentifier)
if #autoFarmCandidates <= 0 then
for _, entity in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("fs_auto_farm")) do
if IsValid(entity) and entity:GetNWString("FSOwnerSteamID64", "") == ownerIdentifier then
registerOwnedAutoFarm(entity, ownerIdentifier)
autoFarmCandidates[#autoFarmCandidates + 1] = entity
end
end
end

local linkRange = math.max(tonumber(FS_AutoFarm_LinkRange) or 384, 1)
local linkRangeSqr = linkRange * linkRange
local dirtPatchPosition = dirtPatch:GetPos()
local processedAutoFarmCount = 0
for _, autoFarm in ipairs(autoFarmCandidates) do
if IsValid(autoFarm)
and autoFarm.GetNWBool
and autoFarm.ProcessAutomationCycle
and autoFarm:GetNWBool("FSAutoFarmActive", false)
and autoFarm:GetPos():DistToSqr(dirtPatchPosition) <= linkRangeSqr then
autoFarm:ProcessAutomationCycle()
processedAutoFarmCount = processedAutoFarmCount + 1
end
end

if processedAutoFarmCount <= 0 then
FS_Utils.WakeOwnedAutoFarms(ownerIdentifier, dirtPatchPosition, linkRange)
end

return processedAutoFarmCount
end

function FS_Utils.IsAutoFarmEntity(entity)
return IsValid(entity) and entity:GetClass() == "fs_auto_farm"
end

function FS_Utils.GetDamageProfile(entity)
if FS_Utils.IsSeedEntity(entity) then
return FS_Utils.SeedMaxHealth, FS_Utils.SeedRegenAmount
end

if FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) then
return FS_Utils.DirtPatchMaxHealth, FS_Utils.DirtPatchRegenAmount
end

if FS_Utils.IsAutoFarmEntity(entity) then
return math.max(math.floor(tonumber(FS_AutoFarm_Health) or 500), 1), math.max(math.floor(tonumber(FS_AutoFarm_RegenAmount) or 10), 0)
end

return nil, nil
end

function FS_Utils.DetachFromParent(entity)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return false
end

local parentEntity = entity:GetParent()
if not IsValid(parentEntity) then
return false
end

local worldPosition, worldAngles = LocalToWorld(entity:GetLocalPos(), entity:GetLocalAngles(), parentEntity:GetPos(), parentEntity:GetAngles())
entity:SetParent(nil)
entity:SetPos(worldPosition)
entity:SetAngles(worldAngles)
return true
end

function FS_Utils.RegisterTrackedDamageEntity(entity)
local maxHealth, regenAmount = FS_Utils.GetDamageProfile(entity)
if not maxHealth then
return false
end

local currentHealth = entity:Health()
entity.fsDamageMaxHealth = maxHealth
entity.fsDamageRegenAmount = regenAmount
entity:SetMaxHealth(maxHealth)
if currentHealth <= 0 or currentHealth > maxHealth or not entity.fsDamageTrackingRegistered then
entity:SetHealth(maxHealth)
else
entity:SetHealth(currentHealth)
end

trackedDamageEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = entity
if entity.fsDamageNextRegenAt and entity:Health() > 0 and entity:Health() < maxHealth then
damageRegenEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = entity
else
damageRegenEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = nil
end
if FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) and (entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove or entity.fsDirtPatchHeld or entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil) then
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = entity
end
if not entity.fsDamageTrackingRegistered then
entity.fsDamageTrackingRegistered = true
entity:CallOnRemove("fs_damage_track_" .. entity:EntIndex(), function(removedEntity)
local entityIndex = removedEntity:EntIndex()
trackedDamageEntities[entityIndex] = nil
damageRegenEntities[entityIndex] = nil
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entityIndex] = nil
end)
end

return true
end

function FS_Utils.StopPhysicsMotion(entity)
local physicsObject = getPhysicsObject(entity)
if not physicsObject then
return false
end

if physicsObject.SetVelocityInstantaneous then
physicsObject:SetVelocityInstantaneous(zeroVector)
else
physicsObject:SetVelocity(zeroVector)
end

if physicsObject.GetAngleVelocity and physicsObject.AddAngleVelocity then
local angleVelocity = physicsObject:GetAngleVelocity()
if angleVelocity then
physicsObject:AddAngleVelocity(angleVelocity * -1)
end
end

return true
end

function FS_Utils.SetDirtPatchCarryState(entity, canMove)
if not FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) then
return false
end

entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove = canMove == true
FS_Utils.SetPhysicsMotion(entity, entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove)
if not entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove then
FS_Utils.StopPhysicsMotion(entity)
end
if entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove or entity.fsDirtPatchHeld or entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil then
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = entity
else
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = nil
end
if entity.RequestManagementCheck then
entity:RequestManagementCheck(true)
end
if not entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove then
FS_Utils.WakeOwnedAutoFarms(entity:GetNWString("FSOwnerSteamID64", ""), entity:GetPos())
end

return true
end

function FS_Utils.PrimeDirtPatchForCarry(entity)
if not FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) then
return false
end

entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil = CurTime() + 0.1
return FS_Utils.SetDirtPatchCarryState(entity, true)
end

function FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchReadyToFreeze(entity)
if not FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) then
return false
end

local physicsObject = FS_Utils.GetPhysicsObject(entity)
if not physicsObject then
return false
end

local velocity = physicsObject:GetVelocity()
if velocity:LengthSqr() > (FS_Utils.DirtPatchFreezeSpeedThreshold * FS_Utils.DirtPatchFreezeSpeedThreshold) then
return false
end

local angleVelocity = physicsObject:GetAngleVelocity()
if angleVelocity:LengthSqr() > (FS_Utils.DirtPatchFreezeAngleSpeedThreshold * FS_Utils.DirtPatchFreezeAngleSpeedThreshold) then
return false
end

if entity:GetUp().z < FS_Utils.DirtPatchFreezeFlatNormalThreshold then
return false
end

local mins, maxs = entity:OBBMins(), entity:OBBMaxs()
local trace = util.TraceHull({
start = entity:GetPos() + Vector(0, 0, 4),
endpos = entity:GetPos() + Vector(0, 0, -10),
mins = Vector(mins.x * 0.7, mins.y * 0.7, mins.z),
maxs = Vector(maxs.x * 0.7, maxs.y * 0.7, math.min(mins.z + 4, maxs.z)),
filter = entity,
mask = MASK_SOLID
})

return trace.Hit and not trace.HitSky and trace.HitNormal.z >= FS_Utils.DirtPatchFreezeFlatNormalThreshold
end

function FS_Utils.UpdateDirtPatchCarryState(entity, currentTime)
if not FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) then
return
end

if entity.fsDirtPatchHeld then
return
end

if entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil and currentTime < entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil then
return
end

if entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove and not FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchReadyToFreeze(entity) then
return
end

entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil = nil
if entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove then
FS_Utils.SetDirtPatchCarryState(entity, false)
end
if entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove or entity.fsDirtPatchHeld or entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil then
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = entity
else
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = nil
end
end

function FS_Utils.DestroySeed(seed)
if not IsValid(seed) then
return false
end

local dirtPatch = seed.fsDirtPatch
local dirtPatchSlot = seed.fsDirtPatchSlot
if IsValid(dirtPatch) and dirtPatch.ClearSeedSlot then
dirtPatch:ClearSeedSlot(dirtPatchSlot, seed)
if dirtPatch.CleanupSeedSlots then
dirtPatch:CleanupSeedSlots()
end
end

if seed.VisualEffect then
seed:VisualEffect()
end
FS_Utils.ReleaseSeedChildren(seed)
seed:EmitSound("physics/body/body_medium_break" .. math.random(2, 4) .. ".wav")
seed:Remove()
return true
end

entity:Remove()
return true
end

function FS_Utils.ApplyTrackedDamage(entity, dmginfo)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return false
end

if not entity.fsDamageMaxHealth then
if not FS_Utils.RegisterTrackedDamageEntity(entity) then
return false
end
end

if entity.TakePhysicsDamage then
entity:TakePhysicsDamage(dmginfo)
end

local damageAmount = math.max(math.ceil(dmginfo:GetDamage()), 0)
if damageAmount <= 0 then
return true
end

entity:SetHealth(math.max(entity:Health() - damageAmount, 0))
entity.fsDamageNextRegenAt = CurTime() + FS_Utils.DamageRegenDelay
damageRegenEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = entity
if entity:Health() > 0 then
return true
end

if FS_Utils.IsSeedEntity(entity) then
return FS_Utils.DestroySeed(entity)
end

if FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) then
return FS_Utils.DestroyDirtPatch(entity)
end

if FS_Utils.IsAutoFarmEntity(entity) then
return FS_Utils.DestroyAutoFarm(entity)
end

return true
end

function FS_Utils.TickTrackedDamageRegen(currentTime)
for entityIndex, entity in pairs(damageRegenEntities) do
if not IsValid(entity) then
damageRegenEntities[entityIndex] = nil
elseif not entity.fsDamageMaxHealth
or not entity.fsDamageRegenAmount
or entity:Health() <= 0
or entity:Health() >= entity.fsDamageMaxHealth
or not entity.fsDamageNextRegenAt then
damageRegenEntities[entityIndex] = nil
else
if currentTime >= entity.fsDamageNextRegenAt then
entity:SetHealth(math.min(entity:Health() + entity.fsDamageRegenAmount, entity.fsDamageMaxHealth))
if entity:Health() < entity.fsDamageMaxHealth then
entity.fsDamageNextRegenAt = currentTime + FS_Utils.DamageRegenInterval
else
entity.fsDamageNextRegenAt = nil
damageRegenEntities[entityIndex] = nil
end
end
end
end
end

function FS_Utils.TickDirtPatchCarryEntities(currentTime)
for entityIndex, entity in pairs(dirtPatchCarryEntities) do
if not IsValid(entity) then
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entityIndex] = nil
else
FS_Utils.UpdateDirtPatchCarryState(entity, currentTime)
if not entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove and not entity.fsDirtPatchHeld and not entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil then
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entityIndex] = nil
end
end
end
end

function FS_Utils.TickTrackedDamageEntities(currentTime, shouldProcessRegen)
FS_Utils.TickDirtPatchCarryEntities(currentTime)
if shouldProcessRegen then
FS_Utils.TickTrackedDamageRegen(currentTime)
end
end

return false
end

return className == "fs_dirt_patch" or className == "fs_auto_farm"
end

local function assignOwnedFarmEntity(player, entity)
if not IsValid(player) or not player:IsPlayer() or not isOwnedFarmUtilityEntity(entity) then
return false
end

if not IsValid(player) or not player:IsPlayer() or not IsValid(entity) then
return
end

FS_Utils.SetEntityOwner(entity, player)
end)

return true
end

local function assignOwnedFarmEntityFromVarArgs(player, ...)
if not IsValid(player) or not player:IsPlayer() then
return false
end

for argumentIndex = 1, select("#", ...) do
local value = select(argumentIndex, ...)
if isOwnedFarmUtilityEntity(value) then
return assignOwnedFarmEntity(player, value)
end
end

return false
end

local function finishSeedGrowth(seed)
if not FS_Utils.IsSeedEntity(seed) then
return false
end

local state = seed:GetDTInt(1)
if state == 0 then
if not FS_Utils.StartSeedGrowth(seed) then
return false
end

state = seed:GetDTInt(1)
end

if state == 1 then
return FS_Utils.MakeSeedReadyToHarvest(seed)
end

return state == 2
end

local function LoadFiles()
local allFiles = file.Find("cutta_inventory_system/*.lua", "LUA")
local sv_files = {}

local shared_files = {}

local known_shared_files = {

}

shared_files[#shared_files + 1] = d
else
local first3 = string.sub(d, 1, 3)
if first3 == "sv_" then
sv_files[#sv_files + 1] = d
elseif first3 == "cl_" then
cl_files[#cl_files + 1] = d
end
end

function cutta_inventory_system:Player_TradeOfferFromUI(securitycode)
if not cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"] then return end
local frame = cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"]

local activeCode = tostring(frame.PanelSecurityCode or "")
local code = tostring(securitycode or "")
if code == "" then
code = activeCode
end

-- If caller passed a stale/wrong code, prefer the active trade code.
if activeCode ~= "" and code ~= activeCode then
code = activeCode
end

if activeCode ~= "" and code ~= activeCode then return end

local offer = {}
if frame.plyinventory_layout and IsValid(frame.plyinventory_layout) then
for _,itemPanel in ipairs(frame.plyinventory_layout:GetChildren()) do
if itemPanel.IsSelected and itemPanel.ItemClass and isstring(itemPanel.ItemClass) then
if cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxTradableItems"] and #offer >= cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxTradableItems"] then
break
end
table.insert(offer, itemPanel.ItemClass)
end
end
end

print("[CIS DEBUG] Player_TradeOfferFromUI - Offer:", table.ToString(offer))

-- Instant local UI feedback: update "Your Offer" immediately.
frame.myAccepted = false
frame.otherAccepted = false
if frame.plytrade_list and IsValid(frame.plytrade_list) then
CIS_PopulateOfferLayout(frame.plytrade_list, offer)
end

cutta_inventory_system:Player_TradeOfferUpdate(code, offer)
end

function cutta_inventory_system:Player_TradeStateUpdate(securitycode, state)
if not cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"] then return end
local frame = cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"]
if frame.PanelSecurityCode ~= securitycode then return end
if not istable(state) then return end

local myid = LocalPlayer():AccountID()
local myid_str = tostring(myid)

local my = state[myid] or state[myid_str] or {}
local other = {}

for k,v in pairs(state) do
if tostring(k) ~= myid_str then
other = v
break
end
end

frame.myAccepted = tobool(my.accepted)
frame.otherAccepted = tobool(other.accepted)

if frame.plytrade_list and IsValid(frame.plytrade_list) then
CIS_PopulateOfferLayout(frame.plytrade_list, my.offer or {})
end

if frame.othertrade_list and IsValid(frame.othertrade_list) then
CIS_PopulateOfferLayout(frame.othertrade_list, other.offer or {})
end
end

local function CIS_CardIsVisibleInScroll(card, scroll)

if not IsValid(card) or not IsValid(scroll) then return false end

local _, cardY = card:LocalToScreen(0, 0)

local _, scrollY = scroll:LocalToScreen(0, 0)

local scrollH = scroll:GetTall()

local cardH = card:GetTall()

return (cardY + cardH) > scrollY and cardY < (scrollY + scrollH)

end

local function CIS_ProcessMerchantLazyModels(scroll, layout)

if not IsValid(scroll) or not IsValid(layout) then return end

local loaded = 0

local maxPerFrame = 4

for _, child in ipairs(layout:GetChildren()) do

if not IsValid(child) then continue end

if child.CIS_ModelLoaded or not child.CIS_PendingModel then continue end

if not CIS_CardIsVisibleInScroll(child, scroll) then continue end

child.CIS_ModelLoaded = true

local modelPanel = vgui.Create("DModelPanel", child)

modelPanel:SetPos(10, 34)

modelPanel:SetSize(138, 92)

modelPanel:SetZPos(-1)

cutta_inventory_system:SetupPreviewModel(modelPanel, child.CIS_PendingModel, 0.82)

child.CIS_PendingModel = nil

loaded = loaded + 1

if loaded >= maxPerFrame then break end

end

return loaded

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Player_CanClick()

local ply = LocalPlayer()

if not IsValid(ply) then return false end

-- Treat nil as not-loading so menus still work if the flag was never initialized.

if ply.CUTTAINVENTORYSYSTEM_LOADING ~= true then

ply.CUTTAINVENTORYSYSTEM_LOADING_STARTED = nil

return true

end

-- Failsafe: if a transfer never comes back, do not permanently lock interactions.

ply.CUTTAINVENTORYSYSTEM_LOADING_STARTED = ply.CUTTAINVENTORYSYSTEM_LOADING_STARTED or CurTime()

if (CurTime() - ply.CUTTAINVENTORYSYSTEM_LOADING_STARTED) > 6 then

ply.CUTTAINVENTORYSYSTEM_LOADING = false

ply.CUTTAINVENTORYSYSTEM_LOADING_STARTED = nil

return true

end

return false

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Player_SecurityCode()

local randomchars = {"q","w","e","r","t","y","u","i","o",

"p","a","s","d","f","g","h","j","k","l",

"z","x","c","v","b","n","m"}

local rnd1 = math.random(1,99)

local rnd2 = math.random(1,99)

local rnd3 = table.Random(randomchars)

local rnd4 = table.Random(randomchars)

local RandomId1 = tostring(rnd1..""..rnd2..""..rnd3..""..rnd4)

local RandomId2 = tostring(rnd2..""..rnd3..""..rnd4..""..rnd1)

local RandomId3 = tostring(rnd3..""..rnd4..""..rnd1..""..rnd2)

local RandomId4 = tostring(rnd4..""..rnd1..""..rnd2..""..rnd3)

local RandomId5 = tostring(rnd3..""..rnd1..""..rnd4..""..rnd2)

local RandomId6 = tostring(rnd1..""..rnd3..""..rnd2..""..rnd4)

local chance = math.random(1,6)

if chance == 1 then

return RandomId1

elseif chance == 2 then

return RandomId2

elseif chance == 3 then

return RandomId3

elseif chance == 4 then

return RandomId4

elseif chance == 5 then

return RandomId5

elseif chance == 6 then

return RandomId6

end

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(slot)

if isstring(slot) then

return slot != "" and slot or nil

end

if not istable(slot) then return nil end

local class = slot.Class or slot.class

if not isstring(class) or class == "" then return nil end

return class

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(slot)

local class = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(slot)

if not class then return 0 end

if isstring(slot) then return 1 end

local amount = math.floor(tonumber(slot.Amount or slot.amount or 1) or 1)

return math.max(amount, 1)

end

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Count_InventoryOccupiedSlots(tbl)

local count = 0

for key, slot in pairs(tbl or {}) do

if not isnumber(key) then continue end

if cutta_inventory_system:InventorySlot_HasItem(slot) then

count = count + 1

end

end

return count

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerInvCapacity(ply)

local baseSlots = tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["StartingInventorySize"] or 0) or 0

local maxSlots = tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxInventorySize"] or baseSlots) or baseSlots

if not IsValid(ply) or not ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] then

return math.min(baseSlots, maxSlots)

end

local upgrades = ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Upgrades"] or {}

local extraSlots = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(upgrades["InventoryUpg"] or 0) or 0), 0)

return math.min(maxSlots, baseSlots + extraSlots)

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerInvFull(ply)

if not IsValid(ply) then return true end

if not ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] then return true end

local inv = ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["InventoryLayout"] or ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Inventory"] or {}

return cutta_inventory_system:Count_InventoryOccupiedSlots(inv) >= cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerInvCapacity(ply)

end

local function CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep)

if not IsValid(wep) then return false end

if wep.ArcticTacRP then return true end

local base = wep.Base

if isstring(base) and string.find(string.lower(base), "tacrp", 1, true) then return true end

return false

end

local function CUTTINVSYS_IsTFAWeapon(wep)

if not IsValid(wep) then return false end

if wep.IsTFAWeapon or wep.TFAWeapon then return true end

local base = wep.Base

if isstring(base) and (string.find(string.lower(base), "tfa_", 1, true) or string.find(string.lower(base), "tfa", 1, true)) then return true end

return false

end

local function CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(ply, wep, key)

if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return 0 end

if not IsValid(wep) then return 0 end

if not ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] then return 0 end

local upg = ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Upgrades"]

if not upg or not upg["Guns"] then return 0 end

local wepUpg = upg["Guns"][wep:GetClass()]

if not wepUpg then return 0 end

return tonumber(wepUpg[key] or 0) or 0

end

-- TacRP integration:

-- TacRP computes weapon stats via SWEP:GetValue() and allows modification through hook.Run("TacRP_Stat_" .. stat).

-- We apply Cutta inventory upgrades there so stats update correctly without fighting TacRP's cache.

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_Damage_Max", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_DamageMax", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local pwr = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Damage")

if pwr <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + pwr

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_Damage_Min", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_DamageMin", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local pwr = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Damage")

if pwr <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + pwr

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_ClipSize", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_ClipSize", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local clip = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "ClipSize")

if clip <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + clip

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_RPM", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_RPM", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local rpmUpg = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "RPM")

if rpmUpg <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + (rpmUpg * 5)

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_Spread", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_Accuracy", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local acc = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Accuracy")

if acc <= 0 then return end

-- TacRP uses very small spread values (e.g., ~0.004), so use a smaller scaling than the legacy StatCache path.

data.add = (data.add or 0) - (acc * 0.0002)

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_RecoilKick", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_Recoil", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local rec = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Recoil")

if rec <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) - (rec * 0.05)

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_ReloadTimeMult", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_Reload", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local res = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "ReloadSpeed")

if res <= 0 then return end

-- Lower ReloadTimeMult = faster reload.

local mult = math.Clamp(1 - (res * 0.05), 0.5, 1)

data.mul = (data.mul or 1) * mult

end)

local weaponsnewtable = weaponclass:GetTable()

if (weaponsnewtable == nil or weaponsnewtable == NULL) then return end

if (weaponsnewtable.ClipSize == -1) then return end

if weaponsnewtable.Primary then

if (weaponsnewtable.Primary.ClipSize == -1) then return end

local CIS_PLAYER_LOAD_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES = 16000

local function CIS_SendPlayerLoadCompressedChunks(ply, compressedData)
if not IsValid(ply) or not isstring(compressedData) or #compressedData == 0 then return end

local maxChunkSize = CIS_PLAYER_LOAD_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES
local totalSize = #compressedData
local totalChunks = math.ceil(totalSize / maxChunkSize)

local function sendChunk(chunkIndex)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
local startIndex = (chunkIndex - 1) * maxChunkSize + 1
local endIndex = math.min(totalSize, startIndex + maxChunkSize - 1)
local part = string.sub(compressedData, startIndex, endIndex)

if isstring(part) and #part > 0 then
net.Start(cutta_inventory_system["StringName"].."Player_Load_CL_Chunk")
net.WriteUInt(totalChunks, 16)
net.WriteUInt(chunkIndex, 16)
net.WriteUInt(totalSize, 32)
net.WriteUInt(#part, 16)
net.WriteData(part, #part)
net.Send(ply)
end

if chunkIndex < totalChunks then
timer.Simple(0, function()
sendChunk(chunkIndex + 1)
end)
end
end

sendChunk(1)
end

function cutta_inventory_system:Player_SaveData(ply, skipNet)

if not ply or not ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] then return end

if cutta_inventory_system.Inventory_SyncLayoutFromRaw then

cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_SyncLayoutFromRaw(ply)

end

local sanitizedData = cutta_inventory_system:SanitizeForJSON(ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]])

local json = util.TableToJSON(sanitizedData)

if not json then

if IsValid(ply) then

print("[Cutta Inventory System] Error: Failed to convert player data to JSON for " .. ply:Nick())

end

return

end

if not skipNet and IsValid(ply) then

local compressed = util.Compress(json)

if not compressed then

print("[Cutta Inventory System] Error: Failed to compress player data for " .. ply:Nick())

return

end

if #compressed <= CIS_PLAYER_LOAD_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES then
net.Start(cutta_inventory_system["StringName"].."Player_Load_CL")
net.WriteUInt(#compressed, 32) -- send the size
net.WriteData(compressed, #compressed)
net.Send(ply)
else
CIS_SendPlayerLoadCompressedChunks(ply, compressed)
end

end

file.Write("cutta_inventory_system/"..tostring(ply:AccountID())..".json", json)

end
