function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_RebuildRawFromLayout(ply)

local data = CIS_GetInventoryPlayerData(ply)

if not data then return end

local rawInventory = {}

for _, slot in ipairs(data["InventoryLayout"] or {}) do

local class = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(slot)

local amount = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(slot)

if class and cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class] then

for _ = 1, amount do

rawInventory[#rawInventory + 1] = class

end

end

end

data["Inventory"] = rawInventory

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_SyncLayoutFromRaw(ply)

local data = CIS_GetInventoryPlayerData(ply)

if not data then return end

local rawInventory = data["Inventory"] or {}

local currentLayout = istable(data["InventoryLayout"]) and data["InventoryLayout"] or {}

local rawCounts = {}

for _, class in ipairs(rawInventory) do

if isstring(class) and cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class] then

rawCounts[class] = (rawCounts[class] or 0) + 1

end

end

if table.IsEmpty(currentLayout) then

local rebuiltLayout = {}

local maxSlots = 0
if isfunction(cutta_inventory_system.Get_PlayerInvCapacity) then
maxSlots = math.max(cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerInvCapacity(ply), 0)
else
maxSlots = math.max(tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxInventorySize"] or cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["StartingInventorySize"] or 0) or 0, 0)
end

for _, class in ipairs(rawInventory) do

if not isstring(class) or not cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class] then continue end

local stackIndex = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_FindFirstSlotByClass(rebuiltLayout, class)

if stackIndex then

rebuiltLayout[stackIndex].Amount = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(rebuiltLayout[stackIndex]) + 1

else

local emptyIndex = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_FindFirstEmptySlot(rebuiltLayout, math.max(maxSlots, #rebuiltLayout + 1)) or (#rebuiltLayout + 1)

rebuiltLayout[emptyIndex] = {

Class = class,

Amount = 1,

}

end

end

data["InventoryLayout"] = rebuiltLayout

return

end

local normalizedLayout = {}

local firstSlotForClass = {}

local layoutSize = math.max(#currentLayout, cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerInvCapacity(ply))

for index = 1, layoutSize do

local slot = currentLayout[index]

local class = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(slot)

if class and cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class] and (rawCounts[class] or 0) > 0 then

local amount = math.min(cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(slot), rawCounts[class])

normalizedLayout[index] = {

Class = class,

Amount = amount,

}

rawCounts[class] = rawCounts[class] - amount

firstSlotForClass[class] = firstSlotForClass[class] or index

else

normalizedLayout[index] = {}

end

end

for class, remaining in pairs(rawCounts) do

if remaining <= 0 then continue end

local existingIndex = firstSlotForClass[class]

if existingIndex then

normalizedLayout[existingIndex].Amount = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(normalizedLayout[existingIndex]) + remaining

else

local emptyIndex = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_FindFirstEmptySlot(normalizedLayout, math.max(layoutSize, #normalizedLayout + 1)) or (#normalizedLayout + 1)

normalizedLayout[emptyIndex] = {

Class = class,

Amount = remaining,

}

firstSlotForClass[class] = emptyIndex

end

end

data["InventoryLayout"] = normalizedLayout

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_GetSlotData(ply, index)

local data = CIS_GetInventoryPlayerData(ply)

if not data then return nil end

cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_SyncLayoutFromRaw(ply)

local slot = data["InventoryLayout"][index]

local class = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(slot)

if not class then return nil end

return slot, class, cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(slot), cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class]

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_AddItemToLayout(ply, class, amount)

local data = CIS_GetInventoryPlayerData(ply)

if not data then return false end

if not isstring(class) or class == "" then return false end

if not cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class] then return false end

amount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 1), 1)

cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_SyncLayoutFromRaw(ply)

local layout = data["InventoryLayout"]

local stackIndex = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_FindFirstSlotByClass(layout, class)

if stackIndex then

layout[stackIndex].Amount = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(layout[stackIndex]) + amount

cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_RebuildRawFromLayout(ply)

return true

end

local emptyIndex = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_FindFirstEmptySlot(layout, cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerInvCapacity(ply))

if not emptyIndex then return false end

layout[emptyIndex] = {

Class = class,

Amount = amount,

}

cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_RebuildRawFromLayout(ply)

return true

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_AddItemToTargetSlot(ply, class, amount, targetIndex)

local data = CIS_GetInventoryPlayerData(ply)
if not data then return false end
if not isstring(class) or class == "" then return false end
if not cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class] then return false end

amount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 1), 1)
targetIndex = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(targetIndex) or 0), 0)

if targetIndex <= 0 then

return cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_AddItemToLayout(ply, class, amount)

end

if targetIndex > cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerInvCapacity(ply) then return false end

cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_SyncLayoutFromRaw(ply)

local slot = data["InventoryLayout"][targetIndex]
local slotClass = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(slot)

if not slotClass then

data["InventoryLayout"][targetIndex] = {

Class = class,

Amount = amount,

}

elseif slotClass == class then

data["InventoryLayout"][targetIndex] = {

Class = class,

Amount = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(slot) + amount,

}

else

return false

end

cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_RebuildRawFromLayout(ply)
return true

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_RemoveSlotAmount(ply, index, amount)

local data = CIS_GetInventoryPlayerData(ply)

if not data then return false end

local slot, class, slotAmount, itemData = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_GetSlotData(ply, index)

if not slot or not itemData then return false end

amount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or slotAmount), 1)

local remaining = slotAmount - amount

if remaining > 0 then

data["InventoryLayout"][index] = {

Class = class,

Amount = remaining,

}

else

data["InventoryLayout"][index] = {}

end

cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_RebuildRawFromLayout(ply)

if itemData.Type == "weapon" and not cutta_inventory_system:Player_WeaponCheck(ply, itemData.Class) then

ply:StripWeapon(itemData.Class)

end

return true

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_MoveSlot(ply, fromIndex, toIndex)

local data = CIS_GetInventoryPlayerData(ply)

if not data then return false end

if fromIndex == toIndex then return false end

if fromIndex <= 0 or toIndex <= 0 then return false end

if toIndex > cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerInvCapacity(ply) then return false end

cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_SyncLayoutFromRaw(ply)

local fromSlot = data["InventoryLayout"][fromIndex]

if not cutta_inventory_system:InventorySlot_HasItem(fromSlot) then return false end

local toSlot = data["InventoryLayout"][toIndex]

local fromClass = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(fromSlot)

local toClass = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(toSlot)

if toClass and toClass == fromClass then

data["InventoryLayout"][toIndex] = {

Class = toClass,

Amount = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(toSlot) + cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(fromSlot),

}

data["InventoryLayout"][fromIndex] = {}

else

data["InventoryLayout"][fromIndex] = toSlot or {}

data["InventoryLayout"][toIndex] = fromSlot or {}

end

cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_RebuildRawFromLayout(ply)

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return true

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_SplitSlot(ply, index)

local data = CIS_GetInventoryPlayerData(ply)

if not data then return false end

local slot, class, amount = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_GetSlotData(ply, index)

if not slot or not class or amount < 2 then return false end

local emptyIndex = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_FindFirstEmptySlot(data["InventoryLayout"], cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerInvCapacity(ply))

if not emptyIndex then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply, "No free inventory slots")

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return false

end

local splitAmount = math.floor(amount * 0.5)

local keepAmount = amount - splitAmount

data["InventoryLayout"][index] = {

Class = class,

Amount = keepAmount,

}

data["InventoryLayout"][emptyIndex] = {

Class = class,

Amount = splitAmount,

}

cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_RebuildRawFromLayout(ply)

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return true

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_TrashSlot(ply, index)

local slot, class, amount = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_GetSlotData(ply, index)

if not slot or not class or amount <= 0 then return false end

cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_RemoveSlotAmount(ply, index, amount)

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return true

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_StoreSlot(ply, index, amount)

local slot, class, slotAmount, itemData = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_GetSlotData(ply, index)

if not slot or not class or slotAmount <= 0 or not itemData then return false end

amount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or slotAmount), 1)

amount = math.min(amount, slotAmount)

local storage = ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Storage"] or {}

local freeSlots = cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerStorageCapacity(ply) - table.Count(storage)

if freeSlots < amount then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply, "Not enough storage space")

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return false

end

for _ = 1, amount do

storage[#storage + 1] = class

end

ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Storage"] = storage

cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_RemoveSlotAmount(ply, index, amount)

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return true

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_FindSafeDropPosition(ply)

if not IsValid(ply) then return nil end

local mins = Vector(-12, -12, 0)

local maxs = Vector(12, 12, 24)

local origin = ply:GetShootPos()

local aim = ply:GetAimVector()

for _, distance in ipairs({40, 56, 72, 88}) do

local target = origin + (aim * distance)

local downTrace = util.TraceHull({

start = target + Vector(0, 0, 28),

endpos = target - Vector(0, 0, 192),

mins = mins,

maxs = maxs,

filter = ply,

mask = MASK_SOLID,

})

if downTrace.Hit then

local pos = downTrace.HitPos + Vector(0, 0, 8)

if util.IsInWorld(pos) then

local solidTrace = util.TraceHull({

start = pos,

endpos = pos,

mins = mins,

maxs = maxs,

filter = ply,

mask = MASK_SOLID,

})

if not solidTrace.StartSolid then

return pos

end

end

end

end

local fallback = ply:GetPos() + (ply:GetForward() * 32) + Vector(0, 0, 36)

if util.IsInWorld(fallback) then

local fallbackTrace = util.TraceHull({

start = fallback,

endpos = fallback,

mins = mins,

maxs = maxs,

filter = ply,

mask = MASK_SOLID,

})

if not fallbackTrace.StartSolid then

return fallback

end

end

return nil

end

local function CIS_GetInventoryAmmoGrant(itemData)

if not istable(itemData) then return nil end

local ammoType = nil
local ammoDefaults = cis_inventory_ammo_entity_defaults[itemData.Class or ""]

if isstring(itemData.AmmoType) and itemData.AmmoType != "" then

ammoType = itemData.AmmoType

elseif itemData.Type == "ammo" and isstring(itemData.Class) and itemData.Class != "" then

ammoType = itemData.Class

elseif ammoDefaults then

ammoType = ammoDefaults.AmmoType

end

if not isstring(ammoType) or ammoType == "" or game.GetAmmoID(ammoType) == -1 then

return nil

end

local ammoAmount = tonumber(itemData.AmmoAmount or itemData.UseAmount or itemData.Ammo or 0) or 0

if ammoAmount <= 0 and ammoDefaults then

ammoAmount = tonumber(ammoDefaults.AmmoAmount or 0) or 0

end

ammoAmount = math.max(math.floor(ammoAmount > 0 and ammoAmount or 1), 1)

return ammoType, ammoAmount

end

local function CIS_SpawnInventoryWorldEntity(ply, itemData, dropPos, placedEntity)

if not IsValid(ply) then return false end
if not istable(itemData) then return false end
if not isstring(itemData.Class) or itemData.Class == "" then return false end
if not isvector(dropPos) then return false end

local ent = ents.Create(itemData.Class)

if not IsValid(ent) then return false end

ent:SetPos(dropPos)
ent:SetAngles(Angle(0, ply:EyeAngles().y, 0))
ent.CIS_InventoryPlaced = placedEntity == true
ent:Spawn()

if cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["EnableItemAutouse"] then
timer.Simple(0, function()
if not IsValid(ent) then return false end
if not IsValid(ply) then return false end
ent:Use(ply, ply, USE_ON, 1)
end)
end

if ent.Activate then

ent:Activate()

end

local phys = ent:GetPhysicsObject()

if IsValid(phys) then

if placedEntity == true then

phys:Wake()

else

phys:SetVelocity((ply:GetAimVector() * 90) + Vector(0, 0, 30))

end

end

return true

end

if not ammoType then return nil end

ply:GiveAmmo(ammoAmount, ammoType, true)
ply:EmitSound("items/ammo_pickup.wav", 65, 105, 0.8, CHAN_ITEM)

end

end

end

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_DropSlot(ply, index)

function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_DropSlotAmount(ply, index, amount)

local slot, class, slotAmount = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_GetSlotData(ply, index)

if not slot or not class or slotAmount <= 0 then return false end

amount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or slotAmount), 1)
amount = math.min(amount, slotAmount)

if not cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_SpawnDroppedItem(ply, class, amount) then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return false

end

cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_RemoveSlotAmount(ply, index, amount)

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return true

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_UseSlot(ply, index)

local slot, itemclass, amount, itemData = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_GetSlotData(ply, index)

if not slot or not itemData then return false end

if itemData.Type == "weapon" then

if not ply:HasWeapon(itemclass) then

ply:Give(itemclass, true)

end

ply:SelectWeapon(itemclass)

return true

end

local usedAmmo = CIS_HandleInventoryAmmoUse(ply, itemData)

if usedAmmo == nil then

if not dropPos then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply, "No safe place to place this item")
cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return false

end

if not CIS_SpawnInventoryWorldEntity(ply, itemData, dropPos, true) then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return false

end

end

local function getProjectedInventorySlotUsage(ply, outgoingOffer, incomingOffer)

if not IsValid(ply) then return 0 end

if not ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] then return 0 end

local layout = ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["InventoryLayout"] or {}

local classAmounts = {}

local classSlots = {}

local usedSlots = 0

for _, slot in ipairs(layout) do

local class = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(slot)

if not class then continue end

usedSlots = usedSlots + 1

classAmounts[class] = (classAmounts[class] or 0) + cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(slot)

classSlots[class] = (classSlots[class] or 0) + 1

end

for class, amount in pairs(countItems(outgoingOffer)) do

local currentAmount = classAmounts[class] or 0

if currentAmount <= 0 then continue end

local remaining = math.max(currentAmount - amount, 0)

if remaining == 0 then

usedSlots = math.max(usedSlots - (classSlots[class] or 1), 0)

classAmounts[class] = nil

classSlots[class] = nil

else

classAmounts[class] = remaining

end

end

for class, amount in pairs(countItems(incomingOffer)) do

if amount <= 0 then continue end

if (classAmounts[class] or 0) > 0 then

classAmounts[class] = classAmounts[class] + amount

else

classAmounts[class] = amount

classSlots[class] = 1

usedSlots = usedSlots + 1

end

end

return usedSlots

end

local classAmounts = {}

end

local function CIS_GetInventoryAmmoGrant(itemData)
if not istable(itemData) then return nil end

local ammoType = nil
local ammoDefaults = cutta_inventory_system.Config["AmmoDefaults"]

if isstring(itemData.AmmoType) and itemData.AmmoType != "" then
ammoType = itemData.AmmoType
elseif itemData.Type == "ammo" and isstring(itemData.Class) and itemData.Class != "" then
ammoType = itemData.Class
elseif ammoDefaults then
ammoType = ammoDefaults.AmmoType
end

if not isstring(ammoType) or ammoType == "" or game.GetAmmoID(ammoType) == -1 then
return nil
end

local ammoAmount = tonumber(itemData.AmmoAmount or itemData.UseAmount or itemData.Ammo or 0) or 0
if ammoAmount <= 0 and ammoDefaults then
ammoAmount = tonumber(ammoDefaults.AmmoAmount or 0) or 0
end

ammoAmount = math.max(math.floor(ammoAmount > 0 and ammoAmount or 1), 1)
return ammoType, ammoAmount
end

Concepts - Conditional Flow Control
# If Statements
The "If" statement is a very common tool found in almost every programming language. This statement is a very basic, direct order to Lua. This can be really useful in creating your own scripts. "If" tells the code to do something if a condition is true or not. This is a simple if statement:

```

local age = 18
if age == 20 then
print("You're 20!")
end
```

The if statement can be a little confusing.

The local age = 18 part of this script sets a "Local" variable named age as 18. Local just means that the variable will only exist within the control structure. In this case the if statement.

The above example basically means "if age is equal to 20 then say 'You're 20!' and stop."

The if statement looks like this to Lua:

```

if (Condition) then
-- Do something
end
```

Condition has to be true to run the code block after it. A code block is code that only runs under certain conditions. In this case, the code block runs if the condition is true.

## Else Statements

Else is used to define the opposite of the condition, so if a condition is false, then else would tell it to execute the following code, a good usage of else is shown below.

```

local age = 40
if age == 20 then
print("You're 20!\n")
else
print("You're NOT 20!\n")
end
```

The above example checks if the variable "age" is 20, if this is true, then it prints to console "You're 20!", but if the variable "age" is NOT 20, then it prints "You're NOT 20!" to console.

## Conditions Available For Use

### Equal To
The equal to condition is true if the thing on the left and right of == are equal.

```

local age = 1
if age == 20 then
print("You are 20!\n")
end
```

### Not Equal To
The "not equal to" condition is true if the thing on the left and right of ~= aren't equal.
You can also use != instead of ~=

```

local age = 15
if age ~= 20 then
print("You are NOT 20!\n")
end
```

The code below is the same as the code above.

```

local age = 15
if age != 20 then
print("You are NOT 20!\n")
end
```

### Less Than
The "less than" condition is true if the thing on the left is less than the thing on the right.

```

local age = 15
if age 20 then
print("You are over 20!\n")
end
```

### Less Than or Equal To
The "less than or equal" condition is true if the thing on the left is less or equal to the thing on the right.

```

local age = 15
if age = 20 then
print("You are 20 or over!\n")
end
```

What are the arguments, return values, and realm details for cam.Start3D2D in Garry's Mod Lua?

Realms
- Client

Arguments
- pos: Vector. Origin of the 3D2D context, ie. the top left corner, (0, 0).
- angles: Angle. Angles of the 3D2D context.
+x in the 2d context corresponds to +x of the angle (its forward direction).
+y in the 2d context corresponds to -y of the angle (its right direction).

If (dx, dy) are your desired (+x, +y) unit vectors, the angle you want is dx:AngleEx(dx:Cross(-dy)).
- scale: number. The scale of the render context.
If scale is 1 then 1 pixel in 2D context will equal to 1 unit in 3D context.

Explain Blocked ConCommands in Garry's Mod Lua.

Notes
- This list was ripped from Garry's Mod dynamic libraries.

Dev.Ref

This is a list of all concommands and convars blacklisted from being ran or changed with Global.RunConsoleCommand , game.ConsoleCommand and Player:ConCommand . Server and clients can still run the commands normally from console. Certain console commands have been disabled for a variety of reasons, usually to prevent harm or annoyance to players, such as unbinding all their keys using `unbindall`.

When you attempt to run Global.RunConsoleCommand with a blocked command, this error will be thrown in console: `RunConsoleCommand: Command is blocked! ( )`.

Running Player:ConCommand with a blocked command will throw red text in console: `ConCommand blocked! ( )`.

Running game.ConsoleCommand with a blocked command will throw red text in console: `game.ConsoleCommand blocked! ( )`.

This list was ripped from Garry's Mod dynamic libraries.

| Name | Reason |
|:-----|:-------|
| `__screenshot_internal` | Now-removed command that in the past could create a screenshot without the client's consent.
| `_restart` | Blocked only client-side. Could crash the player's game.
| `alias` | Could alias commands without the client's consent.
| `askconnect_accept` | Could accept a redirect request without the client wanting to be redirected.
| `bind` | Could be used to rebind keys without the client's consent.
| `bind_mac` | Could be used to rebind keys without the client's consent.
| `bindtoggle` | Could be used to rebind keys without the client's consent.
| `buildcubemaps` | Could rebuild the cubemaps on a server, which can cause errors.
| `cef_credits` | Could open big count of webpanels.
| `cl_allowdownload` | Could change the download settings without the client wanting to.
| `cl_allowupload` | Could change the uploads settings without the client wanting to.
| `cl_chatfilters` | Could change the chat filter settings without the client wanting to.
| `cl_cloud_settings` | Could change the cloud settings without the client wanting to.
| `cl_downloadfilter` | Could change which files can be downloaded from the server without the client consent.
| `cl_enable_loadingurl` | Could enable/disable custom loading screens provided by joined servers without the client wanting to.
| `cl_logofile` | Could choose spray file without the client wanting to.
| `cl_mouseenable` | Could enable or disable the mouse without the client wanting to.
| `cl_software_cursor` | Could replace the cursor with missing material (this makes the cursor invisible).

local function safeKeyName(key)

local name = key and input.GetKeyName(key) or nil

if not name or name == "" then

return tostring(key or "?")

end

return string.upper(name)

end

local ignoredBindInputs = {

[MOUSE_LEFT] = true,

[MOUSE_RIGHT] = true,

[MOUSE_MIDDLE] = true,

}

local function startKeyBindListener(timerName, button, getCurrentKeyFn, saveKeyFn, friendlyLabel)

if timer.Exists(timerName) then

timer.Remove(timerName)

end

local startTime = CurTime()

local timeoutSeconds = 10

local waitingForRelease = true

local lastDown = {}

local currentKey = getCurrentKeyFn and getCurrentKeyFn() or nil

if IsValid(button) then

button.DisplayText = "Release keys"

end

timer.Create(timerName, 0, 0, function()

if not IsValid(ply) or not IsValid(button) then

timer.Remove(timerName)

return

end

if CurTime() - startTime > timeoutSeconds then

button.DisplayText = safeKeyName(currentKey)

cutta_ui_library:Create_Notification("Keybind change timed out.", "ERROR")

timer.Remove(timerName)

return

end

local anyDown = false

local pressedKey = nil

for k = 1, 255 do

if not ignoredBindInputs[k] then

local isDown = input.IsKeyDown(k)

if isDown then

anyDown = true

end

if isDown and not lastDown[k] and not pressedKey then

pressedKey = k

end

lastDown[k] = isDown

end

end

if waitingForRelease then

if anyDown then

return

end

waitingForRelease = false

button.DisplayText = "Press a key"

return

end

if pressedKey then

saveKeyFn(pressedKey)

currentKey = pressedKey

button.DisplayText = safeKeyName(pressedKey)

cutta_ui_library:Create_Notification("Set " .. friendlyLabel .. " key to " .. safeKeyName(pressedKey) .. "!", "SUCCESS")

timer.Remove(timerName)

end

end)

end

local function collectWOSAnimationsFromPlayerModel(targetPly)

if not IsValid(targetPly) then return nil, {}, "Player is not valid" end

local modelPath = string.Trim(tostring(targetPly:GetModel() or ""))

if modelPath == "" then

return nil, {}, "Player model could not be read"

end

local matches = {}

local seen = {}

local seqCount = math.max((targetPly:GetSequenceCount() or 0) - 1, -1)

for index = 0, seqCount do

local sequenceName = targetPly:GetSequenceName(index)

if sequenceName and sequenceName ~= "" then

local lowered = string.lower(sequenceName)

if string.StartWith(lowered, "wos_") and not seen[lowered] then

seen[lowered] = true

matches[#matches + 1] = sequenceName

end

end

end

table.sort(matches, function(a, b)

return string.lower(a) < string.lower(b)

end)

return modelPath, matches

end

local function applyAutoMountToggle(rawValue)

local enabled = rawValue == true or rawValue == 1 or tostring(rawValue or "") == "1" or tostring(rawValue or "") == "true"

if enabled == lastAutoMountToggleValue then return end

lastAutoMountToggleValue = enabled

if cutta_cosmetic_shop.Client_SetWorkshopAutoDownloadEnabled then

cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_SetWorkshopAutoDownloadEnabled(enabled, true)

end

if cutta_ui_library and isfunction(cutta_ui_library.Create_Notification) then

local function resolveAutoMountToggleValue(rawValue)

if rawValue == true or rawValue == 1 then return true end
if rawValue == false or rawValue == 0 then return false end

if rawValue ~= nil then

local normalized = string.lower(string.Trim(tostring(rawValue)))

if normalized == "true" or normalized == "1" or normalized == "yes" or normalized == "on" then

return true

end

if normalized == "false" or normalized == "0" or normalized == "no" or normalized == "off" then

return false

end

end

if IsValid(workshop_autodownload_toggle) then

if isfunction(workshop_autodownload_toggle.GetChecked) then

return workshop_autodownload_toggle:GetChecked() == true

end

if isfunction(workshop_autodownload_toggle.GetValue) then

local controlValue = workshop_autodownload_toggle:GetValue()

if controlValue ~= rawValue then

return resolveAutoMountToggleValue(controlValue)

end

end

end

if IsValid(workshop_autodownload_toggle.Button) then

if isfunction(workshop_autodownload_toggle.Button.GetChecked) then

return workshop_autodownload_toggle.Button:GetChecked() == true

end

if isfunction(workshop_autodownload_toggle.Button.GetValue) then

local buttonValue = workshop_autodownload_toggle.Button:GetValue()

if buttonValue ~= rawValue then

return resolveAutoMountToggleValue(buttonValue)

end

end

end

return lastAutoMountToggleValue

end

if enabled then
local enabled = resolveAutoMountToggleValue(rawValue)
cutta_ui_library:Create_Notification("Workshop cosmetic auto-download enabled.", "SUCCESS")

else

cutta_ui_library:Create_Notification("Workshop cosmetic auto-download disabled.", "INFO")

end

end

end

What is the difference between players and entities in Garry's Mod Lua, and how should addon code handle them?

Players are a specialized kind of Entity.

Practical rules
- Use Entity methods for generic world objects and shared entity behavior.
- Use Player methods when you need player-only state such as SteamID64, Nick, Team, or inventory-like addon data.
- Validate references with IsValid before using them.
- If you need a player specifically, also check ent:IsPlayer().
- Spawn, remove, parent, and mutate important state on the server.
- Replicate only the state clients need to draw or predict.

Common addon hooks
- PlayerInitialSpawn and PlayerSpawn for player setup.
- EntityTakeDamage and OnEntityCreated for world behavior.
- ENT:Initialize, ENT:Think, ENT:Use, and ENT:OnRemove for scripted entities.
- ENT:Draw and HUDPaint for client presentation.

A good pattern is to keep server authority on the entity itself, then expose a small synchronized state to the owning player or nearby clients.

-- Deferred sound scanner: processes directories in small batches across ticks
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER = "CuttaQS_ResourceSoundScan"
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_INTERVAL = 0.1
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_DIRS_PER_TICK = 3
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_MAX_FILES = 2000

local function cuttaqs_resource_add_sounds_deferred(rootPath)
if not isstring(rootPath) then return end

local scanQueue = { rootPath }
local seen = {}
local addedFiles = 0

timer.Create(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER, CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_INTERVAL, 0, function()
local dirsProcessed = 0

while dirsProcessed < CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_DIRS_PER_TICK and #scanQueue > 0 do
local currentPath = table.remove(scanQueue, 1)
if isstring(currentPath) and currentPath ~= "" and not seen[currentPath] then
seen[currentPath] = true
dirsProcessed = dirsProcessed + 1

local files, dirs = file.Find(currentPath .. "/*", "GAME")
files = files or {}
dirs = dirs or {}

if #dirs == 0 and #files > 0 then
for _, name in ipairs(files) do
if not cuttaqs_is_sound_file(name) and file.IsDir(currentPath .. "/" .. name, "GAME") then
table.insert(dirs, name)
end
end
end

for _, f in ipairs(files) do
if addedFiles >= CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_MAX_FILES then
print("[CuttaQS] Auto sound mount limit reached (" .. tostring(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_MAX_FILES) .. ").")
timer.Remove(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER)
return
end

if cuttaqs_is_sound_file(f) and not file.IsDir(currentPath .. "/" .. f, "GAME") then
resource.AddFile(currentPath .. "/" .. f)
addedFiles = addedFiles + 1
end
end

for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
if isstring(d) and d ~= "" and d ~= "." and d ~= ".." and not string.StartWith(d, ".") then
table.insert(scanQueue, currentPath .. "/" .. d)
end
end
end
end

if #scanQueue <= 0 then
timer.Remove(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER)
if addedFiles > 0 then
print("[CuttaQS] Auto-mounted " .. tostring(addedFiles) .. " sound files for download.")
end
end
end)
end

if cuttaqs_should_ship_optional_downloads() then
timer.Simple(1, function()
--cuttaqs_resource_add_sounds_deferred("sound/cutta_quest_system")
end)
else
print("[CuttaQS] ConnectSafeMode active: skipping optional sound/workshop downloads.")
end
end

if not IsValid(clientModel) then return -1 end

local function TruncateText(text, font, maxWidth)
if not isstring(text) then text = tostring(text or "") end
if text == "" then return "" end
surface.SetFont(font)
local w = select(1, surface.GetTextSize(text))
if w <= maxWidth then return text end

local ellipsis = "..."
local low, high = 1, #text
while low < high do
local mid = math.floor((low + high) / 2)
local candidate = string.sub(text, 1, mid) .. ellipsis
local cw = select(1, surface.GetTextSize(candidate))
if cw <= maxWidth then
low = mid + 1
else
high = mid
end
end
local finalLen = math.max(1, low - 1)
return string.sub(text, 1, finalLen) .. ellipsis
end

local function WrapTextLines(text, font, maxWidth, maxLines)
if not isstring(text) then text = tostring(text or "") end
text = string.Trim(text)
if text == "" then return {}, 0 end
if not isnumber(maxWidth) or maxWidth <= 0 then return { text }, 0 end
if not isnumber(maxLines) or maxLines <= 0 then maxLines = 999 end

surface.SetFont(font)
local _, lineH = surface.GetTextSize("Ag")

local lines = {}
local current = ""

local function pushLine(s)
s = string.Trim(s or "")
if s ~= "" then
table.insert(lines, s)
end
end

local function fits(s)
local w = select(1, surface.GetTextSize(s))
return w <= maxWidth
end

local function chunkWord(word)
if fits(word) then
return { word }
end

local parts = {}
local remaining = word
while #remaining > 0 do
local low, high = 1, #remaining
while low < high do
local mid = math.ceil((low + high) / 2)
local candidate = string.sub(remaining, 1, mid)
if fits(candidate) then
low = mid
else
high = mid - 1
end
end
local take = math.max(1, low)
table.insert(parts, string.sub(remaining, 1, take))
remaining = string.sub(remaining, take + 1)
end
return parts
end

for word in string.gmatch(text, "%S+") do
local wordParts = chunkWord(word)
for _,part in ipairs(wordParts) do
local candidate = current ~= "" and (current .. " " .. part) or part
if fits(candidate) then
current = candidate
else
pushLine(current)
current = part
end
end
end
pushLine(current)

if #lines > maxLines then
lines = { unpack(lines, 1, maxLines) }
local ellipsis = "..."
local last = lines[maxLines] or ""
if not fits(last) then
last = TruncateText(last, font, maxWidth)
end
if not string.EndsWith(last, ellipsis) then
last = TruncateText(last .. ellipsis, font, maxWidth)
end
lines[maxLines] = last
end

return lines, lineH
end

local function QuestPassesChecks(ply_, questname)
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_CanQuest(ply_) then
return false
end

if cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerNeedQuestsRequired(ply_, questname) then
local questrequiredtable = cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerQuestsRequired(ply_, questname)
for requiredQuestName,_ in pairs(questrequiredtable) do
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_HasCompletedQuest(ply_, requiredQuestName) then
return false
end
end
end

if cutta_quest_system:Quests_QuestRestrictionsCheck(questname) then
local restictionstable = cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerQuestRestrictionsTable(ply_, questname)
local playerfound = false
for k,v in pairs(restictionstable) do
for _,p in pairs(v) do
if cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestRestrictTo(ply_, k, p) then
playerfound = true
end
end
end
if not playerfound then
return false
end
end

if cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsRepeatable(questname, ply_) then
local questData = nil
for k,v in pairs(cutta_quest_system["Quests"]) do
if v[questname] then questData = v[questname] break end
end

if questData and (questData.ResetMonth or questData.ResetDay or questData.ResetTime) then
local resetMonth = questData.ResetMonth or 0
local resetDay = questData.ResetDay or 0
local resetTimeStr = questData.ResetTime or "00:00"

local resetHour, resetMin = string.match(resetTimeStr, "(%d+):(%d+)")
resetHour = tonumber(resetHour) or 0
resetMin = tonumber(resetMin) or 0

local now = os.time()
local date = os.date("*t", now)

local checkDate = {
year = date.year,
month = date.month,
day = date.day,
hour = resetHour,
min = resetMin,
sec = 0
}

if resetMonth ~= 0 then checkDate.month = resetMonth end
if resetDay ~= 0 then checkDate.day = resetDay end

local resetTimestamp = os.time(checkDate)

local lastResetTimestamp = resetTimestamp
if resetTimestamp > now then
local prevDate = table.Copy(checkDate)
if resetMonth ~= 0 then
prevDate.year = prevDate.year - 1
elseif resetDay ~= 0 then
prevDate.month = prevDate.month - 1
if prevDate.month == 0 then
prevDate.month = 12
prevDate.year = prevDate.year - 1
end
else
prevDate.day = prevDate.day - 1
end
lastResetTimestamp = os.time(prevDate)
end

local lastComplete = ply_.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes and ply_.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes[questname] or 0

if lastComplete > lastResetTimestamp then
return false
end
elseif cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsColddown(questname) then
if cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerOnQuestColddown(ply_, questname) then
return false
end
end
else
if cutta_quest_system:Player_HasCompletedQuest(ply_, questname) then
return false
end
end

return true
end

local function CUTTAQS_Prefix()
if cutta_quest_system and cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] then
return cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"]
end
return "" -- fallback; should always exist in this addon
end

local function CUTTAQS_GlobalIdKey()
return CUTTAQS_Prefix() .. "GlobalQuestId"
end

local function CUTTAQS_IsGlobalFor(ent, ply)
if not IsValid(ent) or not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end

local key = CUTTAQS_GlobalIdKey()
local entGlobalId = ent:GetNWString(key, "")
if not entGlobalId or entGlobalId == "" then return false end

local plyGlobalId = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[key] or nil
return plyGlobalId == entGlobalId
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer = nil
self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract = nil
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_LockValidFor(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if not IsValid(self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer) then return false end
return self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer == ply
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_TickLock()
if not IsValid(self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer) then
self:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
return
end

-- Release lock if solver walks away or goes AFK.
local now = CurTime()
local last = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract) or 0
if last > 0 and (now - last) > 20 then
self:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
return
end

if self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer:GetPos():DistToSqr(self:GetPos()) > (175 * 175) then
self:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
return
end
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_TryAcquireLock(ply)
self:CUTTAQS_TickLock()

if self:CUTTAQS_LockValidFor(ply) then
self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract = CurTime()
return true
end

if IsValid(self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer) then
return false
end

-- New solver gets control; reset progress for a clean attempt.
self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer = ply
self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract = CurTime()
self.CUTTAQS_Progress = 0
return true
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_SetupPuzzle(dotCount)
dotCount = math.floor(tonumber(dotCount) or 4)
dotCount = math.Clamp(dotCount, 1, 8)

self:SetDotCount(dotCount)
self:SetPuzzleType("sequence")
self:SetIsSolved(false)

self.CUTTAQS_Sequence = {}
for i = 1, dotCount do
self.CUTTAQS_Sequence[i] = math.random(1, 8)
end
self.CUTTAQS_Progress = 0
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers = {}
self:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_CanOpen(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if self:GetIsSolved() then return false end
if ply:GetPos():DistToSqr(self:GetPos()) > (150 * 150) then return false end

local prefix = CUTTAQS_Prefix()
local owner = self:GetNWEntity(prefix .. "ObjectiveOwner")
local isGlobal = CUTTAQS_IsGlobalFor(self, ply)
if not isGlobal then
if IsValid(owner) and owner ~= ply then return false end
end

-- For global quests: anyone can open. For all puzzles: only one solver at a time.
if not isGlobal then
return self:CUTTAQS_TryAcquireLock(ply)
end

-- Global: allow open even if someone else is solving.
if not self.CUTTAQS_Viewers then self.CUTTAQS_Viewers = {} end
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers[ply] = true
return true
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_CanPress(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if self:GetIsSolved() then return false end
if ply:GetPos():DistToSqr(self:GetPos()) > (150 * 150) then return false end

local prefix = CUTTAQS_Prefix()
local owner = self:GetNWEntity(prefix .. "ObjectiveOwner")
local isGlobal = CUTTAQS_IsGlobalFor(self, ply)
if not isGlobal then
if IsValid(owner) and owner ~= ply then return false end
end

if not self:CUTTAQS_LockValidFor(ply) then
-- Attempt to acquire if nobody currently has it.
return self:CUTTAQS_TryAcquireLock(ply)
end

self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract = CurTime()

return true
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_SendState(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
local prefix = CUTTAQS_Prefix()
local progress = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_Progress) or 0

net.Start(prefix .. "puzzle_state")
net.WriteEntity(self)
net.WriteUInt(self:GetDotCount() or 0, 4)
net.WriteUInt(progress, 4)
net.WriteBool(self:GetIsSolved() or false)
net.Send(ply)
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_SendStateToViewers()
if not self.CUTTAQS_Viewers then return end
for ply, _ in pairs(self.CUTTAQS_Viewers) do
if IsValid(ply) and ply:IsPlayer() then
if ply:GetPos():DistToSqr(self:GetPos()) <= (300 * 300) then
self:CUTTAQS_SendState(ply)
else
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers[ply] = nil
end
else
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers[ply] = nil
end
end
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_OpenFor(ply)
if not self:CUTTAQS_CanOpen(ply) then return end

if not self.CUTTAQS_Sequence or #self.CUTTAQS_Sequence <= 0 then
self:CUTTAQS_SetupPuzzle(self:GetDotCount() > 0 and self:GetDotCount() or 4)
end

local prefix = CUTTAQS_Prefix()
local progress = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_Progress) or 0

-- Ensure viewer list is tracked for state broadcasts.
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers = self.CUTTAQS_Viewers or {}
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers[ply] = true

net.Start(prefix .. "puzzle_open")
net.WriteEntity(self)
net.WriteUInt(self:GetDotCount() or 0, 4)
net.WriteUInt(progress, 4)
net.Send(ply)
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_HandlePress(ply, buttonIndex)
if not self:CUTTAQS_CanPress(ply) then return end

buttonIndex = math.floor(tonumber(buttonIndex) or 0)
if buttonIndex < 1 or buttonIndex > 8 then return end

self.CUTTAQS_Progress = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_Progress) or 0
self.CUTTAQS_Sequence = self.CUTTAQS_Sequence or {}

local dotCount = self:GetDotCount() or #self.CUTTAQS_Sequence
dotCount = math.Clamp(dotCount, 1, 8)
if #self.CUTTAQS_Sequence ~= dotCount then
self:CUTTAQS_SetupPuzzle(dotCount)
end

local current = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_Progress) or 0
local expected = self.CUTTAQS_Sequence[current + 1]

if buttonIndex == expected then
current = current + 1
else
current = 0
end

if current >= dotCount then
self:SetIsSolved(true)
self.CUTTAQS_Progress = dotCount
self:CUTTAQS_SendStateToViewers()

if cutta_quest_system and cutta_quest_system.Player_NextObjective then
timer.Simple(0, function()
if IsValid(ply) then
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply)
end
end)
end

timer.Simple(0, function()
if IsValid(self) then
self:Remove()
end
end)
return
end

self.CUTTAQS_Progress = current
self:CUTTAQS_SendStateToViewers()
end

local ply = LocalPlayer()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
local sess = ply.CUTTAQS_GlobalDialogueSession
if not istable(sess) or not sess.globalId or not sess.isStarter then return end

local payload = {
dialogText = dialogText,
options = options or {},
singledialogue = singledialogue and true or false,
}
local json = util.TableToJSON(payload)
local compressed = util.Compress(json)

net.Start(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."globalquest_dialogue_step")
net.WriteString(tostring(sess.globalId))
net.WriteUInt(#compressed, 32)
net.WriteData(compressed, #compressed)
net.SendToServer()
end

local function resolveProvidedSequenceId(sequenceName)
if not isstring(sequenceName) or sequenceName == "" then return -1 end

if isnumber(asNumber) and asNumber >= 0 then
return math.floor(asNumber)
end

local direct = ent:LookupSequence(sequenceName)
if isnumber(direct) and direct >= 0 then
return direct
end

local targetLower = string.lower(sequenceName)
local seqList = ent:GetSequenceList() or {}
for _, seqName in ipairs(seqList) do
if string.lower(seqName) == targetLower then
local resolved = ent:LookupSequence(seqName)
if isnumber(resolved) and resolved >= 0 then
return resolved
end
end
end

for _, seqName in ipairs(seqList) do
local seqLower = string.lower(seqName)
if string.find(seqLower, targetLower, 1, true) or string.find(targetLower, seqLower, 1, true) then
local resolved = ent:LookupSequence(seqName)
if isnumber(resolved) and resolved >= 0 then
return resolved
end
end
end

if string.StartWith(string.upper(sequenceName), "ACT_") then
local activityId = _G[string.upper(sequenceName)]
if isnumber(activityId) then
local weighted = ent:SelectWeightedSequence(activityId)
if isnumber(weighted) and weighted >= 0 then
return weighted
end
end
end

return -1

local advanceTimerId = CQS_CutSceneAdvanceTimerId(ply)

local function finishCutscene()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
if not CQS_CutSceneSessionIsCurrent(ply, cutsceneSessionId, cutsceneObjectiveNumber) then return end

local shouldKeepCutsceneOn = false
local chainedCutsceneHold = 0.5
if cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then
local questName = cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestName(ply)
local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questName)
local objectives = questData and questData.Objectives or nil
if istable(objectives) then
local nextObjectiveNumber = (tonumber(cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_Number(ply)) or 0) + 1
local nextObjectiveData = objectives[nextObjectiveNumber]
if istable(nextObjectiveData) then
local nextObjectiveName = tostring(nextObjectiveData.Obj_Name or "")
if nextObjectiveName == "cutscene" or nextObjectiveName == "video_cutscene" then
shouldKeepCutsceneOn = true
end
end
end
end

if not shouldKeepCutsceneOn then
cutta_quest_system:Quests_Player_SetCutscene_Toggle(ply,false)
end

local effectiveDelay = transitionDelay
if shouldKeepCutsceneOn then
effectiveDelay = math.max(effectiveDelay, chainedCutsceneHold)
end

if effectiveDelay <= 0 then
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then return end
if not CQS_CutSceneSessionIsCurrent(ply, cutsceneSessionId, cutsceneObjectiveNumber) then return end
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply)
else
if timer.Exists(advanceTimerId) then
timer.Remove(advanceTimerId)
end

timer.Create(advanceTimerId, effectiveDelay, 1, function()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then return end
if not CQS_CutSceneSessionIsCurrent(ply, cutsceneSessionId, cutsceneObjectiveNumber) then return end
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply)
end)
end
end

if time <= 0 then
timer.Simple(0, finishCutscene)
else
timer.Create(timerId, time, 1, finishCutscene)
end
end

CQS_CutSceneCancelPendingTimers(ply)

local function normalizeLanguageKey(lang)
if not isstring(lang) then return DefaultLanguage end

local lowered = string.lower(string.Trim(lang))
if lowered == "" then return DefaultLanguage end

local aliased = LanguageAliases[lowered]

if Languages[aliased] then return aliased end
return aliased
end

for short, _ in pairs(Languages) do
if string.lower(short) == lowered then

end
end

local prefix = string.match(lowered, "^([a-z][a-z])[-_].+") or lowered
aliased = LanguageAliases[prefix]
if aliased then
if Languages[aliased] then return aliased end
return aliased
end

for short, _ in pairs(Languages) do
local shortLower = string.lower(short)
if shortLower == prefix or string.sub(shortLower, 1, 2) == prefix then
return short
end
end

return DefaultLanguage
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_IsPlayerInZone(ply, zone, zoneCache)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
local cache = zoneCache or CQS_ZoneBuildCache(zone)
if not cache then return false end

local pos = ply:GetPos()
if cache.kind == "point2d" then
-- treat this like a 2D circle at the point's Z (more forgiving than a full 3D sphere)
local dx = pos.x - cache.x
local dy = pos.y - cache.y
return (dx * dx + dy * dy) <= cache.radiusSqr
end

if cache.kind == "box" then
local min, max = cache.min, cache.max
return pos.x >= min.x and pos.x <= max.x
and pos.y >= min.y and pos.y <= max.y
and pos.z >= min.z and pos.z <= max.z
end

maxBytes = tonumber(maxBytes) or CQS_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES
if maxBytes < 12000 then maxBytes = 12000 end

local chunks = {}
local chunk = {}
local chunkBytes = 0

local function flushChunk()
if #chunk <= 0 then return end
local json = util.TableToJSON(chunk)
local compressed = json and util.Compress(json) or nil
if compressed then
chunks[#chunks + 1] = compressed
end
chunk = {}
chunkBytes = 0
end

for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
local entryJson = util.TableToJSON(entry)
if entryJson then
local projectedBytes = chunkBytes + #entryJson
if #chunk > 0 then
projectedBytes = projectedBytes + 1
end

if projectedBytes > maxBytes and #chunk > 0 then
flushChunk()
end

table.insert(chunk, entry)
if #chunk > 1 then
chunkBytes = chunkBytes + 1
end
chunkBytes = chunkBytes + #entryJson
end
end

flushChunk()
return chunks
end

local function cuttaqs_is_sound_file(filename)
if not isstring(filename) then return false end
if string.StartWith(filename, ".") then return false end
local ext = string.lower(string.GetExtensionFromFilename(filename) or "")
return ext == "wav" or ext == "mp3" or ext == "ogg"
end

local CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER = "CuttaQuestSystem_SoundScanQueue"
local CQS_SOUND_SCAN_INITIAL_DELAY = 8
local CQS_SOUND_SCAN_INTERVAL = 0.5
local CQS_SOUND_SCAN_DIRS_PER_TICK = 1

local function cuttaqs_prepare_sound_bucket(soundStore, key, includeRandom)
if not istable(soundStore) then return end

if not istable(soundStore[key]) then
soundStore[key] = {}
else
table.Empty(soundStore[key])
end

if includeRandom then
table.insert(soundStore[key], "Random")
end
end

local function cuttaqs_enqueue_sound_dir(job, searchPath, relativePath)
if not istable(job) then return end
if not isstring(searchPath) or searchPath == "" then return end
job.queue = job.queue or {}
job.queue[#job.queue + 1] = {
searchPath = searchPath,
relativePath = relativePath or ""
}
end

local function cuttaqs_process_sound_job(job, bucket, maxDirsPerTick)
if not istable(job) or not istable(bucket) then return true end

job.queue = job.queue or {}

local processedDirs = 0

while processedDirs < maxDirsPerTick and #job.queue > 0 do
local dirNode = table.remove(job.queue, 1)
processedDirs = processedDirs + 1

if istable(dirNode) and isstring(dirNode.searchPath) and dirNode.searchPath ~= "" then
local files, dirs = file.Find(dirNode.searchPath .. "/*", "GAME")
files = files or {}
dirs = dirs or {}

if #dirs == 0 and #files > 0 then
for _, name in ipairs(files) do
if not cuttaqs_is_sound_file(name) and file.IsDir(dirNode.searchPath .. "/" .. name, "GAME") then
table.insert(dirs, name)
end
end
end

for _, f in ipairs(files) do
if cuttaqs_is_sound_file(f) and not file.IsDir(dirNode.searchPath .. "/" .. f, "GAME") then
local relPath = (dirNode.relativePath ~= "") and (dirNode.relativePath .. "/" .. f) or f
table.insert(bucket, relPath)
end
end

for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
local nextSearch = dirNode.searchPath .. "/" .. d
local nextRelative = (dirNode.relativePath ~= "") and (dirNode.relativePath .. "/" .. d) or d
cuttaqs_enqueue_sound_dir(job, nextSearch, nextRelative)
end
end
end

return #job.queue <= 0
end

local function cuttaqs_queue_sound_scan(cqs)
if not istable(cqs) then return end

cqs["Sounds"] = cqs["Sounds"] or {}

local scanJobs = {
{ key = "Complete", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/complete", includeRandom = true, queue = {}, done = false },
{ key = "Start", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/start", includeRandom = true, queue = {}, done = false },
{ key = "Fail", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/fail", includeRandom = true, queue = {}, done = false },
{ key = "Music", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/music", includeRandom = false, queue = {}, done = false },
{ key = "SFX", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/sfx", includeRandom = false, queue = {}, done = false },
{ key = "GlobalQuestStart", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/globalquests", includeRandom = true, queue = {}, done = false }
}

for _, job in ipairs(scanJobs) do
cuttaqs_prepare_sound_bucket(cqs["Sounds"], job.key, job.includeRandom)
cuttaqs_enqueue_sound_dir(job, job.searchPath, "")
end

if timer.Exists(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER) then
timer.Remove(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER)
end

timer.Simple(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_INITIAL_DELAY, function()
if not istable(cutta_quest_system) then return end

local activeJobIndex = 1
timer.Create(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER, CQS_SOUND_SCAN_INTERVAL, 0, function()
if not istable(cutta_quest_system) then
timer.Remove(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER)
return
end

local unfinishedCount = 0
for _, jobState in ipairs(scanJobs) do
if not jobState.done then
unfinishedCount = unfinishedCount + 1
end
end

if unfinishedCount <= 0 then
timer.Remove(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER)

for _, ply in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do
cqs:Quests_SoundTransfer_ply(ply)
end
print("[CuttaQS] Sound scan queue complete.")
return
end

local selectedJob = nil
local selectedIndex = activeJobIndex
for offset = 0, #scanJobs - 1 do
local idx = ((activeJobIndex - 1 + offset) % #scanJobs) + 1
if not scanJobs[idx].done then
selectedJob = scanJobs[idx]
selectedIndex = idx
break
end
end

if not selectedJob then
return
end

local bucket = cqs["Sounds"][selectedJob.key]
if not istable(bucket) then
bucket = {}
cqs["Sounds"][selectedJob.key] = bucket
if selectedJob.includeRandom then
table.insert(bucket, "Random")
end
end

selectedJob.done = cuttaqs_process_sound_job(selectedJob, bucket, CQS_SOUND_SCAN_DIRS_PER_TICK)
if selectedJob.done then
table.sort(bucket, function(a, b)
if a == "Random" then return true end
if b == "Random" then return false end
return tostring(a) < tostring(b)
end)
end

activeJobIndex = (selectedIndex % #scanJobs) + 1
end)
end)
end

function cutta_quest_system:Quests_SaveQuest(questtable)
if cutta_quest_system.Quests_IsValidQuestContainer and not cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsValidQuestContainer(questtable) then

end

local mapname = string.lower(game.GetMap())
local dir = "cutta_quest_system/quests/"..mapname

if not file.IsDir("cutta_quest_system/quests", "DATA") then
file.CreateDir("cutta_quest_system/quests")
end
if not file.IsDir(dir, "DATA") then
file.CreateDir(dir)
end

local questname = next(questtable)

if questname then

local function CQS_NetOnCooldown(ply, key, cooldownSeconds)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return true end
cooldownSeconds = tonumber(cooldownSeconds) or 0
if cooldownSeconds <= 0 then return false end

ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns = ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns or {}
local now = CurTime()
local nextAllowed = ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns[key] or 0
if nextAllowed > now then return true end

ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns[key] = now + cooldownSeconds
return false
end

end

function cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_AwardQuestXP(completer, questName)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerState(completer) then return false end
if not cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_FeatureEnabled() then return false end

local sourceSteamID64 = tostring(completer.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverSource"] or "")
local sourceQuestName = tostring(completer.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverQuest"] or "")
if sourceSteamID64 == "" or sourceQuestName == "" then return false end
if sourceQuestName ~= tostring(questName or "") then return false end

local giverPly = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_FindPlayerBySteamID64(sourceSteamID64)
if not IsValid(giverPly) or not giverPly:IsPlayer() then return false end

local data = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_EnsureData(giverPly)
if not data then return false end

local xpAward = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_XPPerQuest()
data.XP = data.XP + xpAward
data.TotalXP = data.TotalXP + xpAward

local leveledUp = false
local requiredXP = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_RequiredXP(data.Level)
while data.XP >= requiredXP do
data.XP = data.XP - requiredXP
data.Level = data.Level + 1
leveledUp = true
requiredXP = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_RequiredXP(data.Level)
end

cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_ApplyNW(giverPly)
cutta_quest_system:PlayerSave(giverPly)
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(giverPly, string.format("Quest Giver XP +%d from %s finishing '%s'", xpAward, tostring(completer:Nick()), tostring(questName)))
if leveledUp then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(giverPly, string.format("Quest Giver Level Up! You are now level %d", data.Level))
end

return true
end

local CQS_PLAYER_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES = 18000

local function CQS_SendCompressedPayloadChunks(netName, recipient, compressedData, maxChunkSize)
if not IsValid(recipient) or not isstring(netName) or netName == "" then return end
if not isstring(compressedData) or #compressedData == 0 then return end

maxChunkSize = tonumber(maxChunkSize) or CQS_PLAYER_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES
if maxChunkSize < 8000 then maxChunkSize = 8000 end

local totalSize = #compressedData
local totalChunks = math.ceil(totalSize / maxChunkSize)

for chunkIndex = 1, totalChunks do
local startIndex = (chunkIndex - 1) * maxChunkSize + 1
local endIndex = math.min(totalSize, startIndex + maxChunkSize - 1)
local part = string.sub(compressedData, startIndex, endIndex)
if isstring(part) and #part > 0 then
net.Start(netName)
net.WriteUInt(totalChunks, 16)
net.WriteUInt(chunkIndex, 16)
net.WriteUInt(totalSize, 32)
net.WriteUInt(#part, 16)
net.WriteData(part, #part)
net.Send(recipient)
end
end
end

function cutta_quest_system:Menu_DialogueNPCs_Refresh(tab,editmode)
if not cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame[tab] then return end

local function CQS_GenerateDuplicatedNPCID(baseID)
local cleanBase = string.lower(tostring(baseID or "dialoguenpc"))
if cleanBase == "" then
cleanBase = "dialoguenpc"
end

local copyBase = cleanBase .. "_copy"
if not cutta_quest_system["DialogueNPCs"][copyBase] then
return copyBase
end

local index = 2
while cutta_quest_system["DialogueNPCs"][copyBase .. tostring(index)] do
index = index + 1
end

return copyBase .. tostring(index)
end

local Menu = DermaMenu()

local function option_already_added(restriction_name, restriction_value)
local restrictions = LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname]["Restrictions"]
if not istable(restrictions) then return false end

for _, restrictionEntry in pairs(restrictions) do
if not istable(restrictionEntry) then continue end
for restrictname, restrictValues in pairs(restrictionEntry) do
if restrictname ~= restriction_name then continue end

-- Backward compatible behavior: if no value provided, just check the restriction type exists.
if restriction_value == nil then
return true
end

if istable(restrictValues) then
for _, val in pairs(restrictValues) do
if val == restriction_value then
return true
end
end
else
if restrictValues == restriction_value then
return true
end
end
end
end
return false
end

local function CQS_DialogueSound_IsURL(soundPath)
if not isstring(soundPath) then return false end
soundPath = string.Trim(soundPath)
if soundPath == "" then return false end
return string.StartWith(soundPath, "http://") or string.StartWith(soundPath, "https://")
end

local function CQS_DialogueSound_NormalizeLocalPath(soundPath)
if not isstring(soundPath) then return nil end
soundPath = string.Trim(soundPath)
if soundPath == "" then return nil end
if string.StartWith(soundPath, "sound/") then
soundPath = string.sub(soundPath, 7)
end
return soundPath
end

function cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Stop()
if not IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then return end

if timer.Exists("CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundTimer") then
timer.Remove("CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundTimer")
end

local channel = LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue
if channel then
if channel.IsPlaying and channel:IsPlaying() and channel.Stop then
channel:Stop()
elseif channel.Stop then
channel:Stop()
end
end
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue = nil
end

function cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Play(soundPath)
if not IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then return end
if not isstring(soundPath) then return end
soundPath = string.Trim(soundPath)
if soundPath == "" then return end

cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Stop()

if CQS_DialogueSound_IsURL(soundPath) then
sound.PlayURL(tostring(soundPath), "", function(station)
if IsValid(station) then
station:SetPos(LocalPlayer():GetPos())
station:Play()
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue = station
end
end)
return
end

local normalized = CQS_DialogueSound_NormalizeLocalPath(soundPath)
if not normalized then return end

LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue = CreateSound(LocalPlayer(), normalized)
if LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue then
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue:Play()
end

local dur = SoundDuration(normalized)
if isnumber(dur) and dur > 0 then
timer.Create("CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundTimer", dur, 1, function()
if IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then
cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Stop()
end
end)
end
end

local function CUTTAQS_TruncateTextToWidth(text, font, maxWidth)
text = string.Trim(tostring(text or ""))

surface.SetFont(font)
if select(1, surface.GetTextSize(text)) <= maxWidth then

end

local ellipsis = "..."
local low, high = 1, #text
while low < high do
local mid = math.ceil((low + high) * 0.5)
local candidate = string.sub(text, 1, mid) .. ellipsis
if select(1, surface.GetTextSize(candidate)) <= maxWidth then
low = mid
else
high = mid - 1
end
end

return string.sub(text, 1, math.max(1, low)) .. ellipsis
end

local compactGap = 4
local textStr = string.Trim(tostring(text or ""))

maxHeight = math.max(18, tonumber(maxHeight) or 18)

font = fontName,
lines = lines,
lineHeight = lineHeight,
gap = compactGap,
totalHeight = totalHeight
}

if CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[signatureKey] ~= signature then

end

function cutta_quest_system:Hud_DisplayInfo(objname,objtext,objdesc,objdia)

if hasDialogue then

CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM.dialogueAlpha = 1
CUTTAQS_DrawCutsceneDialogue(objdia, 1)

CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM.dialogueSignature = ""

end

local infoLines = {}
if objname then
table.insert(infoLines, objname)
end
if objtext then
table.insert(infoLines, objtext)
end
if objdesc then
table.insert(infoLines, objdesc)
end

local infoSignature = table.concat(infoLines, "\n")
if CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM.infoSignature ~= infoSignature then

end

local reveal = math.Clamp((CurTime() - CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM.infoChangedAt) / 0.28, 0, 1)

local pulse = (math.sin(CurTime() * 2.1) + 1) * 0.5
local cardWidth = math.min(316, ScrW() * 0.238)
local cardX = screen_x - (1 - reveal) * 28

local objectiveLines = {}
local descLines = {}

objectiveLines = select(1, CUTTAQS_WrapText(objtext, "cuttaqs_8bitfont_small", cardWidth - 40, 2))

if objdesc then

contentY = CUTTAQS_DrawWrappedLines(titleLines, "cuttaqs_bankgothic", cardX + 18, contentY, CUTTAQS_COLOR_TEXT, alpha, 1)
contentY = contentY + 2
CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine("PRIMARY OBJECTIVE", "cuttaqs_8bitfont_mini", cardX + 18, contentY, CUTTAQS_COLOR_AMBER_SOFT, alpha)
contentY = contentY + 12
contentY = CUTTAQS_DrawWrappedLines(objectiveLines, "cuttaqs_8bitfont_small", cardX + 18, contentY, CUTTAQS_COLOR_AMBER, alpha, 2)
if #descLines > 0 then
contentY = contentY + 6
CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine("NOTES", "cuttaqs_8bitfont_mini", cardX + 18, contentY, CUTTAQS_COLOR_TEXT_SOFT, alpha)
contentY = contentY + 12

function cutta_quest_system:Draw3DZone(pos, rad, clr, detail, thick)
local AlphaMask = CUTTAQS_COLOR_ALPHA_MASK
render.SetStencilEnable(true)
render.SetStencilWriteMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilTestMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilReferenceValue( 0 )
render.SetStencilCompareFunction( STENCIL_ALWAYS )
render.SetStencilPassOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilZFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetColorMaterial()
render.ClearStencil()
--All
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_REPLACE)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Under
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Inner
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_INCR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
-- Overall
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_EQUAL)

cam.IgnoreZ(true)
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, clr)
cam.IgnoreZ(false)
render.SetStencilEnable(false)
end

hook.Add("PostDrawTranslucentRenderables", cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."PositionRing", function()
local ply = LocalPlayer()
if cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then
local questname = cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestName(ply)
local questData = cutta_quest_system.Quests_GetQuestData and cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname) or nil
local objectives = questData and questData.Objectives or nil
if not objectives then return end

local objNumber = tonumber(cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_Number(ply))
local objData = objNumber and (objectives[objNumber] or objectives[tostring(objNumber)]) or nil
if not objData then return end
if objData.Obj_Name == "soundcue" or objData.Obj_Name == "musiccue" or objData.Obj_Name == "cutscene" then return end
if objData.Obj_Name ~= cutta_quest_system:Objective_Name(ply) then return end

local point = objData.position or objData["position"]
local distance = objData.distance or objData["distance"]
if point and distance then
cutta_quest_system:Draw3DZone(point, distance, color_white, 30, 8)
end
end
end)

function cutta_quest_system:Draw3DZone(pos, rad, clr, detail, thick)
local AlphaMask = CUTTAQS_OBJHUD_ALPHA_MASK
render.SetStencilEnable(true)
render.SetStencilWriteMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilTestMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilReferenceValue( 0 )
render.SetStencilCompareFunction( STENCIL_ALWAYS )
render.SetStencilPassOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilZFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetColorMaterial()
render.ClearStencil()
--All
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_REPLACE)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Under
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Inner
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_INCR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
-- Overall
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_EQUAL)

cam.IgnoreZ(true)
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, clr)
cam.IgnoreZ(false)
render.SetStencilEnable(false)
end

local function BuildPuzzleWallAngle(hitNormal, eyeYaw)
if not isvector(hitNormal) then return nil end

local normal = hitNormal:GetNormalized()
local ang = (-normal):Angle()
ang:RotateAroundAxis(ang:Right(), 90)
local yawDiff = math.AngleDifference(tonumber(eyeYaw) or 0, ang.y)
ang:RotateAroundAxis(normal, yawDiff)
return ang
end

if not istable(data) and not isangle(data) then return nil end
local p = tonumber(data.p)
local y = tonumber(data.y)
local r = tonumber(data.r)
if p == nil or y == nil or r == nil then return nil end
return { p = p, y = y, r = r }
end

local function ResolveActiveAngleData(objData)
if not istable(objData) then return nil end
if objData["aim_wall"] then
return GetAngleTableFromData(objData["wall_ang"])
end
return GetAngleTableFromData(objData["angle"])
end

local angData = {
p = tonumber(p) or 0,

r = tonumber(r) or 0,
}

objData["angle"] = angData
end
end

net.Receive(cutta_inventory_system["StringName"].."Player_Load_CL_Chunk",function(l,ply)

if !IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then return end

local ply = LocalPlayer()
if not ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] then
ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] = {}
end

ply.CUTTAINV_CHUNK_BUFFERS = ply.CUTTAINV_CHUNK_BUFFERS or {}
local totalChunks = net.ReadUInt(16)
local chunkIndex = net.ReadUInt(16)
local totalSize = net.ReadUInt(32)
local partSize = net.ReadUInt(16)
local chunkData = net.ReadData(partSize)
if not isstring(chunkData) or #chunkData == 0 then return end

local key = cutta_inventory_system["StringName"].."Player_Load_CL"
local buffer = ply.CUTTAINV_CHUNK_BUFFERS[key]
if not buffer or buffer.total ~= totalChunks or buffer.size ~= totalSize then
buffer = { chunks = {}, total = totalChunks, received = 0, size = totalSize }
end

if not buffer.chunks[chunkIndex] then
buffer.chunks[chunkIndex] = chunkData
buffer.received = buffer.received + 1
end

ply.CUTTAINV_CHUNK_BUFFERS[key] = buffer
if buffer.received < buffer.total then return end

local compressed = table.concat(buffer.chunks)
local json = util.Decompress(compressed)
if isstring(json) and json ~= "" then
ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] = util.JSONToTable(json) or {}
end

LocalPlayer().CUTTAINVENTORYSYSTEM_LOADING = false

if cutta_inventory_system.Player_RefreshOpenInventory then
cutta_inventory_system:Player_RefreshOpenInventory()
end

if cutta_inventory_system.LootCrate_RefreshOpenMenu then
cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_RefreshOpenMenu()
end

if cutta_inventory_system:Player_Open_Merchant_Check() then
cutta_inventory_system:Player_Open_Merchant()
end

ply.CUTTAINV_CHUNK_BUFFERS[key] = nil

end)

net.WriteString(upgrade)

net.SendToServer()

end

function RE2_INV_WeaponUpgrades_Upgrades_CL_init(weapon)

local ply = LocalPlayer()

if not IsValid(ply) then return end

if not cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"] then return end

if not cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][weapon] then return end

local itemData = cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][weapon]

local itemType = itemData.Type or itemData.type

if itemType != "weapon" then return end

local gunUpgrades = cutta_inventory_system:Ensure_PlayerGunUpgradeData(ply)

if not gunUpgrades then return end

if not gunUpgrades[weapon] then

gunUpgrades[weapon] = {}

for k,v in pairs(cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["UpgradesMax"]) do

gunUpgrades[weapon][k] = 0

end

end

end

local function sendItemAdd(name, class, model, typeis, price)
net.Start(cutta_inventory_system["StringName"].."Item_Add")
net.WriteString(name or "")
net.WriteString(class or "")
net.WriteString(model or "")
net.WriteString(typeis or "")
net.WriteInt(tonumber(price) or 0, 32)
net.SendToServer()
end

local function sendItemUpdate(class, fields)
net.Start(cutta_inventory_system["StringName"].."Item_Update")
net.WriteString(class or "")
net.WriteTable(fields or {})
net.SendToServer()
end

local function sendItemRemove(class)

net.WriteString(class or "")
net.SendToServer()
end

Concepts - Variables
# Variables, what are they?
Variables let your script hold information. Using a variable, you can store some piece of data once and then reference it later whenever you want. Lua doesn't require you to declare a variable as strictly being a certain type, so they can hold absolutely anything, including nothing (
il`).

## Recap: Saving and running scripts, calling print
From now on, it is assumed you don't need explanations about opening notepad, saving, and loading a script in Garry's Mod. Refer to the Beginner_Tutorial_Intro if you forgot.

Open up your editor. We'll be making a new script, with variables!

In the last tutorial, we learned how to print a simple `string` to the console:

```
print( "Hello World!" )
```

This was simple enough: whenever our script ran, it said "Hello World!" in the console:

Global.print () is a function. A function is a command that does something when you call it. Many functions can take arguments, which is data you give the function to change exactly what it does. In this case, Global.print () takes one argument, which is a string (a series of letters, numbers, spaces, and so on), and when Global.print () is called, it puts that string into the console.

Let's dissect the code piece by piece so we can understand it.

```
print( "Hello World!" )
```

`print` is the name of the function we are calling.
The `(` and the `)` (these symbols are called **parentheses**) are where you put the text you want `print` to put in the console.

"Hello World!" is the text we chose to print; it is a `string` - Notice the `""` (**quotation marks**). The quotation marks tell Lua that everything in between them is a string , and not the name of a variable. Doing this:

```
print( Hello World! )
```

won't work, because we're missing the quotation marks! If we do this, Lua will think that `Hello` and `World!` are the names of two variables, instead of a string literal. Remember: any time we want Lua to know that the information we're giving it is some form of text, we put the text in between quotation marks to represent it as a string.

Whew! Are you still with me? These are the words you need to remember so far:
* **Variable** (holds a value)
* **Function** (does something, may take arguments)
* **Arguments**, a.k.a. Parameters (functions take these and do things with them)
* `print` (a function that puts text in the console)
* **String** (a type of variable that holds text data)
* **Parentheses**

if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end
local position = objdata and (objdata.position or objdata["position"]) or 3

local objNumb = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjNumb"]) or tonumber(instance and instance.objNumb) or 0
if instance and instance.state == "running" and objNumb > 0 then
instance.teleportTimers = instance.teleportTimers or {}
if instance.teleportTimers[objNumb] then return end
instance.teleportTimers[objNumb] = true

local timerName = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalTeleport_" .. tostring(globalId) .. "_" .. tostring(objNumb)

timer.Remove(timerName)

end
if tonumber(inst.objNumb) ~= objNumb then
timer.Remove(timerName)
return
end

timeLeft = (tonumber(timeLeft) or 0) - 1
for p, _ in pairs(inst.participants or {}) do

end
end

if timeLeft <= 0 then
for p, _ in pairs(inst.participants or {}) do
if IsValid(p) and p:IsPlayer() then
p:SetPos(position)
end
end

if cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuest_AdvanceOnce then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_AdvanceOnce(globalId, objNumb)
end
inst.teleportTimers = inst.teleportTimers or {}
inst.teleportTimers[objNumb] = nil
timer.Remove(timerName)
end
end)
return
end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_TimerStart(ply,objdata) --Start Objective Time
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_TimerCreate_Complete(ply,time)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end
if timer.Exists(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."TimerStart") then
timer.Remove(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."TimerStart")

timer.Create(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."TimerStart",1,time+1,function()
if ply:IsValid() then
local current_time = cutta_quest_system:Quests_Player_GetObjTime(ply)
if current_time <= 0 then
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply)
if timer.Exists(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."TimerStart") then
timer.Remove(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."TimerStart")
end
return
end
cutta_quest_system:Quests_Player_SetObjTime(ply,current_time-1)
end
end)
end

if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end
if timer.Exists(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."TimerStart") then
timer.Remove(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."TimerStart")
end
cutta_quest_system:Quests_Player_SetObjTime(ply,time)
cutta_quest_system:Quests_Player_SetObjTime_On(ply,true)
timer.Create(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."TimerStart",1,time+1,function()

cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestFailed(ply)
if timer.Exists(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."TimerStart") then
timer.Remove(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."TimerStart")

return

How should I approach AI, NextBots, and NPC behavior systems in Garry's Mod Lua?

Keep AI server-side and model it as states.

Good pattern
- Sense: gather targets, distances, visibility, and navigation status.
- Decide: choose idle, patrol, chase, attack, flee, or interact.
- Act: move, play animations, trigger attacks, or change schedule.

Tips
- Use simple state machines before trying advanced planners.
- Separate navigation, combat, and presentation.
- Keep expensive searches throttled with timers or intervals.
- Replicate only the client visuals you need, such as effects or overlays.

This pattern also works for turret logic, RTS units, companion NPCs, and enemy waves.

local function CQS_NetOnCooldown(ply, key, cooldownSeconds)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return true end
cooldownSeconds = tonumber(cooldownSeconds) or 0
if cooldownSeconds <= 0 then return false end

ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns = ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns or {}
local now = CurTime()
local nextAllowed = ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns[key] or 0
if nextAllowed > now then return true end

ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns[key] = now + cooldownSeconds
return false
end

local function CQS_ReadCompressedTable()
local size = net.ReadUInt(32)
if not isnumber(size) or size <= 0 then return nil end

local compressed = net.ReadData(size)
if not compressed then return nil end

local json = util.Decompress(compressed)
if not isstring(json) or json == "" then return nil end

return util.JSONToTable(json)
end

local function CQS_SendSettingsQuestListChunks(ply, entries, maxBytes)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
if not istable(entries) or #entries <= 0 then return end

maxBytes = tonumber(maxBytes) or 45000
if maxBytes < 12000 then maxBytes = 12000 end

local function sendChunk(chunk)
if not istable(chunk) or #chunk <= 0 then return false end
local json = util.TableToJSON(chunk)
local compressed = json and util.Compress(json) or nil
if not compressed then return false end

net.Start(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."settings_getquestlist_bulk")
net.WriteUInt(#compressed, 32)
net.WriteData(compressed, #compressed)
net.Send(ply)
return true
end

local chunk = {}
for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
table.insert(chunk, entry)

local testJson = util.TableToJSON(chunk)
local testCompressed = testJson and util.Compress(testJson) or nil
if testCompressed and #testCompressed > maxBytes and #chunk > 1 then
local lastEntry = table.remove(chunk)
sendChunk(chunk)
chunk = {}
table.insert(chunk, lastEntry)
end
end

sendChunk(chunk)
end

net.Receive(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."globalquest_dialogue_step", function(l, ply)
if CQS_NetOnCooldown(ply, "globalquest_dialogue_step", 0.05) then return end
local globalId = net.ReadString()

if not globalId or globalId == "" then return end
if not cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuest_GetInstance then return end

local inst = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not inst or inst.state ~= "running" then return end
if not istable(inst.participants) or inst.participants[ply] ~= true then return end

-- Only the locked starter can drive dialogue updates
if not istable(inst.activeDialogue) then return end
if not IsValid(inst.activeDialogue.starter) or inst.activeDialogue.starter ~= ply then return end

local payload = CQS_ReadCompressedTable()
if not istable(payload) then return end

local outJson = util.TableToJSON(payload)
local outCompressed = util.Compress(outJson)
local npcModel = tostring(inst.activeDialogue.npcModel or "")

for p, _ in pairs(inst.participants) do
if IsValid(p) and p ~= ply then
net.Start(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."globalquest_dialogue_update")
net.WriteString(globalId)
net.WriteUInt(#outCompressed, 32)
net.WriteData(outCompressed, #outCompressed)
net.WriteString(npcModel)
net.Send(p)
end
end
end)
