What are the main ways to save persistent data in Garry's Mod, and when should I use each one?

Garry's Mod addons usually save data in one of four ways.

Player:SetPData and Player:GetPData
- Simple per-player values stored with SQLite.
- Good for small strings or numbers.
- Convenient, but awkward for larger structured tables.

file.Write and file.Read in garrysmod/data
- Good for addon-wide JSON files or one file per player.
- Works well with util.TableToJSON and util.JSONToTable.
- Best when you want readable files or control over save format.

sql.Query
- Good for structured tables, filtering, and larger persistent systems.
- Use sql.SQLStr when interpolating strings.

cookie
- Client-only preferences such as local UI state.
- Not secure and not authoritative for gameplay systems.

For important addon state, save on the server, key data by SteamID64 when possible, and sync only the pieces clients need.
Show a safe server-side net.Receive pattern for a Garry's Mod addon action.

```lua
util.AddNetworkString("MyAddon_RequestUse")

net.Receive("MyAddon_RequestUse", function(_, ply)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end

local ent = net.ReadEntity()
if not IsValid(ent) or ent:GetPos():DistToSqr(ply:GetPos()) > (128 * 128) then
return
end

if ent.UseCooldown and ent.UseCooldown > CurTime() then return end
ent.UseCooldown = CurTime() + 0.25

if ent.MyAddonUse then
ent:MyAddonUse(ply)
end
end)
```

The server validates the player, entity, distance, and cooldown before doing any addon action. Never trust the client request by itself.
Explain Concepts - BaseClasses in Garry's Mod Lua.

The following example demonstrates how an Entity can be used as a Base Class for multiple Child Entities.

The Parent Class (`sent_parentclass.lua`) handles all of the logic for setting up the Entity's model and physics, as well as the logic behind the Entity's unique behavior. In this case, the unique behavior is that some arbitrary visual effect is enabled before the entity draws and is disabled after it draws. In the Parent Class, this visual effect simply turns the Entity blue.

Because the Child Classes (`sent_childclass_1.lua` and `sent_childclass_2.lua`) retain the logic of their Base Class (`sent_parentclass.lua`), they only need to include a very small amount of code to create different visual effects.

`sent_childclass_1.lua` overrides the function to enable the visual effect and replaces the Parent Class's blue color effect with a rainbow color effect.
`sent_childclass_2.lua` overrides both the enable and disable functions of the visual effect. They are replaced by functions that make the Entity (Which now looks like a tire) appear to always be rolling, even when stationary.

Example

The following example demonstrates how an Entity can be used as a Base Class for multiple Child Entities.

The Parent Class (`sent_parentclass.lua`) handles all of the logic for setting up the Entity's model and physics, as well as the logic behind the Entity's unique behavior. In this case, the unique behavior is that some arbitrary visual effect is enabled before the entity draws and is disabled after it draws. In the Parent Class, this visual effect simply turns the Entity blue.

Because the Child Classes (`sent_childclass_1.lua` and `sent_childclass_2.lua`) retain the logic of their Base Class (`sent_parentclass.lua`), they only need to include a very small amount of code to create different visual effects.

`sent_childclass_1.lua` overrides the function to enable the visual effect and replaces the Parent Class's blue color effect with a rainbow color effect.
`sent_childclass_2.lua` overrides both the enable and disable functions of the visual effect. They are replaced by functions that make the Entity (Which now looks like a tire) appear to always be rolling, even when stationary.
```lua
AddCSLuaFile()

-- All Entities must have a Base Class.
-- In this case, the "base_anim" Class is being used.
-- This is one of the default Entity Classes available in Garry's Mod.
DEFINE_BASECLASS( "base_anim" )

ENT.PrintName = "Parent Class"
ENT.Category = "BaseClass Example"
ENT.RenderGroup = RENDERGROUP_TRANSLUCENT
ENT.Spawnable = true

-- This variable exists to demonstrate that a Base Class provides both
-- functions and variables to their children.
-- This is a regular-width crate model.
ENT.ModelToSpawnWith = "models/props_junk/wood_crate001a_damaged.mdl"

-- Set up the Entity
function ENT:Initialize()
if SERVER then
self:SetModel( self.ModelToSpawnWith )
self:PhysicsInit( SOLID_VPHYSICS )
self:SetMoveType( MOVETYPE_VPHYSICS )
self:SetSolid( SOLID_VPHYSICS )
end
end

-- This is a custom function we'll be using to demonstrate that children can
-- override functions from their Base Class.
function ENT:EnableVisualEffects()
-- Modify upcoming rendering to make it look blue.
render.SetColorModulation( 0, 0, 1 )
end

-- This custom function won't be overridden by the child Entity, but that is
-- purely for demonstration purposes. Any function from the Base Class can
-- be overridden by its children.
function ENT:DisableVisualEffects()
-- Reset the color of the rendering system.
render.SetColorModulation( 1, 1, 1 )
end

-- Here we use the custom functions above to change how the entity draws.
-- Because we do not override this function in the child, this will be the
-- Draw function for the child Entity.
function ENT:Draw()
self:EnableVisualEffects()
self:DrawModel()
self:DisableVisualEffects()
end
```

Example

Example usage of layers on a `anim` type SENT.
```lua
AddCSLuaFile()
DEFINE_BASECLASS( "base_gmodentity" )

ENT.PrintName = "Example Animated Overlay"
ENT.AutomaticFrameAdvance = true

function ENT:Initialize()

if ( SERVER ) then

-- Basic set up - a model with animations and physics mode so it doesn't fall over for demonstration
self:SetModel( "models/alyx.mdl" )
self:PhysicsInit( SOLID_OBB )

self:ResetSequence( "walk_all" ) -- Base sequence, walking
self:SetPoseParameter( "move_yaw", 90 ) -- Affects how the base sequence looks

-- Overlayed sequence on top of base animation, move the head
-- false at the end to not kill the animation after it plays once.
self.LayerID = self:AddGestureSequence( self:LookupSequence( "a_bg_lookupright" ), false )
self:SetLayerLooping( self.LayerID, true ) -- Loop the layer

end

end

function ENT:Think()
if ( SERVER ) then
-- Do any logic with layers here, play them, stop them, etc.

-- Make sure the animation is smooth
self:NextThink( CurTime() )
return true
end
end
```

How should I think about client rendering, 3D2D, and visual effects in Garry's Mod Lua?

Rendering belongs on the client.

Common responsibilities
- HUDPaint for 2D screen overlays.
- PostDrawOpaqueRenderables or ENT:Draw for world rendering.
- cam.Start3D2D and cam.End3D2D for world-space panels or labels.
- render and surface libraries for materials, beams, sprites, and simple shapes.

Good pattern
- The server sends compact state.
- The client turns that state into markers, outlines, 3D2D labels, or HUD widgets.
- Expensive drawing is gated by distance, visibility, or relevance.

Do not make the client authoritative for gameplay just because it draws the effect.

-- Helper: get index under mouse by distance to box centers

local function GetNearestIndex(mx, my)

local cx, cy = wheel.centerX, wheel.centerY

local n = #wheel.items

local closestDistSqr, closestIdx = 1e18, nil

for i = 1, n do

local ang = ( (i - 1) / n ) * math.pi * 2 - math.pi * 0.5

local px = cx + math.cos(ang) * wheel.radius

local py = cy + math.sin(ang) * wheel.radius

local dx = (mx - px)

local dy = (my - py)

local dSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy

if dSqr < closestDistSqr then

closestDistSqr = dSqr

closestIdx = i

end

end

return closestIdx, closestDistSqr

end

if not IsValid(target) then return false end

local sequence = target:LookupSequence(resolvedAnimation)

if not sequence or sequence < 0 then

local lowerAnimation = string.lower(resolvedAnimation)

local sequenceCount = math.max((target:GetSequenceCount() or 0) - 1, -1)

for index = 0, sequenceCount do

local sequenceName = target:GetSequenceName(index)

if sequenceName and string.find(string.lower(sequenceName), lowerAnimation, 1, true) then

sequence = index

break

end

end

end

if not sequence or sequence < 0 then return false end

target:ResetSequence(sequence, true)

target:SetCycle(0)

target:SetPlaybackRate(1)

return true

end

local function ExtractWorkshopID(input)

if not isstring(input) then return nil end

local trimmed = string.Trim(input)

if trimmed == "" then return nil end

local directId = string.match(trimmed, "^(%d+)$")

if directId then

return directId

end

local queryId = string.match(trimmed, "[?&]id=(%d+)")

if queryId then

return queryId

end

return string.match(trimmed, "/(%d+)/?$")

end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_RequestWorkshopDownload(workshopID, assetPath, cosmeticID, onComplete, assetType)

local runtimeState = self["WorkshopRuntimeDownloads"]

runtimeState.callbacks = runtimeState.callbacks or {}

assetType = assetType == "sound" and "sound" or "model"

workshopID = tostring(workshopID or ExtractWorkshopID((self:ITEM_GETTABLE(cosmeticID) or {}).WorkshopLink or "") or "")

if workshopID == "" then return false end

if assetType == "sound" then

assetPath = self:NormalizeSoundPath(assetPath)

else

assetPath = self:NormalizeModelPath(assetPath)

end

if assetPath == "" then return false end

local assetMissing = false

if assetType == "sound" then

assetMissing = self:Client_SoundMissing(assetPath)

else

assetMissing = self:Client_ModelMissing(assetPath)

end

if not assetMissing then

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, true, assetPath, cosmeticID, workshopID, assetType)

end

return true

end

if runtimeState.pending[workshopID] then

QueueWorkshopDownloadCallback(workshopID, assetPath, cosmeticID, onComplete, assetType)

return true

end

if runtimeState.mounted[workshopID] then

local stillMissing = false

if assetType == "sound" then

stillMissing = self:Client_SoundMissing(assetPath, true)

else

stillMissing = self:Client_ModelMissing(assetPath, true)

end

if not stillMissing then

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, true, assetPath, cosmeticID, workshopID, assetType)

end

return true

end

-- Recover from stale "mounted" states where files are still unresolved on this client.

runtimeState.mounted[workshopID] = nil

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = CurTime() + retryDelay

if assetType == "sound" then

ClearClientSoundAvailabilityCache(assetPath)

else

ClearClientModelAvailabilityCache(assetPath)

end

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, false, assetPath, cosmeticID, workshopID, assetType)

end

return false

end

if not CanRuntimeDownloadWorkshop(workshopID) then

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, false, assetPath, cosmeticID, workshopID, assetType)

end

return false

end

QueueWorkshopDownloadCallback(workshopID, assetPath, cosmeticID, onComplete, assetType)

runtimeState.pending[workshopID] = true

steamworks.DownloadUGC(workshopID, function(path)

runtimeState.pending[workshopID] = nil

if not path or path == "" then

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = CurTime() + retryDelay

RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, false)

return

end

local mounted, mountedFiles = game.MountGMA(path)

if mounted == false then

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = CurTime() + retryDelay

RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, false)

return

end

runtimeState.mounted[workshopID] = true

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = nil

ClearClientModelAvailabilityCache()

ClearClientSoundAvailabilityCache()

-- Defer refresh to next frame so the engine fully registers mounted files

timer.Simple(0, function()

ClearClientModelAvailabilityCache()

ClearClientSoundAvailabilityCache()

RefreshPlayersUsingMountedWorkshop(workshopID)

RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, true)

end)

end)

return true

end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_RequestWorkshopHotload(workshopID, onComplete)

local runtimeState = self["WorkshopRuntimeDownloads"]

runtimeState.callbacks = runtimeState.callbacks or {}

workshopID = tostring(workshopID or "")

if workshopID == "" then return false end

if runtimeState.pending[workshopID] then

QueueWorkshopDownloadCallback(workshopID, nil, nil, onComplete)

return true

end

if runtimeState.mounted[workshopID] then

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, true, nil, nil, workshopID, "manual")

end

return true

end

if not CanRuntimeDownloadWorkshop(workshopID) then

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, false, nil, nil, workshopID, "manual")

end

return false

end

QueueWorkshopDownloadCallback(workshopID, nil, nil, onComplete)

runtimeState.pending[workshopID] = true

steamworks.DownloadUGC(workshopID, function(path)

runtimeState.pending[workshopID] = nil

if not path or path == "" then

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = CurTime() + retryDelay

RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, false)

return

end

local mounted = game.MountGMA(path)

if mounted == false then

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = CurTime() + retryDelay

RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, false)

return

end

runtimeState.mounted[workshopID] = true

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = nil

ClearClientModelAvailabilityCache()

ClearClientSoundAvailabilityCache()

timer.Simple(0, function()

ClearClientModelAvailabilityCache()

ClearClientSoundAvailabilityCache()

RefreshPlayersUsingMountedWorkshop(workshopID)

RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, true)

end)

end)

return true

end

local function GetConfiguredSoundBindVolumeScale()

local rawVolume = tonumber(cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"] and cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"]["SoundBind_Volume"] or 50) or 50

local function BuildWorkshopSoundCandidates(soundID, preferredSoundPath)

local candidates = {}

local seenCandidates = {}

local function addCandidate(soundPath)

local normalizedSound = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeSoundPath(soundPath)

if normalizedSound == "" or seenCandidates[normalizedSound] then return end

seenCandidates[normalizedSound] = true

candidates[#candidates + 1] = normalizedSound

end

addCandidate(preferredSoundPath)

local item = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_GETTABLE(soundID)

if not item or item.IsSound ~= "true" then

return candidates

end

addCandidate(item.Sound)

if istable(item.WorkshopSounds) then

for _, workshopSound in ipairs(item.WorkshopSounds) do

addCandidate(workshopSound)

end

end

return candidates

end

local function ResolveMountedWorkshopSound(soundID, preferredSoundPath)

local candidates = BuildWorkshopSoundCandidates(soundID, preferredSoundPath)

for i = 1, #candidates do

local candidateSound = candidates[i]

if not cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_SoundMissing(candidateSound) then

return candidateSound, candidates

end

end

return "", candidates

end

local function PlayLocalCosmeticSound(soundPath, sourcePos, maxDistance, sourceEntity)

local normalizedSound = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeSoundPath(soundPath)

if normalizedSound == "" then return false end

if not isvector(sourcePos) then return false end

local localPly = LocalPlayer()

if not IsValid(localPly) then return false end

local maxDistanceValue = math.max(tonumber(maxDistance) or 800, 1)

local distance = localPly:GetPos():Distance(sourcePos)

if distance > maxDistanceValue then return false end

local volumeScale = GetConfiguredSoundBindVolumeScale() * math.max(1 - (distance / maxDistanceValue), 0)

volumeScale = math.Clamp(volumeScale, 0, 1)

if volumeScale <= 0 then return false end

if IsValid(sourceEntity) and sourceEntity:IsPlayer() then

sourceEntity:EmitSound(normalizedSound, 75, 100, volumeScale)

else

sound.Play(normalizedSound, sourcePos, 75, 100, volumeScale)

end

return true

end

local function HandleIncomingLocalCosmeticSound(sourcePly, fallbackSourcePos, soundID, soundPath, workshopID, workshopLink, maxDistance)

local item = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_GETTABLE(soundID)

local mountedSoundPath, soundCandidates = ResolveMountedWorkshopSound(soundID, soundPath)

local normalizedSound = mountedSoundPath

if normalizedSound == "" and istable(soundCandidates) and #soundCandidates > 0 then

normalizedSound = soundCandidates[1]

end

files = {}
end
if not istable(directories) then
directories = {}
end

for i = 1, #files do
local fileName = files[i]
if isstring(fileName) and CuttaCosmetic_IsSupportedSoundPath(fileName) then
local fullPath = CuttaCosmetic_NormalizeModelPath(prefix .. fileName)
local soundIndex = string.find(fullPath, "sound/", 1, true)
if soundIndex then
local relativeSoundPath = CuttaCosmetic_NormalizeSoundPath(string.sub(fullPath, soundIndex))
if relativeSoundPath ~= "" then
results[relativeSoundPath] = true
end
end
end
end

for i = 1, #directories do
local directoryName = directories[i]
if isstring(directoryName) and directoryName ~= "" then
CuttaCosmetic_ScanWorkshopDirectoryRecursiveForSounds(prefix .. directoryName, pathId, results)
end
end
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_ScanWorkshopDirectoryForModels(path)
local results = {}
local candidatePaths = CuttaCosmetic_GetWorkshopPathCandidates(path)
local pathIds = {"DATA", "GAME", "MOD"}

for i = 1, #candidatePaths do
local candidate = candidatePaths[i]
for j = 1, #pathIds do
CuttaCosmetic_ScanWorkshopDirectoryRecursive(candidate, pathIds[j], results)
end
end

local modelPaths = {}
for modelPath in pairs(results) do
modelPaths[#modelPaths + 1] = modelPath
end

table.sort(modelPaths, function(a, b)
return string.lower(a) < string.lower(b)
end)

return modelPaths
end

end)

local function CuttaCosmetic_ParseWorkshopGMAForModels(path)
local fileHandle = CuttaCosmetic_OpenWorkshopBinary(path)
if not fileHandle then return nil end

local magic = fileHandle:Read(4)
if magic ~= "GMAD" then
fileHandle:Close()
return nil
end

fileHandle:Read(1)
fileHandle:Read(8)
fileHandle:Read(8)
CuttaCosmetic_ReadNullTerminatedString(fileHandle)
CuttaCosmetic_ReadNullTerminatedString(fileHandle)
CuttaCosmetic_ReadNullTerminatedString(fileHandle)
CuttaCosmetic_ReadNullTerminatedString(fileHandle)
fileHandle:Read(4)

local modelLookup = {}
local modelPaths = {}

while true do
local entryNumber = CuttaCosmetic_ReadUInt32LE(fileHandle:Read(4))
if not entryNumber or entryNumber == 0 then break end

local fileName = CuttaCosmetic_ReadNullTerminatedString(fileHandle)
if fileName == nil then break end

local sizeData = fileHandle:Read(8)
local crcData = fileHandle:Read(4)
if not sizeData or #sizeData < 8 or not crcData or #crcData < 4 then break end

local normalizedFileName = CuttaCosmetic_NormalizeModelPath(fileName)
if normalizedFileName ~= "" and string.StartWith(normalizedFileName, "models/") and string.EndsWith(normalizedFileName, ".mdl") and not modelLookup[normalizedFileName] then
modelLookup[normalizedFileName] = true
modelPaths[#modelPaths + 1] = normalizedFileName
end
end

fileHandle:Close()

table.sort(modelPaths, function(a, b)
return string.lower(a) < string.lower(b)
end)

return modelPaths
end

fileHandle:Read(4)

local function CuttaCosmetic_MergeModelPathLists(...)
local mergedLookup = {}
local mergedPaths = {}

for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
local pathList = select(i, ...)
if istable(pathList) then
for _, modelPath in ipairs(pathList) do
local normalizedPath = CuttaCosmetic_NormalizeModelPath(modelPath)
if normalizedPath ~= "" and not mergedLookup[normalizedPath] then
mergedLookup[normalizedPath] = true
mergedPaths[#mergedPaths + 1] = normalizedPath
end
end
end
end

table.sort(mergedPaths, function(a, b)
return string.lower(a) < string.lower(b)
end)

return mergedPaths
end

local function CopyStoredModelBodygroups(bodygroups)
local copied = {}
if not istable(bodygroups) then return copied end

for _, bodygroup in ipairs(bodygroups) do
local bodygroupID = tonumber(bodygroup.id or bodygroup.index or bodygroup.bodygroup)
local bodygroupValue = tonumber(bodygroup.value)
if bodygroupID ~= nil and bodygroupValue ~= nil then
copied[math.max(math.floor(bodygroupID), 0)] = math.max(math.floor(bodygroupValue), 0)
end
end

return copied
end

local function BuildStoredModelBodygroupsPayload(bodygroups)
local payload = {}
if not istable(bodygroups) then return payload end

for bodygroupID, bodygroupValue in pairs(bodygroups) do
local sanitizedID = tonumber(bodygroupID)
local sanitizedValue = tonumber(bodygroupValue)
if sanitizedID ~= nil and sanitizedValue ~= nil then
payload[#payload + 1] = {
id = math.max(math.floor(sanitizedID), 0),
value = math.max(math.floor(sanitizedValue), 0)
}
end
end

table.sort(payload, function(a, b)
return a.id < b.id
end)

return payload
end

local requestToken = panel.workshoplookuprequesttoken
if panel.BuildTypeSpecificUI then
panel:BuildTypeSpecificUI()
end

steamworks.FileInfo(workshopId, function(result)
if not IsValid(panel) or panel.workshoplookuprequesttoken ~= requestToken then return end

if not result then
panel.workshoplookupbusy = false
panel.workshoplookupstatus = "Workshop lookup failed. Check the URL or try again."
panel.workshopmodellist = {}
panel.workshoplookupvalidatedid = nil
if panel.BuildTypeSpecificUI then
panel:BuildTypeSpecificUI()
end
return
end

panel.workshoplookuptitle = result.title
panel.workshoplookupstatus = "Downloading " .. tostring(result.title or workshopId) .. "..."

steamworks.DownloadUGC(workshopId, function(path)
if not IsValid(panel) or panel.workshoplookuprequesttoken ~= requestToken then return end

if not path or path == "" then
panel.workshoplookupbusy = false
panel.workshoplookupstatus = "Workshop download failed for " .. tostring(result.title or workshopId) .. "."
panel.workshopmodellist = {}
panel.workshoplookupvalidatedid = nil
if panel.BuildTypeSpecificUI then
panel:BuildTypeSpecificUI()
end
return
end

-- Snapshot mounted models before mounting so we can diff afterwards
local preMountLookup = CuttaCosmetic_CollectMountedModels("models/", {})

local mounted, mountedFiles = game.MountGMA(path)
if mounted == false then
panel.workshoplookupbusy = false
panel.workshoplookupstatus = "The addon downloaded, but Garry's Mod could not mount the GMA on the client."
panel.workshopmodellist = {}
panel.workshoplookupvalidatedid = nil
if panel.BuildTypeSpecificUI then
panel:BuildTypeSpecificUI()
end
return
end

panel.workshoplookupstatus = "Mounted " .. tostring(result.title or workshopId) .. ". Reading model paths..."

-- Strategy 1: Use the files table returned by game.MountGMA (most reliable)
local modelPaths = {}
if istable(mountedFiles) and #mountedFiles > 0 then
local modelLookup = {}
for i = 1, #mountedFiles do
local filePath = mountedFiles[i]
if isstring(filePath) then
local normalizedPath = CuttaCosmetic_NormalizeModelPath(filePath)
if normalizedPath ~= "" and string.EndsWith(normalizedPath, ".mdl") and string.StartWith(normalizedPath, "models/") and not modelLookup[normalizedPath] then
modelLookup[normalizedPath] = true
modelPaths[#modelPaths + 1] = normalizedPath
end
end
end
end

-- Strategy 2: Diff the filesystem to find newly mounted models
if #modelPaths == 0 then
modelPaths = CuttaCosmetic_GetNewMountedModelPaths(preMountLookup)
end

-- Strategy 3: Parse the GMA binary directly (original fallback)
if #modelPaths == 0 then
modelPaths = CuttaCosmetic_ParseWorkshopGMAForModels(path) or {}
end

-- Strategy 4: Scan the filesystem at the download path for models
if #modelPaths == 0 then
modelPaths = CuttaCosmetic_ScanWorkshopDirectoryForModels(path)
end

table.sort(modelPaths, function(a, b)
return string.lower(a) < string.lower(b)
end)

panel.workshoplookupbusy = false
panel.workshoplookupvalidatedid = workshopId
panel.workshopmodellist = table.Copy(modelPaths)
panel.savedworkshopmodellist = table.Copy(modelPaths)
cutta_cosmetic_shop["WorkshopModelLookupCache"][workshopId] = table.Copy(modelPaths)
cutta_cosmetic_shop["WorkshopModelLookupTitleCache"][workshopId] = result.title

if #modelPaths > 0 then
panel.workshoplookupstatus = "Found " .. tostring(#modelPaths) .. " model paths in " .. tostring(result.title or workshopId) .. "."
else
panel.workshoplookupstatus = "No model paths were found inside the downloaded GMA for this workshop addon."
end

if panel.BuildTypeSpecificUI then
panel:BuildTypeSpecificUI()
end
end)
end)
end

local function ApplyPreviewBodygroups()
if not IsValid(previewPanel) or not IsValid(previewPanel.Entity) then return end
if not istable(newframe.newpanel.modelbodygroups) then return end

for bodygroupID, bodygroupValue in pairs(newframe.newpanel.modelbodygroups) do

local sanitizedValue = tonumber(bodygroupValue)
if sanitizedID ~= nil and sanitizedValue ~= nil then
previewPanel.Entity:SetBodygroup(math.max(math.floor(sanitizedID), 0), math.max(math.floor(sanitizedValue), 0))
end
end
end

local function RebuildModelBodygroupsEditor()
if not IsValid(modelBodygroupsHolder) then return end

for _, child in ipairs(modelBodygroupsHolder:GetChildren()) do
child:Remove()
end

local nextHeight = 0
local function AddInfoRow(text)
cutta_ui_library:Panel(modelBodygroupsHolder, cutta_ui_library["DockMode"]["TOP"], {0,0,0,5}, text, 28)
nextHeight = nextHeight + 33
end

if not newframe.newpanel.itemmodeltext or newframe.newpanel.itemmodeltext == "" then
AddInfoRow("Enter or select a model path to edit bodygroups.")
modelBodygroupsHolder:SetTall(math.max(nextHeight, 33))
return
end

if not IsValid(previewPanel) or not IsValid(previewPanel.Entity) then
AddInfoRow("Load the preview model to inspect bodygroups.")
modelBodygroupsHolder:SetTall(math.max(nextHeight, 33))
return
end

local ent = previewPanel.Entity
local editableBodygroups = 0
local previousBodygroups = newframe.newpanel.modelbodygroups or {}
local validBodygroups = {}
newframe.newpanel.modelbodygroups = validBodygroups
for _, bodygroup in ipairs(ent:GetBodyGroups() or {}) do
local bodygroupID = tonumber(bodygroup.id or bodygroup.index or bodygroup.bodygroup)
local bodygroupCount = tonumber(bodygroup.num or bodygroup.submodels or 1) or 1
local maxValue = math.max(math.floor(bodygroupCount) - 1, 0)
if bodygroupID ~= nil and maxValue > 0 then
editableBodygroups = editableBodygroups + 1
local bodygroupName = tostring(bodygroup.name or ("Bodygroup " .. tostring(bodygroupID)))
cutta_ui_library:Panel(modelBodygroupsHolder, cutta_ui_library["DockMode"]["TOP"], {0,0,0,5}, bodygroupName .. " (0-" .. tostring(maxValue) .. ")", 28)
nextHeight = nextHeight + 33

local entry = cutta_ui_library:Number_Entry(modelBodygroupsHolder, cutta_ui_library["DockMode"]["TOP"], {0,0,0,5}, 28, "0")
local currentValue = tonumber(previousBodygroups[bodygroupID])
if currentValue == nil then
currentValue = ent:GetBodygroup(bodygroupID) or 0
end
currentValue = math.Clamp(math.floor(currentValue), 0, maxValue)
validBodygroups[bodygroupID] = currentValue
entry:SetValue(tostring(currentValue))
nextHeight = nextHeight + 33

function entry:Think()
local rawValue = self:GetValue() or self:GetText()
local numericValue = tonumber(rawValue)
if numericValue == nil then
numericValue = 0
end
numericValue = math.Clamp(math.floor(numericValue), 0, maxValue)

if tostring(rawValue) ~= tostring(numericValue) then
self:SetValue(tostring(numericValue))
end

validBodygroups[bodygroupID] = numericValue
newframe.newpanel.modelbodygroups[bodygroupID] = numericValue

if IsValid(previewPanel) and IsValid(previewPanel.Entity) and previewPanel.Entity:GetBodygroup(bodygroupID) ~= numericValue then
previewPanel.Entity:SetBodygroup(bodygroupID, numericValue)
end
end
end
end

if editableBodygroups == 0 then
AddInfoRow("This model has no editable bodygroups.")
end

modelBodygroupsHolder:SetTall(math.max(nextHeight, 33))
end

local function safeKeyName(key)

local name = key and input.GetKeyName(key) or nil

if not name or name == "" then

return tostring(key or "?")

end

return string.upper(name)

end

local ignoredBindInputs = {

[MOUSE_LEFT] = true,

[MOUSE_RIGHT] = true,

[MOUSE_MIDDLE] = true,

}

local function startKeyBindListener(timerName, button, getCurrentKeyFn, saveKeyFn, friendlyLabel)

if timer.Exists(timerName) then

timer.Remove(timerName)

end

local startTime = CurTime()

local timeoutSeconds = 10

local waitingForRelease = true

local lastDown = {}

local currentKey = getCurrentKeyFn and getCurrentKeyFn() or nil

if IsValid(button) then

button.DisplayText = "Release keys"

end

timer.Create(timerName, 0, 0, function()

if not IsValid(ply) or not IsValid(button) then

timer.Remove(timerName)

return

end

if CurTime() - startTime > timeoutSeconds then

button.DisplayText = safeKeyName(currentKey)

cutta_ui_library:Create_Notification("Keybind change timed out.", "ERROR")

timer.Remove(timerName)

return

end

local anyDown = false

local pressedKey = nil

for k = 1, 255 do

if not ignoredBindInputs[k] then

local isDown = input.IsKeyDown(k)

if isDown then

anyDown = true

end

if isDown and not lastDown[k] and not pressedKey then

pressedKey = k

end

lastDown[k] = isDown

end

end

if waitingForRelease then

if anyDown then

return

end

waitingForRelease = false

button.DisplayText = "Press a key"

return

end

if pressedKey then

saveKeyFn(pressedKey)

local function collectWOSAnimationsFromPlayerModel(targetPly)

if not IsValid(targetPly) then return nil, {}, "Player is not valid" end

local modelPath = string.Trim(tostring(targetPly:GetModel() or ""))

if modelPath == "" then

return nil, {}, "Player model could not be read"

end

local matches = {}

local seen = {}

local seqCount = math.max((targetPly:GetSequenceCount() or 0) - 1, -1)

for index = 0, seqCount do

local sequenceName = targetPly:GetSequenceName(index)

if sequenceName and sequenceName ~= "" then

local lowered = string.lower(sequenceName)

if string.StartWith(lowered, "wos_") and not seen[lowered] then

seen[lowered] = true

matches[#matches + 1] = sequenceName

end

end

end

table.sort(matches, function(a, b)

return string.lower(a) < string.lower(b)

end)

return modelPath, matches

end

local function EnsureCoreTables()
local function NormalizeArrayLikeTable(tbl)
if not istable(tbl) then return {} end

if #tbl > 0 then
return tbl
end

local remapped = {}
local maxIndex = 0
local foundNumericKeys = false

for key, value in pairs(tbl) do
local numericKey = nil
if isnumber(key) then
numericKey = math.floor(key)
elseif isstring(key) then
numericKey = tonumber(key)
if numericKey ~= nil then
numericKey = math.floor(numericKey)
end
end

if numericKey ~= nil and numericKey >= 1 then
remapped[numericKey] = value
foundNumericKeys = true
if numericKey > maxIndex then
maxIndex = numericKey
end
end
end

if not foundNumericKeys then
return tbl
end

local normalized = {}
for index = 1, maxIndex do
if remapped[index] ~= nil then
normalized[#normalized + 1] = remapped[index]
end
end

return normalized
end

cutta_cosmetic_shop.NormalizeArrayTable = cutta_cosmetic_shop.NormalizeArrayTable or function(self, tbl)
return NormalizeArrayLikeTable(tbl)
end

cutta_cosmetic_shop["Items"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeArrayTable(cutta_cosmetic_shop["Items"] or {})
cutta_cosmetic_shop["Categories"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeArrayTable(cutta_cosmetic_shop["Categories"] or {})

cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"] or {}
cutta_cosmetic_shop["_ItemIndex"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop["_ItemIndex"] or {}
cutta_cosmetic_shop["_ItemBatchDepth"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop["_ItemBatchDepth"] or 0
cutta_cosmetic_shop["DarkRPMoneyCoinExchange"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop["DarkRPMoneyCoinExchange"] or {
MoneyCost = 100000,

}
cutta_cosmetic_shop["InventoryMoneyCoinExchange"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop["InventoryMoneyCoinExchange"] or {

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeModelPath(modelPath)
if not isstring(modelPath) then return "" end

local normalized = string.Trim(modelPath)
if normalized == "" then return "" end

normalized = string.Replace(normalized, "\\", "/")
normalized = string.lower(normalized)

while string.find(normalized, "//", 1, true) do
normalized = string.Replace(normalized, "//", "/")
end

return normalized
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeSoundPath(soundPath)
if not isstring(soundPath) then return "" end

local normalized = string.Trim(soundPath)
if normalized == "" then return "" end

normalized = string.Replace(normalized, "\\", "/")
normalized = string.lower(normalized)

while string.find(normalized, "//", 1, true) do
normalized = string.Replace(normalized, "//", "/")
end

while string.StartWith(normalized, "/") do
normalized = string.sub(normalized, 2)
end

if string.StartWith(normalized, "sound/") then
normalized = string.sub(normalized, 7)
end

return normalized
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:ExtractWorkshopID(input)
if not isstring(input) then return nil end

local trimmed = string.Trim(input)
if trimmed == "" then return nil end

local directId = string.match(trimmed, "^(%d+)$")
if directId then
return directId
end

local queryId = string.match(trimmed, "[?&]id=(%d+)")
if queryId then
return queryId
end

return string.match(trimmed, "/(%d+)/?$")
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:BuildWorkshopLink(workshopID)
workshopID = tostring(workshopID or "")
if workshopID == "" then return "" end

return "https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=" .. workshopID
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeManualWorkshopLinkEntries(entries)
EnsureCoreTables()

local normalizedEntries = {}
local seenWorkshopIDs = {}
local normalizedInput = self:NormalizeArrayTable(entries or {})

for _, entry in ipairs(normalizedInput) do
if istable(entry) then
local rawLink = string.Trim(tostring(entry.WorkshopLink or entry.Link or entry.link or ""))
local workshopID = tostring(entry.WorkshopID or entry.workshopid or self:ExtractWorkshopID(rawLink) or "")
local workshopTitle = string.Trim(tostring(entry.WorkshopTitle or entry.Title or entry.title or ""))

if workshopID ~= "" and not seenWorkshopIDs[workshopID] then
seenWorkshopIDs[workshopID] = true

local workshopLink = rawLink
if workshopLink == "" then
workshopLink = self:BuildWorkshopLink(workshopID)
end

normalizedEntries[#normalizedEntries + 1] = {
WorkshopID = workshopID,
WorkshopLink = workshopLink,
WorkshopTitle = workshopTitle ~= "" and workshopTitle or nil,
AutoMountOnJoin = entry.AutoMountOnJoin == true
or entry.AutoMount == true
or entry.automountonjoin == true
or entry.automount == true
}
end
end
end

table.sort(normalizedEntries, function(a, b)
local aTitle = string.lower(tostring(a.WorkshopTitle or a.WorkshopLink or a.WorkshopID or ""))
local bTitle = string.lower(tostring(b.WorkshopTitle or b.WorkshopLink or b.WorkshopID or ""))
if aTitle == bTitle then
return string.lower(tostring(a.WorkshopLink or a.WorkshopID or "")) < string.lower(tostring(b.WorkshopLink or b.WorkshopID or ""))
end

return aTitle < bTitle
end)

return normalizedEntries
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:RebuildItemCaches()
EnsureCoreTables()

local items = self:NormalizeArrayTable(cutta_cosmetic_shop["Items"])
cutta_cosmetic_shop["Items"] = items
local itemIndex = {}
local categories = {}
local seenCategories = {}
local workshopModelIndex = {}

local function IndexWorkshopLinkedModel(itemID, itemData, modelPath)
local normalizedModel = self:NormalizeModelPath(modelPath)
if normalizedModel == "" or workshopModelIndex[normalizedModel] then return end

workshopModelIndex[normalizedModel] = {
itemID = itemID,
workshopID = itemData.WorkshopID,
workshopLink = itemData.WorkshopLink,
modelPath = normalizedModel
}
end

local function ParseHiddenInCosmeticsMenu(value)
if value == nil then return nil end
if value == true or value == 1 then return true end
if isstring(value) then
local normalized = string.lower(string.Trim(value))
if normalized == "true" or normalized == "1" or normalized == "yes" then
return true
end
if normalized == "" or normalized == "false" or normalized == "0" or normalized == "no" or normalized == "nil" then
return nil
end
end
return nil
end

for index, itemData in ipairs(items) do
if istable(itemData) and itemData.ID then
local itemID = tostring(itemData.ID)
itemData.ID = itemID
itemIndex[itemID] = index

local category = itemData.Category or "Misc"
itemData.Category = category
itemData.Price = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(itemData.Price) or 0), 0)
if tonumber(itemData.PremiumPrice) and tonumber(itemData.PremiumPrice) > 0 then
itemData.Price = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(itemData.PremiumPrice) or 0), 0)
itemData.PriceCurrency = "premium"
itemData.PremiumPrice = nil
end
itemData.PriceCurrency = self:NormalizePriceCurrency(itemData.PriceCurrency)

if itemData.HideInCosmeticsMenu ~= nil then
itemData.HideInCosmeticsMenu = ParseHiddenInCosmeticsMenu(itemData.HideInCosmeticsMenu)
end

if not seenCategories[category] then
seenCategories[category] = true
categories[#categories + 1] = category
end

if itemData.WorkshopID ~= nil then
itemData.WorkshopID = tostring(itemData.WorkshopID)
if itemData.WorkshopID == "" then
itemData.WorkshopID = nil
end
end

if itemData.WorkshopLink ~= nil then
itemData.WorkshopLink = string.Trim(tostring(itemData.WorkshopLink))
if itemData.WorkshopLink == "" then
itemData.WorkshopLink = nil
end
end

if itemData.IsSound == "true" then
itemData.Sound = self:NormalizeSoundPath(itemData.Sound)
elseif itemData.IsAnimation == "true" then
itemData.Animation = string.Trim(tostring(itemData.Animation or ""))
itemData.WorkshopID = nil
itemData.WorkshopLink = nil
itemData.WorkshopAnimations = nil
end

if (itemData.WorkshopID or itemData.WorkshopLink) and itemData.IsSound ~= "true" and itemData.IsAnimation ~= "true" then
IndexWorkshopLinkedModel(itemID, itemData, itemData.Model)

if itemData.IsModel == "true" then
IndexWorkshopLinkedModel(itemID, itemData, itemData.HandsModel)
end
end

if itemData.IsSound == "true" then
if (not istable(itemData.WorkshopSounds) or #itemData.WorkshopSounds == 0) and (itemData.WorkshopID or itemData.WorkshopLink) then
local fallbackWorkshopSounds = {}
local normalizedItemSound = self:NormalizeSoundPath(itemData.Sound)
if normalizedItemSound ~= "" then
fallbackWorkshopSounds[#fallbackWorkshopSounds + 1] = normalizedItemSound
end
if #fallbackWorkshopSounds > 0 then
itemData.WorkshopSounds = fallbackWorkshopSounds
end
end

if istable(itemData.WorkshopSounds) then
local sanitizedWorkshopSounds = {}
local seenWorkshopSounds = {}
for _, workshopSound in ipairs(itemData.WorkshopSounds) do
local normalizedWorkshopSound = self:NormalizeSoundPath(workshopSound)
if normalizedWorkshopSound ~= "" and not seenWorkshopSounds[normalizedWorkshopSound] then
seenWorkshopSounds[normalizedWorkshopSound] = true
sanitizedWorkshopSounds[#sanitizedWorkshopSounds + 1] = normalizedWorkshopSound
end
end
itemData.WorkshopSounds = sanitizedWorkshopSounds
end
elseif (not istable(itemData.WorkshopModels) or #itemData.WorkshopModels == 0) and (itemData.WorkshopID or itemData.WorkshopLink) then
local fallbackWorkshopModels = {}
local normalizedItemModel = self:NormalizeModelPath(itemData.Model)
if normalizedItemModel ~= "" then
fallbackWorkshopModels[#fallbackWorkshopModels + 1] = normalizedItemModel
end
local normalizedHandsModel = self:NormalizeModelPath(itemData.HandsModel)
if normalizedHandsModel ~= "" and normalizedHandsModel ~= normalizedItemModel then
fallbackWorkshopModels[#fallbackWorkshopModels + 1] = normalizedHandsModel
end
if #fallbackWorkshopModels > 0 then
itemData.WorkshopModels = fallbackWorkshopModels
end
end

if itemData.IsSound ~= "true" and istable(itemData.WorkshopModels) then
local sanitizedWorkshopModels = {}
local seenWorkshopModels = {}
for _, workshopModel in ipairs(itemData.WorkshopModels) do
local normalizedWorkshopModel = self:NormalizeModelPath(workshopModel)
if normalizedWorkshopModel ~= "" and not seenWorkshopModels[normalizedWorkshopModel] then
seenWorkshopModels[normalizedWorkshopModel] = true
sanitizedWorkshopModels[#sanitizedWorkshopModels + 1] = normalizedWorkshopModel
end
end
itemData.WorkshopModels = sanitizedWorkshopModels
end
end
end

cutta_cosmetic_shop["_ItemIndex"] = itemIndex
cutta_cosmetic_shop["Categories"] = categories
cutta_cosmetic_shop["_WorkshopModelIndex"] = workshopModelIndex
cutta_cosmetic_shop["_ItemCachesReady"] = true

return itemIndex, categories
end

-- Returns true if the player's usergroup is permitted for this item.
-- Accepts either `item.RequiredUserGroups` (table of strings) or legacy `item.RequiredUserGroup` (single string).
function cutta_cosmetic_shop:Item_UserGroupAllowed(ply, cosmeticid)
if not IsValid(ply) or not cosmeticid then return true end
local item = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_GETTABLE(cosmeticid)
if not item then return true end
local plyGroup = string.lower(ply:GetUserGroup() or "")

-- Gather required groups into a flat table of lowercase strings
local required = {}

-- If server stored a table already
if istable(item.RequiredUserGroups) then
for _, g in ipairs(item.RequiredUserGroups) do
if isstring(g) and g ~= "" then
table.insert(required, string.lower(g))
end
end
end

-- Legacy single string field
if isstring(item.RequiredUserGroup) and item.RequiredUserGroup ~= "" then
local s = item.RequiredUserGroup
-- If it contains commas, treat as multi-list
if s:find(",", 1, true) then
for token in s:gmatch("[^,]+") do
local trimmed = string.Trim(token)
if trimmed ~= "" then
table.insert(required, string.lower(trimmed))
end
end
else
table.insert(required, string.lower(s))
end
end

-- If original creation sent a JSON string and was not parsed server-side
if #required == 0 and isstring(item.RequiredUserGroups) and item.RequiredUserGroups ~= "" then
local raw = item.RequiredUserGroups
local ok, parsed = pcall(util.JSONToTable, raw)
if ok and istable(parsed) then
for _, g in ipairs(parsed) do
if isstring(g) and g ~= "" then
table.insert(required, string.lower(g))
end
end
elseif raw:find(",", 1, true) then
for token in raw:gmatch("[^,]+") do
local trimmed = string.Trim(token)
if trimmed ~= "" then
table.insert(required, string.lower(trimmed))
end
end
elseif raw ~= "" then
table.insert(required, string.lower(raw))
end
end

-- No restriction specified
if #required == 0 then return true end

for _, g in ipairs(required) do
if plyGroup == g then
return true
end
end
return false
end

if not item then return false end
if (item.RequiredUserGroups and istable(item.RequiredUserGroups) and #item.RequiredUserGroups > 0) or (item.RequiredUserGroup and item.RequiredUserGroup ~= "") then
return true
end
return false
end

local function boolFromValue(value, defaultValue)
if value == nil then return defaultValue == true end
if value == true or value == 1 then return true end

if isstring(value) then
local normalized = string.lower(string.Trim(value))
if normalized == "true" or normalized == "1" or normalized == "yes" then
return true
end

if normalized == "false" or normalized == "0" or normalized == "no" or normalized == "" then
return false
end
end

return defaultValue == true
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:SanitizeCharacterPropsTable(ply, tbl)
if not IsValid(ply) or not istable(tbl) then return {} end

local out = {}
for rawId, rawInfo in pairs(tbl) do
local cosmeticid = tostring(rawId or "")
if cosmeticid == "" then continue end
if not cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_VALID(cosmeticid) then continue end
if not cutta_cosmetic_shop:PLY_ITEM_CHECK(ply, cosmeticid) then continue end

local itemType = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_TYPE_CHECK(cosmeticid)
if itemType ~= "IsProp" and itemType ~= "IsPet" then
continue
end

if not istable(rawInfo) then continue end
local added = rawInfo.added == true or rawInfo.added == "true"
if not added then
continue
end

local info = {}
info.added = true
info.model = tostring(rawInfo.model or cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_MODEL_GET(cosmeticid) or "")
info.cosmetic_id = cosmeticid
info.boneselect = tostring(rawInfo.boneselect or "ValveBiped.Bip01_Head1")

info.posx = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.posx) or 0, -300, 300)
info.posy = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.posy) or 0, -300, 300)
info.posz = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.posz) or 0, -300, 300)
info.pitch = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.pitch) or 0, -180, 180)
info.yaw = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.yaw) or 0, -180, 180)
info.roll = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.roll) or 0, -180, 180)

info.scale = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ClampCosmeticScale(rawInfo.scale)

if itemType == "IsPet" then
local defaultAnim = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_PETANIM_CHECK(cosmeticid)
info.petanimation = tostring(rawInfo.petanimation or defaultAnim or "idle")
else
-- keep field absent for props (cleaner saves)
if rawInfo.petanimation ~= nil then
-- do nothing
end
end

out[cosmeticid] = info
end

return out
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:ConvertDarkRPMoneyToCoins(ply, requestedCount)
if not IsValid(ply) then
return false, "Player is not valid."
end

if not DarkRP then
return false, "DarkRP is not active on this server."
end

if not isfunction(ply.getDarkRPVar) or not isfunction(ply.addMoney) then
return false, "DarkRP money is unavailable right now."
end

local moneyCost, coinReward = self:GetDarkRPMoneyCoinExchangeRate()
if moneyCost <= 0 or coinReward <= 0 then
return false, "The exchange rate is invalid."
end

local currentMoney = self:GetDarkRPMoney(ply)
local affordableCount = math.floor(math.max(currentMoney, 0) / moneyCost)
if affordableCount < 1 then
return false, "You need $" .. string.Comma(moneyCost) .. " DarkRP money to convert."
end

local convertCount = math.min(sanitize_requested_conversion_count(requestedCount), affordableCount)
local totalMoneyCost = moneyCost * convertCount
local totalCoinReward = coinReward * convertCount

if isfunction(ply.canAfford) and not ply:canAfford(totalMoneyCost) then
return false, "You need $" .. string.Comma(totalMoneyCost) .. " DarkRP money to convert."
end

local removedMoney = pcall(function()
ply:addMoney(-totalMoneyCost)
end)
if not removedMoney then
return false, "Failed to remove DarkRP money."

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:ConvertInventoryMoneyToCoins(ply, requestedCount)
if not IsValid(ply) then
return false, "Player is not valid."
end

if not cutta_inventory_system or not isfunction(cutta_inventory_system.Get_PlayerMoney) or not isfunction(cutta_inventory_system.Player_MoneyGive) then
return false, "Cutta Inventory money is unavailable on this server."
end

if DarkRP then
return false, "Cutta Inventory is currently using DarkRP money. Use the DarkRP conversion instead."
end

local moneyCost, coinReward = self:GetInventoryMoneyCoinExchangeRate()
if moneyCost <= 0 or coinReward <= 0 then
return false, "The exchange rate is invalid."
end

local currentMoney = self:GetInventoryMoney(ply)
local affordableCount = math.floor(math.max(currentMoney, 0) / moneyCost)
if affordableCount < 1 then
return false, "You need $" .. string.Comma(moneyCost) .. " Cutta Inventory money to convert."
end

local convertCount = math.min(sanitize_requested_conversion_count(requestedCount), affordableCount)
local totalMoneyCost = moneyCost * convertCount
local totalCoinReward = coinReward * convertCount

local removedMoney = pcall(function()
cutta_inventory_system:Player_MoneyGive(ply, -totalMoneyCost, "Cosmetic coin conversion")
end)
if not removedMoney then
return false, "Failed to remove Cutta Inventory money."
end

self:COINS_ADD(ply, totalCoinReward)
return true, "Converted $" .. string.Comma(totalMoneyCost) .. " Cutta Inventory money into " .. string.Comma(totalCoinReward) .. " cosmetic coins" .. format_exchange_suffix(convertCount) .. "."
end

self:Transfer(ply)

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:GetTimedGiveawayPrize()
local items = self["Items"] or {}
local pool = {}

local function itemHasUserGroupRestriction(itemData)
if not itemData then return false end
if istable(itemData.RequiredUserGroups) and #itemData.RequiredUserGroups > 0 then
return true
end
if isstring(itemData.RequiredUserGroup) and string.Trim(itemData.RequiredUserGroup) ~= "" then
return true
end
if isstring(itemData.RequiredUserGroups) and string.Trim(itemData.RequiredUserGroups) ~= "" then
return true
end
return false
end

for _, itemData in pairs(items) do
if itemData and itemData.ID and not itemHasUserGroupRestriction(itemData) then
pool[#pool + 1] = itemData
end
end

if #pool == 0 then return nil end
return pool[math.random(#pool)]
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:StartTimedGiveaway()

if not enabled then return false, "Timed giveaways are disabled" end
if timer.Exists("CuttaCosmetic_Giveaway_Announce") then
return false, "A giveaway is already running"
end

local onlinePlayers = player.GetHumans()
if #onlinePlayers < minPlayers then
return false, "Not enough players online"
end

local prize = self:GetTimedGiveawayPrize()
if not prize then

end

local winnerIndex
local forcedMatched = false
local forced = normalizeSteam64(forcedSteamID64)
if forced then
for idx, entry in RandomPairs(entries) do

end
end

winnerIndex = math.random(#entries)

net.WriteUInt(winnerIndex, 8)
net.WriteFloat(rollDuration)

local msg = string.format("[Cutta Cosmetics] %s has won the giveaway!", winnerEntry.name)

end)

return true, winnerEntry, forcedMatched
end

Based on the provided code files, here is what **Cutta Cosmetics** (and Cutta Inventory) are in Garry's Mod:

## What They Are

They are a **custom cosmetic system** for Garry's Mod that allows players to:

1. **Create custom items** - Players can create their own cosmetic items with names, categories, prices, and workshop links
2. **Manage inventory** - Items are stored in a database as "inventory" objects within the game
3. **Customize character appearance** - Players can equip these custom cosmetics onto their models
4. **Sound and animation bindings** - Players can bind sounds and animations to their character
5. **Giveaway system** - Timed giveaway feature where players compete for prizes
6. **Admin tools** - Admins can manage items, remove cosmetics, set player currencies, etc.

## How It Works

The system uses a combination of:

- **Lua scripting** (File 1-19): Handles all the logic for item creation, management, and gameplay
- **Cutta Inventory System** (File 2): Manages player currency (Cosmetic Coins, Premium Coins)
- **Net communication** (File 18): Transfers items between players via network packets
- **Server-side storage** (File 20): Saves all player data to JSON files in the `cuttacosmeticshop` folder

## Key Features

### Main Components:

1. **Cosmetics Panel**: A UI where players can browse and equip cosmetics
2. **Inventory System**: Stores items as inventory objects with properties like name, model, price, category
3. **Giveaway System**: Timed giveaway feature for competitive gameplay
4. **Sound/Animation Binds**: Allows players to bind sounds and animations to their character

local CIS_PLAYER_LOAD_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES = 16000

local function CIS_SendPlayerLoadCompressedChunks(ply, compressedData)
if not IsValid(ply) or not isstring(compressedData) or #compressedData == 0 then return end

local maxChunkSize = CIS_PLAYER_LOAD_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES
local totalSize = #compressedData
local totalChunks = math.ceil(totalSize / maxChunkSize)

local function sendChunk(chunkIndex)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
local startIndex = (chunkIndex - 1) * maxChunkSize + 1
local endIndex = math.min(totalSize, startIndex + maxChunkSize - 1)
local part = string.sub(compressedData, startIndex, endIndex)

if isstring(part) and #part > 0 then
net.Start(cutta_inventory_system["StringName"].."Player_Load_CL_Chunk")
net.WriteUInt(totalChunks, 16)
net.WriteUInt(chunkIndex, 16)
net.WriteUInt(totalSize, 32)
net.WriteUInt(#part, 16)
net.WriteData(part, #part)
net.Send(ply)
end

if chunkIndex < totalChunks then
timer.Simple(0, function()
sendChunk(chunkIndex + 1)
end)
end
end

sendChunk(1)
end

function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_SyncLayoutFromRaw(ply)

end

end

if table.IsEmpty(currentLayout) then

local rebuiltLayout = {}

if isfunction(cutta_inventory_system.Get_PlayerInvCapacity) then
maxSlots = math.max(cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerInvCapacity(ply), 0)
else
maxSlots = math.max(tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxInventorySize"] or cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["StartingInventorySize"] or 0) or 0, 0)
end

for _, class in ipairs(rawInventory) do

if not isstring(class) or not cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class] then continue end

local stackIndex = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_FindFirstSlotByClass(rebuiltLayout, class)

if stackIndex then

rebuiltLayout[stackIndex].Amount = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(rebuiltLayout[stackIndex]) + 1

else

local emptyIndex = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_FindFirstEmptySlot(rebuiltLayout, math.max(maxSlots, #rebuiltLayout + 1)) or (#rebuiltLayout + 1)

rebuiltLayout[emptyIndex] = {

Class = class,

Amount = 1,

}

end

end

data["InventoryLayout"] = rebuiltLayout

return

end

local firstSlotForClass = {}

local layoutSize = math.max(#currentLayout, cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerInvCapacity(ply))

for index = 1, layoutSize do

local slot = currentLayout[index]

local class = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(slot)

if class and cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class] and (rawCounts[class] or 0) > 0 then

local amount = math.min(cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(slot), rawCounts[class])

normalizedLayout[index] = {

Amount = amount,

}

rawCounts[class] = rawCounts[class] - amount

firstSlotForClass[class] = firstSlotForClass[class] or index

else

normalizedLayout[index] = {}

end

end

for class, remaining in pairs(rawCounts) do

if remaining <= 0 then continue end

local existingIndex = firstSlotForClass[class]

if existingIndex then

normalizedLayout[existingIndex].Amount = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(normalizedLayout[existingIndex]) + remaining

else

local emptyIndex = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_FindFirstEmptySlot(normalizedLayout, math.max(layoutSize, #normalizedLayout + 1)) or (#normalizedLayout + 1)

normalizedLayout[emptyIndex] = {

Class = class,

Amount = remaining,

}

firstSlotForClass[class] = emptyIndex

end

end

data["InventoryLayout"] = normalizedLayout

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_FindSafeDropPosition(ply)

maxs = maxs,

filter = ply,

mask = MASK_SOLID,

})

local pos = downTrace.HitPos + Vector(0, 0, 8)

local solidTrace = util.TraceHull({

start = pos,

endpos = pos,

mins = mins,

maxs = maxs,

filter = ply,

mask = MASK_SOLID,

})

if not solidTrace.StartSolid then

return pos

end

end

end

end

mins = mins,

maxs = maxs,

end

end

if not isstring(ammoType) or ammoType == "" or game.GetAmmoID(ammoType) == -1 then

return nil

end

local ammoAmount = tonumber(itemData.AmmoAmount or itemData.UseAmount or itemData.Ammo or 0) or 0

if ammoAmount <= 0 and ammoDefaults then

ammoAmount = tonumber(ammoDefaults.AmmoAmount or 0) or 0

end

ammoAmount = math.max(math.floor(ammoAmount > 0 and ammoAmount or 1), 1)

return ammoType, ammoAmount

end

local function CIS_SpawnInventoryWorldEntity(ply, itemData, dropPos, placedEntity)

if not IsValid(ply) then return false end
if not istable(itemData) then return false end
if not isstring(itemData.Class) or itemData.Class == "" then return false end
if not isvector(dropPos) then return false end

local ent = ents.Create(itemData.Class)

if not IsValid(ent) then return false end

ent:SetPos(dropPos)
ent:SetAngles(Angle(0, ply:EyeAngles().y, 0))
ent.CIS_InventoryPlaced = placedEntity == true
ent:Spawn()

timer.Simple(0, function()
if not IsValid(ent) then return false end
if not IsValid(ply) then return false end
ent:Use(ply, ply, USE_ON, 1)
end)
end

if ent.Activate then

ent:Activate()

end

local phys = ent:GetPhysicsObject()

if IsValid(phys) then

if placedEntity == true then

phys:Wake()

else

phys:SetVelocity((ply:GetAimVector() * 90) + Vector(0, 0, 30))

end

end

return true

end

local function CIS_GetMerchantPurchaseUnitPrice(ply, class, itemData, fallbackAmount, typeis)

local unitPrice = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(itemData and itemData.Price or fallbackAmount or 0) or 0))
local adjustedAmount = hook.Run("CuttaDarkRPJobLevels_GetMerchantPrice", ply, class or "", unitPrice, typeis)

if adjustedAmount == nil then

return unitPrice

end

return math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(adjustedAmount) or unitPrice))

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Player_Purchase(ply,amount,class,typeis,quantity)

amount = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0))
quantity = math.min(math.max(math.floor(tonumber(quantity) or 1), 1), 2047)

-- Optional: require a minimum level for weapon purchases (Cutta Leveling V2)

if typeis == "item" and isstring(class) and class ~= "" then

local itemData = cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class]

if not itemData then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return

end

if not cutta_inventory_system:Is_ItemBuyEnabled(itemData) then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply, "Buying Disabled")
cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return

end

if itemData and itemData.Type == "weapon" and cutta_inventory_system:IsLevelingV2Installed() then

local req = tonumber(itemData.LevelReq or 0) or 0

if req > 0 then

local level = cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerLevel(ply)

if level < req then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply, "Locked: Requires Level " .. tostring(req))

return

end

end

end

amount = CIS_GetMerchantPurchaseUnitPrice(ply, class, itemData, amount, typeis) * quantity

end

if DarkRP then

if ply:getDarkRPVar("money") < amount then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply,"You Are Broke")

return

end

else

if ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Money"] < amount then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply,"You Are Broke")

return

end

end

if typeis == "item" and class then

if not cutta_inventory_system:Player_AddItem(ply,class,quantity) then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply,"Inventory Full")

return

end

end

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MoneyGive(ply,-amount)

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Player_MoneyGive(ply,amount,reason)

if DarkRP then

ply:addMoney(amount)

else

if not ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] then

ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] = {}

end

ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Money"] = ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Money"]+amount

if ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Money"] >= cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxMoney"] then

ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Money"] = cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxMoney"]

end

end

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

end

local function CIS_ResolveSellSlotData(ply, index)

local slot, class, amount, itemData = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_GetSlotData(ply, index)

if slot and itemData then

return index, slot, class, amount, itemData

end

if not IsValid(ply) then return nil end

if not ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] then return nil end

local rawInventory = ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Inventory"] or {}

local rawClass = rawInventory[index]

if not isstring(rawClass) or rawClass == "" then return nil end

cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_SyncLayoutFromRaw(ply)

local layoutIndex = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_FindFirstSlotByClass(ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["InventoryLayout"] or {}, rawClass)

if not layoutIndex then return nil end

local resolvedSlot, resolvedClass, resolvedAmount, resolvedItemData = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_GetSlotData(ply, layoutIndex)

if not resolvedSlot or not resolvedItemData then return nil end

return layoutIndex, resolvedSlot, resolvedClass, resolvedAmount, resolvedItemData

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Player_Sell(ply,amount,index,typeis,sellAmount)

local payout = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0))

if index and typeis == "item" then

local resolvedIndex, slot, itemclass, slotAmount, itemData = CIS_ResolveSellSlotData(ply, index)

if not resolvedIndex or not slot or not itemData then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return

end

if not cutta_inventory_system:Is_ItemSellEnabled(itemData) then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply, "Selling Disabled")
cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return

end

sellAmount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(sellAmount) or 1), 1)

sellAmount = math.min(sellAmount, slotAmount)

if sellAmount <= 0 then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return

end

payout = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(itemData.Price or 0) or 0)) * sellAmount

if not cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_RemoveSlotAmount(ply, resolvedIndex, sellAmount) then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

return

end

end

if payout > 0 then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MoneyGive(ply,payout)

else

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

end

end

local function countItems(tbl)

local function getProjectedInventorySlotUsage(ply, outgoingOffer, incomingOffer)

if not IsValid(ply) then return 0 end

if not ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] then return 0 end

local layout = ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["InventoryLayout"] or {}

local classAmounts = {}

local classSlots = {}

local usedSlots = 0

for _, slot in ipairs(layout) do

local class = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(slot)

if not class then continue end

usedSlots = usedSlots + 1

classAmounts[class] = (classAmounts[class] or 0) + cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(slot)

classSlots[class] = (classSlots[class] or 0) + 1

end

for class, amount in pairs(countItems(outgoingOffer)) do

local currentAmount = classAmounts[class] or 0

if currentAmount <= 0 then continue end

local remaining = math.max(currentAmount - amount, 0)

if remaining == 0 then

usedSlots = math.max(usedSlots - (classSlots[class] or 1), 0)

classAmounts[class] = nil

classSlots[class] = nil

else

classAmounts[class] = remaining

end

end

for class, amount in pairs(countItems(incomingOffer)) do

if amount <= 0 then continue end

if (classAmounts[class] or 0) > 0 then

classAmounts[class] = classAmounts[class] + amount

else

classAmounts[class] = amount

classSlots[class] = 1

usedSlots = usedSlots + 1

end

end

return usedSlots

end

local function hasOffer(ply, offer)

if not IsValid(ply) then return false end

if not ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] then return false end

local inv = ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Inventory"] or {}

local invCounts = countItems(inv)

local offerCounts = countItems(offer)

for class,needed in pairs(offerCounts) do

if (invCounts[class] or 0) < needed then

return false

end

end

return true

end

local function removeOffer(ply, offer)

if not IsValid(ply) then return end

if not ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] then return end

local offerCounts = countItems(offer)

local inv = ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Inventory"] or {}

for i = #inv, 1, -1 do

local class = inv[i]

if offerCounts[class] and offerCounts[class] > 0 then

table.remove(inv, i)

offerCounts[class] = offerCounts[class] - 1

end

end

end

local function stripWeaponIfNeeded(ply, class)

if not IsValid(ply) then return end

if not isstring(class) or class == "" then return end

local itemData = cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class]

if not itemData or itemData.Type ~= "weapon" then return end

end

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Trade_BroadcastState(code)

local trade = cutta_inventory_system.ActiveTrades[code]

if not trade then return end

if not IsValid(trade.ply1) or not IsValid(trade.ply2) then return end

net.Start(cutta_inventory_system["StringName"].."Player_TradeState")

net.WriteString(code)

net.WriteTable({

[tostring(trade.ply1:AccountID())] = { offer = trade.offer1 or {}, accepted = trade.accept1 == true },

[tostring(trade.ply2:AccountID())] = { offer = trade.offer2 or {}, accepted = trade.accept2 == true },

})

net.Send({trade.ply1, trade.ply2})

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Trade_Cancel(code, reason)

local trade = cutta_inventory_system.ActiveTrades[code]

if not trade then return end

local targets = {}

if IsValid(trade.ply1) then table.insert(targets, trade.ply1) end

if IsValid(trade.ply2) then table.insert(targets, trade.ply2) end

cutta_inventory_system.ActiveTrades[code] = nil

net.Start(cutta_inventory_system["StringName"].."Player_TradeMenuClosed")

net.WriteString(code)

net.Send(targets)

if reason then

for _,ply in ipairs(targets) do

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply, reason)

end

end

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Trade_CreateOrGetSession(ply1, ply2)

if not IsValid(ply1) or not IsValid(ply2) then return end

if ply1 == ply2 then return end

for code,trade in pairs(cutta_inventory_system.ActiveTrades) do

if (trade.ply1 == ply1 and trade.ply2 == ply2) or (trade.ply1 == ply2 and trade.ply2 == ply1) then

return

end

end

local code = cutta_inventory_system:Player_SecurityCode()

cutta_inventory_system.ActiveTrades[code] = {

ply1 = ply1,

ply2 = ply2,

offer1 = {},

offer2 = {},

accept1 = false,

accept2 = false,

}

net.Start(cutta_inventory_system["StringName"].."Player_TradeAccept")

net.WriteString(ply2:Nick())

net.WriteString(code)

net.Send(ply1)

net.Start(cutta_inventory_system["StringName"].."Player_TradeAccept")

net.WriteString(ply1:Nick())

net.WriteString(code)

net.Send(ply2)

cutta_inventory_system:Trade_BroadcastState(code)

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Trade_SetOffer(ply, code, offer)

if not IsValid(ply) then return end

if not isstring(code) or code == "" then return end

if not istable(offer) then return end

local trade = cutta_inventory_system.ActiveTrades[code]

if not trade then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply, "Trade offer update failed: invalid trade code")

return

end

-- Clean + clamp to what the player currently owns (prevents phantom offers).

local inv = ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] and ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Inventory"] or {}

local invCounts = countItems(inv)

local used = {}

local clean = {}

print("[CIS DEBUG] Trade_SetOffer - Player:", ply:Nick())

print("[CIS DEBUG] Incoming offer:", table.ToString(offer))

print("[CIS DEBUG] Inventory counts:", table.ToString(invCounts))

for _,class in ipairs(offer) do

if isstring(class) and cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class] then

if cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxTradableItems"] and #clean >= cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxTradableItems"] then

break

end

used[class] = (used[class] or 0) + 1

if used[class] <= (invCounts[class] or 0) then

table.insert(clean, class)

else

print("[CIS DEBUG] Item rejected (not enough in inv):", class, "Used:", used[class], "Have:", invCounts[class])

end

else

print("[CIS DEBUG] Item rejected (invalid/unknown):", class)

end

end

print("[CIS DEBUG] Clean offer:", table.ToString(clean))

if trade.ply1 == ply then

trade.offer1 = clean

trade.accept1 = false

trade.accept2 = false

elseif trade.ply2 == ply then

trade.offer2 = clean

trade.accept1 = false

trade.accept2 = false

else

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply, "Trade offer update failed: not in this trade")

return

end

cutta_inventory_system:Trade_BroadcastState(code)

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Trade_SetAccepted(ply, code, accepted)

if not IsValid(ply) then return end

if not isstring(code) or code == "" then return end

local trade = cutta_inventory_system.ActiveTrades[code]

if not trade then return end

if not accepted then

cutta_inventory_system:Trade_Cancel(code, ply:Nick().." declined the trade")

return

end

if trade.ply1 == ply then

trade.accept1 = true

elseif trade.ply2 == ply then

trade.accept2 = true

else

return

end

cutta_inventory_system:Trade_BroadcastState(code)

if not (trade.accept1 and trade.accept2) then return end

if not IsValid(trade.ply1) or not IsValid(trade.ply2) then

cutta_inventory_system:Trade_Cancel(code, "Trade canceled")

return

end

if not hasOffer(trade.ply1, trade.offer1) or not hasOffer(trade.ply2, trade.offer2) then

cutta_inventory_system:Trade_Cancel(code, "Trade failed: items changed")

return

end

local cap1 = getInvCapacity(trade.ply1)
local cap2 = getInvCapacity(trade.ply2)
local final1 = getProjectedInventorySlotUsage(trade.ply1, trade.offer1, trade.offer2)
local final2 = getProjectedInventorySlotUsage(trade.ply2, trade.offer2, trade.offer1)

if final1 > cap1 or final2 > cap2 then

cutta_inventory_system:Trade_Cancel(code, "Trade failed: inventory full")

return

end

removeOffer(trade.ply1, trade.offer1)

removeOffer(trade.ply2, trade.offer2)

-- Strip traded-away weapons if the player no longer owns them.

for _,class in ipairs(trade.offer1 or {}) do

stripWeaponIfNeeded(trade.ply1, class)

end

for _,class in ipairs(trade.offer2 or {}) do

stripWeaponIfNeeded(trade.ply2, class)

end

addOffer(trade.ply1, trade.offer2)

addOffer(trade.ply2, trade.offer1)

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(trade.ply1)

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(trade.ply2)

cutta_inventory_system:Trade_Cancel(code, "Trade completed")

end

net.WriteString(ply:Nick())

net.WriteString(tostring(ply:AccountID()))

net.Send(otherply)

end

local function CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply)
return IsValid(ply) and ply:IsPlayer()
end

local function CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerTables(ply)
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return false end

ply.CuttaQS = istable(ply.CuttaQS) and ply.CuttaQS or {}
ply.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes = istable(ply.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes) and ply.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = istable(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars) and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}

return true
end

function cutta_quest_system:PlayerAccountID(ply)
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return "0" end
return tostring(ply:AccountID())
end

function cutta_quest_system:PlayerUserGroupAllowed(ply)
local grouplist = {}
grouplist["superadmin"] = true
grouplist["admin"] = cutta_quest_system["Configuration"]["Admins_Can_Use"]
grouplist["owner"] = true
if game.SinglePlayer() then
return "admin"
end
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return false end
if ply:IsSuperAdmin() then
return "admin"
end
if grouplist[ply:GetUserGroup()] then
return "admin"
end
for k,v in pairs(cutta_quest_system["Configuration"]["Allowed_Users"]) do
if v == ply:AccountID() then
return "allowed"
end
end
return false
end

function cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply,text)
text = tostring(text or "")
--ply:PrintMessage(HUD_PRINTTALK,text)
if SERVER then
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return end
net.Start(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."player_chat_box_send")
net.WriteString(text)
net.Send(ply)
else
cutta_quest_system:Player_Message_PopUp_Setup(text)
end
end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply)
local check = false
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerTables(ply) then return false end
if ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["IsInQuest"] then
check = true
end
return check
end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_CanQuest(ply)
local check = false
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then
check = true
end
if cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then
check = false
end
return check
end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestName(ply)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerTables(ply) then return nil end
return ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["InQuest"]
end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_Number(ply)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerTables(ply) then return 0 end
return ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjNumb"]
end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Name(ply)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerTables(ply) then return "" end
if not ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["Objective"] then ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["Objective"] = "" end
return ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["Objective"]
end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_HasCompletedQuest(ply,questname)
local check = false
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerTables(ply) then return false end
if cutta_quest_system:Quests_QuestExists(questname) then
if istable(ply.CuttaQS) then
for k,v in ipairs(ply.CuttaQS) do
if questname == v then
check = true
end
end
end
end
return check
end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestRestrictTo(ply,restriction,valuetable)
local check = false
if restriction == "Server Only" and not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then
return true
end
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return false end
if not istable(valuetable) then return false end
if restriction == "Teams" then
for zz,ee in pairs(valuetable) do
if cutta_quest_system:Player_DefaultTeamCheck(ply,ee) then
check = true
end
end
end
if restriction == "Cutta Factions" then
for zz,ee in pairs(valuetable) do
if cutta_quest_system:Player_CuttaFactionsCheck(ply,ee) then
check = true
end
end
end
if DarkRP then
if restriction == "Groups" then
for zz,ee in pairs(valuetable) do
if cutta_quest_system:Player_DarkRPCategoryCheck(ply,ee) then
check = true
end
end
end
end
if restriction == "Player(s)" then
for zz,ee in pairs(valuetable) do
if ply:Nick() == ee then
check = true
end
end
end
if restriction == "Cutta Levels" then
for zz,ee in pairs(valuetable) do
if cutta_quest_system:Player_CuttaLevelCheck(ply,ee) then
check = true
end
end
end
return check
end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_DefaultTeamCheck(ply,value)
local check = false
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return false end
if team.GetName(ply:Team()) == value then
check = true
end
return check
end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_CuttaFactionsCheck(ply,value)
local check = false
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return false end
if cutta_factions then
if ply.cuttafactions == value then
check = true
end
else
check = true
end
return check
end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_DarkRPCategoryCheck(ply,value)
local check = false
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return false end
if DarkRP then
for k,v in pairs(RPExtraTeams or {}) do
if istable(v) and v.category == value and team.GetName(ply:Team()) == v.name then
check = true
end
end
else
check = true
end
return check
end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_CuttaLevelCheck(ply,value)
local check = false
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return false end
if CUTTALEVEL then
if not CUTTALEVEL_PDATA then return false end
if not istable(ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]) then return false end
if ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["level"] == nil then return false end
if ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["level"] == value then
check = true
end
else
check = true
end
return check
end

if CLIENT then
function cutta_quest_system:Objective_StayHere_Hud(objdata)
local point = objdata and (objdata.position or objdata["position"]) or nil
if not point then return end
point = point + Vector(0,0,75) -- Gets the position of the entity, specifically the center
local data2D = point:ToScreen() -- Gets the position of the entity on your screen
cutta_quest_system:Hud_DrawArrowOverPoint(data2D.x,data2D.y,data2D.x,data2D.y)
cutta_quest_system:Hud_DrawTextOverPoint("Stay On Point",data2D.x,data2D.y)
end
end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_StayAtPoint(ply,objdata) --Start Objective Time
if not objdata then return end
local timetillend = objdata.time or objdata["time"] or 3
local distance = objdata.distance or objdata["distance"] or 500
if distance < 80 then distance = 80 end
local position = objdata.position or objdata["position"]
if not position then return end

if timer.Exists(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."StayAtPos") then return end
cutta_quest_system:Objective_TimerCreate_Complete(ply,timetillend)
if istable(objdata.entities) and #objdata.entities > 0 then
cutta_quest_system:Objective_SpawnZombies(ply,objdata,{skipAutoAdvance = true})
local spawnTimerId = ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."StaySpawnLoop"
if timer.Exists(spawnTimerId) then
timer.Remove(spawnTimerId)
end
timer.Create(spawnTimerId,1,0,function()
if not IsValid(ply) then
timer.Remove(spawnTimerId)
return
end
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) or cutta_quest_system:Objective_Name(ply) ~= "stay" then
timer.Remove(spawnTimerId)
return
end
if ply:GetPos():Distance(position) > distance then
return
end
if cutta_quest_system:Objective_EntityOBJCheck(ply) then
return
end
cutta_quest_system:Objective_SpawnZombies(ply,objdata,{skipAutoAdvance = true, forceRespawn = true})
end)
end
timer.Create(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."StayAtPos",1,timetillend+1,function()
if ply:GetPos():Distance(position) > (distance) then
cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestFailed(ply)
end
end)
end

timer.Remove(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."StayAtPos")
end
if timer.Exists(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."StaySpawnLoop") then
timer.Remove(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."StaySpawnLoop")
end
end

Show an example of how to use Concepts - Boolean Values in Garry's Mod Lua.

Example

Demonstrates how conditional statements treat booleans.
```lua
if false then print("Value is false!") end
if true then print("Value is true!") end
```

Inverting a boolean is often very useful. The easiest way to do that is to use the "not" operator.
```lua
local bool = false
if bool then
print("Boolean is false, this code is not run!")
end

// Boolean is now being inverted ( false -> true )
bool = not bool

if bool then
print("Boolean has been inverted and is now true!")
end

// This also works backwards. Note how "!" can be used in place of "not"
bool = !bool

if bool then
print("Boolean is false again, and won't be printed!")
end
```

In Garry's Mod Lua, what does baseclass.Get do?

Gets the base class of an an object.

This is used not just by entities, but also by widgets, panels, drive modes, weapons and gamemodes (with "gamemode_" prefix).

The keyword **DEFINE_BASECLASS** translates into a call to this function. In the engine, it is replaced with:

```lua
local BaseClass = baseclass.Get
```

You should prefer using this instead of `self.BaseClass` to avoid infinite recursion.

For more information, including usage examples, see the BaseClasses reference page.

Realms
- Shared and Menu

Arguments
- name: string. The child class.

Returns
- value: table. The base class's meta table.

Notes
- You should prefer using this instead of `self.BaseClass` to avoid infinite recursion.

Example

Inherits the weapon from weapon_csbasegun and calls its base functions.
