function FS_ClientUI.GetFramePlayerData()
local frameNumber = FrameNumber()
local cachedFrameData = FS_ClientUI.FramePlayerData
if cachedFrameData and cachedFrameData.frameNumber == frameNumber then
return cachedFrameData
end

local localPlayer = LocalPlayer()
cachedFrameData = {
frameNumber = frameNumber,
player = localPlayer,
position = nil,
eyeYaw = 0,
focusEntity = nil
}

if IsValid(localPlayer) then
cachedFrameData.position = localPlayer:GetPos()
cachedFrameData.eyeYaw = localPlayer:EyeAngles().y
local eyeTrace = localPlayer:GetEyeTrace()
cachedFrameData.focusEntity = eyeTrace and eyeTrace.Entity or nil
end

FS_ClientUI.FramePlayerData = cachedFrameData
return cachedFrameData
end

function FS_ClientUI.GetBillboardAngle(eyeYaw)
return Angle(0, (eyeYaw or 0) - 90, 90)
end

function FS_ClientUI.GetEntityDrawContext(entity, maxDrawDistance, requireFocus)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return nil
end

local frameData = FS_ClientUI.GetFramePlayerData()
if not IsValid(frameData.player) or not frameData.position then
return nil
end

local drawDistance = maxDrawDistance or FS_DrawDistance
if drawDistance and drawDistance > 0 and frameData.position:DistToSqr(entity:GetPos()) > (drawDistance * drawDistance) then
return nil
end

if requireFocus and frameData.focusEntity ~= entity then
return nil
end

return frameData
end

local function getDecorColor(value)
if isfunction(value) then
return value()
end

return value or color_white
end

function FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(colorValue, alpha)
if not colorValue then
return Color(255, 255, 255, alpha)
end

return Color(colorValue.r, colorValue.g, colorValue.b, math.Clamp(math.floor((colorValue.a or 255) * (alpha / 255)), 0, 255))
end

function FS_ClientUI.GetDistanceFadeAlpha(worldPosition, maxDrawDistance, fadeStartDistance)
local frameData = FS_ClientUI.GetFramePlayerData()
if not IsValid(frameData.player) or not frameData.position then
return 0
end

local maxDistance = maxDrawDistance or FS_DrawDistance
if not maxDistance or maxDistance <= 0 then
return 255
end

local distanceSqr = frameData.position:DistToSqr(worldPosition)
if distanceSqr >= (maxDistance * maxDistance) then
return 0
end

local fadeStart = fadeStartDistance or FS_ClientUI.FadeStartDistance or 250
if maxDistance <= fadeStart or distanceSqr <= (fadeStart * fadeStart) then
return 255
end

local distance = math.sqrt(distanceSqr)
local fadeFraction = 1 - ((distance - fadeStart) / (maxDistance - fadeStart))
return math.Clamp(math.floor(fadeFraction * 255), 0, 255)
end

function FS_ClientUI.ClearSeedHarvestDecor(entity)

end

for _, part in ipairs(entity.fsHarvestDecorModels) do
if IsValid(part) then
part:Remove()
end

entity.fsHarvestDecorModels = nil
end

function FS_ClientUI.DrawSeedHarvestDecor(entity, maxDrawDistance)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return false
end

if entity:GetDTInt(1) ~= 2 then
FS_ClientUI.ClearSeedHarvestDecor(entity)
return false
end

local frameData = FS_ClientUI.GetEntityDrawContext(entity, maxDrawDistance, false)
if not frameData then
return false
end

local meta = FS_ClientUI.GetSeedPatchMeta(entity)
local harvestDecor = meta and meta.harvestDecor
if not harvestDecor or #harvestDecor == 0 then
return false
end

if not entity.fsHarvestDecorModels or #entity.fsHarvestDecorModels ~= #harvestDecor then
FS_ClientUI.ClearSeedHarvestDecor(entity)
entity.fsHarvestDecorModels = {}
for index, decor in ipairs(harvestDecor) do
local part = ClientsideModel(decor.model, RENDERGROUP_BOTH)
if IsValid(part) then
part:SetNoDraw(true)
part:SetRenderMode(RENDERMODE_TRANSCOLOR)
entity.fsHarvestDecorModels[index] = part
end
end
end

for index, decor in ipairs(harvestDecor) do
local part = entity.fsHarvestDecorModels and entity.fsHarvestDecorModels[index]
if IsValid(part) then
local worldPos, worldAng = LocalToWorld(decor.pos or vector_origin, decor.ang or angle_zero, entity:GetPos(), entity:GetAngles())
part:SetPos(worldPos)
part:SetAngles(worldAng)
part:SetColor(getDecorColor(decor.color))
part:SetMaterial(decor.material or "")

local matrix = Matrix()
matrix:Scale(decor.scale or Vector(1, 1, 1))
part:EnableMatrix("RenderMultiply", matrix)
part:DrawModel()
end
end

return true
end

function FS_ClientUI.DrawInfoPanel(titleText, bodyText, titleColor, bodyColor, textPosition, scale, panelWidth, panelHeight, maxDrawDistance)

if not IsValid(frameData.player) then
return
end

local alpha = FS_ClientUI.GetDistanceFadeAlpha(textPosition, maxDrawDistance)
if alpha <= 0 then
return
end

local panelBackgroundColor = FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(FS_ClientUI.PanelBackgroundColor, alpha)
local panelBorderColor = FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(FS_ClientUI.PanelBorderColor, alpha)
local panelShadowColor = FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(FS_ClientUI.PanelShadowColor, alpha)
local fadedTitleColor = FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(titleColor, alpha)
local fadedBodyColor = FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(bodyColor, alpha)

cam.IgnoreZ(true)
render.OverrideDepthEnable(true, false)
cam.Start3D2D(textPosition, FS_ClientUI.GetBillboardAngle(frameData.eyeYaw), scale or 0.11)
surface.SetDrawColor(panelBackgroundColor)
surface.DrawRect(-panelWidth * 0.5, -panelHeight * 0.5, panelWidth, panelHeight)
surface.SetDrawColor(panelBorderColor)
surface.DrawOutlinedRect(-panelWidth * 0.5, -panelHeight * 0.5, panelWidth, panelHeight)

draw.SimpleTextOutlined(titleText, "fsSeedPatchTitle", 0, -12, fadedTitleColor, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, 1, panelShadowColor)
draw.SimpleTextOutlined(bodyText, "fsSeedPatchBody", 0, 14, fadedBodyColor, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, 1, panelShadowColor)
cam.End3D2D()
render.OverrideDepthEnable(false, false)
cam.IgnoreZ(false)
end

Explain Addons Menu in Garry's Mod Lua.

Play.GettingStarted

The Addons Menu is located in the Main_Menu , and it is used for manipulating addons, allowing the user to enable, disable, subscribe and unsubscribe from addons.

## Addons Menu

### 1.Subscribed addons
View the addons you are subscribed to, quickly enable or disable all subscriptions. In the list of subscriptions which appears on the right, you can disable/enable and unsubscribe specific addons.

When an addon is disabled, it means it is not loaded in the game, but will still be updated when the author makes any changes. When the addon is unsubscribed, it will be removed from the game and will not be available for use, unless you decide to subscribe to the addon again.

### 2. Viewing addons
Using the set of buttons, you can quickly view addons by categories: Gamemodes, Maps, Weapons, Tools, NPCs and Vehicles.

### 3. Friends Uploads
Using the buttons you can view the addons which your friends have uploaded.

### 4. My Uploads
View the addons which yourself has uploaded.

### 5. Open Workshop
Selecting this option will allow you to open up the Garry's Mod Workshop in the steam browser, the advantage of this is that it offers you with a few search options.

local requestedCount = 1
if l >= 16 then
requestedCount = math.min(math.max(net.ReadUInt(16), 1), 65535)

if not IsValid(ply) then return end

local compressed = net.ReadData(size)
local ok,json = pcall(util.Decompress,compressed)
if not ok or not json then
print("[CuttaCosmeticShop] Failed to decompress char animation bind from client for "..ply:Nick())
return
end
local tbl = util.JSONToTable(json)
local animationid
local bindtype
for k,v in pairs(tbl) do
if k == "bindtype" then bindtype = v end
if k == "animationid" then animationid = v end
end
if not bindtype or not animationid then return end
cutta_cosmetic_shop:Ply_Animation_Equip(ply,animationid,bindtype)
end)

In Garry's Mod Lua, what does cam.Start3D2D do?

Sets up the model transformation matrix to draw 2D content in 3D space and pushes it into the stack ( cam.PushModelMatrix ).

Matrix formula:
```
local m = Matrix()
m:SetAngles( angles )
m:SetTranslation( pos )
m:SetScale( Vector( scale, -scale, 1 ) )
```
This must be closed by cam.End3D2D . If not done so, unexpected issues might arise.

render.SetToneMappingScaleLinear may of use when dealing with bloom.

Realms
- Client

Arguments
- pos: Vector. Origin of the 3D2D context, ie. the top left corner, (0, 0).
- angles: Angle. Angles of the 3D2D context.
+x in the 2d context corresponds to +x of the angle (its forward direction).
+y in the 2d context corresponds to -y of the angle (its right direction).

If (dx, dy) are your desired (+x, +y) unit vectors, the angle you want is dx:AngleEx(dx:Cross(-dy)).
- scale: number. The scale of the render context.
If scale is 1 then 1 pixel in 2D context will equal to 1 unit in 3D context.

Warnings
- This must be closed by cam.End3D2D . If not done so, unexpected issues might arise.

-- Get the angle between the local player and the target player
local angle = ( pos - EyePos() ):GetNormalized():Angle()

-- Only use the Yaw component of the angle
angle = Angle( 0, angle.y, 0 )

-- Apply some animation to the angle
angle.y = angle.y + math.sin( CurTime() ) * 10

-- Correct the angle so it points at the camera
-- This is usually done by trial and error using Up(), Right() and Forward() axes
angle:RotateAroundAxis( angle:Up(), -90 )
angle:RotateAroundAxis( angle:Forward(), 90 )

-- Notice the scale is small, so text looks crispier
cam.Start3D2D( pos, angle, 0.05 )
-- Get the size of the text we are about to draw

-- This is to make sure the 3d2d display rotates around our position by its center, not left corner
surface.SetDrawColor( 0, 0, 0, 100 )
surface.DrawRect( -tW / 2 - padX, -padY, tW + padX * 2, tH + padY * 2 )

-- Draw some text
draw.SimpleText( ply:Nick(), "PlayerTagFont", -tW / 2, 0, color_white )
cam.End3D2D()
end )

-- Deferred sound scanner: processes directories in small batches across ticks
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER = "CuttaQS_ResourceSoundScan"
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_INTERVAL = 0.1
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_DIRS_PER_TICK = 3
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_MAX_FILES = 2000

local function cuttaqs_resource_add_sounds_deferred(rootPath)
if not isstring(rootPath) then return end

local scanQueue = { rootPath }
local seen = {}
local addedFiles = 0

timer.Create(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER, CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_INTERVAL, 0, function()
local dirsProcessed = 0

while dirsProcessed < CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_DIRS_PER_TICK and #scanQueue > 0 do
local currentPath = table.remove(scanQueue, 1)
if isstring(currentPath) and currentPath ~= "" and not seen[currentPath] then
seen[currentPath] = true
dirsProcessed = dirsProcessed + 1

local files, dirs = file.Find(currentPath .. "/*", "GAME")
files = files or {}
dirs = dirs or {}

if #dirs == 0 and #files > 0 then
for _, name in ipairs(files) do
if not cuttaqs_is_sound_file(name) and file.IsDir(currentPath .. "/" .. name, "GAME") then
table.insert(dirs, name)
end
end
end

for _, f in ipairs(files) do
if addedFiles >= CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_MAX_FILES then
print("[CuttaQS] Auto sound mount limit reached (" .. tostring(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_MAX_FILES) .. ").")
timer.Remove(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER)
return
end

if cuttaqs_is_sound_file(f) and not file.IsDir(currentPath .. "/" .. f, "GAME") then
resource.AddFile(currentPath .. "/" .. f)
addedFiles = addedFiles + 1
end
end

for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
if isstring(d) and d ~= "" and d ~= "." and d ~= ".." and not string.StartWith(d, ".") then
table.insert(scanQueue, currentPath .. "/" .. d)
end
end
end
end

if #scanQueue <= 0 then
timer.Remove(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER)
if addedFiles > 0 then
print("[CuttaQS] Auto-mounted " .. tostring(addedFiles) .. " sound files for download.")
end
end
end)
end

local function ArePlayersWithinCosmeticSyncDistance(sourcePly, recipientPly)

if not IsValidCosmeticSyncPlayer(sourcePly) or not IsValidCosmeticSyncPlayer(recipientPly) then

return false

end

if sourcePly == recipientPly then

return true

end

local sourcePos = sourcePly:GetPos()

local recipientPos = recipientPly:GetPos()

if not isvector(sourcePos) or not isvector(recipientPos) then

return false

end

return sourcePos:DistToSqr(recipientPos) <= cosmeticStateSyncDistanceSqr

end

if recipientPly == sourcePly then

local function SendCosmeticsStateBulk(targetPly, entries)

if not IsValid(targetPly) or not istable(entries) or #entries == 0 then return end

local json = util.TableToJSON(entries) or "[]"

local compressed = util.Compress(json)

if not compressed then return end

if #compressed > bulkSyncMaxCompressedBytes and #entries > 1 then
print("[CuttaCosmeticShop] Splitting bulk net message: size=", #compressed, "bytes, entries=", #entries)
local midpoint = math.max(math.floor(#entries / 2), 1)
local leftEntries = {}
local rightEntries = {}

for i = 1, midpoint do
leftEntries[#leftEntries + 1] = entries[i]
end

for i = midpoint + 1, #entries do
rightEntries[#rightEntries + 1] = entries[i]
end

SendCosmeticsStateBulk(targetPly, leftEntries)
SendCosmeticsStateBulk(targetPly, rightEntries)
return
end

print("[CuttaCosmeticShop] SendCosmeticsStateBulk: size=", #compressed, "bytes, entries=", #entries)
if CUTTA_NET and CUTTA_NET.SendTable then
CUTTA_NET.SendTable(targetPly, "CuttaCosmetic_Ply_Send_CosmeticsBulk", entries)
return
end
net.Start("CuttaCosmetic_Ply_Send_CosmeticsBulk")
net.WriteUInt(#compressed, 32)
net.WriteData(compressed, #compressed)
net.Send(targetPly)
end

local function GetBulkSyncTimerName(targetPly)

return "CuttaCosmetic_BulkStateSend_" .. tostring(targetPly:EntIndex())

end

local function GetQueuedCosmeticsStateTransfer(targetPly)

if not IsValidCosmeticSyncPlayer(targetPly) then return nil, nil end

local targetKey = tonumber(targetPly:EntIndex()) or 0

if targetKey <= 0 then return nil, nil end

queuedCosmeticsStateTransfers[targetKey] = queuedCosmeticsStateTransfers[targetKey] or {

order = {},

entries = {}

}

return queuedCosmeticsStateTransfers[targetKey], targetKey

end

local function ClearQueuedCosmeticsStateTransfer(targetPly)

if not IsValid(targetPly) then return end

local targetKey = tonumber(targetPly:EntIndex()) or 0

if targetKey <= 0 then return end

queuedCosmeticsStateTransfers[targetKey] = nil

timer.Remove(GetBulkSyncTimerName(targetPly))

end

local function QueueCosmeticsStateEntries(targetPly, entries)

if not IsValidCosmeticSyncPlayer(targetPly) or not istable(entries) or #entries == 0 then return end

local queueState = GetQueuedCosmeticsStateTransfer(targetPly)

if not queueState then return end

local addedEntries = false

for i = 1, #entries do

local entry = entries[i]

if not istable(entry) then continue end

local sourceKey = tonumber(entry.EntIndex) or 0

if sourceKey <= 0 then continue end

if not queueState.entries[sourceKey] then

queueState.order[#queueState.order + 1] = sourceKey

end

queueState.entries[sourceKey] = entry

addedEntries = true

end

if not addedEntries then return end

local timerName = GetBulkSyncTimerName(targetPly)

if timer.Exists(timerName) then return end

local function SendNextQueuedEntry()

if not IsValidCosmeticSyncPlayer(targetPly) then

ClearQueuedCosmeticsStateTransfer(targetPly)

return

end

local batch = {}

local activeQueueState = GetQueuedCosmeticsStateTransfer(targetPly)

if not activeQueueState then

ClearQueuedCosmeticsStateTransfer(targetPly)

return

end

while #batch < bulkSyncBatchSize and #activeQueueState.order > 0 do

local sourceKey = table.remove(activeQueueState.order, 1)

local entry = activeQueueState.entries[sourceKey]

activeQueueState.entries[sourceKey] = nil

if istable(entry) then

batch[#batch + 1] = entry

end

end

if #batch > 0 then

SendCosmeticsStateBulk(targetPly, batch)

end

if #activeQueueState.order == 0 then

ClearQueuedCosmeticsStateTransfer(targetPly)

end

end

timer.Create(timerName, bulkSyncInterval, 0, SendNextQueuedEntry)

end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:SendAllCosmeticsTo(targetPly)

if not IsValidCosmeticSyncPlayer(targetPly) then return end

local entries = {}

for _, otherPly in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do

if otherPly == targetPly then continue end

if not ArePlayersWithinCosmeticSyncDistance(otherPly, targetPly) then continue end

local entry = BuildCosmeticsStateEntry(otherPly)

if entry then

entries[#entries + 1] = entry

end

end

QueueCosmeticsStateEntries(targetPly, entries)

end

local function SyncCosmeticsForNearbyPlayers()

local allPlayers = player.GetAll()

if not istable(allPlayers) or #allPlayers == 0 then return end

for _, recipientPly in ipairs(allPlayers) do

if not IsValidCosmeticSyncPlayer(recipientPly) then continue end

recipientPly.CuttaCosmetic_NearbyStateRecipients = recipientPly.CuttaCosmetic_NearbyStateRecipients or {}

local seenLookup = recipientPly.CuttaCosmetic_NearbyStateRecipients

local currentNearby = {}

local pendingEntries = {}

for _, sourcePly in ipairs(allPlayers) do

if not ArePlayersWithinCosmeticSyncDistance(sourcePly, recipientPly) then continue end

local sourceKey = tonumber(sourcePly:EntIndex()) or 0

if sourceKey <= 0 then continue end

currentNearby[sourceKey] = true

if sourcePly == recipientPly then

seenLookup[sourceKey] = true

continue

end

if seenLookup[sourceKey] then continue end

local entry = BuildCosmeticsStateEntry(sourcePly)

if entry then

pendingEntries[#pendingEntries + 1] = entry

seenLookup[sourceKey] = true

end

end

for sourceKey in pairs(seenLookup) do

if not currentNearby[sourceKey] then

seenLookup[sourceKey] = nil

end

end

if #pendingEntries > 0 then

QueueCosmeticsStateEntries(recipientPly, pendingEntries)

end

end

end

SyncCosmeticsForNearbyPlayers()

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:Ply_Equip_Cosmetic(ply,cosmeticid,requestedUnequip)

if not IsValid(ply) or not cosmeticid then return end

local targetID = tostring(cosmeticid or "")

if targetID == "" then return end

if cutta_cosmetic_shop:PLY_ITEM_CHECK(ply,targetID) then

local cosinv = cutta_cosmetic_shop:COSMETICS_GET(ply)

if not istable(cosinv) then return end

local itemRestrict = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_GETTABLE(targetID)

if itemRestrict and not cutta_cosmetic_shop:Item_UserGroupAllowed(ply, targetID) then

local msg = "[Cutta Cosmetics] You lack the required usergroup"

-- Build friendly list for message

local groupsForMsg = {}

if istable(itemRestrict.RequiredUserGroups) and #itemRestrict.RequiredUserGroups > 0 then

for _,g in ipairs(itemRestrict.RequiredUserGroups) do table.insert(groupsForMsg, tostring(g)) end

elseif isstring(itemRestrict.RequiredUserGroup) and itemRestrict.RequiredUserGroup ~= "" then

if itemRestrict.RequiredUserGroup:find(",",1,true) then

for token in itemRestrict.RequiredUserGroup:gmatch("[^,]+") do

local trimmed = string.Trim(token)

if trimmed ~= "" then table.insert(groupsForMsg, trimmed) end

end

else

table.insert(groupsForMsg, itemRestrict.RequiredUserGroup)

end

end

if #groupsForMsg > 0 then

msg = msg .. ": " .. table.concat(groupsForMsg, ", ")

end

ply:ChatPrint(msg)

return

end

local currentlyEquipped = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_EQUIP_CHECK(ply,targetID) == true

local shouldUnequip = currentlyEquipped

if requestedUnequip ~= nil then

shouldUnequip = requestedUnequip == true

end

if shouldUnequip then

for i=1,#cosinv do

for k,v in pairs(cosinv[i]) do

if tostring(k) == targetID then

cosinv[i][k] = false

end

end

end

if ply.CuttaCosmeticShop_InitialPlyModel then

cutta_cosmetic_shop:SetupPlayerModelAndHands(ply, ply.CuttaCosmeticShop_InitialPlyModel, nil)

else

cutta_cosmetic_shop:SetupPlayerModelAndHands(ply, ply:GetModel(), nil)

end

else

for i=1,#cosinv do

for k,v in pairs(cosinv[i]) do

local item = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_GETTABLE(tostring(k))

if item then

if item.IsModel == "true" then

cosinv[i][k] = false

end

end

end

for k,v in pairs(cosinv[i]) do

if tostring(k) == targetID then

cosinv[i][k] = true

end

end

local item = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_GETTABLE(targetID)

if item and item.IsModel == "true" then

cutta_cosmetic_shop:SetupPlayerModelAndHands(ply, item.Model, item.Bodygroups)

end

end

end

cutta_cosmetic_shop:Transfer(ply)

cutta_cosmetic_shop:SendCosmeticsTo(ply)

end

end

local function SendLocalSoundBindPlayback(sourcePly, soundID, item)
if not IsValid(sourcePly) or not istable(item) then return end

local soundPath = string.Trim(tostring(item.Sound or ""))
if cutta_cosmetic_shop.NormalizeSoundPath then
soundPath = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeSoundPath(soundPath)
end
if soundPath == "" then return end

-- Send to all active players and let clients apply distance + volume attenuation.
local recipients = {}
for _, recipientPly in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do
if IsValid(recipientPly) and recipientPly:IsPlayer() then
recipients[#recipients + 1] = recipientPly
end
end
if not istable(recipients) or #recipients == 0 then return end

local sourcePos = sourcePly:GetPos()
if not isvector(sourcePos) then
sourcePos = vector_origin
end

net.Start("CuttaCosmetic_PlaySound_Local")
net.WriteEntity(sourcePly)
net.WriteVector(sourcePos)
net.WriteString(tostring(soundID or ""))
net.WriteString(soundPath)
net.WriteString(tostring(item.WorkshopID or ""))
net.WriteString(tostring(item.WorkshopLink or ""))
net.WriteFloat(math.max(tonumber(cosmeticStateSyncDistance) or 800, 1))
net.Send(recipients)
end

/*
Puzzle
*/

local function CUTTAQS_Puzzle_WallAngleFromNormal(hitNormal, eyeYaw)
if not isvector(hitNormal) then return nil end

local normal = hitNormal:GetNormalized()
local ang = (-normal):Angle()
ang:RotateAroundAxis(ang:Right(), 90)

if eyeYaw ~= nil then
local yawDiff = math.AngleDifference(tonumber(eyeYaw) or 0, ang.y)
ang:RotateAroundAxis(normal, yawDiff)
end

return ang
end

if CLIENT then
function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Puzzle_Hud(objdata)
local point = objdata and (objdata.position or objdata["position"]) or nil
if not point then return end

local data2D = point:ToScreen()
cutta_quest_system:Hud_DrawArrowOverPoint(data2D.x, data2D.y, data2D.x, data2D.y)
cutta_quest_system:Hud_DrawTextOverPoint("Puzzle", data2D.x, data2D.y)
end

-- Puzzle objective/entity UI
function cutta_quest_system:CUTTAQS_Puzzle_CloseIfOpen()
local ply = LocalPlayer()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
local frame = ply.CUTTAQS_PuzzleFrame
ply.CUTTAQS_PuzzleFrame = nil

if IsValid(frame) then
-- DFrame:Close() runs OnClose and handles removal.
frame:Close()
end
end

function cutta_quest_system:CUTTAQS_Puzzle_Open(ent, dotCount, progress)
local ply = LocalPlayer()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
if not IsValid(ent) then return end

dotCount = math.Clamp(math.floor(tonumber(dotCount) or 0), 1, 8)
progress = math.Clamp(math.floor(tonumber(progress) or 0), 0, 8)

if IsValid(ply.CUTTAQS_PuzzleFrame) then
if ply.CUTTAQS_PuzzleFrame.PuzzleEnt ~= ent then
cutta_quest_system:CUTTAQS_Puzzle_CloseIfOpen()
end
end

if not IsValid(ply.CUTTAQS_PuzzleFrame) then
local frame = vgui.Create("DFrame")
frame:SetSize(340, 280)
frame:Center()
frame:MakePopup()
frame:SetTitle("Puzzle")
frame:ShowCloseButton(true)
frame.PuzzleEnt = ent
frame.DotCount = dotCount
frame.Progress = progress

local dotsPanel = vgui.Create("DPanel", frame)
dotsPanel:Dock(TOP)
dotsPanel:SetTall(40)
dotsPanel.Paint = function(pan, w, h)
draw.RoundedBox(0, 0, 0, w, h, Color(0, 0, 0, 150))

local maxDots = frame.DotCount or 0
local prog = frame.Progress or 0
local spacing = 8
local size = 16
local totalW = (maxDots * size) + ((maxDots - 1) * spacing)
local startX = (w * 0.5) - (totalW * 0.5)
local y = (h * 0.5) - (size * 0.5)
for i = 1, maxDots do
local x = startX + (i - 1) * (size + spacing)
local col = (i <= prog) and Color(0, 255, 0) or Color(60, 60, 60)
draw.RoundedBox(4, x, y, size, size, col)
end
end

local grid = vgui.Create("DPanel", frame)
grid:Dock(FILL)
grid:DockPadding(10, 10, 10, 10)
grid.Paint = function(pan, w, h)
draw.RoundedBox(0, 0, 0, w, h, Color(0, 0, 0, 0))
end

local prefix = cutta_quest_system and cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] or ""

local cols, rows = 4, 2
local btnW, btnH = 70, 70
local gap = 10
local startY = 10
local puzzleButtons = {}

local function RepositionButtons()
if not IsValid(grid) then return end
local startX = (grid:GetWide() * 0.5) - ((cols * btnW + (cols - 1) * gap) * 0.5)

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_PuzzleStart(ply, objdata)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end

-- Prevent double-spawning for global quest instances using live entity checks.
-- This avoids stale spawn flags blocking respawns after entity removal/retries.
local globalIdKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"
local globalId = ply and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[globalIdKey] or nil
local objIndex = ply and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjNumb"]) or nil
if globalId and globalId ~= "" and objIndex and cutta_quest_system.entitylist then
for _, existingEnt in pairs(cutta_quest_system.entitylist) do
if IsValid(existingEnt)
and existingEnt:GetClass() == "cutta_quest_puzzle"
and existingEnt:GetNWString(globalIdKey, "") == globalId
and tonumber(existingEnt:GetNWInt(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "ObjectiveObjNumb", 0)) == objIndex then
return
end
end
end

local useAimWall = objdata and (objdata.aim_wall or objdata["aim_wall"] or objdata.aimwall or objdata["aimwall"]) or false
useAimWall = useAimWall and true or false

local position = objdata and (objdata.position or objdata["position"]) or nil
local spawnPos = position
local spawnAng = nil
local spawnData = nil

-- If the quest editor stored a wall orientation, prefer it so the keypad matches
-- the wall you were looking at when you clicked "Set From Your Aim".
local wallAng = objdata and (objdata.wall_ang or objdata["wall_ang"]) or nil
if useAimWall and isvector(position) and istable(wallAng) then
local p = tonumber(wallAng.p)
local y = tonumber(wallAng.y)
local r = tonumber(wallAng.r)
if p and y and r then
spawnPos = position
spawnAng = Angle(p, y, r)
spawnData = { wall_mount = true }
end
end

if useAimWall and not isangle(spawnAng) then
local tr = util.TraceLine({
start = ply:EyePos(),
endpos = ply:EyePos() + ply:EyeAngles():Forward() * 200,
filter = ply,
mask = MASK_SOLID,
})

if tr and tr.Hit and isvector(tr.HitPos) and isvector(tr.HitNormal) then
spawnPos = tr.HitPos + tr.HitNormal * 2

spawnAng = CUTTAQS_Puzzle_WallAngleFromNormal(tr.HitNormal, ply:EyeAngles().y)

local parentEnt = tr.Entity
if isangle(spawnAng) and IsValid(parentEnt) and (not tr.HitWorld) and (not parentEnt:IsPlayer()) then
spawnData = {
wall_mount = true,
parentEnt = parentEnt,
localPos = parentEnt:WorldToLocal(spawnPos),
localAng = parentEnt:WorldToLocalAngles(spawnAng),
}
else
spawnData = { wall_mount = true }
end
end
end

if not isvector(spawnPos) then
-- enabled but trace failed, fall back to If aim-wall is configured position.
if not isvector(position) then return end
spawnPos = position
end

-- If not using aim wall, use the angle saved from player's eye angle in editor
-- Flip yaw 180° so the keypad faces toward where the player was standing
if not useAimWall then
local savedAng = objdata and (objdata.angle or objdata["angle"]) or nil
if istable(savedAng) then
local p = tonumber(savedAng.p)
local y = tonumber(savedAng.y)
local r = tonumber(savedAng.r)
if p and y and r then
spawnAng = Angle(p, y + 180, r)
end
end
end

local dotCount = tonumber(objdata and (objdata.dots or objdata["dots"] or objdata.dotcount or objdata["dotcount"])) or 4
dotCount = math.Clamp(math.floor(dotCount), 1, 8)

local ent = cutta_quest_system:Objective_CreateEntity("cutta_quest_puzzle", spawnPos, ply, true, nil, nil, nil, nil, spawnAng, spawnData)
if IsValid(ent) and ent.CUTTAQS_SetupPuzzle then
ent:CUTTAQS_SetupPuzzle(dotCount)
end
end
end

-- Global quest instances (server)

if not cutta_quest_system then return end

cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestInstances = cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestInstances or {}
cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestByQuestName = cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestByQuestName or {}

local function CQS_GetDefaultJoinRadius()
local cfg = cutta_quest_system["Configuration"] or {}
local r = tonumber(cfg["GlobalQuestJoinRadius"]) or 400
-- keep values reasonable (also must fit in settings_transfer_int 16-bit)
if r < 50 then r = 50 end
if r > 30000 then r = 30000 end
return r
end

local function CQS_MakeGlobalId(questname)
return string.format("%s_%d_%d", tostring(questname or "global"), os.time(), math.random(1000, 9999))
end

local function CQS_GetAnyActiveGlobalInstance()
if not istable(cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestInstances) then return nil end
for _, inst in pairs(cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestInstances) do
if istable(inst) and (inst.state == "gathering" or inst.state == "running") then
return inst
end
end
return nil
end

local function CQS_GetRandomGlobalQuestName()
local candidates = {}
for _, bucket in ipairs(cutta_quest_system["Quests"] or {}) do
if istable(bucket) then
local questname = next(bucket)
if questname then
local qd = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname)
if qd and qd.GlobalQuest == true then
table.insert(candidates, questname)
end
end
end
end
if #candidates < 1 then return nil end
return table.Random(candidates)
end

local function CQS_ZoneBounds(zone)
if not istable(zone) then return end
local p1 = zone.pos1 or zone["pos1"]
local p2 = zone.pos2 or zone["pos2"]
if not p1 or not p2 then return end

local min = Vector(
math.min(p1.x, p2.x),
math.min(p1.y, p2.y),
math.min(p1.z, p2.z)
)
local max = Vector(
math.max(p1.x, p2.x),
math.max(p1.y, p2.y),
math.max(p1.z, p2.z)
)
return min, max
end

local function CQS_ZoneBuildCache(zone)
if not istable(zone) then return nil end

local p = zone.pos or zone["pos"]
if isvector(p) then
local radius = tonumber(zone.radius or zone["radius"]) or CQS_GetDefaultJoinRadius()
if radius < 50 then radius = 50 end
return {
kind = "point2d",
pos = p,
x = p.x,
y = p.y,
z = p.z,
radius = radius,
radiusSqr = radius * radius,
}
end

local min, max = CQS_ZoneBounds(zone)
if not min or not max then return nil end

local center = (min + max) * 0.5
local radius = min:Distance(max) * 0.5
radius = math.max(radius, 80)

return {
kind = "box",
min = min,
max = max,
center = center,
radius = radius,
}
end

local function CQS_ZoneGatherDisplay(zone, zoneCache)
local cache = zoneCache or CQS_ZoneBuildCache(zone)
if not cache then return end

if cache.kind == "point2d" then
return cache.pos, cache.radius
end

if cache.kind == "box" then
return cache.center, cache.radius
end
end

local function CQS_SelectGlobalQuestGatherSound()
local cfg = cutta_quest_system["Configuration"] or {}
if cfg.EnableGlobalQuestStartMusic ~= true then return "" end

local forced = tostring(cfg.GlobalQuestStartMusic or "")
if forced ~= "" and forced ~= "Random" then
return forced
end

local sounds = cutta_quest_system["Sounds"] and cutta_quest_system["Sounds"]["GlobalQuestStart"] or nil
if not istable(sounds) or #sounds < 1 then return "" end

local candidates = {}
for _, s in ipairs(sounds) do
s = tostring(s or "")
if s ~= "" and s ~= "Random" then
table.insert(candidates, s)
end
end
if #candidates < 1 then return "" end
return table.Random(candidates)
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Gather_BroadcastStart(instance)
if not istable(instance) then return end
if not istable(instance.zone) then return end
local pos, radius = CQS_ZoneGatherDisplay(instance.zone, instance.zoneCache)
if not pos or not radius then return end

net.Start(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "globalquest_gather_start")
net.WriteString(tostring(instance.questname or ""))
net.WriteVector(pos)
net.WriteFloat(tonumber(radius) or CQS_GetDefaultJoinRadius())
net.WriteFloat(tonumber(instance.joinEndTime) or CurTime())
net.WriteString(tostring(instance.gatherSound or ""))
net.Broadcast()
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Gather_SendToPlayer(ply, instance)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end
if not istable(instance) then return end
if not istable(instance.zone) then return end
local pos, radius = CQS_ZoneGatherDisplay(instance.zone, instance.zoneCache)
if not pos or not radius then return end

net.Start(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "globalquest_gather_start")
net.WriteString(tostring(instance.questname or ""))
net.WriteVector(pos)
net.WriteFloat(tonumber(radius) or CQS_GetDefaultJoinRadius())
net.WriteFloat(tonumber(instance.joinEndTime) or CurTime())
net.WriteString(tostring(instance.gatherSound or ""))
net.Send(ply)
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_IsPlayerInZone(ply, zone, zoneCache)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
local cache = zoneCache or CQS_ZoneBuildCache(zone)
if not cache then return false end

local pos = ply:GetPos()
if cache.kind == "point2d" then
-- treat this like a 2D circle at the point's Z (more forgiving than a full 3D sphere)
local dx = pos.x - cache.x
local dy = pos.y - cache.y
return (dx * dx + dy * dy) <= cache.radiusSqr
end

if cache.kind == "box" then
local min, max = cache.min, cache.max
return pos.x >= min.x and pos.x <= max.x
and pos.y >= min.y and pos.y <= max.y
and pos.z >= min.z and pos.z <= max.z
end

return false
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstanceIdForQuest(questname)
return cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestByQuestName and cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestByQuestName[questname] or nil
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not globalId then return nil end
return cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestInstances and cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestInstances[globalId] or nil
end

local function CQS_CountValidParticipants(instance)
if not istable(instance) or not istable(instance.participants) then return 0 end
local count = 0
for ply, enabled in pairs(instance.participants) do
if enabled == true and IsValid(ply) and ply:IsPlayer() then
count = count + 1
end
end
return count
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_RemoveParticipant(globalId, ply)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance or not istable(instance.participants) then return false end
if not ply then return false end

if instance.participants[ply] ~= true then
return false
end

instance.participants[ply] = nil

if CQS_CountValidParticipants(instance) < 1 then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Cleanup(globalId)
end

return true
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_FailPlayer(globalId, ply)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance or instance.state ~= "running" then return false end
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if not cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_RemoveParticipant(globalId, ply) then return false end

-- Important: clear global id BEFORE resetting objectives, so Objective_RemoveEntities
-- doesn't remove shared global quest entities.
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"] = nil

-- Clean up this player's objective state.
cutta_quest_system:Player_ResetQuestObjective(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_ResetNumber(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Objective_Soundcue_stopclientmusic(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Objective_Musiccue_stopclientmusic(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Player_EndQuest_Vars(ply, instance.questname)
cutta_quest_system:Player_PlayFailedQuestSound(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Player_ShowFailMessageText(ply)

return true
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_AdvanceOnce(globalId, objNumb)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance or instance.state ~= "running" then return end

objNumb = tonumber(objNumb) or tonumber(instance.objNumb) or 0
if objNumb < 1 then return end

instance.advanceOnce = instance.advanceOnce or {}
if instance.advanceOnce[objNumb] then return end
instance.advanceOnce[objNumb] = true

-- Avoid re-entrancy; only advance if we're still on that objective.
timer.Simple(0, function()
local inst = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not inst or inst.state ~= "running" then return end
if tonumber(inst.objNumb) ~= objNumb then return end
-- Force because instant objectives (sound/music cues) can legitimately advance
-- within the normal anti-double-advance window.
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Advance(globalId, true)
end)
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_IsPlayerInInstance(ply, globalId)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance or not istable(instance.participants) then return false end
return instance.participants[ply] == true
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_StopQuest_AndTimer()
cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_RefreshTimer()
local activeInst = CQS_GetAnyActiveGlobalInstance()
if not activeInst then return end
if not activeInst.id then return end
for k,v in pairs(activeInst.participants or {}) do
if IsValid(k) and k:IsPlayer() then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_FailPlayer(activeInst.id, k)
end
end
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Gather_BroadcastEnd(activeInst.id)
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Cleanup(activeInst.id)

end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_RequestStart(ply, questname)
local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname)
if not questData or questData.GlobalQuest ~= true then
return false
end

-- Only allow ONE active global quest at a time (gathering or running)
local activeInst = CQS_GetAnyActiveGlobalInstance()
if activeInst then
local activeName = tostring(activeInst.questname or "")
if activeName == "" then activeName = "(unknown)" end
local stateTxt = tostring(activeInst.state or "active")
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply, string.format("A global quest is already %s: %s", stateTxt, activeName))
return false
end

if cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstanceIdForQuest(questname) then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply, "A global instance of this quest is already active.")
return false
end

local zone = questData.GlobalQuestZone
local joinTime = tonumber(questData.GlobalQuestJoinTime) or 0
if joinTime < 1 then joinTime = 1 end

local zoneCache = CQS_ZoneBuildCache(zone)
if not zoneCache then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply, "Global quest has no valid zone.")
return false
end

local globalId = CQS_MakeGlobalId(questname)

local instance = {
id = globalId,
questname = questname,
state = "gathering",
zone = zone,
zoneCache = zoneCache,
joinEndTime = CurTime() + joinTime,
gatherSound = CQS_SelectGlobalQuestGatherSound(),
participants = {},
objNumb = 0,
lastAdvance = 0,
spawnedForObj = {},
}

cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestInstances[globalId] = instance
cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestByQuestName[questname] = globalId

cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Gather_BroadcastStart(instance)

for _, p in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do
if IsValid(p) then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(p, string.format("Global quest '%s' is starting soon. Go to the zone within %d seconds.", questname, math.floor(joinTime)))
end
end

timer.Create(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalGather_" .. globalId, 0.5, 0, function()
local inst = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not inst then
timer.Remove(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalGather_" .. globalId)
return
end

if inst.state ~= "gathering" then
timer.Remove(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalGather_" .. globalId)
return
end

-- If everyone is already in the zone, don't force them to wait out a long join timer.
-- Clamp remaining time down to 10 seconds (never increases the timer).
do
local players = player.GetHumans()
if #players > 0 and istable(inst.zone) and inst.joinEndTime then
local allInZone = true
for _, p in ipairs(players) do
if IsValid(p) and p:IsPlayer() then
if not cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_IsPlayerInZone(p, inst.zone, inst.zoneCache) then
allInZone = false
break
end
end
end
if allInZone then
local remaining = (inst.joinEndTime or 0) - CurTime()
if remaining > 10 then
inst.joinEndTime = CurTime() + 10
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Gather_BroadcastStart(inst)
end
end
end
end

if CurTime() >= inst.joinEndTime then
timer.Remove(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalGather_" .. globalId)
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Begin(globalId)
end
end)

return true
end

end

function cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_GetDelay()
local cfg = cutta_quest_system["Configuration"] or {}
local delay = tonumber(cfg["Random Global Quests Events Timer"]) or 600
if delay < 30 then delay = 30 end
if delay > 32760 then delay = 32760 end
return delay
end

function cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_IsEnabled()
local cfg = cutta_quest_system["Configuration"] or {}
return cfg["Enable Random Global Quests Events"] == true
end

function cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_TryRun()
if not cutta_quest_system then return false end
if not cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_IsEnabled() then return false end
if CQS_GetAnyActiveGlobalInstance() then return false end

local delay = cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_GetDelay()
local nextAt = tonumber(cutta_quest_system.RandomGlobalQuestEvents_NextAt)
if not nextAt then
-- default schedule: don't fire immediately just because the addon loaded
nextAt = CurTime() + delay
cutta_quest_system.RandomGlobalQuestEvents_NextAt = nextAt
return false
end

if CurTime() < nextAt then return false end
if #player.GetAll() < 1 then return false end

local questname = CQS_GetRandomGlobalQuestName()
-- advance the schedule regardless, so we don't spam checks if there are no global quests
cutta_quest_system.RandomGlobalQuestEvents_NextAt = CurTime() + delay
if not questname then return false end

return cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_RequestStartServer(questname) == true
end

function cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_RefreshTimer()
if timer.Exists(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "RandomGlobalQuestEvents") then
timer.Remove(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "RandomGlobalQuestEvents")
end

if not cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_IsEnabled() then
cutta_quest_system.RandomGlobalQuestEvents_NextAt = nil
return
end

-- Use a short repeating timer and a next-run timestamp.
-- This keeps the schedule consistent and allows a player-join trigger to fire immediately.
timer.Create(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "RandomGlobalQuestEvents", 5, 0, function()
if not cutta_quest_system then return end
cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_TryRun()
end)
end

hook.Add("PlayerInitialSpawn", cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "RandomGlobalQuestEvents_OnJoin", function(ply)
-- If the server was empty/hibernating, timers may not tick; on join, run an event if due.
timer.Simple(2, function()
if not IsValid(ply) or ply.CUTTAQS_Player_Has_Loaded_Save ~= true then return end
if not cutta_quest_system or not cutta_quest_system.RandomGlobalQuestEvents_RefreshTimer then return end

cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_RefreshTimer()
if not cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_IsEnabled() then return end

-- First join after enabling: fire immediately once, then schedule the next run.
if cutta_quest_system.RandomGlobalQuestEvents_NextAt == nil then
cutta_quest_system.RandomGlobalQuestEvents_NextAt = CurTime() + cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_GetDelay()
end
cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_TryRun()
end)
end)

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Begin(globalId)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance or instance.state ~= "gathering" then return end

instance.state = "running"

cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Gather_BroadcastEnd(instance.questname)

local joined = {}
for _, ply in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do
if IsValid(ply) and ply:IsPlayer() then
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) and cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_IsPlayerInZone(ply, instance.zone, instance.zoneCache) then
joined[ply] = true
end
end
end

if table.Count(joined) < 1 then
for _, p in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do
if IsValid(p) then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(p, string.format("Global quest '%s' cancelled (no players in zone).", instance.questname))
end
end
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Cleanup(globalId)
return
end

instance.participants = joined

for ply, _ in pairs(joined) do
if IsValid(ply) then
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["IsInQuest"] = true
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["InQuest"] = instance.questname
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjNumb"] = 0
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["Objective"] = ""
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"] = globalId
cutta_quest_system:PlayerVariableTransfer(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Player_ShowStartMessageText(ply)
end
end

cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Advance(globalId)
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Advance(globalId, force)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance or instance.state ~= "running" then return end

local now = CurTime()
if not force then
if instance.lastAdvance and instance.lastAdvance > now - 0.25 then
return
end
end
instance.lastAdvance = now

local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(instance.questname)
local objectives = questData and questData.Objectives or nil
if not istable(objectives) then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Fail(globalId)
return
end

instance.objNumb = (tonumber(instance.objNumb) or 0) + 1

if instance.objNumb > table.Count(objectives) then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Complete(globalId)
return
end

-- Reset first (avoid removing newly spawned entities)
for ply, _ in pairs(instance.participants) do
if IsValid(ply) then
cutta_quest_system:Player_ResetQuestObjective(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_SetNumber(ply, instance.objNumb)
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"] = globalId
end
end

for ply, _ in pairs(instance.participants) do
if IsValid(ply) then
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective_Ext(ply)
end
end
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Complete(globalId)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance then return end
if instance.state == "completed" or instance.state == "completing" then return end
instance.state = "completing"

local participants = {}
for ply, _ in pairs(instance.participants or {}) do
if IsValid(ply) and ply:IsPlayer() then
table.insert(participants, ply)
end
end

for _, ply in ipairs(participants) do
if IsValid(ply) and ply:IsPlayer() then
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["IsInQuest"] = true
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["InQuest"] = instance.questname
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"] = nil
cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestCompleteNamed(ply, instance.questname)
end
end

instance.state = "completed"

cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Cleanup(globalId)
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Fail(globalId)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance then return end

-- Prevent recursion by clearing the global id before failing each player.
for ply, _ in pairs(instance.participants or {}) do
if IsValid(ply) then
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"] = nil
cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestFailed(ply)
end
end

cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Cleanup(globalId)
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Cleanup(globalId)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance then return end

-- ensure gather hud is cleared on clients
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Gather_BroadcastEnd(instance.questname)

-- remove any remaining global entities
if cutta_quest_system.entitylist then
for _, ent in pairs(cutta_quest_system.entitylist) do
if IsValid(ent) and ent:GetNWString(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId", "") == globalId then
ent:Remove()
end
end
end

if timer.Exists(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalGather_" .. globalId) then
timer.Remove(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalGather_" .. globalId)
end

if cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestByQuestName and instance.questname then
if cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestByQuestName[instance.questname] == globalId then
cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestByQuestName[instance.questname] = nil
end
end

cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestInstances[globalId] = nil
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_OnObjectiveEntityRemoved(globalId, removedObjNumb)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance or instance.state ~= "running" then return end

local currentObjNumb = tonumber(instance.objNumb) or 0
if currentObjNumb < 1 then return end

removedObjNumb = tonumber(removedObjNumb) or 0
if removedObjNumb > 0 and removedObjNumb ~= currentObjNumb then
return
end

-- If no required entities remain for this global quest, advance.
local anyLeft = false
if cutta_quest_system.entitylist then
for _, ent in pairs(cutta_quest_system.entitylist) do
if IsValid(ent)
and ent:GetNWString(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId", "") == globalId
and ent:GetNWBool(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "ObjectiveOwned", false)
and tonumber(ent:GetNWInt(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "ObjectiveObjNumb", 0)) == currentObjNumb then
anyLeft = true
break
end
end
end

if not anyLeft then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Advance(globalId)
end
end

-- Returns the global quest instance that the player is currently a participant of, or nil.
local function CQS_GetInstanceForPlayer(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return nil end
if not istable(cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestInstances) then return nil end
for _, inst in pairs(cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestInstances) do
if istable(inst) and inst.state == "running" and istable(inst.participants) then
if inst.participants[ply] == true then
return inst
end
end
end
return nil
end

-- Prevent players in the same global quest from dealing damage to each other.
hook.Add("EntityTakeDamage", cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuest_FriendlyFire", function(victim, dmginfo)
if not IsValid(victim) or not victim:IsPlayer() then return end
local attacker = dmginfo:GetAttacker()
if not IsValid(attacker) or not attacker:IsPlayer() then return end
if attacker == victim then return end

local victimInst = CQS_GetInstanceForPlayer(victim)
if not victimInst then return end
local attackerInst = CQS_GetInstanceForPlayer(attacker)
if not attackerInst then return end

if victimInst == attackerInst then
return true -- block the damage
end
end)

local function CQS_SendCompressedChunk(netName, recipient, payloadTable)
if not istable(payloadTable) then return end
if not isstring(netName) or netName == "" then return end

local json = util.TableToJSON(payloadTable)
if not json then return end

local compressed = util.Compress(json)
if not compressed then return end

net.Start(netName)
net.WriteUInt(#compressed, 32)
net.WriteData(compressed, #compressed)

if IsValid(recipient) then
net.Send(recipient)
else
net.Broadcast()
end
end

local CQS_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES = 30000
local CQS_PLAYER_SYNC_CHUNK_INTERVAL = 0.06

-- Send a pre-compressed byte string directly (for cached payloads)
local function CQS_SendPreCompressedChunk(netName, recipient, compressedData)
if not isstring(compressedData) or #compressedData == 0 then return end
if not isstring(netName) or netName == "" then return end

net.Start(netName)
net.WriteUInt(#compressedData, 32)
net.WriteData(compressedData, #compressedData)

if IsValid(recipient) then
net.Send(recipient)
else
net.Broadcast()
end
end

local function CQS_SendPreCompressedChunksQueued(netName, recipient, chunks, onDone)
if not IsValid(recipient) then return end
if not istable(chunks) or #chunks <= 0 then
if isfunction(onDone) then
onDone()
end
return
end

local timerName = string.format("%sChunkQueue_%s_%s", tostring(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] or "CQS"), tostring(recipient:EntIndex()), string.gsub(tostring(netName or ""), "[^%w]", "_"))
if timer.Exists(timerName) then
timer.Remove(timerName)
end

local index = 1
local function finishQueue()
if timer.Exists(timerName) then
timer.Remove(timerName)
end
if isfunction(onDone) then
onDone()
end
end

local function sendNextChunk()
if not IsValid(recipient) then
if timer.Exists(timerName) then
timer.Remove(timerName)
end
return
end

local compressedData = chunks[index]
if isstring(compressedData) and #compressedData > 0 then
CQS_SendPreCompressedChunk(netName, recipient, compressedData)
end

index = index + 1
if index > #chunks then
finishQueue()
end
end

sendNextChunk()
if index <= #chunks then
timer.Create(timerName, CQS_PLAYER_SYNC_CHUNK_INTERVAL, 0, sendNextChunk)
end
end

local function CQS_AppendChunkedEntry(chunks, chunk, chunkBytes, entry, entryJson, maxBytes)
local jsonSize = isstring(entryJson) and #entryJson or 0
if jsonSize <= 0 then return chunk, chunkBytes end

local projectedBytes = chunkBytes + jsonSize
if #chunk > 0 then
projectedBytes = projectedBytes + 1
end

if projectedBytes > maxBytes and #chunk > 0 then
chunks[#chunks + 1] = chunk
chunk = {}
chunkBytes = 0
end

chunk[#chunk + 1] = entry
if #chunk > 1 then
chunkBytes = chunkBytes + 1
end
chunkBytes = chunkBytes + jsonSize

return chunk, chunkBytes
end

local function CQS_SendCompressedChunks(netName, recipient, entries, maxBytes, onDone)
if not istable(entries) or #entries <= 0 then
if isfunction(onDone) then
onDone()
end
return
end

maxBytes = tonumber(maxBytes) or CQS_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES
if maxBytes < 12000 then
maxBytes = 12000
end

local chunks = {}
local chunk = {}
local chunkBytes = 0

for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
local entryJson = util.TableToJSON(entry)
if entryJson then
chunk, chunkBytes = CQS_AppendChunkedEntry(chunks, chunk, chunkBytes, entry, entryJson, maxBytes)
end
end

if #chunk > 0 then
chunks[#chunks + 1] = chunk
end

local function sendQueuedChunk(index)
if recipient ~= nil and not IsValid(recipient) then
if isfunction(onDone) then
onDone()
end
return
end

local nextChunk = chunks[index]
if istable(nextChunk) and #nextChunk > 0 then
CQS_SendCompressedChunk(netName, recipient, nextChunk)
end

if index < #chunks then
timer.Simple(0, function()
sendQueuedChunk(index + 1)
end)
elseif isfunction(onDone) then
onDone()
end
end

sendQueuedChunk(1)
end

-- Pre-build compressed chunks for a set of entries and return cached byte-string array
local function CQS_BuildCompressedChunks(entries, maxBytes)
if not istable(entries) or #entries <= 0 then return {} end

maxBytes = tonumber(maxBytes) or CQS_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES
if maxBytes < 12000 then maxBytes = 12000 end

local chunks = {}
local chunk = {}
local chunkBytes = 0

local function flushChunk()
if #chunk <= 0 then return end
local json = util.TableToJSON(chunk)
local compressed = json and util.Compress(json) or nil
if compressed then
chunks[#chunks + 1] = compressed
end
chunk = {}
chunkBytes = 0
end

for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
local entryJson = util.TableToJSON(entry)
if entryJson then
local projectedBytes = chunkBytes + #entryJson
if #chunk > 0 then
projectedBytes = projectedBytes + 1
end

if projectedBytes > maxBytes and #chunk > 0 then
flushChunk()
end

table.insert(chunk, entry)
if #chunk > 1 then
chunkBytes = chunkBytes + 1
end
chunkBytes = chunkBytes + #entryJson
end
end

flushChunk()
return chunks
end

local function cuttaqs_is_sound_file(filename)
if not isstring(filename) then return false end
if string.StartWith(filename, ".") then return false end
local ext = string.lower(string.GetExtensionFromFilename(filename) or "")
return ext == "wav" or ext == "mp3" or ext == "ogg"
end

local CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER = "CuttaQuestSystem_SoundScanQueue"
local CQS_SOUND_SCAN_INITIAL_DELAY = 8
local CQS_SOUND_SCAN_INTERVAL = 0.5
local CQS_SOUND_SCAN_DIRS_PER_TICK = 1

local function cuttaqs_prepare_sound_bucket(soundStore, key, includeRandom)
if not istable(soundStore) then return end

if not istable(soundStore[key]) then
soundStore[key] = {}
else
table.Empty(soundStore[key])
end

if includeRandom then
table.insert(soundStore[key], "Random")
end
end

local function cuttaqs_enqueue_sound_dir(job, searchPath, relativePath)
if not istable(job) then return end
if not isstring(searchPath) or searchPath == "" then return end
job.queue = job.queue or {}
job.queue[#job.queue + 1] = {
searchPath = searchPath,
relativePath = relativePath or ""
}
end

local function cuttaqs_process_sound_job(job, bucket, maxDirsPerTick)
if not istable(job) or not istable(bucket) then return true end

job.queue = job.queue or {}

local processedDirs = 0

while processedDirs < maxDirsPerTick and #job.queue > 0 do
local dirNode = table.remove(job.queue, 1)
processedDirs = processedDirs + 1

if istable(dirNode) and isstring(dirNode.searchPath) and dirNode.searchPath ~= "" then
local files, dirs = file.Find(dirNode.searchPath .. "/*", "GAME")
files = files or {}
dirs = dirs or {}

if #dirs == 0 and #files > 0 then
for _, name in ipairs(files) do
if not cuttaqs_is_sound_file(name) and file.IsDir(dirNode.searchPath .. "/" .. name, "GAME") then
table.insert(dirs, name)
end
end
end

for _, f in ipairs(files) do
if cuttaqs_is_sound_file(f) and not file.IsDir(dirNode.searchPath .. "/" .. f, "GAME") then
local relPath = (dirNode.relativePath ~= "") and (dirNode.relativePath .. "/" .. f) or f
table.insert(bucket, relPath)
end
end

for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
local nextSearch = dirNode.searchPath .. "/" .. d
local nextRelative = (dirNode.relativePath ~= "") and (dirNode.relativePath .. "/" .. d) or d
cuttaqs_enqueue_sound_dir(job, nextSearch, nextRelative)
end
end
end

return #job.queue <= 0
end

local function cuttaqs_queue_sound_scan(cqs)
if not istable(cqs) then return end

cqs["Sounds"] = cqs["Sounds"] or {}

local scanJobs = {
{ key = "Complete", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/complete", includeRandom = true, queue = {}, done = false },
{ key = "Start", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/start", includeRandom = true, queue = {}, done = false },
{ key = "Fail", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/fail", includeRandom = true, queue = {}, done = false },
{ key = "Music", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/music", includeRandom = false, queue = {}, done = false },
{ key = "SFX", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/sfx", includeRandom = false, queue = {}, done = false },
{ key = "GlobalQuestStart", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/globalquests", includeRandom = true, queue = {}, done = false }
}

for _, job in ipairs(scanJobs) do
cuttaqs_prepare_sound_bucket(cqs["Sounds"], job.key, job.includeRandom)
cuttaqs_enqueue_sound_dir(job, job.searchPath, "")
end

if timer.Exists(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER) then
timer.Remove(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER)
end

timer.Simple(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_INITIAL_DELAY, function()
if not istable(cutta_quest_system) then return end

local activeJobIndex = 1
timer.Create(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER, CQS_SOUND_SCAN_INTERVAL, 0, function()
if not istable(cutta_quest_system) then
timer.Remove(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER)
return
end

local unfinishedCount = 0
for _, jobState in ipairs(scanJobs) do
if not jobState.done then
unfinishedCount = unfinishedCount + 1
end
end

if unfinishedCount <= 0 then
timer.Remove(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER)

for _, ply in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do
cqs:Quests_SoundTransfer_ply(ply)
end
print("[CuttaQS] Sound scan queue complete.")
return
end

local selectedJob = nil
local selectedIndex = activeJobIndex
for offset = 0, #scanJobs - 1 do
local idx = ((activeJobIndex - 1 + offset) % #scanJobs) + 1
if not scanJobs[idx].done then
selectedJob = scanJobs[idx]
selectedIndex = idx
break
end
end

if not selectedJob then
return
end

local bucket = cqs["Sounds"][selectedJob.key]
if not istable(bucket) then
bucket = {}
cqs["Sounds"][selectedJob.key] = bucket
if selectedJob.includeRandom then
table.insert(bucket, "Random")
end
end

selectedJob.done = cuttaqs_process_sound_job(selectedJob, bucket, CQS_SOUND_SCAN_DIRS_PER_TICK)
if selectedJob.done then
table.sort(bucket, function(a, b)
if a == "Random" then return true end
if b == "Random" then return false end
return tostring(a) < tostring(b)
end)
end

activeJobIndex = (selectedIndex % #scanJobs) + 1
end)
end)
end

local function SanitizeModelBodygroups(bodygroups)
local sanitized = {}
if not istable(bodygroups) then return nil end

for _, bodygroup in ipairs(bodygroups) do

local bodygroupValue = tonumber(bodygroup.value)
if bodygroupID ~= nil and bodygroupValue ~= nil then
sanitized[#sanitized + 1] = {
id = math.max(math.floor(bodygroupID), 0),
value = math.max(math.floor(bodygroupValue), 0)
}
end
end

if #sanitized == 0 then
return nil
end

table.sort(sanitized, function(a, b)
return a.id < b.id
end)

return sanitized
end

local ok, parsed = pcall(util.JSONToTable, itemdata.requiredusergroup)
if ok and istable(parsed) then
groupsTbl = {}
for _, g in ipairs(parsed) do
if isstring(g) and g ~= "" then table.insert(groupsTbl, g) end
end
end
-- Fallback: comma-separated list or Lua-like braces
if not groupsTbl then
local s = tostring(itemdata.requiredusergroup)
s = string.Trim(s)
-- strip surrounding braces if present
if string.StartWith(s, "{") and string.EndsWith(s, "}") then
s = string.sub(s, 2, #s-1)
end
-- remove quotes
s = s:gsub("[\"']", "")
-- split by comma
local tmp = {}
for token in string.gmatch(s, "[^,]+") do
local t = string.Trim(token)
if t ~= "" then table.insert(tmp, t) end
end
if #tmp > 0 then groupsTbl = tmp end
end
if groupsTbl and #groupsTbl > 0 then
ITEM.RequiredUserGroups = groupsTbl
end
end

local TIMED_GIVEAWAY_TIMER = "CuttaCosmetic_TimedGiveaway"

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:GetTimedGiveawaySettings()
self["Config"] = self["Config"] or {}

local enabled = self["Config"]["TimedGiveaway_Enabled"] == true
local minPlayers = math.Clamp(math.floor(tonumber(self["Config"]["TimedGiveaway_MinPlayers"]) or 5), 1, 128)
local intervalMinutes = math.Clamp(math.floor(tonumber(self["Config"]["TimedGiveaway_IntervalMinutes"]) or 30), 1, 1440)

return enabled, minPlayers, intervalMinutes
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:GetTimedGiveawayPrize()
local items = self["Items"] or {}
local pool = {}

local function itemHasUserGroupRestriction(itemData)
if not itemData then return false end
if istable(itemData.RequiredUserGroups) and #itemData.RequiredUserGroups > 0 then
return true
end
if isstring(itemData.RequiredUserGroup) and string.Trim(itemData.RequiredUserGroup) ~= "" then
return true
end
if isstring(itemData.RequiredUserGroups) and string.Trim(itemData.RequiredUserGroups) ~= "" then
return true
end
return false
end

for _, itemData in pairs(items) do
if itemData and itemData.ID and not itemHasUserGroupRestriction(itemData) then
pool[#pool + 1] = itemData
end
end

if #pool == 0 then return nil end
return pool[math.random(#pool)]
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:StartTimedGiveaway()
local enabled, minPlayers = self:GetTimedGiveawaySettings()
if not enabled then return false, "Timed giveaways are disabled" end
if timer.Exists("CuttaCosmetic_Giveaway_Announce") then
return false, "A giveaway is already running"
end

local onlinePlayers = player.GetHumans()
if #onlinePlayers < minPlayers then
return false, "Not enough players online"
end

local prize = self:GetTimedGiveawayPrize()
if not prize then
return false, "No cosmetic items are available for giveaways"
end

local ok, winnerOrError = self:StartGiveaway(nil, prize.ID)
if not ok then
return false, winnerOrError
end

PrintMessage(HUD_PRINTTALK, string.format("[Cutta Cosmetics] Timed giveaway started for %s!", prize.Name or prize.ID))
return true, winnerOrError, prize
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:SyncTimedGiveawayTimer()
local enabled, _, intervalMinutes = self:GetTimedGiveawaySettings()
timer.Remove(TIMED_GIVEAWAY_TIMER)

if not enabled then return end

timer.Create(TIMED_GIVEAWAY_TIMER, intervalMinutes * 60, 0, function()
if not cutta_cosmetic_shop then return end
cutta_cosmetic_shop:StartTimedGiveaway()
end)
end

local function normalizeSteam64(id)
if not id or id == "" then return nil end
id = string.Trim(tostring(id))
if id == "" then return nil end
if string.find(id, "STEAM_", 1, true) then
id = util.SteamIDTo64(id) or id
end
return id
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:StartGiveaway(forcedSteamID64, giveawayID,rollDuration)
local entries = self:BuildGiveawayEntries()
if #entries == 0 then return false, "No players online" end
if timer.Exists("CuttaCosmetic_Giveaway_Announce") then
return false, "A giveaway is already running"
end

local winnerIndex
local forcedMatched = false
local forced = normalizeSteam64(forcedSteamID64)
if forced then
for idx, entry in RandomPairs(entries) do
if entry.steam64 == forced then
winnerIndex = idx
forcedMatched = true
break
end
end
end

if not winnerIndex then
winnerIndex = math.random(#entries)
end

local winnerEntry = entries[winnerIndex]
if not rollDuration then
rollDuration = math.Clamp(#entries * 0.25 + 4, 5, 14)
end

net.Start("CuttaCosmetic_Giveaway_Start")
net.WriteUInt(#entries, 8)
for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
net.WriteString(entry.name)
net.WriteString(entry.steam64)
net.WriteBool(entry.isBot)
end
net.WriteUInt(winnerIndex, 8)
net.WriteFloat(rollDuration)
net.Broadcast()

timer.Remove("CuttaCosmetic_Giveaway_Announce")
timer.Create("CuttaCosmetic_Giveaway_Announce", rollDuration, 1, function()
if not winnerEntry then return end
local msg = string.format("[Cutta Cosmetics] %s has won the giveaway!", winnerEntry.name)
PrintMessage(HUD_PRINTTALK, msg)
PrintMessage(HUD_PRINTCENTER, winnerEntry.name .. " won the giveaway!")
cutta_cosmetic_shop:Ply_Won_Giveaway(player.GetBySteamID64(winnerEntry.steam64), giveawayID)
end)

return true, winnerEntry, forcedMatched
end

- target: number. The target angle snap interval

Returns

Notes
- This will modify the original angle too!

Example

Example usage
```lua
print( Angle( 0, 92, 0 ):SnapTo( "y", 90 ) )
print( Angle( 0, 115, 0 ):SnapTo( "y", 45 ) )

```

What are the main performance rules for Garry's Mod Lua addons and complex systems?

Performance problems usually come from code that runs too often or sends too much.

Checklist
- Do not do heavy work in Think or HUDPaint unless it is cached or gated.
- Cache lookups, panels, and expensive calculations when possible.
- Prefer event-driven hooks over polling loops.
- Avoid broadcasting net messages when only one player needs the data.
- Avoid serializing giant tables every frame.
- Reuse timers and materials instead of recreating them repeatedly.
- Be careful with ents.GetAll, player.GetAll, and large table scans in hot paths.
- Cull expensive drawing by distance, visibility, or ownership.

When debugging lag, first identify the hot hook, then reduce frequency, allocations, and network volume.

Show an example of saving and loading player addon data on the server in Garry's Mod Lua.

```lua
local SAVE_DIR = "myaddon"

local function data_path(ply)
return SAVE_DIR .. "/" .. ply:SteamID64() .. ".json"
end

local function load_player_data(ply)
if not file.Exists(data_path(ply), "DATA") then
return {coins = 0, loadout = {}}
end

local raw = file.Read(data_path(ply), "DATA") or ""
local decoded = util.JSONToTable(raw) or {}
decoded.coins = tonumber(decoded.coins) or 0
decoded.loadout = istable(decoded.loadout) and decoded.loadout or {}
return decoded
end

local function save_player_data(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply.MyAddonData then return end
file.CreateDir(SAVE_DIR)
file.Write(data_path(ply), util.TableToJSON(ply.MyAddonData, true))
end

hook.Add("PlayerInitialSpawn", "MyAddon_LoadData", function(ply)
ply.MyAddonData = load_player_data(ply)
end)

hook.Add("PlayerDisconnected", "MyAddon_SaveData", function(ply)
save_player_data(ply)
end)

hook.Add("ShutDown", "MyAddon_SaveAllPlayers", function()
for _, ply in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do
save_player_data(ply)
end
end)
```

This keeps persistence authoritative on the server and uses JSON files in garrysmod/data/myaddon.

local function CQS_GenerateDuplicatedNPCID(baseID)
local cleanBase = string.lower(tostring(baseID or "dialoguenpc"))
if cleanBase == "" then
cleanBase = "dialoguenpc"

local function CIS_TableContainsValue(tbl, value)

local function CIS_CanImportWeapons(ply)

if not IsValid(ply) then return true end
if ply:IsSuperAdmin() then return true end

local trusted = cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["TrustedWeaponImporterSteamID64s"] or {}
local steamID64 = ply:SteamID64()

if not isstring(steamID64) or steamID64 == "" then return false end
if trusted[steamID64] == true then return true end

return CIS_TableContainsValue(trusted, steamID64)

end

local function CIS_IsWeaponBlacklisted(class)

local blacklist = cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["BulkWeaponImportClassBlacklist"] or {}

if blacklist[class] == true then return true end

return CIS_TableContainsValue(blacklist, class)

function cutta_inventory_system:Item_BulkImportCustomWeapons(price)

local importPrice = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(price) or cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["BulkWeaponImportDefaultPrice"] or 0), 0)
local added = 0
local skippedExisting = 0
local skippedBlacklisted = 0
local skippedHidden = 0
local skippedInvalid = 0

for _, swep in ipairs(weapons.GetList() or {}) do

local class = tostring(swep.ClassName or swep.Class or "")

if class == "" then

skippedInvalid = skippedInvalid + 1

elseif CIS_IsWeaponBlacklisted(class) then

skippedBlacklisted = skippedBlacklisted + 1

elseif cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class] then

skippedExisting = skippedExisting + 1

else

local stored = weapons.GetStored(class) or swep
local canSpawn = stored.Spawnable == true or stored.AdminOnly == true or swep.Spawnable == true or swep.AdminOnly == true
local model = stored.WorldModel or swep.WorldModel or ""
local name = stored.PrintName or swep.PrintName or class

if not canSpawn then

skippedHidden = skippedHidden + 1

elseif not isstring(model) or model == "" then

skippedInvalid = skippedInvalid + 1

else

cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class] = {

Name = isstring(name) and name != "" and name or class,
Class = class,
Model = model,
Type = "weapon",
Price = importPrice,

}

added = added + 1

end

end

end

if added > 0 then

CIS_SaveItemsData()

for _, target in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do

if IsValid(target) then

cutta_inventory_system:Item_Transfer(target)

end

end

end

return {
Added = added,
SkippedExisting = skippedExisting,
SkippedBlacklisted = skippedBlacklisted,
SkippedHidden = skippedHidden,
SkippedInvalid = skippedInvalid,
}

end

.. " | hidden: " .. tostring(result.SkippedHidden or 0)
.. " | invalid: " .. tostring(result.SkippedInvalid or 0)

end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:AttachPropToPlayer(ply, modelPath, boneName, posOffset, angOffset, cosmeticID)

if not IsValid(ply) then return end

local ent = ClientsideModel(modelPath)

if not IsValid(ent) then return end

ent:SetNoDraw(true) -- Keep model no-draw; we'll render it in PostPlayerDraw so it's visible to all clients

ent:SetModel(modelPath)

ent:SetupBones()

local boneID = ply:LookupBone(boneName or "")

if not boneID then boneID = 0 end

posOffset = posOffset or Vector(0,0,0)

angOffset = angOffset or Angle(0,0,0)

ent._cosmetic_owner = ply

ent._cosmetic_id = cosmeticID

return ent

end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:ApplyCharacterProps(ply)

if not IsValid(ply) then return end

local cosmeticData = ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"]

if not cosmeticData then return end

ply.Cutta_AttachedProps = ply.Cutta_AttachedProps or {}

-- Remove props not in saved list

for id, ent in pairs(ply.Cutta_AttachedProps) do

if not cosmeticData[id] or not cosmeticData[id].added then

if IsValid(ent) then ent:Remove() end

ply.Cutta_AttachedProps[id] = nil

end

end

-- Create props for each saved item

for id, data in pairs(cosmeticData) do

if data.added then

local item = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_GETTABLE(id)

if not item then continue end

local expectedModel = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeModelPath(item.Model)

local modelMissing = expectedModel ~= "" and cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_ModelMissing(expectedModel)

local ent = ply.Cutta_AttachedProps[id]

-- If the model is missing, remove any ERROR entity and try a workshop download

if modelMissing then

if IsValid(ent) then

ent:Remove()

ply.Cutta_AttachedProps[id] = nil

end

if cutta_cosmetic_shop.Client_RequestItemWorkshopDownload

and cutta_cosmetic_shop.Client_WorkshopAutoDownloadEnabled

and cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_WorkshopAutoDownloadEnabled() then

cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_RequestItemWorkshopDownload(id)

end

continue

end

-- If entity exists but shows the wrong model (e.g. error.mdl), recreate it

if IsValid(ent) then

local currentModel = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeModelPath(ent:GetModel() or "")

if currentModel ~= expectedModel and expectedModel ~= "" then

ent:Remove()

ply.Cutta_AttachedProps[id] = nil

ent = nil

end

end

if not IsValid(ent) then

ent = cutta_cosmetic_shop:AttachPropToPlayer(

ply,

item.Model,

data.boneselect,

Vector(data.posx, data.posy, data.posz),

Angle(data.pitch, data.yaw, data.roll),

id

)

ply.Cutta_AttachedProps[id] = ent

-- If this item is a pet, attempt to play its stored pet animation once

if item.IsPet == "true" and item.PetAnimation and IsValid(ent) then

local seq = ent:LookupSequence(item.PetAnimation)

if seq and seq >= 0 then

ent:ResetSequence(seq)

ent:SetCycle(0)

ent:SetPlaybackRate(1)

end

end

end

-- Apply scale (always clamped <= 1)

if IsValid(ent) and ent.SetModelScale then

local scale = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ClampCosmeticScale(data.scale)

ent:SetModelScale(scale, 0)

end

end

end

end

hook.Add("PostPlayerDraw", "CuttaCosmetics_Render", function(ply)

if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:Alive() then return end

if ply == LocalPlayer() and GetViewEntity() and GetViewEntity():GetClass() == 'player' and (GetConVar('thirdperson') and GetConVar('thirdperson'):GetInt() == 0) then return end

if not ply.Cutta_AttachedProps or next(ply.Cutta_AttachedProps) == nil or not ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"] then return end

local savedProps = ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"] or {}

if next(savedProps) == nil then return end

local canrender = hook.Run("CuttaCosmetics_PreRender_Check", ply)

if canrender == false then return end

-- Ensure bones are available for this player

if ply.InvalidateBoneCache then

ply:InvalidateBoneCache()

end

if ply.SetupBones then

ply:SetupBones()

end

for id, model in pairs(ply.Cutta_AttachedProps) do

if not IsValid(model) then

ply.Cutta_AttachedProps[id] = nil

else

local data = savedProps[id]

if not data or not data.added then

-- nothing to draw for this id

else

-- Lookup bone index via name if provided, else fallback to 0

local boneName = data.boneselect

local boneIndex = ply:LookupBone(boneName or "")

if not boneIndex or boneIndex < 0 then

boneIndex = 0

end

-- Try to get a bone matrix for exact transforms

local bonePos, boneAng

local mat

if ply.GetBoneMatrix and boneIndex and boneIndex >= 0 then

mat = ply:GetBoneMatrix(boneIndex)

end

if mat then

bonePos = mat:GetTranslation()

boneAng = mat:GetAngles()

else

-- fallback to GetBonePosition which returns pos/ang

local pos1, ang1 = ply:GetBonePosition(boneIndex)

if pos1 and ang1 then

bonePos = pos1

boneAng = ang1

else

-- as last resort use the player's origin

bonePos = ply:GetPos()

boneAng = ply:GetAngles()

end

end

local localPos = Vector(data.posx or 0, data.posy or 0, data.posz or 0)

local function TryPlayAnimationSequence(target, animationName)

if not IsValid(target) then return false end

local resolvedAnimation = string.Trim(tostring(animationName or ""))

if resolvedAnimation == "" then return false end

local sequence = target:LookupSequence(resolvedAnimation)

if not sequence or sequence < 0 then

local lowerAnimation = string.lower(resolvedAnimation)

local sequenceCount = math.max((target:GetSequenceCount() or 0) - 1, -1)

for index = 0, sequenceCount do

local sequenceName = target:GetSequenceName(index)

if sequenceName and string.find(string.lower(sequenceName), lowerAnimation, 1, true) then

sequence = index

break

end

end

end

if not sequence or sequence < 0 then return false end

target:ResetSequence(sequence, true)

target:SetCycle(0)

target:SetPlaybackRate(1)

return true

end

local function RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, success)

local runtimeState = cutta_cosmetic_shop["WorkshopRuntimeDownloads"]

runtimeState.callbacks = runtimeState.callbacks or {}

local callbacks = runtimeState.callbacks[workshopID]

runtimeState.callbacks[workshopID] = nil

if not istable(callbacks) then return end

for i = 1, #callbacks do

local callbackEntry = callbacks[i]

local callback = callbackEntry

local callbackAssetPath = nil

local callbackCosmeticID = nil

local callbackAssetType = "model"

if istable(callbackEntry) then

callback = callbackEntry.callback

callbackAssetType = callbackEntry.assetType == "sound" and "sound" or "model"

if callbackAssetType == "sound" then

callbackAssetPath = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeSoundPath(callbackEntry.assetPath or callbackEntry.modelPath)

else

callbackAssetPath = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeModelPath(callbackEntry.assetPath or callbackEntry.modelPath)

end

callbackCosmeticID = callbackEntry.cosmeticID

end

local callbackSuccess = success == true

if callbackSuccess and callbackAssetPath ~= nil and callbackAssetPath ~= "" then

if callbackAssetType == "sound" then

callbackSuccess = not cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_SoundMissing(callbackAssetPath)

else

callbackSuccess = not cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_ModelMissing(callbackAssetPath)

end

end

if isfunction(callback) then

pcall(callback, callbackSuccess, callbackAssetPath, callbackCosmeticID, workshopID, callbackAssetType)

end

end

end

runtimeState.callbacks[workshopID] = runtimeState.callbacks[workshopID] or {}

local resolvedAssetType = assetType == "sound" and "sound" or "model"

local normalizedAssetPath = resolvedAssetType == "sound"

and cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeSoundPath(assetPath)

or cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeModelPath(assetPath)

runtimeState.callbacks[workshopID][#runtimeState.callbacks[workshopID] + 1] = {

assetType = resolvedAssetType,

assetPath = normalizedAssetPath,

cosmeticID = cosmeticID ~= nil and tostring(cosmeticID) or nil

}

end

local function ExtractWorkshopID(input)

local trimmed = string.Trim(input)

if trimmed == "" then return nil end

local directId = string.match(trimmed, "^(%d+)$")

if directId then

return directId

end

local queryId = string.match(trimmed, "[?&]id=(%d+)")

if queryId then

return queryId

end

return string.match(trimmed, "/(%d+)/?$")

end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_SoundMissing(soundPath, bypassCache)

local normalizedSound = self:NormalizeSoundPath(soundPath)

if normalizedSound == "" then return false end

self["ClientSoundAvailabilityCache"] = self["ClientSoundAvailabilityCache"] or {}

if bypassCache == true then

self["ClientSoundAvailabilityCache"][normalizedSound] = nil

end

local cachedAvailability = self["ClientSoundAvailabilityCache"][normalizedSound]

if cachedAvailability ~= nil then

return cachedAvailability ~= true

end

local soundAvailable = false

if sound and isfunction(sound.Exists) then

local ok, existsInGame = pcall(sound.Exists, normalizedSound, "GAME")

soundAvailable = ok and existsInGame == true

end

if not soundAvailable and file.Exists("sound/" .. normalizedSound, "GAME") then

soundAvailable = true

end

if not soundAvailable and file.Exists("sound/" .. normalizedSound, "MOD") then

soundAvailable = true

end

self["ClientSoundAvailabilityCache"][normalizedSound] = soundAvailable == true

return self["ClientSoundAvailabilityCache"][normalizedSound] ~= true

end

end

if not modelAvailable and file.Exists(normalizedModel, "GAME") then

end

local shouldReapplyProps = false

ply.Cutta_AttachedProps = ply.Cutta_AttachedProps or {}

for i = 1, #trackedProps do

local trackedProp = trackedProps[i]

local trackedWorkshopID = tostring(trackedProp.item.WorkshopID or ExtractWorkshopID(trackedProp.item.WorkshopLink or "") or "")

if trackedWorkshopID ~= workshopID then continue end

if cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_ModelMissing(trackedProp.modelPath, true) then continue end
