return istable(RPExtraTeams)
end

function ADDON:SanitizeFactionMember(entry, command)
if not istable(entry) then
entry = {
command = command
}
end

local stored_team_id = self:NormalizeInteger(entry.team_id, 0, 0) or 0

command = self:NormalizeAssignmentKey(command or entry.command)

if command == "" and stored_team_id > 0 then
command = self:GetTeamAssignmentKey(stored_team_id)
end

if command == "" then return nil end

local live_team_index = self:GetJobTeamIndexByCommand(command) or stored_team_id
local live_name = self:GetJobNameFromCommand(command)
local player_kill_value = self:NormalizeMagnitude(entry.player_kill_value or entry.enemy_player_delta or entry.player_delta, self.Config.DefaultPlayerDelta, self.Config.MaxDelta)
local npc_kill_value = self:NormalizeMagnitude(entry.npc_kill_value or entry.npc_delta, self.Config.DefaultNPCDelta, self.Config.MaxDelta)

return {
command = command,
name = self:NormalizeString(live_name, self:NormalizeString(entry.name, command)),
team_id = self:NormalizeInteger(live_team_index or entry.team_id, 0, 0) or 0,
player_kill_value = player_kill_value,
npc_kill_value = npc_kill_value
}
end

function ADDON:SanitizeFactionLookup(raw_lookup)
local sanitized = {}

if not istable(raw_lookup) then
return sanitized
end

for key, value in pairs(raw_lookup) do
local member = self:SanitizeFactionMember(value, key)
if member then
sanitized[member.command] = member
end
end

return sanitized
end

function ADDON:SanitizeStoredCollapseState(raw_collapse)
local stored_collapse = istable(raw_collapse) and raw_collapse or {}
local default_duration = math.max(60, math.floor(tonumber(self.Config.CollapseCountdownSeconds) or 60))

return {
duration_seconds = default_duration,
deadline_unix = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(stored_collapse.deadline_unix) or 0)),
five_minute_triggered = stored_collapse.five_minute_triggered == true,
two_minute_triggered = stored_collapse.two_minute_triggered == true
}
end

function ADDON:NormalizeEscapeModel(model_path)
local fallback_model = self:NormalizeString(self.Config.EscapePointDefaultModel, "models/props_phx/misc/bunker01.mdl")
local normalized_model = self:NormalizeString(model_path, fallback_model)

if normalized_model == "" then
return fallback_model
end

if util.IsValidModel and util.IsValidModel(normalized_model) then
return normalized_model
end

return fallback_model
end

function ADDON:SerializeVector(vector_value)
if not isvector(vector_value) then
return {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0}
end

return {
x = tonumber(vector_value.x) or 0,
y = tonumber(vector_value.y) or 0,
z = tonumber(vector_value.z) or 0
}
end

function ADDON:SerializeAngle(angle_value)
if not isangle(angle_value) then
return {p = 0, y = 0, r = 0}
end

return {
p = tonumber(angle_value.p) or 0,
y = tonumber(angle_value.y) or 0,
r = tonumber(angle_value.r) or 0
}
end

function ADDON:BuildVectorFromTable(raw_value)
if isvector(raw_value) then
return Vector(raw_value.x, raw_value.y, raw_value.z)
end

if not istable(raw_value) then
return nil
end

local x = tonumber(raw_value.x or raw_value[1])
local y = tonumber(raw_value.y or raw_value[2])
local z = tonumber(raw_value.z or raw_value[3])

if x == nil or y == nil or z == nil then
return nil
end

return Vector(x, y, z)
end

function ADDON:BuildAngleFromTable(raw_value)
if isangle(raw_value) then
return Angle(raw_value.p, raw_value.y, raw_value.r)
end

if not istable(raw_value) then
return Angle(0, 0, 0)
end

return Angle(
tonumber(raw_value.p or raw_value[1]) or 0,
tonumber(raw_value.y or raw_value[2]) or 0,
tonumber(raw_value.r or raw_value[3]) or 0
)
end

function ADDON:GenerateEscapePointId()
return "escape_" .. util.CRC(string.format("%s:%s:%s", tostring(os.time() or 0), tostring(SysTime() or 0), tostring(math.random())))
end

function ADDON:GetEscapePointMapKey(map_name)
local fallback_map = string.lower(self:NormalizeString(game.GetMap(), "unknown"))
local normalized_map = string.lower(self:NormalizeString(map_name, fallback_map))

if normalized_map == "" then
return fallback_map
end

return normalized_map
end

function ADDON:SanitizeEscapeMapState(raw_escape, fallback_prefix)
local stored_escape = istable(raw_escape) and raw_escape or {}
local sanitized_points = {}
local seen_ids = {}

for index, raw_point in ipairs(stored_escape.points or stored_escape.locations or {}) do
local sanitized_point = self:SanitizeEscapePoint(raw_point, string.format("%s_escape_%d", fallback_prefix or "escape", index))

if sanitized_point and not seen_ids[sanitized_point.id] then
seen_ids[sanitized_point.id] = true
sanitized_points[#sanitized_points + 1] = sanitized_point
end
end

local active_point = self:SanitizeEscapePoint(stored_escape.active_point, string.format("%s_active_escape", fallback_prefix or "escape"))

if active_point and seen_ids[active_point.id] then
for _, stored_point in ipairs(sanitized_points) do
if stored_point.id == active_point.id then
active_point = self:CopyEscapePoint(stored_point)
break
end
end
end

return {
points = sanitized_points,
active_point = active_point
}
end

function ADDON:BuildStoredEscapeMapState(raw_escape)
local stored_points = {}

for _, point in ipairs(istable(raw_escape) and raw_escape.points or {}) do
stored_points[#stored_points + 1] = self:CopyEscapePoint(point)
end

return {
points = stored_points,
active_point = self:CopyEscapePoint(istable(raw_escape) and raw_escape.active_point or nil)
}
end

function ADDON:BindEscapeStateToCurrentMap(create_missing)
self.State = self.State or {}
self.State.escape = self.State.escape or {}

local escape_state = self.State.escape
local current_map = self:GetEscapePointMapKey()

escape_state.maps = escape_state.maps or {}

local map_state = escape_state.maps[current_map]

if not istable(map_state) and create_missing ~= false then
map_state = {
points = {},
active_point = nil
}
escape_state.maps[current_map] = map_state
end

if istable(map_state) then
map_state.points = istable(map_state.points) and map_state.points or {}
map_state.active_point = self:SanitizeEscapePoint(map_state.active_point, string.format("%s_active_escape", current_map))
escape_state.points = map_state.points
escape_state.active_point = map_state.active_point
else
escape_state.points = {}
escape_state.active_point = nil
end

escape_state.current_map = current_map

return map_state, current_map
end

function ADDON:SetEscapeStateActivePoint(point)
local map_state = self:BindEscapeStateToCurrentMap(true)
local sanitized_point = self:SanitizeEscapePoint(point, istable(point) and point.id or "active_escape")

map_state.active_point = sanitized_point and self:CopyEscapePoint(sanitized_point) or nil
self.State.escape.active_point = map_state.active_point

return map_state.active_point
end

function ADDON:CopyEscapePoint(point)
if not istable(point) then return nil end

return {
id = self:NormalizeString(point.id, ""),
source_id = self:NormalizeString(point.source_id, self:NormalizeString(point.id, "")),
model = self:NormalizeEscapeModel(point.model),
position = self:SerializeVector(self:BuildVectorFromTable(point.position or point.pos) or Vector(0, 0, 0)),
angle = self:SerializeAngle(self:BuildAngleFromTable(point.angle or point.ang))
}
end

function ADDON:SanitizeEscapePoint(raw_point, fallback_id)
if not istable(raw_point) then return nil end

local position = self:BuildVectorFromTable(raw_point.position or raw_point.pos)

if not isvector(position) then
return nil
end

local angle = self:BuildAngleFromTable(raw_point.angle or raw_point.ang)
local point_id = self:NormalizeString(raw_point.id, self:NormalizeString(raw_point.source_id, fallback_id or ""))

if point_id == "" then
point_id = fallback_id or self:GenerateEscapePointId()
end

return {
id = point_id,
source_id = self:NormalizeString(raw_point.source_id, point_id),
model = self:NormalizeEscapeModel(raw_point.model),
position = self:SerializeVector(position),
angle = self:SerializeAngle(angle)
}
end

function ADDON:SanitizeStoredEscapeState(raw_escape)
local stored_escape = istable(raw_escape) and raw_escape or {}
local sanitized_maps = {}
local current_map = self:GetEscapePointMapKey()

if istable(stored_escape.maps) then
for map_name, raw_map_state in pairs(stored_escape.maps) do
local normalized_map = self:GetEscapePointMapKey(map_name)

if normalized_map ~= "" then
sanitized_maps[normalized_map] = self:SanitizeEscapeMapState(raw_map_state, normalized_map)
end
end
end

if next(sanitized_maps) == nil then
local legacy_state = self:SanitizeEscapeMapState(stored_escape, current_map)

if #legacy_state.points > 0 or legacy_state.active_point ~= nil then
sanitized_maps[current_map] = legacy_state
else
sanitized_maps[current_map] = {
points = {},
active_point = nil
}
end
elseif not istable(sanitized_maps[current_map]) then
sanitized_maps[current_map] = {
points = {},
active_point = nil
}
end

local current_map_state = sanitized_maps[current_map] or {
points = {},
active_point = nil
}

if not istable(current_map_state.points) then
current_map_state.points = {}
end

return {
maps = sanitized_maps,
current_map = current_map,
points = current_map_state.points,
active_point = current_map_state.active_point
}
end

function ADDON:CanGenerateAutomaticEscapePointsFromNavMesh()
return navmesh ~= nil
and navmesh.IsLoaded ~= nil
and navmesh.IsLoaded()
and navmesh.GetNavAreaCount ~= nil
and navmesh.GetNavAreaCount() > 0
end

function ADDON:SelectAutomaticEscapeNavAreas(max_count)
if not self:CanGenerateAutomaticEscapePointsFromNavMesh() then
return {}
end

max_count = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(max_count) or AUTO_ESCAPE_POINT_COUNT))

local all_nav_areas = navmesh.GetAllNavAreas and navmesh.GetAllNavAreas() or {}
local candidate_areas = {}

for _, area in pairs(all_nav_areas) do
if area and area.GetCenter then
local center = area:GetCenter()

if isvector(center) then
candidate_areas[#candidate_areas + 1] = area
end
end
end

if #candidate_areas <= 0 then
return {}
end

local selected_areas = {}
local fallback_areas = table.Copy(candidate_areas)
local minimum_distance_sqr = AUTO_ESCAPE_POINT_MIN_DISTANCE * AUTO_ESCAPE_POINT_MIN_DISTANCE

while #selected_areas < max_count and #candidate_areas > 0 do
local area = table.remove(candidate_areas, math.random(1, #candidate_areas))
local center = area:GetCenter()
local far_enough = true

for _, chosen_area in ipairs(selected_areas) do
if center:DistToSqr(chosen_area:GetCenter()) < minimum_distance_sqr then
far_enough = false
break
end
end

if far_enough then
selected_areas[#selected_areas + 1] = area
end
end

while #selected_areas < max_count and #fallback_areas > 0 do
selected_areas[#selected_areas + 1] = fallback_areas[math.random(1, #fallback_areas)]
end

return selected_areas
end

function ADDON:EnsureCurrentMapEscapePointsAvailable()
self:EnsureStateTables()

local map_state, current_map = self:BindEscapeStateToCurrentMap(true)

if #(map_state.points or {}) > 0 then
return false, "existing", #map_state.points
end

if not self:CanGenerateAutomaticEscapePointsFromNavMesh() then
return false, "no_navmesh", 0
end

local selected_areas = self:SelectAutomaticEscapeNavAreas(AUTO_ESCAPE_POINT_COUNT)

if #selected_areas <= 0 then
return false, "no_nav_areas", 0
end

for index, area in ipairs(selected_areas) do
local center = area:GetCenter()
local point_id = string.format(
"auto_%s_%d_%s",
current_map,
index,
util.CRC(string.format("%s:%0.2f:%0.2f:%0.2f:%d", current_map, center.x, center.y, center.z, index))
)
local escape_point = self:SanitizeEscapePoint({
id = point_id,
source_id = point_id,
model = self.Config.EscapePointDefaultModel,
position = center,
angle = Angle(0, 0, 0)
}, point_id)

if escape_point then
map_state.points[#map_state.points + 1] = escape_point
end
end

if #map_state.points <= 0 then
return false, "generation_failed", 0
end

if self:IsCollapseCountdownActive() then
self:UpdateEscapePointForCountdown(self:GetCollapseCountdownRemaining(), false)
end

self:SaveState()
self:BroadcastAdminSnapshots()

if self:IsCollapseCountdownActive() then
self:BroadcastCollapseSignal("sync")
end

return true, "generated", #map_state.points
end

function ADDON:EnsureStateTables()
self.State = self.State or {}
self.State.version = self.Version
self.State.points = self:ClampPoints(self.State.points)
self.State.factions = self.State.factions or {}
self.State.factions.good = self:SanitizeFactionLookup(self.State.factions.good)
self.State.factions.bad = self:SanitizeFactionLookup(self.State.factions.bad)
self.State.collapse = self:SanitizeStoredCollapseState(self.State.collapse)
self.State.escape = self:SanitizeStoredEscapeState(self.State.escape)
self:BindEscapeStateToCurrentMap(true)
end

function ADDON:RefreshFactionMetadata()
self:EnsureStateTables()

for _, faction_key in ipairs({"good", "bad"}) do
for command, member in pairs(self.State.factions[faction_key]) do
local sanitized = self:SanitizeFactionMember(member, command)

if sanitized then
self.State.factions[faction_key][command] = sanitized
else
self.State.factions[faction_key][command] = nil
end
end
end
end

function ADDON:UpdateGlobalState()
local stage_data = self:GetStageData(self.State.points)

SetGlobalInt(self.GlobalKeys.Points, stage_data.points)
SetGlobalString(self.GlobalKeys.Stage, stage_data.label)
SetGlobalInt(self.GlobalKeys.StageIndex, stage_data.index)
end

function ADDON:GetCollapseConfiguredDuration()
self:EnsureStateTables()

return math.max(60, math.floor(tonumber(self.State.collapse and self.State.collapse.duration_seconds) or tonumber(self.Config.CollapseCountdownSeconds) or 60))
end

function ADDON:CanCollapseCountdownPersist(stage_data)
if not istable(stage_data) then
return false
end

return (tonumber(stage_data.index) or 0) > 2
end

function ADDON:GetEscapeRuntime()
self.Runtime = self.Runtime or {}
self.Runtime.Escape = self.Runtime.Escape or {}

local escape_runtime = self.Runtime.Escape

if not IsValid(escape_runtime.entity) then
escape_runtime.entity = nil
end

if escape_runtime.active ~= nil then
escape_runtime.active = self:SanitizeEscapePoint(escape_runtime.active, istable(escape_runtime.active) and escape_runtime.active.id or "active_escape")
end

return escape_runtime
end

function ADDON:FindEscapePointById(point_id)
self:EnsureStateTables()

point_id = self:NormalizeString(point_id, "")

if point_id == "" then
return nil, nil
end

for index, point in ipairs(self.State.escape.points or {}) do
if tostring(point.id or "") == point_id then
return point, index
end
end

return nil, nil
end

function ADDON:BuildEscapePointListSnapshot()
self:EnsureStateTables()

local snapshot = {}

for _, point in ipairs(self.State.escape.points or {}) do
snapshot[#snapshot + 1] = self:CopyEscapePoint(point)
end

return snapshot
end

function ADDON:GetActiveEscapePoint()
local escape_runtime = self:GetEscapeRuntime()
return escape_runtime.active
end

function ADDON:BuildActiveEscapeSnapshot()
local active_point = self:GetActiveEscapePoint()

if not istable(active_point) then
return {
active = false,
safe_radius = math.max(96, math.floor(tonumber(self.Config.EscapePointSafeRadius) or 320))
}
end

local snapshot = self:CopyEscapePoint(active_point)
snapshot.active = true
snapshot.safe_radius = math.max(96, math.floor(tonumber(self.Config.EscapePointSafeRadius) or 320))

return snapshot
end

function ADDON:BuildStoredEscapeState()
self:EnsureStateTables()

local stored_maps = {}
local _, current_map = self:BindEscapeStateToCurrentMap(true)

for map_name, map_state in pairs(self.State.escape.maps or {}) do
stored_maps[self:GetEscapePointMapKey(map_name)] = self:BuildStoredEscapeMapState(map_state)
end

stored_maps[current_map] = {
points = self:BuildEscapePointListSnapshot(),
active_point = self:IsCollapseCountdownActive() and self:CopyEscapePoint(self:GetActiveEscapePoint()) or nil
}

local current_map_state = stored_maps[current_map] or {
points = {},
active_point = nil
}

return {
maps = stored_maps,
current_map = current_map,
points = current_map_state.points,
active_point = current_map_state.active_point
}
end

function ADDON:RestoreEscapeRuntimeFromState()
self:EnsureStateTables()

self.State.escape = self:SanitizeStoredEscapeState(self.State.escape)
local current_map_state = self:BindEscapeStateToCurrentMap(true)

local escape_runtime = self:GetEscapeRuntime()

if IsValid(escape_runtime.entity) then
escape_runtime.entity:Remove()
end

escape_runtime.entity = nil
escape_runtime.active = self:CopyEscapePoint(current_map_state and current_map_state.active_point or nil)
end

function ADDON:ClearEscapePointEntity()
local escape_runtime = self:GetEscapeRuntime()

if IsValid(escape_runtime.entity) then
escape_runtime.entity:Remove()
end

escape_runtime.entity = nil
end

function ADDON:SpawnEscapePointEntity(point)
local position = self:BuildVectorFromTable(point and (point.position or point.pos))

if not isvector(position) then
return nil
end

local entity = ents.Create(ESCAPE_POINT_ENTITY_CLASS)

if not IsValid(entity) then
entity = ents.Create("prop_dynamic")
end

if not IsValid(entity) then
return nil
end

entity:SetModel(self:NormalizeEscapeModel(point.model))
entity:SetPos(position)
entity:SetAngles(self:BuildAngleFromTable(point.angle or point.ang))
entity:Spawn()
entity:Activate()
entity:SetMoveType(MOVETYPE_NONE)
entity:SetSolid(SOLID_NONE)
entity:SetNotSolid(true)
entity:SetCollisionGroup(COLLISION_GROUP_WORLD)
entity:SetTrigger(false)
entity.OutbreakSystemEscapePoint = true

return entity
end

function ADDON:IsEscapePointActiveWindow(remaining_seconds)
remaining_seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(remaining_seconds) or self:GetCollapseCountdownRemaining() or 0))

return self:IsCollapseCountdownActive()
and remaining_seconds <= self.Config.CollapseFiveMinuteAlarmSeconds
and #(self.State.escape and self.State.escape.points or {}) > 0
end

function ADDON:SelectRandomEscapePoint()
self:EnsureStateTables()

local escape_points = self.State.escape.points or {}

if #escape_points <= 0 then
return nil
end

return self:CopyEscapePoint(escape_points[math.random(1, #escape_points)])
end

function ADDON:DeactivateEscapePoint(notify_clients)
self:EnsureStateTables()

local escape_runtime = self:GetEscapeRuntime()
local had_active_point = istable(escape_runtime.active) or istable(self.State.escape.active_point) or IsValid(escape_runtime.entity)

self:ClearEscapePointEntity()
escape_runtime.active = nil
self:SetEscapeStateActivePoint(nil)

if had_active_point then
self:QueueSave()
end

if notify_clients == true and had_active_point then
self:BroadcastCollapseSignal("sync")
self:BroadcastAdminSnapshots()
end

return had_active_point
end

function ADDON:ActivateEscapePoint(point, notify_clients)
local sanitized_point = self:SanitizeEscapePoint(point, istable(point) and point.id or "active_escape")

if not sanitized_point then
return false
end

local escape_runtime = self:GetEscapeRuntime()

self:ClearEscapePointEntity()

escape_runtime.active = self:CopyEscapePoint(sanitized_point)
escape_runtime.entity = self:SpawnEscapePointEntity(sanitized_point)
self:SetEscapeStateActivePoint(sanitized_point)

self:QueueSave()

if notify_clients == true then
self:BroadcastCollapseSignal("sync")
self:BroadcastAdminSnapshots()
end

return true
end

function ADDON:UpdateEscapePointForCountdown(remaining_seconds, notify_clients)
self:EnsureStateTables()

remaining_seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(remaining_seconds) or self:GetCollapseCountdownRemaining() or 0))

if not self:IsEscapePointActiveWindow(remaining_seconds) then
return self:DeactivateEscapePoint(notify_clients)
end

local active_point = self:GetActiveEscapePoint()

if istable(active_point) then
local source_point = self:FindEscapePointById(self:NormalizeString(active_point.source_id, active_point.id))

if source_point then
local copied_point = self:CopyEscapePoint(source_point)
local escape_runtime = self:GetEscapeRuntime()

escape_runtime.active = copied_point
self:SetEscapeStateActivePoint(copied_point)

if not IsValid(escape_runtime.entity) then
escape_runtime.entity = self:SpawnEscapePointEntity(copied_point)

if notify_clients == true then
self:BroadcastCollapseSignal("sync")
self:BroadcastAdminSnapshots()
end

return true
end

return false
end

self:DeactivateEscapePoint(false)
end

local stored_active = self:SanitizeEscapePoint(self.State.escape.active_point, "active_escape")
local selected_point = nil

if stored_active then
local source_point = self:FindEscapePointById(self:NormalizeString(stored_active.source_id, stored_active.id))
selected_point = self:CopyEscapePoint(source_point or stored_active)
end

if not selected_point then
selected_point = self:SelectRandomEscapePoint()
end

if not selected_point then
return false
end

return self:ActivateEscapePoint(selected_point, notify_clients)
end

function ADDON:IsPlayerInActiveEscapeSafeRadius(player_entity, active_point)
if not IsValid(player_entity) or not player_entity:IsPlayer() then
return false
end

active_point = self:SanitizeEscapePoint(active_point or self:GetActiveEscapePoint(), "active_escape")

if not active_point then
return false
end

local position = self:BuildVectorFromTable(active_point.position or active_point.pos)

if not isvector(position) then
return false
end

local player_position = player_entity.WorldSpaceCenter and player_entity:WorldSpaceCenter() or player_entity:GetPos()
local safe_radius = math.max(96, math.floor(tonumber(self.Config.EscapePointSafeRadius) or 320))

return player_position:DistToSqr(position) <= (safe_radius * safe_radius)
end

function ADDON:AddEscapePoint(player_entity, model_path)
if not IsValid(player_entity) or not player_entity:IsPlayer() then
return false, "Only players can add escape points."
end

self:EnsureStateTables()

local requested_model = self:NormalizeString(model_path, self.Config.EscapePointDefaultModel)

if requested_model ~= "" and requested_model ~= self.Config.EscapePointDefaultModel and util.IsValidModel and not util.IsValidModel(requested_model) then
return false, "That escape point model could not be found."
end

local point_id = self:GenerateEscapePointId()
local escape_point = self:SanitizeEscapePoint({
id = point_id,
source_id = point_id,
model = requested_model,
position = player_entity:GetPos(),
angle = Angle(0, player_entity:EyeAngles().y, 0)
}, point_id)

if not escape_point then
return false, "Could not create that escape point."
end

self.State.escape.points[#self.State.escape.points + 1] = escape_point
self:QueueSave()

if self:IsCollapseCountdownActive() then
self:UpdateEscapePointForCountdown(self:GetCollapseCountdownRemaining(), false)
self:BroadcastCollapseSignal("sync")
end

self:BroadcastAdminSnapshots()

return true, "Escape point added at your position."
end

function ADDON:RemoveEscapePoint(point_id)
self:EnsureStateTables()

local escape_point, point_index = self:FindEscapePointById(point_id)

if not escape_point or not point_index then
return false, "That escape point could not be found."
end

table.remove(self.State.escape.points, point_index)

local active_point = self:GetActiveEscapePoint()
local removed_active = istable(active_point) and tostring(active_point.id or "") == tostring(escape_point.id or "")

if removed_active then
self:DeactivateEscapePoint(false)
end

self:QueueSave()

if self:IsCollapseCountdownActive() then
self:UpdateEscapePointForCountdown(self:GetCollapseCountdownRemaining(), false)
self:BroadcastCollapseSignal("sync")
end

self:BroadcastAdminSnapshots()

return true, "Escape point removed."
end

function ADDON:ResetCollapseAlarmFlags(collapse, duration_seconds)
if not istable(collapse) then return end

duration_seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(duration_seconds) or 0))
collapse.five_minute_triggered = duration_seconds < self.Config.CollapseFiveMinuteAlarmSeconds
collapse.two_minute_triggered = duration_seconds < self.Config.CollapseTwoMinuteAlarmSeconds
end

function ADDON:BuildStoredCollapseState()
self:EnsureStateTables()

local stage_data = self:GetStageData(self.State.points)
local collapse = self:GetCollapseRuntime()
local deadline_unix = 0

if self:IsCollapseCountdownActive() and self:CanCollapseCountdownPersist(stage_data) then
local remaining_seconds = self:GetCollapseCountdownRemaining()
local unix_now = math.floor(tonumber(os.time()) or 0)

if remaining_seconds > 0 and unix_now > 0 then
deadline_unix = unix_now + remaining_seconds
end
end

return {
duration_seconds = self:GetCollapseConfiguredDuration(),
deadline_unix = math.max(0, math.floor(deadline_unix)),
five_minute_triggered = deadline_unix > 0 and collapse.five_minute_triggered == true or false,
two_minute_triggered = deadline_unix > 0 and collapse.two_minute_triggered == true or false
}
end

function ADDON:RestoreCollapseRuntimeFromState()
self:EnsureStateTables()

local stored_collapse = self:SanitizeStoredCollapseState(self.State.collapse)
self.State.collapse = stored_collapse

local collapse = self:GetCollapseRuntime()
collapse.deadline = 0
collapse.five_minute_triggered = false
collapse.two_minute_triggered = false

if not self:CanCollapseCountdownPersist(self:GetStageData(self.State.points)) then
return
end

local deadline_unix = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(stored_collapse.deadline_unix) or 0))
local unix_now = math.floor(tonumber(os.time()) or 0)

if deadline_unix <= 0 or unix_now <= 0 then
return
end

local remaining_seconds = math.max(0, deadline_unix - unix_now)

if remaining_seconds <= 0 then
return
end

collapse.deadline = CurTime() + remaining_seconds
collapse.five_minute_triggered = stored_collapse.five_minute_triggered == true
collapse.two_minute_triggered = stored_collapse.two_minute_triggered == true
end

function ADDON:HasSavedCollapseDeadlineExpired()
self:EnsureStateTables()

local deadline_unix = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(self.State.collapse and self.State.collapse.deadline_unix) or 0))
local unix_now = math.floor(tonumber(os.time()) or 0)

return deadline_unix > 0 and unix_now > 0 and deadline_unix <= unix_now
end

function ADDON:GetCollapseRuntime()
self.Runtime = self.Runtime or {}
self.Runtime.Collapse = self.Runtime.Collapse or {}

local collapse = self.Runtime.Collapse
collapse.deadline = tonumber(collapse.deadline) or 0
collapse.five_minute_triggered = collapse.five_minute_triggered == true
collapse.two_minute_triggered = collapse.two_minute_triggered == true

return collapse
end

function ADDON:GetCollapseCountdownRemaining()
local collapse = self:GetCollapseRuntime()
local deadline = tonumber(collapse.deadline) or 0

if deadline <= 0 then
return 0
end

return math.max(0, math.ceil(deadline - CurTime()))
end

function ADDON:IsCollapseCountdownActive()
local stage_data = self:GetStageData(self.State and self.State.points or 0)

if not self:CanCollapseCountdownPersist(stage_data) then
return false
end

return self:GetCollapseCountdownRemaining() > 0
end

function ADDON:BuildCollapseSnapshot()
return {
active = self:IsCollapseCountdownActive(),
remaining_seconds = self:GetCollapseCountdownRemaining(),
duration_seconds = self:GetCollapseConfiguredDuration()
}
end

function ADDON:BroadcastCollapseSignal(signal_type, payload, recipient)
local message = {
type = self:NormalizeString(signal_type, "sync"),
collapse = self:BuildCollapseSnapshot(),
escape = self:BuildActiveEscapeSnapshot()
}

if istable(payload) then
for key, value in pairs(payload) do
message[key] = value
end
end

send_compressed_table(self.Net.CollapseSignal, message, recipient)
end

function ADDON:ArmCollapseCountdownTimer()
timer.Remove(COLLAPSE_TIMER)

timer.Create(COLLAPSE_TIMER, 1, 0, function()
if not OUTBREAK_SYSTEM then return end
OUTBREAK_SYSTEM:ThinkCollapseCountdown()
end)
end

function ADDON:StartCollapseCountdown(notify_clients)
local collapse = self:GetCollapseRuntime()
local duration_seconds = self:GetCollapseConfiguredDuration()

collapse.deadline = CurTime() + duration_seconds
self:ResetCollapseAlarmFlags(collapse, duration_seconds)
self:UpdateEscapePointForCountdown(duration_seconds, false)

timer.Remove(COLLAPSE_CLEANUP_TIMER)
self:ArmCollapseCountdownTimer()
self:QueueSave()

if notify_clients == true then
self:BroadcastCollapseSignal("sync")
end
end

function ADDON:EnsureCollapseCountdown(notify_clients)
local collapse = self:GetCollapseRuntime()

if (tonumber(collapse.deadline) or 0) <= CurTime() then
self:StartCollapseCountdown(notify_clients)
return
end

self:UpdateEscapePointForCountdown(self:GetCollapseCountdownRemaining(), false)
self:ArmCollapseCountdownTimer()

if notify_clients == true then
self:BroadcastCollapseSignal("sync")
end
end

function ADDON:StopCollapseCountdown(notify_clients, cleared_payload)
local collapse = self:GetCollapseRuntime()
local had_active_countdown = (tonumber(collapse.deadline) or 0) > 0

collapse.deadline = 0
collapse.five_minute_triggered = false
collapse.two_minute_triggered = false
self:DeactivateEscapePoint(false)

timer.Remove(COLLAPSE_TIMER)
timer.Remove(COLLAPSE_CLEANUP_TIMER)
self:QueueSave()

if notify_clients == true then
if had_active_countdown and istable(cleared_payload) then
self:BroadcastCollapseSignal("cleared", cleared_payload)
else
self:BroadcastCollapseSignal("sync")
end
end
end

function ADDON:SetCollapseCountdownRemaining(seconds)
if not self:IsCollapseCountdownActive() then
return false, self:GetCollapseCountdownRemaining(), "inactive"
end

local current_remaining = self:GetCollapseCountdownRemaining()
local remaining_seconds = math.max(60, self:NormalizeInteger(seconds, current_remaining, 60) or current_remaining)

if remaining_seconds == current_remaining then
return false, current_remaining, "unchanged"
end

local collapse = self:GetCollapseRuntime()
collapse.deadline = CurTime() + remaining_seconds
self:ResetCollapseAlarmFlags(collapse, remaining_seconds)
self:UpdateEscapePointForCountdown(remaining_seconds, false)

timer.Remove(COLLAPSE_CLEANUP_TIMER)
self:ArmCollapseCountdownTimer()
self:QueueSave()
self:BroadcastCollapseSignal("sync")
self:BroadcastAdminSnapshots()

return true, remaining_seconds, "updated"
end

function ADDON:ResumeCollapseCountdownAfterLoad(notify_clients)
local stage_data = self:GetStageData(self.State and self.State.points or 0)

if not self:CanCollapseCountdownPersist(stage_data) then
self:StopCollapseCountdown(notify_clients)
return
end

local collapse = self:GetCollapseRuntime()

if (tonumber(collapse.deadline) or 0) > CurTime() then
self:UpdateEscapePointForCountdown(self:GetCollapseCountdownRemaining(), false)
self:ArmCollapseCountdownTimer()

if notify_clients == true then
self:BroadcastCollapseSignal("sync")
end

return
end

if self:HasSavedCollapseDeadlineExpired() then
self:DetonateCollapseCountdown()
return
end

if self:IsCollapseStage(stage_data) then
self:StartCollapseCountdown(notify_clients)
return
end

self:StopCollapseCountdown(notify_clients)
end

function ADDON:EmitCollapseAlarm(milestone_key, sound_name, pitch, volume, repeat_count, spacing)
if not isstring(sound_name) or sound_name == "" then return end

self:BroadcastCollapseSignal("alarm", {
milestone = self:NormalizeString(milestone_key, "alarm"),
sound = sound_name,
pitch = math.Clamp(math.floor(tonumber(pitch) or 100), 1, 255),
volume = math.Clamp(tonumber(volume) or 1, 0, 1),
repeat_count = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(repeat_count) or 1)),
spacing = math.max(0.05, tonumber(spacing) or 0.35)
})
end

function ADDON:CreateCollapseBlast(origin, scale)
if not isvector(origin) then return end

local effect_data = EffectData()
effect_data:SetOrigin(origin)
effect_data:SetScale(tonumber(scale) or 12)
effect_data:SetMagnitude(14)
effect_data:SetRadius(640)

util.Effect("HelicopterMegaBomb", effect_data, true, true)
util.Effect("Explosion", effect_data, true, true)
end

function ADDON:CreateCollapseDamageInfo(origin, attacker, inflictor)
local damage_info = DamageInfo()
damage_info:SetDamage(COLLAPSE_DETONATION_DAMAGE)
damage_info:SetDamageType(bit.bor(DMG_BLAST, DMG_RADIATION, DMG_DISSOLVE))
damage_info:SetAttacker(attacker)
damage_info:SetInflictor(inflictor)
damage_info:SetDamagePosition(origin)
return damage_info
end

function ADDON:DetonateCollapseCountdown()
local collapse = self:GetCollapseRuntime()
local active_escape_point = self:CopyEscapePoint(self:GetActiveEscapePoint())

if (tonumber(collapse.deadline) or 0) <= 0 then
return
end

local world_entity = game.GetWorld()
local final_origin = Vector(0, 0, 0)
local blast_budget = 24

self:StopCollapseCountdown(false)
self:BroadcastCollapseSignal("sync")

local detonation_ok, detonation_error = xpcall(function()
for _, player_entity in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do
if IsValid(player_entity) then
if self:IsPlayerInActiveEscapeSafeRadius(player_entity, active_escape_point) then
final_origin = self:BuildVectorFromTable(active_escape_point.position or active_escape_point.pos) or final_origin
continue
end

local player_origin = player_entity:WorldSpaceCenter()
local damage_info = self:CreateCollapseDamageInfo(player_origin, world_entity, world_entity)

final_origin = player_origin

if blast_budget > 0 then
blast_budget = blast_budget - 1
self:CreateCollapseBlast(player_origin, 15)
end

util.ScreenShake(player_origin, 36, 255, 4.5, 12000)

if player_entity.HasGodMode and player_entity:HasGodMode() then
player_entity:GodDisable()
end

player_entity:TakeDamageInfo(damage_info)

if IsValid(player_entity) and player_entity:Alive() then
player_entity:Kill()
end
end
end

for _, entity in ipairs(ents.GetAll()) do
if IsValid(entity) and (entity:IsNPC() or entity:IsNextBot()) then
local entity_origin = entity.WorldSpaceCenter and entity:WorldSpaceCenter() or entity:GetPos()
local damage_info = self:CreateCollapseDamageInfo(entity_origin, world_entity, world_entity)

final_origin = entity_origin

if blast_budget > 0 then
blast_budget = blast_budget - 1
self:CreateCollapseBlast(entity_origin, 11)
end

if entity.TakeDamageInfo then
entity:TakeDamageInfo(damage_info)
elseif entity.TakeDamage then
entity:TakeDamage(COLLAPSE_DETONATION_DAMAGE, world_entity, world_entity)
end

if IsValid(entity) then
entity:Remove()
end
end
end

sound.Play("ambient/explosions/explode_8.wav", final_origin, 150, 72, 1)
util.ScreenShake(final_origin, 48, 255, 5.5, 32768)
end, debug.traceback)

self:SetPoints(0, "collapse_detonated", {
system = true,
detonation_origin = final_origin
})

if not detonation_ok then
ErrorNoHalt(string.format("[OutbreakSystem] Collapse detonation encountered an error after countdown expiry:\n%s\n", tostring(detonation_error)))
end

local hook_ok, hook_error = xpcall(function()
hook.Run("OutbreakSystemCollapseDetonated", final_origin)
end, debug.traceback)

if not hook_ok then
ErrorNoHalt(string.format("[OutbreakSystem] Collapse detonation hook failed:\n%s\n", tostring(hook_error)))
end

timer.Create(COLLAPSE_CLEANUP_TIMER, self.Config.CollapseCleanupDelaySeconds, 1, function()
if not OUTBREAK_SYSTEM then return end
game.CleanUpMap()
end)
end

function ADDON:ThinkCollapseCountdown()
local stage_data = self:GetStageData(self.State and self.State.points or 0)

if not self:CanCollapseCountdownPersist(stage_data) then
self:StopCollapseCountdown(true, {
cleared_reason = "contained",
stage_label = self:NormalizeString(stage_data.label, "Outbreak")
})
return
end

local collapse = self:GetCollapseRuntime()
local remaining_seconds = self:GetCollapseCountdownRemaining()

if remaining_seconds <= 0 then
self:DetonateCollapseCountdown()
return
end

if not collapse.five_minute_triggered and remaining_seconds <= self.Config.CollapseFiveMinuteAlarmSeconds then
collapse.five_minute_triggered = true
self:EmitCollapseAlarm("five_minutes", self.Config.CollapseFiveMinuteAlarmSound, 98, 0.92, 4, 0.45)
end

if not collapse.two_minute_triggered and remaining_seconds <= self.Config.CollapseTwoMinuteAlarmSeconds then
collapse.two_minute_triggered = true
self:EmitCollapseAlarm("two_minutes", self.Config.CollapseTwoMinuteAlarmSound, 100, 1, 6, 0.32)
end

self:UpdateEscapePointForCountdown(remaining_seconds, true)
end

function ADDON:SaveState()
file.CreateDir(self.DataFolder)

self:EnsureStateTables()
self:RefreshFactionMetadata()
self.State.collapse = self:BuildStoredCollapseState()
self.State.escape = self:BuildStoredEscapeState()

local payload = {
version = self.Version,
points = self.State.points,
factions = {
good = self.State.factions.good,
bad = self.State.factions.bad
},
collapse = self.State.collapse,
escape = self.State.escape
}

file.Write(self.DataFile, util.TableToJSON(payload, true) or "{}")
end

function ADDON:QueueSave()
timer.Create(SAVE_TIMER, self.Config.SaveDebounceSeconds, 1, function()
if not OUTBREAK_SYSTEM then return end
OUTBREAK_SYSTEM:SaveState()
end)
end

function ADDON:LoadState()
file.CreateDir(self.DataFolder)

local raw_state = file.Read(self.DataFile, "DATA")
local decoded = util.JSONToTable(raw_state or "")

if istable(decoded) then
self.State = decoded
else
self.State = {}
end

self:EnsureStateTables()
self:RefreshFactionMetadata()
self:RestoreCollapseRuntimeFromState()
self:RestoreEscapeRuntimeFromState()
self:UpdateGlobalState()
end

function ADDON:GetAvailableJobs()
local jobs = {}
local seen = {}

local team_indexes = {}

if team and team.GetAllTeams then
for team_index in pairs(team.GetAllTeams() or {}) do
team_index = tonumber(team_index) or 0

if team_index > 0 then
team_indexes[team_index] = true
end
end
end

for team_index in pairs(RPExtraTeams or {}) do
team_index = tonumber(team_index) or 0

if team_index > 0 then
team_indexes[team_index] = true
end
end

for team_index in pairs(team_indexes) do
local command = self:GetTeamAssignmentKey(team_index)

if command ~= "" and not seen[command] then
seen[command] = true

table.insert(jobs, {
command = command,
name = self:GetJobNameFromCommand(command),
team_id = team_index,
team_name = self:GetTeamName(team_index, ""),
assignment_type = self:GetAssignmentType(command)
})
end
end
function ADDON:GetTrackedPlayersInFaction(faction_key)
local tracked_players = {}

if not self:IsTrackedOutbreakFaction(faction_key) then
return tracked_players
end

for _, player_entity in ipairs(player.GetHumans()) do
local is_tracked_player, player_faction, _, command = self:GetTrackedOutbreakPlayer(player_entity)

if is_tracked_player and player_faction == faction_key then
tracked_players[#tracked_players + 1] = {
player = player_entity,
command = command
}
end
end

return tracked_players
end

function ADDON:AwardTimedUtilityFactionXP(item_data)
if not istable(item_data) then return end

local xp_amount = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(self.Config.TimedUtilityFactionXPAmount) or 0))

if xp_amount <= 0 then return end

local faction_key = self:NormalizeFactionKey(item_data.required_faction)

if not self:IsTrackedOutbreakFaction(faction_key) then return end

local job_levels_addon = CUTTADARKRPJOBLEVELS

if not istable(job_levels_addon) or not isfunction(job_levels_addon.AddJobXP) then return end

for _, tracked_entry in ipairs(self:GetTrackedPlayersInFaction(faction_key)) do
if IsValid(tracked_entry.player) then
local tracked_command = self:NormalizeAssignmentKey(tracked_entry.command)
local tracked_team_index = self:GetJobTeamIndexByCommand(tracked_command)
local tracked_job_table = self:GetJobTable(tracked_team_index)
local tracked_job_command = istable(tracked_job_table) and self:NormalizeJobCommand(tracked_job_table.command) or ""

if tracked_job_command ~= "" and tracked_job_command == tracked_command then
job_levels_addon:AddJobXP(
tracked_entry.player,
xp_amount,
item_data.key .. "_outbreak_tick_xp",
tracked_job_command
)
end
end
end
end

table.sort(jobs, function(left, right)
local left_name = string.lower(left.name or left.command or "")
local right_name = string.lower(right.name or right.command or "")

if left_name == right_name then
return (left.command or "") < (right.command or "")
end

return left_name < right_name
end)

return jobs
end

function ADDON:GetAssignmentSnapshot()
local assignments = {}

self:RefreshFactionMetadata()

for _, faction_key in ipairs({"good", "bad"}) do
for command, member in pairs(self.State.factions[faction_key] or {}) do
local faction = self.Factions[faction_key] or {label = faction_key}

table.insert(assignments, {
faction = faction_key,
faction_label = faction.label or faction_key,
command = command,
name = self:GetJobNameFromCommand(command),
team_id = self:GetJobTeamIndexByCommand(command) or member.team_id or 0,
assignment_type = self:GetAssignmentType(command),
player_kill_value = self:NormalizeMagnitude(member.player_kill_value, self.Config.DefaultPlayerDelta, self.Config.MaxDelta),
npc_kill_value = self:NormalizeMagnitude(member.npc_kill_value, self.Config.DefaultNPCDelta, self.Config.MaxDelta)
})
end
end

table.sort(assignments, function(left, right)
if left.faction == right.faction then
local left_name = string.lower(left.name or left.command or "")
local right_name = string.lower(right.name or right.command or "")

if left_name == right_name then
return (left.command or "") < (right.command or "")
end

return left_name < right_name
end

return (left.faction or "") < (right.faction or "")
end)

return assignments
end

function ADDON:BuildSnapshot(player_entity)
local stage_data = self:GetStageData(self.State.points)
local assignments = self:GetAssignmentSnapshot()
local good_assignments = {}
local bad_assignments = {}
local can_manage = IsValid(player_entity) and player_entity:IsPlayer() and player_entity:IsSuperAdmin() or false

for _, assignment in ipairs(assignments) do
if assignment.faction == "good" then
table.insert(good_assignments, assignment)
elseif assignment.faction == "bad" then
table.insert(bad_assignments, assignment)
end
end

return {
points = stage_data.points,
max_points = stage_data.max_points,
stage_index = stage_data.index,
stage_label = stage_data.label,
can_manage = can_manage,
collapse = self:BuildCollapseSnapshot(),
active_escape = self:BuildActiveEscapeSnapshot(),
escape_points = can_manage and self:BuildEscapePointListSnapshot() or {},
passive_increase_interval = self.Config.PassiveIncreaseInterval,
passive_increase_amount = self.Config.PassiveIncreaseAmount,
assignments = assignments,
good_assignments = good_assignments,
bad_assignments = bad_assignments,
jobs = self:GetAvailableJobs()
}
end

function ADDON:SendSnapshot(recipient)
send_compressed_table(self.Net.Snapshot, self:BuildSnapshot(recipient), recipient)
end

function ADDON:BroadcastAdminSnapshots()
for _, player_entity in ipairs(player.GetHumans()) do
if IsValid(player_entity) and player_entity:IsSuperAdmin() then
self:SendSnapshot(player_entity)
end
end
end

function ADDON:SendFeedback(player_entity, was_successful, message)
if not IsValid(player_entity) or not player_entity:IsPlayer() then return end

net.Start(self.Net.Feedback)
net.WriteBool(was_successful == true)
net.WriteString(self:NormalizeString(message, was_successful and "Outbreak system updated." or "Outbreak system request failed."))
net.Send(player_entity)
end

function ADDON:GetTimedUtilityPlayerKey(player_entity)
if not IsValid(player_entity) or not player_entity:IsPlayer() then return nil end

local steam_id64 = player_entity:SteamID64()

if isstring(steam_id64) and steam_id64 ~= "" and steam_id64 ~= "0" then
return "sid64:" .. steam_id64
end

local steam_id = player_entity:SteamID()

if isstring(steam_id) and steam_id ~= "" and steam_id ~= "NULL" then
return "sid:" .. steam_id
end

return string.format("userid:%d:%d", player_entity:UserID(), player_entity:EntIndex())
end

function ADDON:GetTimedUtilityCooldownRemaining(player_entity, item_key)
local item_data = self:GetUtilityItemData(item_key)

if not item_data then
return 0, nil
end

if IsValid(player_entity) and player_entity:IsPlayer() and player_entity:IsSuperAdmin() then
return 0, item_data
end

local player_key = self:GetTimedUtilityPlayerKey(player_entity)

if not player_key then
return 0, item_data
end

self.Runtime.PlayerCooldowns[player_key] = self.Runtime.PlayerCooldowns[player_key] or {}

local ready_at = tonumber(self.Runtime.PlayerCooldowns[player_key][item_data.key]) or 0

return math.max(0, ready_at - CurTime()), item_data
end

function ADDON:SetTimedUtilityCooldown(player_entity, item_data, cooldown_seconds)
if not IsValid(player_entity) or not player_entity:IsPlayer() or player_entity:IsSuperAdmin() then return end

local player_key = self:GetTimedUtilityPlayerKey(player_entity)

if not player_key then return end

self.Runtime.PlayerCooldowns[player_key] = self.Runtime.PlayerCooldowns[player_key] or {}
self.Runtime.PlayerCooldowns[player_key][item_data.key] = CurTime() + math.max(0, tonumber(cooldown_seconds) or 0)
end

function ADDON:BuildTimedUtilityRecipients(origin, radius)
if not isvector(origin) then return {} end

local recipients = {}
local clamped_radius = math.max(128, math.floor(tonumber(radius) or self.Config.TimedUtilityEffectRadius))
local max_distance_sqr = clamped_radius * clamped_radius

for _, player_entity in ipairs(player.GetHumans()) do
if IsValid(player_entity) and player_entity:GetPos():DistToSqr(origin) <= max_distance_sqr then
recipients[#recipients + 1] = player_entity
end
end

return recipients
end

function ADDON:SendTimedUtilityEffectEvent(item_data, origin, phase, expires_at, intensity, radius, stack_count)
if not istable(item_data) or not isvector(origin) then return end

local effect_radius = math.max(128, math.floor(tonumber(radius) or item_data.radius or self.Config.TimedUtilityEffectRadius))
local recipients = tostring(phase or "") == "pulse" and self:BuildTimedUtilityRecipients(origin, effect_radius) or player.GetHumans()

if #recipients <= 0 then return end

net.Start(self.Net.TimedEffect)
net.WriteString(self:NormalizeString(item_data.effect, item_data.key))
net.WriteString(self:NormalizeString(phase, "pulse"))
net.WriteVector(origin)
net.WriteFloat(tonumber(expires_at) or CurTime())
net.WriteUInt(math.min(4095, effect_radius), 12)
net.WriteUInt(math.min(255, math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(intensity) or 0))), 8)
net.WriteUInt(math.min(255, math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(stack_count) or 1))), 8)
net.Send(recipients)
end

function ADDON:CanUseTimedUtilityItem(player_entity, item_key)
local item_data = self:GetUtilityItemData(item_key)

if not item_data then
return false, "That outbreak utility is not configured.", nil, 0
end

if not IsValid(player_entity) or not player_entity:IsPlayer() then
return false, "Only players can use that.", item_data, 0
end

if not player_entity:IsSuperAdmin() and item_data.required_faction then
local is_tracked_player, faction_key = self:GetTrackedOutbreakPlayer(player_entity)
local faction_data = self.Factions[item_data.required_faction] or {label = item_data.required_faction}

if not is_tracked_player or faction_key ~= item_data.required_faction then
return false, string.format("%s can only be used by %s.", item_data.label, string.lower(faction_data.label or item_data.required_faction)), item_data, 0
end
end

local cooldown_remaining = select(1, self:GetTimedUtilityCooldownRemaining(player_entity, item_key))

if cooldown_remaining > 0 then
return false, string.format("%s is on cooldown. %s remaining out of %s.", item_data.label, self:FormatDuration(cooldown_remaining), self:FormatDuration(item_data.cooldown)), item_data, cooldown_remaining
end

function ADDON:PerformTimedUtilityStackTick(item_data)
local stack_state = self.Runtime.ActiveUtilityStacks[item_data.key]

if not stack_state then
return false, true
end

stack_state.tick_index = (stack_state.tick_index or 0) + 1
local applied_delta = item_data.delta

local did_change = self:AdjustPoints(applied_delta, item_data.key .. "_tick", {
actor = IsValid(stack_state.last_actor) and stack_state.last_actor or nil,
actor_key = stack_state.last_actor_key,
item_key = item_data.key,
item_label = item_data.label,
effect_origin = stack_state.origin,
tick_index = stack_state.tick_index,
total_ticks = stack_state.total_ticks,
stack_count = stack_state.stack_count,
applied_delta = applied_delta
})

if did_change then
self:AwardTimedUtilityFactionXP(item_data)
end

self:SendTimedUtilityEffectEvent(
item_data,
stack_state.origin,
"pulse",
stack_state.expires_at,
math.floor((stack_state.tick_index / math.max(1, stack_state.total_ticks)) * 255),
item_data.radius,
stack_state.stack_count
)

if stack_state.tick_index >= stack_state.total_ticks then
self:SendTimedUtilityEffectEvent(item_data, stack_state.origin, "stop", stack_state.expires_at or CurTime(), 255, item_data.radius, stack_state.stack_count)
self.Runtime.ActiveUtilityStacks[item_data.key] = nil
timer.Remove(self:GetTimedUtilityStackTimerName(item_data.key))
return true, true
end

return true, false
end

function ADDON:ActivateTimedUtilityItem(player_entity, item_key, origin_override)

end

local effect_origin = isvector(origin_override) and origin_override or (IsValid(player_entity) and player_entity:WorldSpaceCenter() or vector_origin)
local current_time = CurTime()
local player_key = self:GetTimedUtilityPlayerKey(player_entity) or "world"
local delta_prefix = item_data.delta > 0 and "+" or ""
local timer_name = self:GetTimedUtilityStackTimerName(item_data.key)

stack_state.stack_count = math.max(1, (stack_state.stack_count or 0) + 1)
stack_state.last_actor = IsValid(player_entity) and player_entity or nil
stack_state.last_actor_key = player_key
end

stack_state.expires_at = (tonumber(stack_state.started_at) or current_time) + math.max(0, stack_state.total_ticks * item_data.tick_interval)

self:SetTimedUtilityCooldown(player_entity, item_data, item_data.cooldown)
self:SendFeedback(
player_entity,
true,
string.format(

)

local runtime_state = OUTBREAK_SYSTEM.Runtime.ActiveUtilityStacks[item_data.key]

function ADDON:GetQuestDifficultyLabel(quest_name, quest_data)
local normalized_quest_name = string.lower(self:NormalizeString(quest_name, ""))
local difficulty_candidates = {}

if istable(quest_data) then
local quest_keys = {
"Difficulty",
"difficulty",
"QuestDifficulty",
"questdifficulty",
"DifficultyName",
"difficultyname",
"Tier",
"tier",
"QuestTier",
"questtier"
}

for _, key_name in ipairs(quest_keys) do
local value = quest_data[key_name]

if type(value) == "string" then
table.insert(difficulty_candidates, string.lower(string.Trim(value)))
end
end
end

if normalized_quest_name ~= "" then
table.insert(difficulty_candidates, normalized_quest_name)
end

for _, candidate in ipairs(difficulty_candidates) do
if candidate ~= "" then
if string.find(candidate, "hard", 1, true) then
return "hard"
end

if string.find(candidate, "medium", 1, true) then
return "medium"
end

if string.find(candidate, "easy", 1, true) then
return "easy"
end
end
end

return nil
end

function ADDON:GetQuestRewardAmount(quest_name, quest_data)
local normalized_quest_name = string.lower(self:NormalizeString(quest_name, ""))

if normalized_quest_name ~= "" and string.find(normalized_quest_name, "boss", 1, true) then
return self.Config.QuestRewardBoss, "boss"
end

if istable(quest_data) and quest_data.GlobalQuest == true then
return self.Config.QuestRewardGlobal, "global"
end

local difficulty_label = self:GetQuestDifficultyLabel(quest_name, quest_data)

if difficulty_label == "hard" then
return self.Config.QuestRewardHard, "hard"
end

if difficulty_label == "medium" then
return self.Config.QuestRewardMedium, "medium"
end

if difficulty_label == "easy" then
return self.Config.QuestRewardEasy, "easy"
end

return 0, nil
end

function ADDON:SetPoints(new_points, reason, context)
self:EnsureStateTables()

local previous_points = self.State.points or 0
local clamped_points = self:ClampPoints(new_points)
local previous_stage = self:GetStageData(previous_points)

if clamped_points == previous_points then
return false, previous_points, 0
end

self.State.points = clamped_points
self:UpdateGlobalState()
self:QueueSave()

local delta = clamped_points - previous_points
local current_stage = self:GetStageData(clamped_points)

if self:IsCollapseStage(current_stage) then
if not self:IsCollapseStage(previous_stage) then
self:StartCollapseCountdown(false)
else
self:EnsureCollapseCountdown(false)
end
elseif self:IsCollapseCountdownActive() and not self:CanCollapseCountdownPersist(current_stage) then
self:StopCollapseCountdown(true, {
cleared_reason = "contained",
stage_label = self:NormalizeString(current_stage.label, "Outbreak")
})
end

local collapse_snapshot = self:BuildCollapseSnapshot()

net.Start(self.Net.StateUpdate)
net.WriteUInt(clamped_points, 14)
net.WriteInt(delta, 16)
net.WriteString(self:NormalizeString(reason, "unknown"))
net.WriteBool(collapse_snapshot.active == true)
net.WriteUInt(math.Clamp(math.floor(tonumber(collapse_snapshot.remaining_seconds) or 0), 0, 65535), 16)
net.WriteUInt(math.Clamp(math.floor(tonumber(collapse_snapshot.duration_seconds) or 0), 0, 65535), 16)
net.Broadcast()

hook.Run("OutbreakSystemLevelChanged", clamped_points, previous_points, delta, reason or "unknown", context or {})

return true, clamped_points, delta
end

function ADDON:IsZombieLikeTarget(target)

local haystacks = {
target.GetClass and target:GetClass() or "",
target.GetName and target:GetName() or "",
target.PrintName,
target.GetModel and target:GetModel() or ""
}

for _, value in ipairs(haystacks) do
local normalized_value = string.lower(self:NormalizeString(tostring(value or ""), ""))

if normalized_value ~= "" then
for _, hint in ipairs(ZOMBIE_NAME_HINTS) do

end

end

function ADDON:AdjustPoints(delta, reason, context)

end

return self:SetPoints((self.State.points or 0) + delta, reason, context)
end

function ADDON:UpsertFactionJob(faction_key, command, player_kill_value, npc_kill_value)
faction_key = self:NormalizeFactionKey(faction_key)
command = self:NormalizeAssignmentKey(command)

if not faction_key then
return false, "Invalid outbreak faction."
end

if command == "" then
return false, "Invalid team or job selection."
end

local team_index = self:GetJobTeamIndexByCommand(command)
if not team_index then
return false, "That team or DarkRP job could not be found."
end

local existing_faction = select(1, self:GetFactionEntryByCommand(command))
local opposite_faction = faction_key == "good" and "bad" or "good"

self.State.factions[faction_key][command] = {
command = command,
name = self:GetJobNameFromCommand(command),
team_id = team_index,
player_kill_value = self:NormalizeMagnitude(player_kill_value, self.Config.DefaultPlayerDelta, self.Config.MaxDelta),
npc_kill_value = self:NormalizeMagnitude(npc_kill_value, self.Config.DefaultNPCDelta, self.Config.MaxDelta)
}

self.State.factions[opposite_faction][command] = nil

self:QueueSave()
self:BroadcastAdminSnapshots()

if existing_faction then
return true, "Outbreak faction assignment updated."
end

return true, "Outbreak faction assignment added."
end

return true, "Outbreak faction assignment removed."
end

function ADDON:CanCountOppositionPlayerKill(attacker, victim)
if not IsValid(victim) or not victim:IsPlayer() then return false end
if not IsValid(attacker) then return false end
if attacker == victim then return false end
if not attacker:IsPlayer() then return false end
return true
end

function ADDON:HandleOppositionPlayerKill(attacker, victim)
if not self:CanCountOppositionPlayerKill(attacker, victim) then return end

local attacker_is_tracked, attacker_faction = self:GetTrackedOutbreakPlayer(attacker)
local victim_is_tracked, victim_faction, victim_entry = self:GetTrackedOutbreakPlayer(victim)

if not attacker_is_tracked or not victim_is_tracked then return end
if not attacker_faction or not victim_faction or not victim_entry then return end
if attacker_faction == victim_faction then return end

if (attacker_faction == "good" and victim_faction == "bad") or (attacker_faction == "bad" and victim_faction == "good") then
local player_kill_value = self:NormalizeMagnitude(victim_entry.player_kill_value, self.Config.DefaultPlayerDelta, self.Config.MaxDelta)

if player_kill_value <= 0 then return end

local delta = victim_faction == "bad" and -player_kill_value or player_kill_value

if delta ~= 0 then
self:AdjustPoints(delta, "opposition_player_kill", {
attacker = attacker,
victim = victim,
killed_faction = victim_faction,
applied_value = player_kill_value
})
end
end
end

function ADDON:HandleGoodFactionNPCKill(attacker, target)
if not IsValid(attacker) or not attacker:IsPlayer() then return end
if not IsValid(target) then return end

local attacker_is_tracked, faction_key, faction_entry = self:GetTrackedOutbreakPlayer(attacker)

if not attacker_is_tracked then return end
if faction_key ~= "good" or not faction_entry then return end

local delta = -self:NormalizeMagnitude(faction_entry.npc_kill_value, self.Config.DefaultNPCDelta, self.Config.MaxDelta)
if delta == 0 then return end

local reason = self:IsZombieLikeTarget(target) and "zombie_kill" or "good_npc_kill"

self:AdjustPoints(delta, reason, {
attacker = attacker,
target = target,
is_zombie = reason == "zombie_kill"
})
end

local function CUTTAQS_Prefix()
if cutta_quest_system and cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] then
return cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"]
end
return "" -- fallback; should always exist in this addon
end

local function CUTTAQS_GlobalIdKey()
return CUTTAQS_Prefix() .. "GlobalQuestId"
end

local function CUTTAQS_IsGlobalFor(ent, ply)
if not IsValid(ent) or not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end

local key = CUTTAQS_GlobalIdKey()
local entGlobalId = ent:GetNWString(key, "")
if not entGlobalId or entGlobalId == "" then return false end

local plyGlobalId = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[key] or nil
return plyGlobalId == entGlobalId
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer = nil
self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract = nil
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_LockValidFor(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if not IsValid(self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer) then return false end
return self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer == ply
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_TickLock()
if not IsValid(self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer) then
self:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
return
end

-- Release lock if solver walks away or goes AFK.
local now = CurTime()
local last = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract) or 0
if last > 0 and (now - last) > 20 then
self:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
return
end

if self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer:GetPos():DistToSqr(self:GetPos()) > (175 * 175) then
self:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
return
end
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_TryAcquireLock(ply)
self:CUTTAQS_TickLock()

if self:CUTTAQS_LockValidFor(ply) then
self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract = CurTime()
return true
end

if IsValid(self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer) then
return false
end

-- New solver gets control; reset progress for a clean attempt.
self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer = ply
self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract = CurTime()
self.CUTTAQS_Progress = 0
return true
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_SetupPuzzle(dotCount)
dotCount = math.floor(tonumber(dotCount) or 4)
dotCount = math.Clamp(dotCount, 1, 8)

self:SetDotCount(dotCount)
self:SetPuzzleType("sequence")
self:SetIsSolved(false)

self.CUTTAQS_Sequence = {}
for i = 1, dotCount do
self.CUTTAQS_Sequence[i] = math.random(1, 8)
end
self.CUTTAQS_Progress = 0
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers = {}
self:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_CanOpen(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if self:GetIsSolved() then return false end
if ply:GetPos():DistToSqr(self:GetPos()) > (150 * 150) then return false end

local prefix = CUTTAQS_Prefix()
local owner = self:GetNWEntity(prefix .. "ObjectiveOwner")
local isGlobal = CUTTAQS_IsGlobalFor(self, ply)
if not isGlobal then
if IsValid(owner) and owner ~= ply then return false end
end

-- For global quests: anyone can open. For all puzzles: only one solver at a time.
if not isGlobal then
return self:CUTTAQS_TryAcquireLock(ply)
end

-- Global: allow open even if someone else is solving.
if not self.CUTTAQS_Viewers then self.CUTTAQS_Viewers = {} end
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers[ply] = true
return true
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_CanPress(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if self:GetIsSolved() then return false end
if ply:GetPos():DistToSqr(self:GetPos()) > (150 * 150) then return false end

local prefix = CUTTAQS_Prefix()
local owner = self:GetNWEntity(prefix .. "ObjectiveOwner")
local isGlobal = CUTTAQS_IsGlobalFor(self, ply)
if not isGlobal then
if IsValid(owner) and owner ~= ply then return false end
end

if not self:CUTTAQS_LockValidFor(ply) then
-- Attempt to acquire if nobody currently has it.
return self:CUTTAQS_TryAcquireLock(ply)
end

self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract = CurTime()

return true
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_SendState(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
local prefix = CUTTAQS_Prefix()
local progress = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_Progress) or 0

net.Start(prefix .. "puzzle_state")
net.WriteEntity(self)
net.WriteUInt(self:GetDotCount() or 0, 4)
net.WriteUInt(progress, 4)
net.WriteBool(self:GetIsSolved() or false)
net.Send(ply)
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_SendStateToViewers()
if not self.CUTTAQS_Viewers then return end
for ply, _ in pairs(self.CUTTAQS_Viewers) do
if IsValid(ply) and ply:IsPlayer() then
if ply:GetPos():DistToSqr(self:GetPos()) <= (300 * 300) then
self:CUTTAQS_SendState(ply)
else
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers[ply] = nil
end
else
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers[ply] = nil
end
end
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_OpenFor(ply)
if not self:CUTTAQS_CanOpen(ply) then return end

if not self.CUTTAQS_Sequence or #self.CUTTAQS_Sequence <= 0 then
self:CUTTAQS_SetupPuzzle(self:GetDotCount() > 0 and self:GetDotCount() or 4)
end

local prefix = CUTTAQS_Prefix()
local progress = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_Progress) or 0

-- Ensure viewer list is tracked for state broadcasts.
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers = self.CUTTAQS_Viewers or {}
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers[ply] = true

net.Start(prefix .. "puzzle_open")
net.WriteEntity(self)
net.WriteUInt(self:GetDotCount() or 0, 4)
net.WriteUInt(progress, 4)
net.Send(ply)
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_HandlePress(ply, buttonIndex)
if not self:CUTTAQS_CanPress(ply) then return end

buttonIndex = math.floor(tonumber(buttonIndex) or 0)
if buttonIndex < 1 or buttonIndex > 8 then return end

self.CUTTAQS_Progress = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_Progress) or 0
self.CUTTAQS_Sequence = self.CUTTAQS_Sequence or {}

local dotCount = self:GetDotCount() or #self.CUTTAQS_Sequence
dotCount = math.Clamp(dotCount, 1, 8)
if #self.CUTTAQS_Sequence ~= dotCount then
self:CUTTAQS_SetupPuzzle(dotCount)
end

local current = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_Progress) or 0
local expected = self.CUTTAQS_Sequence[current + 1]

if buttonIndex == expected then
current = current + 1
else
current = 0
end

if current >= dotCount then
self:SetIsSolved(true)
self.CUTTAQS_Progress = dotCount
self:CUTTAQS_SendStateToViewers()

if cutta_quest_system and cutta_quest_system.Player_NextObjective then
timer.Simple(0, function()
if IsValid(ply) then
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply)
end
end)
end

timer.Simple(0, function()
if IsValid(self) then
self:Remove()
end
end)
return
end

self.CUTTAQS_Progress = current
self:CUTTAQS_SendStateToViewers()
end

function ENT:Initialize()
self:SetModel("models/props_lab/keypad.mdl")
self:SetMoveType(MOVETYPE_NONE)
self:SetSolid(SOLID_VPHYSICS)

self:SetPuzzleID(math.random(1, 2147483647))
self:CUTTAQS_SetupPuzzle(4)

local phys = self:GetPhysicsObject()

phys:Wake()
phys:EnableMotion(false)
end
end

function ENT:Use(activator, caller)
self:CUTTAQS_OpenFor(activator)
end

function ENT:Think()
self:CUTTAQS_TickLock()

if self.CUTTAQS_Viewers then
for ply, _ in pairs(self.CUTTAQS_Viewers) do
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers[ply] = nil
end
end
end

self:NextThink(CurTime() + 0.25)
return true
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_ExtractWorkshopID(input)
if not isstring(input) then return nil end

local trimmed = string.Trim(input)
if trimmed == "" then return nil end

local directId = string.match(trimmed, "^(%d+)$")
if directId then
return directId
end

local queryId = string.match(trimmed, "[?&]id=(%d+)")
if queryId then
return queryId
end

return string.match(trimmed, "/(%d+)/?$")
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_NormalizeModelPath(modelPath)
if cutta_cosmetic_shop.NormalizeModelPath then
return cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeModelPath(modelPath)
end

if not isstring(modelPath) then return "" end
local normalized = string.Trim(modelPath)
if normalized == "" then return "" end

normalized = string.Replace(normalized, "\\", "/")
normalized = string.lower(normalized)

while string.find(normalized, "//", 1, true) do
normalized = string.Replace(normalized, "//", "/")
end

return normalized
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_NormalizeSoundPath(soundPath)
if cutta_cosmetic_shop.NormalizeSoundPath then
return cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeSoundPath(soundPath)
end

if not isstring(soundPath) then return "" end

local normalized = string.Trim(soundPath)
if normalized == "" then return "" end

normalized = string.Replace(normalized, "\\", "/")
normalized = string.lower(normalized)

while string.find(normalized, "//", 1, true) do
normalized = string.Replace(normalized, "//", "/")
end

while string.StartWith(normalized, "/") do
normalized = string.sub(normalized, 2)
end

if string.StartWith(normalized, "sound/") then
normalized = string.sub(normalized, 7)
end

return normalized
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_IsSupportedSoundPath(filePath)
local normalizedPath = string.lower(tostring(filePath or ""))
return string.EndsWith(normalizedPath, ".wav")
or string.EndsWith(normalizedPath, ".mp3")
or string.EndsWith(normalizedPath, ".ogg")
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_GetEntityAnimations(ent)
local animations = {}
local seenAnimations = {}
if not IsValid(ent) then return animations end

local sequenceCount = ent:GetSequenceCount() or 0
for index = 0, sequenceCount - 1 do
local animationName = string.Trim(tostring(ent:GetSequenceName(index) or ""))
local animationKey = string.lower(animationName)
if animationName ~= "" and not seenAnimations[animationKey] then
seenAnimations[animationKey] = true
animations[#animations + 1] = animationName
end
end

table.sort(animations, function(a, b)
return string.lower(a) < string.lower(b)
end)

return animations
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_PlayEntityAnimation(ent, animationName)
if not IsValid(ent) then return false end

local resolvedAnimation = string.Trim(tostring(animationName or ""))
if resolvedAnimation == "" then return false end

local sequenceIndex = ent:LookupSequence(resolvedAnimation)
if not sequenceIndex or sequenceIndex < 0 then
local lowerAnimation = string.lower(resolvedAnimation)
local sequenceCount = ent:GetSequenceCount() or 0
for index = 0, sequenceCount - 1 do
local sequenceName = ent:GetSequenceName(index)
if sequenceName and string.find(string.lower(sequenceName), lowerAnimation, 1, true) then
sequenceIndex = index
break
end
end
end

if not sequenceIndex or sequenceIndex < 0 then return false end

ent:ResetSequence(sequenceIndex)
ent:SetCycle(0)
ent:SetPlaybackRate(1)
return true
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_MergeAnimationLists(...)
local mergedAnimations = {}
local seenAnimations = {}

for listIndex = 1, select("#", ...) do
local animationList = select(listIndex, ...)
if istable(animationList) then
for _, animationName in ipairs(animationList) do
local normalizedAnimation = string.Trim(tostring(animationName or ""))
local animationKey = string.lower(normalizedAnimation)
if normalizedAnimation ~= "" and not seenAnimations[animationKey] then

local function CuttaCosmetic_ReadUInt32LE(bytes)
if not bytes or #bytes < 4 then return nil end
local b1, b2, b3, b4 = string.byte(bytes, 1, 4)
return b1 + b2 * 256 + b3 * 65536 + b4 * 16777216
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_ReadNullTerminatedString(fileHandle)
if not fileHandle then return nil end

local chars = {}
while true do
local chunk = fileHandle:Read(1)
if not chunk or chunk == "" then
return table.concat(chars)
end

if string.byte(chunk) == 0 then
return table.concat(chars)
end

chars[#chars + 1] = chunk
end
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_GetWorkshopPathCandidates(path)
if not isstring(path) or path == "" then return {} end

local candidatePaths = {path}
local normalizedPath = string.Replace(path, "\\", "/")
local lowerPath = string.lower(normalizedPath)
local rootIndex = string.find(lowerPath, "garrysmod/", 1, true)
if rootIndex then
candidatePaths[#candidatePaths + 1] = string.sub(normalizedPath, rootIndex + string.len("garrysmod/"))
end

local pathMarkers = {
"cache/",
"download/",
"downloads/",
"downloads/server/",
"workshop/"
}
for i = 1, #pathMarkers do
local marker = pathMarkers[i]
local markerIndex = string.find(lowerPath, marker, 1, true)
if markerIndex then
candidatePaths[#candidatePaths + 1] = string.sub(normalizedPath, markerIndex)
end
end

local expandedPaths = {}
local seenCandidates = {}
for i = 1, #candidatePaths do
local candidate = string.Trim(tostring(candidatePaths[i] or ""))
if candidate ~= "" and not seenCandidates[candidate] then
seenCandidates[candidate] = true
expandedPaths[#expandedPaths + 1] = candidate

local dirPath = string.match(candidate, "^(.*[/])")
if dirPath then
dirPath = string.Trim(dirPath)
if dirPath ~= "" and not seenCandidates[dirPath] then
seenCandidates[dirPath] = true
expandedPaths[#expandedPaths + 1] = dirPath
end
end
end
end

return expandedPaths
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_OpenWorkshopBinary(path)
if not isstring(path) or path == "" then return nil end

local candidatePaths = CuttaCosmetic_GetWorkshopPathCandidates(path)

for i = 1, #candidatePaths do
local candidate = candidatePaths[i]

local fileHandle = file.Open(candidate, "rb", "GAME")
if fileHandle then return fileHandle end

fileHandle = file.Open(candidate, "rb", "MOD")
if fileHandle then return fileHandle end

fileHandle = file.Open(candidate, "rb", "DATA")
if fileHandle then return fileHandle end
end

return nil
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_ScanWorkshopDirectoryRecursive(basePath, pathId, results)
if not isstring(basePath) or basePath == "" then return end

local prefix = basePath
if not string.EndsWith(prefix, "/") then
prefix = prefix .. "/"
end

local files, directories = file.Find(prefix .. "*", pathId)
if not istable(files) then
files = {}
end
if not istable(directories) then
directories = {}
end

for i = 1, #files do
local fileName = files[i]
if isstring(fileName) and string.EndsWith(string.lower(fileName), ".mdl") then
local fullPath = CuttaCosmetic_NormalizeModelPath(prefix .. fileName)
local modelIndex = string.find(fullPath, "models/", 1, true)
if modelIndex then
local relativeModelPath = string.sub(fullPath, modelIndex)
results[relativeModelPath] = true
end
end
end

for i = 1, #directories do
local directoryName = directories[i]
if isstring(directoryName) and directoryName ~= "" then
CuttaCosmetic_ScanWorkshopDirectoryRecursive(prefix .. directoryName, pathId, results)
end
end
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_ParseWorkshopGMAForModels(path)
local fileHandle = CuttaCosmetic_OpenWorkshopBinary(path)
if not fileHandle then return nil end

local magic = fileHandle:Read(4)
if magic ~= "GMAD" then
fileHandle:Close()
return nil
end

fileHandle:Read(1)
fileHandle:Read(8)
fileHandle:Read(8)
CuttaCosmetic_ReadNullTerminatedString(fileHandle)
CuttaCosmetic_ReadNullTerminatedString(fileHandle)
CuttaCosmetic_ReadNullTerminatedString(fileHandle)
CuttaCosmetic_ReadNullTerminatedString(fileHandle)
fileHandle:Read(4)

local modelLookup = {}
local modelPaths = {}

while true do
local entryNumber = CuttaCosmetic_ReadUInt32LE(fileHandle:Read(4))
if not entryNumber or entryNumber == 0 then break end

local fileName = CuttaCosmetic_ReadNullTerminatedString(fileHandle)
if fileName == nil then break end

local sizeData = fileHandle:Read(8)
local crcData = fileHandle:Read(4)
if not sizeData or #sizeData < 8 or not crcData or #crcData < 4 then break end

local normalizedFileName = CuttaCosmetic_NormalizeModelPath(fileName)
if normalizedFileName ~= "" and string.StartWith(normalizedFileName, "models/") and string.EndsWith(normalizedFileName, ".mdl") and not modelLookup[normalizedFileName] then
modelLookup[normalizedFileName] = true
modelPaths[#modelPaths + 1] = normalizedFileName
end
end

fileHandle:Close()

table.sort(modelPaths, function(a, b)
return string.lower(a) < string.lower(b)
end)

return modelPaths
end

end
end

return copied
end

local function BuildStoredModelBodygroupsPayload(bodygroups)
local payload = {}
if not istable(bodygroups) then return payload end

for bodygroupID, bodygroupValue in pairs(bodygroups) do
local sanitizedID = tonumber(bodygroupID)
local sanitizedValue = tonumber(bodygroupValue)
if sanitizedID ~= nil and sanitizedValue ~= nil then
payload[#payload + 1] = {
id = math.max(math.floor(sanitizedID), 0),
value = math.max(math.floor(sanitizedValue), 0)
}
end
end

table.sort(payload, function(a, b)
return a.id < b.id
end)

return payload
end

local function ResetWorkshopLookupState(statusText)
panel.workshoplookuprequesttoken = (panel.workshoplookuprequesttoken or 0) + 1

panel.workshoplookupvalidatedid = nil

local function RefreshWorkshopLinkState(workshopLink)
local trimmedWorkshopLink = string.Trim(tostring(workshopLink or ""))
local activeWorkshopID = tostring(panel.workshoplookupvalidatedid or panel.workshoplookupid or "")
local currentWorkshopID = CuttaCosmetic_ExtractWorkshopID(trimmedWorkshopLink)

if trimmedWorkshopLink == "" then
panel.workshoplinktext = nil
if activeWorkshopID ~= "" or (istable(panel.workshopsoundlist) and #panel.workshopsoundlist > 0) then
ResetWorkshopLookupState(nil)
QueueWorkshopLookupUIRefresh()
end
return
end

panel.workshoplinktext = trimmedWorkshopLink

if activeWorkshopID ~= "" and tostring(currentWorkshopID or "") ~= activeWorkshopID then
ResetWorkshopLookupState("Workshop link changed. Fetch sound paths again.")
QueueWorkshopLookupUIRefresh()
end
end

local function ApplyPreviewBodygroups()
if not IsValid(previewPanel) or not IsValid(previewPanel.Entity) then return end
if not istable(newframe.newpanel.modelbodygroups) then return end

for bodygroupID, bodygroupValue in pairs(newframe.newpanel.modelbodygroups) do
local sanitizedID = tonumber(bodygroupID)
local sanitizedValue = tonumber(bodygroupValue)
if sanitizedID ~= nil and sanitizedValue ~= nil then
previewPanel.Entity:SetBodygroup(math.max(math.floor(sanitizedID), 0), math.max(math.floor(sanitizedValue), 0))
end
end
end

local function RebuildModelBodygroupsEditor()
if not IsValid(modelBodygroupsHolder) then return end

for _, child in ipairs(modelBodygroupsHolder:GetChildren()) do
child:Remove()
end

local nextHeight = 0
local function AddInfoRow(text)
cutta_ui_library:Panel(modelBodygroupsHolder, cutta_ui_library["DockMode"]["TOP"], {0,0,0,5}, text, 28)
nextHeight = nextHeight + 33
end

if not newframe.newpanel.itemmodeltext or newframe.newpanel.itemmodeltext == "" then
AddInfoRow("Enter or select a model path to edit bodygroups.")
modelBodygroupsHolder:SetTall(math.max(nextHeight, 33))
return
end

if not IsValid(previewPanel) or not IsValid(previewPanel.Entity) then
AddInfoRow("Load the preview model to inspect bodygroups.")
modelBodygroupsHolder:SetTall(math.max(nextHeight, 33))
return
end

local ent = previewPanel.Entity
local editableBodygroups = 0
local previousBodygroups = newframe.newpanel.modelbodygroups or {}
local validBodygroups = {}
newframe.newpanel.modelbodygroups = validBodygroups
for _, bodygroup in ipairs(ent:GetBodyGroups() or {}) do
local bodygroupID = tonumber(bodygroup.id or bodygroup.index or bodygroup.bodygroup)
local bodygroupCount = tonumber(bodygroup.num or bodygroup.submodels or 1) or 1
local maxValue = math.max(math.floor(bodygroupCount) - 1, 0)
if bodygroupID ~= nil and maxValue > 0 then
editableBodygroups = editableBodygroups + 1
local bodygroupName = tostring(bodygroup.name or ("Bodygroup " .. tostring(bodygroupID)))
cutta_ui_library:Panel(modelBodygroupsHolder, cutta_ui_library["DockMode"]["TOP"], {0,0,0,5}, bodygroupName .. " (0-" .. tostring(maxValue) .. ")", 28)
nextHeight = nextHeight + 33

local entry = cutta_ui_library:Number_Entry(modelBodygroupsHolder, cutta_ui_library["DockMode"]["TOP"], {0,0,0,5}, 28, "0")
local currentValue = tonumber(previousBodygroups[bodygroupID])
if currentValue == nil then
currentValue = ent:GetBodygroup(bodygroupID) or 0
end
currentValue = math.Clamp(math.floor(currentValue), 0, maxValue)
validBodygroups[bodygroupID] = currentValue
entry:SetValue(tostring(currentValue))
nextHeight = nextHeight + 33

function entry:Think()
local rawValue = self:GetValue() or self:GetText()
local numericValue = tonumber(rawValue)
if numericValue == nil then
numericValue = 0
end
numericValue = math.Clamp(math.floor(numericValue), 0, maxValue)

if tostring(rawValue) ~= tostring(numericValue) then
self:SetValue(tostring(numericValue))
end

validBodygroups[bodygroupID] = numericValue
newframe.newpanel.modelbodygroups[bodygroupID] = numericValue

if IsValid(previewPanel) and IsValid(previewPanel.Entity) and previewPanel.Entity:GetBodygroup(bodygroupID) ~= numericValue then
previewPanel.Entity:SetBodygroup(bodygroupID, numericValue)
end
end
end
end

if editableBodygroups == 0 then
AddInfoRow("This model has no editable bodygroups.")
end

modelBodygroupsHolder:SetTall(math.max(nextHeight, 33))
end

local function CUTTAQS_AnimateValue(current, target, speed)
return Lerp(math.Clamp(FrameTime() * (speed or 10), 0, 1), current, target)
end

local function CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(colorValue, alphaMultiplier)
local alpha = math.Clamp(tonumber(alphaMultiplier) or 1, 0, 1)
return Color(colorValue.r, colorValue.g, colorValue.b, math.floor((colorValue.a or 255) * alpha))
end

local function CUTTAQS_GetTextHeight(font)
surface.SetFont(font)
local _, textH = surface.GetTextSize("Ag")
return textH
end

local function CUTTAQS_WrapText(text, font, maxWidth, maxLines)
if not isstring(text) then
text = tostring(text or "")
end

text = string.Trim(text)
if text == "" then
return {}, CUTTAQS_GetTextHeight(font)
end

surface.SetFont(font)
local _, lineHeight = surface.GetTextSize("Ag")
if not isnumber(maxWidth) or maxWidth <= 0 then
return { text }, lineHeight
end

maxLines = tonumber(maxLines) or 99
if maxLines < 1 then maxLines = 1 end

local lines = {}
local currentLine = ""

local function pushLine(lineText)
lineText = string.Trim(lineText or "")
if lineText == "" then return end
table.insert(lines, lineText)
end

local function fits(lineText)
local textW = surface.GetTextSize(lineText)
return textW <= maxWidth
end

for word in string.gmatch(text, "%S+") do
local candidate = currentLine == "" and word or (currentLine .. " " .. word)
if fits(candidate) then
currentLine = candidate
else
pushLine(currentLine)
currentLine = word
if #lines >= maxLines then
break
end
end
end

if #lines < maxLines then
pushLine(currentLine)
end

if #lines > maxLines then
while #lines > maxLines do
table.remove(lines)
end
end

if #lines == maxLines and currentLine ~= "" and not fits(currentLine) then
lines[#lines] = string.sub(lines[#lines], 1, math.max(1, #lines[#lines] - 3)) .. "..."
end

return lines, lineHeight
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine(text, font, x, y, colorValue, alphaMultiplier, alignX, alignY)
text = string.Trim(tostring(text or ""))
if text == "" then return end
draw.SimpleText(text, font, x, y, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(colorValue, alphaMultiplier), alignX or TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT, alignY or TEXT_ALIGN_TOP)
end

draw.RoundedBox(0, x, y, thickness, size, colorValue)
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawPanelChrome(x, y, width, height, accentColor, alpha, pulse)
local lineAlpha = (0.08 + pulse * 0.04) * alpha
local shimmerW = math.max(26, math.floor(width * 0.14))
local shimmerX = x + 18 + (((CurTime() * 34) % (width + shimmerW)) - shimmerW)

for row = y + 16, y + height - 16, 8 do

end

local bracketColor = CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(accentColor, (0.46 + pulse * 0.16) * alpha)
CUTTAQS_DrawCornerBracket(x + 12, y + 12, 14, 2, bracketColor)
CUTTAQS_DrawCornerBracket(x + width - 26, y + height - 26, 14, 2, bracketColor)

draw.RoundedBox(0, x + 18, y + 18, 52, 1, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_BORDER, alpha))

end

end

return railX, railY
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawCardShell(x, y, width, height, accentColor, alpha, pulse)
