pulse = tonumber(pulse) or 0
local shadowOffset = 10
local cardX = x
local cardY = y

draw.RoundedBox(14, cardX + shadowOffset, cardY + shadowOffset, width, height, Color(0, 0, 0, math.floor(84 * alpha)))

draw.RoundedBox(14, cardX + 1, cardY + 1, width - 2, height - 2, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_PANEL_SOFT, 0.58 * alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(14, cardX + 8, cardY + 8, width - 16, height - 16, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(Color(6,9,13,160), 0.45 * alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(0, cardX, cardY, 4, height, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(accentColor, 0.78 * alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(0, cardX + 18, cardY + height - 3, width - 36, 3, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(accentColor, (0.18 + pulse * 0.12) * alpha))
surface.SetDrawColor(CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_BORDER, alpha * 0.7))

local function CUTTAQS_DrawToast(y, text, remaining, accentColor, headerText)
text = string.Trim(tostring(text or ""))
if text == "" then return 0 end

remaining = math.max(tonumber(remaining) or 0, 0)
local totalDuration = 5
local progress = math.Clamp(1 - (remaining / totalDuration), 0, 1)
local fadeIn = math.Clamp(progress / 0.16, 0, 1)
local fadeOut = math.Clamp(remaining / 0.75, 0, 1)
local alpha = fadeIn * fadeOut
if alpha <= 0 then return 0 end

local pulse = (math.sin(CurTime() * 7) + 1) * 0.5
local railX = CUTTAQS_GetHudRailAnchor()
local width = math.min(288, ScrW() * 0.215)
local height = 44
local x = railX - (1 - fadeIn) * 30

CUTTAQS_DrawCardShell(x, y, width, height, accentColor, alpha, pulse)
CUTTAQS_DrawHeaderDot(x + 18, y + 12, accentColor, alpha, pulse)
CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine(headerText or "QUEST UPDATE", "cuttaqs_8bitfont_mini", x + 30, y + 9, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(accentColor, 0.95), alpha)
CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine(text, "cuttaqs_8bitfont_small", x + 18, y + 21, CUTTAQS_COLOR_TEXT, alpha)

draw.RoundedBox(0, x + 18, y + height - 10, width - 36, 3, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(Color(255,255,255,26), alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(0, x + 18, y + height - 10, (width - 36) * math.Clamp(remaining / totalDuration, 0, 1), 3, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(accentColor, alpha))
return height + 8
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawWrappedLines(lines, font, x, y, colorValue, alphaMultiplier, lineGap)
local textY = y
local textHeight = CUTTAQS_GetTextHeight(font)
lineGap = tonumber(lineGap) or 4

for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine(line, font, x, textY, colorValue, alphaMultiplier)
textY = textY + textHeight + lineGap
end

return textY
end

local function CUTTAQS_TruncateTextToWidth(text, font, maxWidth)
text = string.Trim(tostring(text or ""))
if text == "" then return "" end

surface.SetFont(font)
if select(1, surface.GetTextSize(text)) <= maxWidth then
return text
end

local ellipsis = "..."
local low, high = 1, #text
while low < high do
local mid = math.ceil((low + high) * 0.5)
local candidate = string.sub(text, 1, mid) .. ellipsis
if select(1, surface.GetTextSize(candidate)) <= maxWidth then
low = mid
else
high = mid - 1
end
end

return string.sub(text, 1, math.max(1, low)) .. ellipsis
end

local function CUTTAQS_GetCutsceneDialogueLayout(text, maxWidth, maxHeight)
local candidateFonts = {
"cuttaqs_tothepoint",
"cuttaqs_cutscene_text",
"cuttaqs_bankgothic",
"cuttaqs_8bitfont_small",
"cuttaqs_8bitfont_mini"
}

local bestLayout = nil
local compactGap = 4
local textStr = string.Trim(tostring(text or ""))
if textStr == "" then return nil end

maxWidth = math.max(140, tonumber(maxWidth) or 140)
maxHeight = math.max(18, tonumber(maxHeight) or 18)

for _, fontName in ipairs(candidateFonts) do
local lineHeight = CUTTAQS_GetTextHeight(fontName)
local maxLines = math.max(1, math.floor((maxHeight + compactGap) / (lineHeight + compactGap)))
local lines = select(1, CUTTAQS_WrapText(textStr, fontName, maxWidth, maxLines))

if #lines > 0 then
local joinedLength = string.len(table.concat(lines, " "))
if #lines >= maxLines and joinedLength < string.len(textStr) then
lines[#lines] = CUTTAQS_TruncateTextToWidth(lines[#lines], fontName, maxWidth)
end

local totalHeight = (#lines * lineHeight) + math.max(0, (#lines - 1) * compactGap)
if totalHeight <= maxHeight then
bestLayout = {
font = fontName,
lines = lines,
lineHeight = lineHeight,
gap = compactGap,
totalHeight = totalHeight
}
break
end

bestLayout = {
font = fontName,
lines = lines,
lineHeight = lineHeight,
gap = compactGap,
totalHeight = totalHeight
}
end
end

return bestLayout
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawCutsceneDialogue(text, alpha)
text = string.Trim(tostring(text or ""))
alpha = math.Clamp(tonumber(alpha) or 0, 0, 1)
if text == "" or alpha <= 0 then return end

local bottomBarHeight = math.max(tonumber(CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM.cutsceneBarHeight) or 0, 0)
if bottomBarHeight <= 4 then return end

local horizontalMargin = math.max(36, ScrW() * 0.08)
local verticalMargin = math.max(10, bottomBarHeight * 0.12)
local availableWidth = math.max(160, ScrW() - (horizontalMargin * 2))
local availableHeight = math.max(18, bottomBarHeight - (verticalMargin * 2))
local layout = CUTTAQS_GetCutsceneDialogueLayout(text, availableWidth, availableHeight)
if not layout then return end

local baseY = ScrH() - bottomBarHeight + ((bottomBarHeight - layout.totalHeight) * 0.5)
local textY = math.max(ScrH() - bottomBarHeight + verticalMargin, baseY)
local centerX = ScrW() * 0.5
local shadowAlpha = alpha * 0.7

for _, line in ipairs(layout.lines) do
draw.SimpleText(line, layout.font, centerX + 2, textY + 2, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_BLACK, shadowAlpha), TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP)
draw.SimpleText(line, layout.font, centerX, textY, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_TEXT, alpha), TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP)
textY = textY + layout.lineHeight + layout.gap
end
end

local function CUTTAQS_GetRecurringHudAlpha(prefix, signature, isActive)
local stateKey = prefix .. "CycleState"
local changedAtKey = prefix .. "CycleChangedAt"
local signatureKey = prefix .. "CycleSignature"
local alphaKey = prefix .. "CycleAlpha"
local now = CurTime()

if not isActive then
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[signatureKey] = ""
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[stateKey] = "visible"
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[changedAtKey] = now
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[alphaKey] = CUTTAQS_AnimateValue(CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[alphaKey] or 0, 0, 8)
return CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[alphaKey] or 0
end

signature = tostring(signature or "")
if CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[signatureKey] ~= signature then
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[signatureKey] = signature
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[stateKey] = "visible"
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[changedAtKey] = now
end

local cycleState = CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[stateKey] or "visible"
local stateDuration = cycleState == "visible" and CUTTAQS_PASSIVE_HUD_SHOW_TIME or CUTTAQS_PASSIVE_HUD_HIDE_TIME
if now - (CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[changedAtKey] or now) >= stateDuration then
cycleState = cycleState == "visible" and "hidden" or "visible"
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[stateKey] = cycleState
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[changedAtKey] = now
end

local targetAlpha = cycleState == "visible" and 1 or 0
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[alphaKey] = CUTTAQS_AnimateValue(CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[alphaKey] or targetAlpha, targetAlpha, targetAlpha == 1 and 6 or 5)
return CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[alphaKey] or 0
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawGlobalGatherCard(x, y, gg)
local isActive = gg and gg.endTime and gg.questname and gg.pos and gg.endTime > CurTime()
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM.gatherAlpha = CUTTAQS_AnimateValue(CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM.gatherAlpha or 0, isActive and 1 or 0, 10)

end
local cycleAlpha = CUTTAQS_GetRecurringHudAlpha("gather", gatherSignature, isActive)

local alpha = (CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM.gatherAlpha or 0) * cycleAlpha
if alpha <= 0.02 or not isActive then return 0 end

local pulse = (math.sin(CurTime() * 3.2) + 1) * 0.5
local width = math.min(308, ScrW() * 0.235)
local timeLeft = math.max(0, math.ceil(gg.endTime - CurTime()))

local radius = tonumber(gg.radius) or 0
if radius > 0 then
local players = player.GetHumans()

return height + 8
end

CUTTAQS_IsPlayerInGatherCircle = function(ply, center, radius)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if not isvector(center) then return false end
radius = tonumber(radius) or 0
if radius <= 0 then return false end

local pos = ply:GetPos()
pos = Vector(pos.x, pos.y, center.z)
return pos:DistToSqr(center) <= (radius * radius)
end

function cutta_quest_system:Draw3DZone(pos, rad, clr, detail, thick)
local AlphaMask = CUTTAQS_COLOR_ALPHA_MASK
render.SetStencilEnable(true)
render.SetStencilWriteMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilTestMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilReferenceValue( 0 )
render.SetStencilCompareFunction( STENCIL_ALWAYS )
render.SetStencilPassOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilZFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetColorMaterial()
render.ClearStencil()
--All
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_REPLACE)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Under
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Inner
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_INCR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
-- Overall
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_EQUAL)

cam.IgnoreZ(true)
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, clr)
cam.IgnoreZ(false)
render.SetStencilEnable(false)
end

if CIS_IsValidMerchantModel(CIS_MERCHANT_MODEL) then

return CIS_MERCHANT_MODEL

end

return CIS_MERCHANT_FALLBACK_MODEL

end

local function CIS_FindIdleSequence(ent)

if not IsValid(ent) then return nil end

for _, activityId in ipairs(CIS_MERCHANT_IDLE_ACTIVITIES) do

local activitySequence = ent:SelectWeightedSequence(activityId)
if isnumber(activitySequence) and activitySequence >= 0 then

return activitySequence

end

end

for _, sequenceName in ipairs(CIS_MERCHANT_IDLE_SEQUENCES) do

local sequenceId = ent:LookupSequence(sequenceName)
if isnumber(sequenceId) and sequenceId >= 0 then

return sequenceId

end

end

return nil

end

local function CIS_ApplyMerchantIdleSequence(ent)

if not IsValid(ent) then return false end

local sequenceId = CIS_FindIdleSequence(ent)
if not sequenceId then return false end

ent.CIS_IdleSequence = sequenceId
ent:SetSequence(sequenceId)
ent:SetCycle(0)
ent:SetPlaybackRate(1)
ent:ResetSequenceInfo()

return true

end

local function CIS_OpenMerchantForPlayer(ent, activator, caller)

local target = IsValid(activator) and activator or caller
if not IsValid(ent) or not IsValid(target) then return end
if not target:IsPlayer() then return end

if ent.CIS_NextUse and ent.CIS_NextUse > CurTime() then return end

ent.CIS_NextUse = CurTime() + 0.25

net.Start(cutta_inventory_system["StringName"].."Player_OpenMerchant")
net.Send(target)

end

function ENT:Initialize()

self:SetModel(CIS_GetResolvedMerchantModel())
if self:GetModel() == "models/error.mdl" then

self:SetModel(CIS_MERCHANT_FALLBACK_MODEL)

end

self:SetHullType(HULL_HUMAN)
self:SetHullSizeNormal()
self:SetNPCState(NPC_STATE_SCRIPT)
self:SetSolid(SOLID_BBOX)
self:SetCollisionGroup(COLLISION_GROUP_NPC)
self:SetUseType(SIMPLE_USE)
self:SetBloodColor(BLOOD_COLOR_RED)
self:CapabilitiesAdd(bit.bor(CAP_ANIMATEDFACE, CAP_TURN_HEAD))
self:SetMaxYawSpeed(90)
self:DropToFloor()
self:SetMoveType(MOVETYPE_NONE)

self.CIS_HasIdleSequence = CIS_ApplyMerchantIdleSequence(self)
self:NextThink(CurTime())

end

function ENT:AcceptInput(name, activator, caller)

if name != "Use" then return end

CIS_OpenMerchantForPlayer(self, activator, caller)

end

function ENT:Use(activator, caller)

CIS_OpenMerchantForPlayer(self, activator, caller)

end

function ENT:Think()

if self:GetModel() == "models/error.mdl" and self:GetModel() != CIS_MERCHANT_FALLBACK_MODEL then

self:SetModel(CIS_MERCHANT_FALLBACK_MODEL)
self.CIS_HasIdleSequence = CIS_ApplyMerchantIdleSequence(self)

elseif not self.CIS_HasIdleSequence then

self.CIS_HasIdleSequence = CIS_ApplyMerchantIdleSequence(self)

elseif self.CIS_IdleSequence and self:GetSequence() != self.CIS_IdleSequence then

self:SetSequence(self.CIS_IdleSequence)
self:SetCycle(0)
self:ResetSequenceInfo()

end

self:FrameAdvance()
self:NextThink(CurTime())
return true

end

In Garry's Mod Lua, what does bit.lshift do?

Returns the result of shifting given value left bitwise by given number of bits. See [this wiki article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#Bit_shifts) for more details.
The returned value will be clamped to a signed 32-bit integer, even on 64-bit builds.

Realms
- Shared and Menu

Arguments
- value: number. The value to be manipulated.
- shiftCount: number. Amounts of bits to shift left by.

Returns
- value: number. The resulting value. Input of `0b1001` will become `0b10010` for one left shift, etc.

Notes
- The returned value will be clamped to a signed 32-bit integer, even on 64-bit builds.

local CUTTA_COSMETIC_INITIAL_SYNC_DEBOUNCE = 3

local function CuttaCosmetic_RunInitialSync(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end

local lastSync = tonumber(ply.CuttaCosmetic_LastFullLoadAt or 0) or 0
if lastSync > 0 and (CurTime() - lastSync) < CUTTA_COSMETIC_INITIAL_SYNC_DEBOUNCE then
return
end

ply.CuttaCosmetic_InitialSyncInProgress = true

-- Stagger transfers to avoid a burst of net messages in the same tick
cutta_cosmetic_shop:Cosmetics_InitFile_Transfer(ply)

timer.Simple(0.3, function()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
cutta_cosmetic_shop:Transfer(ply)
cutta_cosmetic_shop:Spawn_WithModel_Equipped(ply)
end)

timer.Simple(0.6, function()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
cutta_cosmetic_shop:LoadCharacterProps(ply, false)
end)

timer.Simple(0.9, function()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
cutta_cosmetic_shop:LoadCosmeticSounds(ply)
cutta_cosmetic_shop:LoadCosmeticAnimations(ply)
end)

timer.Simple(1.2, function()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
cutta_cosmetic_shop:Send_Admin_Settings(ply)
end)

timer.Simple(1.5, function()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
ply.CuttaCosmetic_InitialSyncInProgress = nil
cutta_cosmetic_shop:SendAllCosmeticsTo(ply)
end)

ply.CuttaCosmetic_LastFullLoadAt = CurTime()
end

if not file.IsDir("cuttacosmeticshop","DATA") then

CuttaCosmetic_RunInitialSync(ply)

end

if not ply or not ply:IsValid() then return {} end

net.Send(ply)

if includeSourcePly == nil then
includeSourcePly = true

cutta_cosmetic_shop:SendCosmeticsTo(ply, includeSourcePly == true)

Write the Garry's Mod scripted entity file "farm_system/lua/entities/fs_auto_farm/init.lua".

AddCSLuaFile("cl_init.lua")
AddCSLuaFile("shared.lua")
include("shared.lua")

if not FS_Utils or not FS_Utils.GetAutoFarmSeedCatalog or not FS_Utils.SetEntityOwner then
include("autorun/server/fs_server_helpers.lua")
end

util.AddNetworkString("FS_AutoFarmOpen")
util.AddNetworkString("FS_AutoFarmAction")

local stateMessageName = "FS_AutoFarmOpen"
local actionMessageName = "FS_AutoFarmAction"

local function getAutoFarmHealth()
return math.max(math.floor(tonumber(FS_AutoFarm_Health) or 400), 1)
end

local function getAutoFarmMaxStoredMoney()
return math.max(math.floor(tonumber(FS_AutoFarm_MaxStoredMoney) or 100000), 0)
end

local function getAutoFarmMaxHarvestedTreeMoney()
return 2000000000
end

local function getAutoFarmMaxFertilizer()
return math.max(math.floor(tonumber(FS_AutoFarm_MaxFertilizer) or 25), 0)
end

local function getAutoFarmLinkRange()
return math.max(math.floor(tonumber(FS_AutoFarm_LinkRange) or 384), 0)
end

local function getAutoFarmThinkInterval()
return math.max(tonumber(FS_AutoFarm_ThinkInterval) or 1, 0.25)
end

local function getAutoFarmFertilizerPrice()
if FS_Utils.GetFertilizerPrice then
return FS_Utils.GetFertilizerPrice()
end

return math.max(math.floor(tonumber(FS_Fertilizer_Price) or 0), 0)
end

local autoFarmMenuCloseCooldown = 1

local function getAutoFarmPlayerKey(playerEntity)
if not IsValid(playerEntity) or not playerEntity:IsPlayer() then
return ""
end

local steamId64 = playerEntity:SteamID64()
if steamId64 and steamId64 ~= "" and steamId64 ~= "0" then
return steamId64
end

return tostring(playerEntity:UserID() or playerEntity:EntIndex())
end

local function getAutoFarmTimerName(autoFarm)
return "FS_AutoFarmAutomation_" .. autoFarm:EntIndex()
end

local function setCachedNWValue(entity, key, value, setter)
entity.fsNetworkState = entity.fsNetworkState or {}
if entity.fsNetworkState[key] == value then
return false
end

entity.fsNetworkState[key] = value
setter(entity, key, value)
return true
end

local function setCachedNWInt(entity, key, value)
return setCachedNWValue(entity, key, math.floor(tonumber(value) or 0), entity.SetNWInt)
end

local function setCachedNWBool(entity, key, value)
return setCachedNWValue(entity, key, value == true, entity.SetNWBool)
end

local function setCachedNWString(entity, key, value)
return setCachedNWValue(entity, key, tostring(value or ""), entity.SetNWString)
end

local function writeStateMessage(autoFarm, receiver, shouldOpen)
if not IsValid(autoFarm) then
return
end

local stateData = autoFarm:BuildState()
local serializedState = util.TableToJSON(stateData) or "{}"
local compressedState = util.Compress(serializedState) or ""

net.Start(stateMessageName)
net.WriteEntity(autoFarm)
net.WriteBool(shouldOpen == true)
net.WriteUInt(#compressedState, 32)
if #compressedState > 0 then
net.WriteData(compressedState, #compressedState)
end
if IsValid(receiver) then
net.Send(receiver)
end
end

function ENT:Initialize()
self:SetModel("models/props_junk/wood_crate002a.mdl")
self:PhysicsInit(SOLID_VPHYSICS)
self:SetMoveType(MOVETYPE_VPHYSICS)
self:SetSolid(SOLID_VPHYSICS)
self:SetUseType(SIMPLE_USE)
self:SetHealth(getAutoFarmHealth())
self.fsLinkedPatches = {}
self.fsSelectedSeeds = {}
self.fsStoredMoney = 0
self.fsHarvestedTreeMoney = 0
self.fsFertilizerStock = 0
self.fsSeedPurchaseCursor = 0
self.fsSelectedSeedCount = 0
self.fsRefundedMoney = false
self.fsAutomationTimerName = getAutoFarmTimerName(self)
self.fsAutomationTimerInterval = nil
self.fsNetworkState = {}
self.fsMenuReopenByPlayer = {}
self:SetStoredMoney(0)
self:SetHarvestedTreeMoney(0)
self:SetFertilizerStock(0)
setCachedNWBool(self, "FSAutoFarmActive", false)
setCachedNWBool(self, "FSAutoFarmAutoFertilizer", false)
setCachedNWInt(self, "FSAutoFarmLinkedPatches", 0)
setCachedNWBool(self, "FSAutoFarmInRange", false)
setCachedNWString(self, "FSAutoFarmOwnerName", "Unclaimed")
setCachedNWString(self, "FSAutoFarmStatus", "Idle")

local physicsObject = FS_Utils.GetPhysicsObject(self)
if physicsObject then
physicsObject:SetMass(125)
physicsObject:Wake()
end
if FS_Utils.RegisterTrackedDamageEntity then
FS_Utils.RegisterTrackedDamageEntity(self)
end

timer.Simple(0, function()
if not IsValid(self) then
return
end

self:RefreshRuntimeState(true)
self:EnsureAutomationTimer()
end)
end

function ENT:GetAutomationTimerName()
self.fsAutomationTimerName = self.fsAutomationTimerName or getAutoFarmTimerName(self)
return self.fsAutomationTimerName
end

function ENT:StopAutomationTimer()
local timerName = self:GetAutomationTimerName()
if timer.Exists(timerName) then
timer.Remove(timerName)
end

self.fsAutomationTimerInterval = nil
end

function ENT:EnsureAutomationTimer()
if not self:IsActive() then
self:StopAutomationTimer()
return false
end

local timerName = self:GetAutomationTimerName()
local thinkInterval = getAutoFarmThinkInterval()
if timer.Exists(timerName) and self.fsAutomationTimerInterval == thinkInterval then
return true
end

timer.Remove(timerName)
self.fsAutomationTimerInterval = thinkInterval
timer.Create(timerName, thinkInterval, 0, function()
if not IsValid(self) then
timer.Remove(timerName)
return
end

self:ProcessAutomationCycle()
end)

return true
end

function ENT:RequestAutomationCheck(immediate)
if not self:IsActive() then
self:StopAutomationTimer()
return false
end

if immediate == true and not self.fsAutomationProcessing and not self.fsAutomationImmediateQueued then
self.fsAutomationImmediateQueued = true
timer.Simple(0, function()
if not IsValid(self) then
return
end

self.fsAutomationImmediateQueued = nil
if self:IsActive() then
self:ProcessAutomationCycle()
end
end)
end

return self:EnsureAutomationTimer()
end

function ENT:MarkMenuClosedForPlayer(playerEntity)
local playerKey = getAutoFarmPlayerKey(playerEntity)
if playerKey == "" then
return false
end

self.fsMenuReopenByPlayer = self.fsMenuReopenByPlayer or {}
self.fsMenuReopenByPlayer[playerKey] = CurTime() + autoFarmMenuCloseCooldown
return true
end

function ENT:CanPlayerOpenMenu(playerEntity)
local playerKey = getAutoFarmPlayerKey(playerEntity)
if playerKey == "" then
return false
end

local reopenTime = self.fsMenuReopenByPlayer and self.fsMenuReopenByPlayer[playerKey] or 0
if reopenTime <= 0 then
return true
end

if CurTime() >= reopenTime then
self.fsMenuReopenByPlayer[playerKey] = nil
return true
end

return false
end

function ENT:GetStoredMoney()
return self.fsStoredMoney or 0
end

function ENT:SetStoredMoney(amount)
local clampedAmount = math.Clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, getAutoFarmMaxStoredMoney())
self.fsStoredMoney = clampedAmount
setCachedNWInt(self, "FSAutoFarmMoney", clampedAmount)
self:RequestAutomationCheck()
return clampedAmount
end

function ENT:GetHarvestedTreeMoney()
return self.fsHarvestedTreeMoney or 0
end

function ENT:SetHarvestedTreeMoney(amount)
local clampedAmount = math.Clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, getAutoFarmMaxHarvestedTreeMoney())
self.fsHarvestedTreeMoney = clampedAmount
return clampedAmount
end

function ENT:AddHarvestedTreeMoney(amount)
local addedAmount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0)
if addedAmount <= 0 then
return 0
end

local previousTotal = self:GetHarvestedTreeMoney()
local newTotal = self:SetHarvestedTreeMoney(previousTotal + addedAmount)
return math.max(newTotal - previousTotal, 0)
end

function ENT:GetFertilizerStock()
return self.fsFertilizerStock or 0
end

function ENT:SetFertilizerStock(amount)
local clampedAmount = math.Clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, getAutoFarmMaxFertilizer())
self.fsFertilizerStock = clampedAmount
setCachedNWInt(self, "FSAutoFarmFertilizerStock", clampedAmount)

function ENT:IsAutoFertilizerEnabled()

function ENT:ResolveOwner()

if IsValid(owner) then
setCachedNWString(self, "FSAutoFarmOwnerName", owner:Nick() or "Unclaimed")
end

end

function ENT:ClaimOwner(playerEntity)

end

FS_Utils.SetEntityOwner(self, playerEntity)
setCachedNWString(self, "FSAutoFarmOwnerName", playerEntity:Nick() or "Unclaimed")
self:RefreshRuntimeState(true)

function ENT:IsSeedSelected(seedClass)
return self.fsSelectedSeeds and self.fsSelectedSeeds[seedClass] == true
end

function ENT:GetSelectedSeedDefinitions()
local selectedSeeds = {}

for _, seedDefinition in ipairs(FS_Utils.GetAutoFarmSeedCatalog()) do
if self:IsSeedSelected(seedDefinition.Class) then
selectedSeeds[#selectedSeeds + 1] = seedDefinition
end
end

return selectedSeeds
end

function ENT:GetSelectedSeedCount()
return self.fsSelectedSeedCount or 0
end

function ENT:ToggleSeedSelection(seedClass)
if not FS_Utils.GetAutoFarmSeedDefinition(seedClass) then
return false
end

local wasSelected = self:IsSeedSelected(seedClass)
self.fsSelectedSeeds[seedClass] = not wasSelected
self.fsSelectedSeedCount = math.max((self.fsSelectedSeedCount or 0) + (wasSelected and -1 or 1), 0)
self:RequestAutomationCheck()
return true
end

function ENT:UpdateLinkedPatches(owner)
local linkedPatches = {}
if not IsValid(owner) then
self.fsLinkedPatches = linkedPatches
setCachedNWInt(self, "FSAutoFarmLinkedPatches", 0)
setCachedNWBool(self, "FSAutoFarmInRange", false)
return linkedPatches
end

local autoFarmPosition = self:GetPos()
local linkRangeSqr = getAutoFarmLinkRange() * getAutoFarmLinkRange()
local ownedPatches = FS_Utils.GetOwnedDirtPatches and FS_Utils.GetOwnedDirtPatches(owner) or ents.FindInSphere(autoFarmPosition, getAutoFarmLinkRange())
for _, entity in ipairs(ownedPatches) do
if FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) and autoFarmPosition:DistToSqr(entity:GetPos()) <= linkRangeSqr then
linkedPatches[#linkedPatches + 1] = entity
end
end

if #linkedPatches > 1 then
table.sort(linkedPatches, function(leftPatch, rightPatch)
return autoFarmPosition:DistToSqr(leftPatch:GetPos()) < autoFarmPosition:DistToSqr(rightPatch:GetPos())
end)
end

self.fsLinkedPatches = linkedPatches
setCachedNWInt(self, "FSAutoFarmLinkedPatches", #linkedPatches)
setCachedNWBool(self, "FSAutoFarmInRange", #linkedPatches > 0)
return linkedPatches
end

function ENT:HasAffordableSelectedSeed()
local storedMoney = self:GetStoredMoney()
if storedMoney <= 0 or self:GetSelectedSeedCount() <= 0 then
return false
end

for _, seedDefinition in ipairs(FS_Utils.GetAutoFarmSeedCatalog()) do
if self:IsSeedSelected(seedDefinition.Class) and (FS_Utils.GetAutoFarmSeedPrice(seedDefinition.Class) or 0) <= storedMoney then
return true
end
end

return false
end

function ENT:PatchHasHarvestReadySeed(dirtPatch)
for _, seedEntity in pairs(dirtPatch.fsSeedSlots or {}) do
if IsValid(seedEntity) and seedEntity:GetDTInt(1) == 2 then
return true
end
end

return false
end

function ENT:PatchNeedsPlanting(dirtPatch)
if not self:HasAffordableSelectedSeed() then
return false
end

local seedCapacity = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(dirtPatch.SeedCapacity) or 0), 0)
local seedSlots = dirtPatch.fsSeedSlots or {}
for slotIndex = 1, seedCapacity do
if not IsValid(seedSlots[slotIndex]) then
return true
end
end

return false
end

function ENT:PatchNeedsFertilizer(dirtPatch)
if not self:IsAutoFertilizerEnabled() or self:GetFertilizerStock() <= 0 then
return false
end

for _, seedEntity in pairs(dirtPatch.fsSeedSlots or {}) do
if IsValid(seedEntity) and seedEntity:GetDTInt(1) == 1 and not seedEntity:GetDTBool(4) then
return true
end
end

return false
end

function ENT:PatchNeedsAutomation(dirtPatch)
if not IsValid(dirtPatch) then
return false
end

return self:PatchHasHarvestReadySeed(dirtPatch)
or self:PatchNeedsPlanting(dirtPatch)
or self:PatchNeedsFertilizer(dirtPatch)
end

function ENT:GetActionableLinkedPatches(linkedPatches)
local actionablePatches = {}
for _, dirtPatch in ipairs(linkedPatches or self.fsLinkedPatches or {}) do
if IsValid(dirtPatch) and self:PatchNeedsAutomation(dirtPatch) then
actionablePatches[#actionablePatches + 1] = dirtPatch
end
end

return actionablePatches
end

function ENT:GetStatusLabel(owner, linkedPatches)
if not IsValid(owner) then
return "Unclaimed"
end

if not self:IsActive() then
return "Idle"
end

linkedPatches = linkedPatches or self.fsLinkedPatches or {}
if #linkedPatches <= 0 then
return "Move closer to your dirt patches"
end

if self:GetSelectedSeedCount() <= 0 then
return "No seeds selected"
end

if self:GetStoredMoney() <= 0 then
return "Out of stored cash"
end

return "Running"
end

function ENT:SyncRuntimeState(owner, linkedPatches)
linkedPatches = linkedPatches or self.fsLinkedPatches or {}
setCachedNWInt(self, "FSAutoFarmFertilizerStock", self:GetFertilizerStock())
setCachedNWBool(self, "FSAutoFarmAutoFertilizer", self:IsAutoFertilizerEnabled())
if IsValid(owner) then
setCachedNWString(self, "FSAutoFarmOwnerName", owner:Nick() or "Unclaimed")
setCachedNWString(self, "FSAutoFarmStatus", self:GetStatusLabel(owner, linkedPatches))
return
end

setCachedNWString(self, "FSAutoFarmOwnerName", "Unclaimed")
setCachedNWString(self, "FSAutoFarmStatus", "Unclaimed")
setCachedNWInt(self, "FSAutoFarmLinkedPatches", 0)
setCachedNWBool(self, "FSAutoFarmInRange", false)
end

function ENT:RefreshRuntimeState(forceLinkRefresh)
local owner = self:ResolveOwner()
local linkedPatches = self.fsLinkedPatches or {}
if forceLinkRefresh then
linkedPatches = self:UpdateLinkedPatches(owner)
end

self:SyncRuntimeState(owner, linkedPatches)
return owner, linkedPatches
end

function ENT:BuildState()
local owner, linkedPatches = self:RefreshRuntimeState(true)
local linkedPatchEntIndices = {}

for _, dirtPatch in ipairs(linkedPatches) do
if IsValid(dirtPatch) then
linkedPatchEntIndices[#linkedPatchEntIndices + 1] = dirtPatch:EntIndex()
end
end

local stateData = {
ownerName = self:GetNWString("FSAutoFarmOwnerName", "Unclaimed"),
storedMoney = self:GetStoredMoney(),
maxMoney = getAutoFarmMaxStoredMoney(),
treeMoney = self:GetHarvestedTreeMoney(),
fertilizerStock = self:GetFertilizerStock(),
maxFertilizer = getAutoFarmMaxFertilizer(),
fertilizerPrice = getAutoFarmFertilizerPrice(),
autoFertilizer = self:IsAutoFertilizerEnabled(),
active = self:IsActive(),
linkedPatches = #linkedPatches,
linkedPatchEntIndices = linkedPatchEntIndices,
inRange = #linkedPatches > 0,
status = self:GetNWString("FSAutoFarmStatus", "Idle"),
linkRange = getAutoFarmLinkRange(),
seeds = {}
}

for _, seedDefinition in ipairs(FS_Utils.GetAutoFarmSeedCatalog()) do
stateData.seeds[#stateData.seeds + 1] = {
class = seedDefinition.Class,
name = seedDefinition.Name,
price = FS_Utils.GetAutoFarmSeedPrice(seedDefinition.Class) or 0,
selected = self:IsSeedSelected(seedDefinition.Class)
}
end

return stateData
end

end

function ENT:DepositFromPlayer(playerEntity, amount)
local remainingCapacity = math.max(getAutoFarmMaxStoredMoney() - self:GetStoredMoney(), 0)
if remainingCapacity <= 0 then
return 0
end

local requestedAmount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0)
if requestedAmount <= 0 then
return 0
end

local depositedAmount = FS_Utils.TryTakeMoney(playerEntity, math.min(requestedAmount, remainingCapacity))
if depositedAmount <= 0 then
return 0
end

self:SetStoredMoney(self:GetStoredMoney() + depositedAmount)
self:EmitSound("items/ammo_pickup.wav", 60, 110)
return depositedAmount
end

function ENT:CollectHarvestedTreeMoney(playerEntity)
if not IsValid(playerEntity) or not playerEntity:IsPlayer() then
return 0
end

local harvestedTreeMoney = self:GetHarvestedTreeMoney()
if harvestedTreeMoney <= 0 then
return 0
end

FS_Utils.AddMoney(playerEntity, harvestedTreeMoney)
self:SetHarvestedTreeMoney(0)
self:EmitSound("items/ammo_pickup.wav", 60, 100)
return harvestedTreeMoney
end

function ENT:WithdrawStoredMoney(playerEntity)
if not IsValid(playerEntity) or not playerEntity:IsPlayer() then
return 0
end

local storedMoney = self:GetStoredMoney()
if storedMoney <= 0 then
return 0
end

FS_Utils.AddMoney(playerEntity, storedMoney)
self:SetStoredMoney(0)
self:EmitSound("items/ammo_pickup.wav", 60, 105)
return storedMoney
end

function ENT:PurchaseFertilizerFromPlayer(playerEntity, requestedCount)
local remainingCapacity = math.max(getAutoFarmMaxFertilizer() - self:GetFertilizerStock(), 0)
if remainingCapacity <= 0 then
return 0
end

local requestedAmount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(requestedCount) or 0), 0)
local isMaxRequest = requestedAmount <= 0
local fertilizerCount = isMaxRequest and remainingCapacity or math.min(requestedAmount, remainingCapacity)
if fertilizerCount <= 0 then
return 0
end

local fertilizerPrice = getAutoFarmFertilizerPrice()
if fertilizerPrice > 0 then
local availableMoney = FS_Utils.GetPlayerMoney(playerEntity)
if availableMoney <= 0 then
return 0
end

if isMaxRequest then
fertilizerCount = math.min(fertilizerCount, math.floor(availableMoney / fertilizerPrice))
elseif availableMoney < (fertilizerCount * fertilizerPrice) then
return 0
end

if fertilizerCount <= 0 then
return 0
end

local takenAmount = FS_Utils.TryTakeMoney(playerEntity, fertilizerCount * fertilizerPrice)
fertilizerCount = math.floor(takenAmount / fertilizerPrice)
if fertilizerCount <= 0 then
return 0
end
end

self:SetFertilizerStock(self:GetFertilizerStock() + fertilizerCount)
self:EmitSound("items/ammo_pickup.wav", 60, 120)
return fertilizerCount
end

function ENT:RefundStoredMoney()
if self.fsRefundedMoney then
return 0
end

local storedMoney = self:GetStoredMoney()
local harvestedTreeMoney = self:GetHarvestedTreeMoney()
if storedMoney <= 0 and harvestedTreeMoney <= 0 then
return 0
end

-- Drop the seed-purchase budget and the uncollected money-tree balance separately.
local moneyEntity = storedMoney > 0 and FS_Utils.SpawnWorldMoney(self:GetPos() + (self:GetUp() * 24) + (self:GetRight() * 10), storedMoney) or nil
local harvestedMoneyEntity = harvestedTreeMoney > 0 and FS_Utils.SpawnWorldMoney(self:GetPos() + (self:GetUp() * 24) - (self:GetRight() * 10), harvestedTreeMoney) or nil
self.fsRefundedMoney = true
self:SetStoredMoney(0)
self:SetHarvestedTreeMoney(0)
if IsValid(moneyEntity) then
FS_Utils.SetPhysicsMotion(moneyEntity, true, (self:GetUp() * 36) + (VectorRand() * 18))
end
if IsValid(harvestedMoneyEntity) then
FS_Utils.SetPhysicsMotion(harvestedMoneyEntity, true, (self:GetUp() * 36) + (VectorRand() * 18))
end
return storedMoney + harvestedTreeMoney
end

function ENT:PickSeedDefinitionForPurchase()
local selectedSeeds = self:GetSelectedSeedDefinitions()
if #selectedSeeds <= 0 then
return nil, 0
end

local startIndex = ((self.fsSeedPurchaseCursor or 0) % #selectedSeeds) + 1
for offset = 0, #selectedSeeds - 1 do
local currentIndex = ((startIndex + offset - 1) % #selectedSeeds) + 1
local seedDefinition = selectedSeeds[currentIndex]
local seedPrice = FS_Utils.GetAutoFarmSeedPrice(seedDefinition.Class) or 0
if seedPrice <= self:GetStoredMoney() then
self.fsSeedPurchaseCursor = currentIndex
return seedDefinition, seedPrice
end
end

return nil, 0
end

function ENT:TryPlantSeedOnPatch(dirtPatch, owner, openSlotIndex)
if not IsValid(dirtPatch) or not dirtPatch.AssignSeedToSlot then
return false
end

local seedDefinition, seedPrice = self:PickSeedDefinitionForPurchase()
if not seedDefinition or seedPrice > self:GetStoredMoney() then
return false
end

local seedEntity = ents.Create(seedDefinition.Class)
if not IsValid(seedEntity) then
return false
end

local slotPosition = dirtPatch:GetSlotWorldPosition(openSlotIndex)
seedEntity:SetPos(slotPosition + Vector(0, 0, 24))
seedEntity:SetAngles(Angle(0, dirtPatch:GetAngles().y, 0))
seedEntity:Spawn()
seedEntity:Activate()
FS_Utils.SetEntityOwner(seedEntity, owner)

if not IsValid(seedEntity) or not dirtPatch:AssignSeedToSlot(seedEntity, openSlotIndex) then
if IsValid(seedEntity) then
seedEntity:Remove()
end
return false
end

self:SetStoredMoney(self:GetStoredMoney() - seedPrice)
self:EmitSound("physics/wood/wood_box_impact_hard3.wav", 55, 115)
return true
end

function ENT:TryFertilizePatch(dirtPatch)
if not self:IsAutoFertilizerEnabled() or self:GetFertilizerStock() <= 0 then
return false
end

if not IsValid(dirtPatch) or not FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizerToDirtPatch then
return false
end

local fertilizerResult = FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizerToDirtPatch(dirtPatch)
if fertilizerResult ~= 1 then
return false
end

self:SetFertilizerStock(self:GetFertilizerStock() - 1)
self:EmitSound("physics/cardboard/cardboard_box_break3.wav", 55, 120)
return true
end

function ENT:HarvestPatch(dirtPatch, owner)
local harvestedAnything = false

for _, seedEntity in pairs(dirtPatch.fsSeedSlots or {}) do
if IsValid(seedEntity) and seedEntity:GetDTInt(1) == 2 then
if FS_Utils.HarvestSeed(seedEntity, owner, { forceAutoCollect = true, autoFarm = self }) then
harvestedAnything = true
end
end
end

return harvestedAnything
end

function ENT:PlantPatch(dirtPatch, owner)
local plantedAnything = false

while IsValid(dirtPatch) do
local openSlotIndex = dirtPatch:GetOpenSlotIndex()
if not openSlotIndex then
break
end

if not self:TryPlantSeedOnPatch(dirtPatch, owner, openSlotIndex) then
break
end

plantedAnything = true
end

return plantedAnything
end

function ENT:RunAutomation(owner, linkedPatches)
for _, dirtPatch in ipairs(linkedPatches) do
if IsValid(dirtPatch) then
self:HarvestPatch(dirtPatch, owner)
end
end

for _, dirtPatch in ipairs(linkedPatches) do
if IsValid(dirtPatch) then
self:PlantPatch(dirtPatch, owner)
end
end

if self:IsAutoFertilizerEnabled() and self:GetFertilizerStock() > 0 then
for _, dirtPatch in ipairs(linkedPatches) do
if self:GetFertilizerStock() <= 0 then
break
end

if IsValid(dirtPatch) then
self:TryFertilizePatch(dirtPatch)
end
end
end
end

function ENT:SpawnFunction(playerEntity, trace)

return
end

local entity = ents.Create("fs_auto_farm")
entity:SetAngles(Angle(0, playerEntity:EyeAngles().y, 0))
entity:SetPos(trace.HitPos + trace.HitNormal * 12)
entity:Spawn()
entity:Activate()
FS_Utils.SetEntityOwner(entity, playerEntity)
entity:RefreshRuntimeState(true)
return entity
end

function ENT:Use(activator)
if not IsValid(activator) or not activator:IsPlayer() then
return
end

if not FS_Utils.CanPlayerUseEntity(activator, self) then
return
end

local owner = self:ResolveOwner()
if not IsValid(owner) then
owner = self:ClaimOwner(activator)
end

if not FS_Utils.EntityBelongsToPlayer(self, activator) then
return
end

if not self:CanPlayerOpenMenu(activator) then
return
end

self:SendState(activator, true)
end

function ENT:ProcessAutomationCycle()
if self.fsAutomationProcessing then
return false
end

self.fsAutomationProcessing = true

if not self:IsActive() then
self.fsAutomationProcessing = nil
self:StopAutomationTimer()
self:RefreshRuntimeState(true)
return false
end

local owner, linkedPatches = self:RefreshRuntimeState(true)
if not IsValid(owner) or #linkedPatches <= 0 then
self.fsAutomationProcessing = nil
self:StopAutomationTimer()
return false
end

local actionablePatches = self:GetActionableLinkedPatches(linkedPatches)
if #actionablePatches <= 0 then
self.fsAutomationProcessing = nil
self:StopAutomationTimer()
self:SyncRuntimeState(owner, linkedPatches)
return false
end

self:RunAutomation(owner, actionablePatches)
self:SyncRuntimeState(owner, self.fsLinkedPatches)

if #self:GetActionableLinkedPatches(self.fsLinkedPatches) <= 0 then
self.fsAutomationProcessing = nil
self:StopAutomationTimer()
return false
end

self.fsAutomationProcessing = nil
return true
end

end

end

local function CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply)
return IsValid(ply) and ply:IsPlayer()
end

local function CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerState(ply)
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return false end

ply.CuttaQS = istable(ply.CuttaQS) and ply.CuttaQS or {}
ply.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes = istable(ply.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes) and ply.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = istable(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars) and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestGiverData = istable(ply.CuttaQS_QuestGiverData) and ply.CuttaQS_QuestGiverData or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["QuestColddown"] = istable(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["QuestColddown"]) and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["QuestColddown"] or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["OnColddown"] = istable(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["OnColddown"]) and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["OnColddown"] or {}

return true
end

function cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_FeatureEnabled()
local cfg = cutta_quest_system["Configuration"] or {}
return DarkRP ~= nil and cfg["Hide Quest NPCs While Quest Givers Online"] == true
end

function cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_EnsureData(ply)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerState(ply) then return nil end

local data = ply.CuttaQS_QuestGiverData or {}
data.Level = math.max(1, tonumber(data.Level) or 1)
data.XP = math.max(0, tonumber(data.XP) or 0)
data.TotalXP = math.max(0, tonumber(data.TotalXP) or 0)
ply.CuttaQS_QuestGiverData = data

return data
end

function cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_XPPerQuest()
return 25
end

function cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_RequiredXP(level)
level = math.max(1, tonumber(level) or 1)
return 100
end

function cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_ApplyNW(ply)
local data = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_EnsureData(ply)
if not data then return end

ply:SetNWInt(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverLevel", data.Level)
ply:SetNWInt(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverXP", data.XP)
ply:SetNWInt(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverTotalXP", data.TotalXP)
ply:SetNWInt(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverNextXP", cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_RequiredXP(data.Level))
end

function cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_FindPlayerBySteamID64(steamID64)
steamID64 = tostring(steamID64 or "")
if steamID64 == "" then return nil end

for _, ply in ipairs(player.GetHumans()) do
if IsValid(ply) and ply:SteamID64() == steamID64 then
return ply
end
end

return nil
end

function cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_ClearPendingSource(ply)
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return end
ply.CUTTAQS_PendingQuestGiverSource = nil
end

function cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_SetPendingSource(ply, giverPly)
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return end

if not cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_FeatureEnabled() then
cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_ClearPendingSource(ply)
return
end

if not IsValid(giverPly) or not giverPly:IsPlayer() then
cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_ClearPendingSource(ply)
return
end

if not cutta_quest_system.DarkRP_IsQuestGiverPlayer or not cutta_quest_system:DarkRP_IsQuestGiverPlayer(giverPly) then
cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_ClearPendingSource(ply)
return
end

ply.CUTTAQS_PendingQuestGiverSource = {
steamID64 = giverPly:SteamID64(),
expiresAt = CurTime() + 60,
}
end

function cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_GetPendingSourceSteamID64(ply)
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return nil end
if not cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_FeatureEnabled() then return nil end

local pending = ply.CUTTAQS_PendingQuestGiverSource
if not istable(pending) then return nil end
if tonumber(pending.expiresAt or 0) < CurTime() then
ply.CUTTAQS_PendingQuestGiverSource = nil
return nil
end

return tostring(pending.steamID64 or "")
end

function cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_AssignSourceToQuest(ply, questName)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerState(ply) then return end

local sourceSteamID64 = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_GetPendingSourceSteamID64(ply)
ply.CUTTAQS_PendingQuestGiverSource = nil

if sourceSteamID64 == nil or sourceSteamID64 == "" then
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverSource"] = nil
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverQuest"] = nil
cutta_quest_system:PlayerVariableTransfer(ply)
return
end

ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverSource"] = sourceSteamID64
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverQuest"] = tostring(questName or "")
cutta_quest_system:PlayerVariableTransfer(ply)
end

function cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_AwardQuestXP(completer, questName)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerState(completer) then return false end
if not cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_FeatureEnabled() then return false end

local sourceSteamID64 = tostring(completer.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverSource"] or "")
local sourceQuestName = tostring(completer.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverQuest"] or "")
if sourceSteamID64 == "" or sourceQuestName == "" then return false end
if sourceQuestName ~= tostring(questName or "") then return false end

local giverPly = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_FindPlayerBySteamID64(sourceSteamID64)
if not IsValid(giverPly) or not giverPly:IsPlayer() then return false end

local data = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_EnsureData(giverPly)
if not data then return false end

local xpAward = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_XPPerQuest()
data.XP = data.XP + xpAward
data.TotalXP = data.TotalXP + xpAward

local leveledUp = false
local requiredXP = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_RequiredXP(data.Level)
while data.XP >= requiredXP do
data.XP = data.XP - requiredXP
data.Level = data.Level + 1
leveledUp = true
requiredXP = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_RequiredXP(data.Level)
end

cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_ApplyNW(giverPly)
cutta_quest_system:PlayerSave(giverPly)
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(giverPly, string.format("Quest Giver XP +%d from %s finishing '%s'", xpAward, tostring(completer:Nick()), tostring(questName)))
if leveledUp then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(giverPly, string.format("Quest Giver Level Up! You are now level %d", data.Level))
end

return true
end

local CQS_INITIAL_SYNC_DEBOUNCE = 3
local CQS_INITIAL_SYNC_STAGE_DELAY = 0.15

local function CQS_RunInitialSync(ply)
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return end

local lastSync = tonumber(ply.CUTTAQS_LastFullSyncAt or 0) or 0
if lastSync > 0 and (CurTime() - lastSync) < CQS_INITIAL_SYNC_DEBOUNCE then
return
end

cutta_quest_system:Settings_Transfer_ply(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Quests_SoundTransfer_ply(ply)

local function finishSync()
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return end
cutta_quest_system:LoadingSreen_FinishTransfer(ply)
end

local function sendDialogueNPCs()
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return end
cutta_quest_system:DialogueNPCs_Transfer_ply(ply, finishSync)
end

local function sendPlayerData()
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return end
cutta_quest_system:PlayerDataTransfer(ply)
timer.Simple(CQS_INITIAL_SYNC_STAGE_DELAY, sendDialogueNPCs)
end

local function sendQuests()
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return end
cutta_quest_system:Player_EndQuest(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlyTransfer(ply, function()
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return end
timer.Simple(CQS_INITIAL_SYNC_STAGE_DELAY, sendPlayerData)
end)
end

local function sendDialogues()
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return end
cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_Transfer_ply(ply, function()
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return end
timer.Simple(CQS_INITIAL_SYNC_STAGE_DELAY, sendQuests)
end)
end

timer.Simple(CQS_INITIAL_SYNC_STAGE_DELAY, sendDialogues)

ply.CUTTAQS_LastFullSyncAt = CurTime()
end

local CQS_PLAYER_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES = 18000

local function CQS_SendCompressedPayloadChunks(netName, recipient, compressedData, maxChunkSize)
if not IsValid(recipient) or not isstring(netName) or netName == "" then return end
if not isstring(compressedData) or #compressedData == 0 then return end

maxChunkSize = tonumber(maxChunkSize) or CQS_PLAYER_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES
if maxChunkSize < 8000 then maxChunkSize = 8000 end

local totalSize = #compressedData
local totalChunks = math.ceil(totalSize / maxChunkSize)

for chunkIndex = 1, totalChunks do
local startIndex = (chunkIndex - 1) * maxChunkSize + 1
local endIndex = math.min(totalSize, startIndex + maxChunkSize - 1)
local part = string.sub(compressedData, startIndex, endIndex)
if isstring(part) and #part > 0 then
net.Start(netName)
net.WriteUInt(totalChunks, 16)
net.WriteUInt(chunkIndex, 16)
net.WriteUInt(totalSize, 32)
net.WriteUInt(#part, 16)
net.WriteData(part, #part)
net.Send(recipient)
end
end
end

function cutta_quest_system:PlayerDataTransfer_Reset(ply)
if not CQS_IsValidQuestPlayer(ply) then return end
net.Start(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."playerload_reset")
net.Send(ply)
end

function cutta_quest_system:PlayerDataTransfer(ply)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerState(ply) then return end
cutta_quest_system:PlayerDataTransfer_Reset(ply)

local payload = {
quests = istable(ply.CuttaQS) and ply.CuttaQS or {},
completionTimes = istable(ply.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes) and ply.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes or {}
}
local json = util.TableToJSON(payload)
local compressed = json and util.Compress(json) or nil
if compressed then
if #compressed <= CQS_PLAYER_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES then
net.Start(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."playerload_bulk")
net.WriteUInt(#compressed, 32)
net.WriteData(compressed, #compressed)
net.Send(ply)
else
cutta_quest_system:PlayerDataTransfer_Reset(ply)
CQS_SendCompressedPayloadChunks(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."playerload_bulk_chunk", ply, compressed, CQS_PLAYER_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES)
end
else
for k,v in ipairs(ply.CuttaQS) do
net.Start(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."playerload")
net.WriteString(v)
local time = (ply.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes and ply.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes[v]) or 0
net.WriteUInt(time, 32)
net.Send(ply)
end
end

cutta_quest_system:PlayerSave(ply)
end

function cutta_quest_system:PlayerVariableTransfer(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}

local json = util.TableToJSON(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars)
if not isstring(json) or json == "" then return end

-- Avoid sending identical quest-var payloads repeatedly.
if ply.CUTTAQS_LastQuestVarPayload == json then return end
ply.CUTTAQS_LastQuestVarPayload = json

local compressed = util.Compress(json)
if not compressed then return end

if #compressed <= CQS_PLAYER_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES then
net.Start(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."playervartransfer")
net.WriteUInt(#compressed, 32) -- send the size
net.WriteData(compressed, #compressed)
net.Send(ply)
else
CQS_SendCompressedPayloadChunks(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."playervartransfer_chunk", ply, compressed, CQS_PLAYER_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES)
end
end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_StartQuestColddown(ply,questname)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerState(ply) then return end
if timer.Exists(cutta_quest_system:PlayerAccountID(ply)..""..questname.."Colddown") then
timer.Remove(cutta_quest_system:PlayerAccountID(ply)..""..questname.."Colddown")
end
if cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsColddown(questname) then
cutta_quest_system:Player_SetQuestColddown(ply,questname)

local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname)
local timelimit = tonumber(questData and questData.ColddownTime) or 5
if timelimit < 5 then timelimit = 5 end

local timeLeft = timelimit
timer.Create(cutta_quest_system:PlayerAccountID(ply)..""..questname.."Colddown", 1, timelimit, function()
if ply:IsValid() then
if timeLeft <= 1 then
cutta_quest_system:Player_RemoveQuestColddownTime(ply,questname)
else
cutta_quest_system:Player_SetQuestColddownTime(ply,questname,timeLeft)
end
end
timeLeft = timeLeft - 1
end)
end
end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_SetQuestColddownTime(ply,questname,timelimit)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerState(ply) then return end
if not isstring(questname) or questname == "" then return end

ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["QuestColddown"][questname] = timelimit
cutta_quest_system:PlayerColddownVariableTransfer(ply,questname)
end

if CLIENT then
function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Soundcue_urlcheck(url)
url = string.Trim(tostring(url or ""))
if url == "" then return false end
return string.find(url, "^https?://") ~= nil
end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Soundcue_soundpathcheck(soundpath)
local ply = LocalPlayer()
if not IsValid(ply) then return false end

soundpath = string.Trim(tostring(soundpath or ""))
if soundpath == "" then return false end

local soundObject = CreateSound(ply, soundpath)
if not soundObject then return false end

ply.CUTTAQS_Soundcue = soundObject
soundObject:Stop()
soundObject:Play()

local duration = SoundDuration(soundpath)
if duration > 0 then
local timerId = soundpath .. "_soundcue_timer"
if timer.Exists(timerId) then timer.Remove(timerId) end
timer.Create(timerId, duration, 1, function()
if IsValid(soundObject) then soundObject:Stop() end
if ply.CUTTAQS_Soundcue == soundObject then
ply.CUTTAQS_Soundcue = nil
end
end)
end

return true
end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Soundcue_playsound(objdata)
local soundPath = objdata and (objdata.sound or objdata["sound"]) or nil
if not soundPath then return end
if not IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then return end

local ply = LocalPlayer()
ply.CUTTAQS_Soundcue = nil

local function playUrl()
sound.PlayURL(tostring(soundPath), "noblock", function(station)
if not IsValid(station) then return end
if not IsValid(ply) then
station:Stop()
return
end
station:SetPos(ply:GetPos())
station:Play()
ply.CUTTAQS_Soundcue = station

local duration = station.GetLength and station:GetLength() or SoundDuration(soundPath) or 0
if duration > 0 then
local timerId = soundPath .. "_soundcue_timer"
if timer.Exists(timerId) then timer.Remove(timerId) end
timer.Create(timerId, duration, 1, function()
if IsValid(station) then station:Stop() end
if ply.CUTTAQS_Soundcue == station then ply.CUTTAQS_Soundcue = nil end
end)
end
end)
end

local soundPathStr = string.Trim(tostring(soundPath))
if soundPathStr == "" then return end

if cutta_quest_system:Objective_Soundcue_urlcheck(soundPathStr) then
playUrl()
else
cutta_quest_system:Objective_Soundcue_soundpathcheck(soundPathStr)
end
end
end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Soundcue_stopclientmusic(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end

net.Start(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."objective_soundcuestop")
net.Send(ply)

end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Soundcue_startclientmusic(ply,objdata)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end
if not istable(objdata) then return end
local json = util.TableToJSON(objdata)
if not json then return end
local compressed = util.Compress(json)
if not compressed then return end
net.Start(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."objective_soundcuestart")
net.WriteUInt(#compressed, 32) -- send the size
net.WriteData(compressed, #compressed)
net.Send(ply)

local globalIdKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"
local globalId = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[globalIdKey] or nil
local objNumb = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjNumb"]) or nil
if globalId and cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuest_AdvanceOnce then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_AdvanceOnce(globalId, objNumb)
end

timer.Simple(0,function()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
if cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply)
end
end)

end

How should I structure a Garry's Mod addon so shared, server, and client code stay organized?

Treat a Garry's Mod addon as a small Lua project with clear realm boundaries.

Rules
- Put authority, spawning, damage, persistence, and validation on the server.
- Put HUD, VGUI, rendering, and client-only effects on the client.
- Put constants, shared helpers, and network message names in shared files.
- Send client files from the server with AddCSLuaFile before clients need them.
- Use include to load modules explicitly instead of putting all logic in one file.

Common layout
- lua/autorun/myaddon.lua
- lua/autorun/server/sv_myaddon.lua
- lua/autorun/client/cl_myaddon.lua
- lua/myaddon/sh_config.lua
- lua/entities/sent_example/shared.lua
- lua/entities/sent_example/init.lua
- lua/entities/sent_example/cl_init.lua
- lua/weapons/weapon_example/shared.lua
- lua/weapons/weapon_example/init.lua
- lua/weapons/weapon_example/cl_init.lua

The shared bootstrap usually decides which files to send and include. Scripted entities and SWEPs usually keep shared definitions in shared.lua, server logic in init.lua, and client drawing code in cl_init.lua.

function cutta_quest_system:Player_StartQuest(ply,questname,notallowed,forceStart)

questname = string.Trim(tostring(questname or ""))
if questname == "" then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply,"Quest Does Not Exist")
return
end
local bypassValidation = forceStart and cutta_quest_system:PlayerUserGroupAllowed(ply) and true or false

if not bypassValidation then
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_CanQuest(ply) then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply,"You Are In A Quest")
return
end
if not cutta_quest_system:Quests_QuestExists(questname) then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply,"Quest Does Not Exist")
return
end
if cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerNeedQuestsRequired(ply,questname) then
local questrequiredtable = cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerQuestsRequired(ply,questname)
for k,v in pairs(questrequiredtable) do
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_HasCompletedQuest(ply,k) then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply,"Finish Quest: "..k)
return
end
end
end
if cutta_quest_system:Quests_QuestRestrictionsCheck(questname) then
local restictionstable = cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerQuestRestrictionsTable(ply,questname)
local function restrictionplayer_f()
local playerfound = false
for k,v in pairs(restictionstable) do
for z,p in pairs(v) do
if cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestRestrictTo(ply,k,p) then
playerfound = true
end
end
end
if playerfound == false then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply,"You Can't Do This Quest")
end
return playerfound
end
if not restrictionplayer_f() then
return
end
end
if cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsRepeatable(questname,ply) then
local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname)

if questData and (questData.ResetMonth or questData.ResetDay or questData.ResetTime) then
if not cutta_quest_system:PlayerUserGroupAllowed(ply) then
local resetMonth = questData.ResetMonth or 0
local resetDay = questData.ResetDay or 0
local resetTimeStr = questData.ResetTime or "00:00"

local resetHour, resetMin = string.match(resetTimeStr, "(%d+):(%d+)")
resetHour = tonumber(resetHour) or 0
resetMin = tonumber(resetMin) or 0

local now = os.time()
local date = os.date("*t", now)

local checkDate = {
year = date.year,
month = date.month,
day = date.day,
hour = resetHour,
min = resetMin,
sec = 0
}

if resetMonth ~= 0 then checkDate.month = resetMonth end
if resetDay ~= 0 then checkDate.day = resetDay end

local resetTimestamp = os.time(checkDate)

-- Calculate Last Reset (when the quest became available)
local lastResetTimestamp = resetTimestamp
if resetTimestamp > now then
local prevDate = table.Copy(checkDate)
if resetMonth ~= 0 then
prevDate.year = prevDate.year - 1
elseif resetDay ~= 0 then
prevDate.month = prevDate.month - 1
if prevDate.month == 0 then
prevDate.month = 12
prevDate.year = prevDate.year - 1
end
else
prevDate.day = prevDate.day - 1
end
lastResetTimestamp = os.time(prevDate)
end

-- Calculate Next Reset (for display)
local nextResetTimestamp = resetTimestamp
if resetTimestamp <= now then
local nextDate = table.Copy(checkDate)
if resetMonth ~= 0 then
nextDate.year = nextDate.year + 1
elseif resetDay ~= 0 then
nextDate.month = nextDate.month + 1
if nextDate.month > 12 then
nextDate.month = 1
nextDate.year = nextDate.year + 1
end
else
nextDate.day = nextDate.day + 1
end
nextResetTimestamp = os.time(nextDate)
end

local lastComplete = ply.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes and ply.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes[questname] or 0

if lastComplete > lastResetTimestamp then
local timeDiff = nextResetTimestamp - now
local h = math.floor(timeDiff / 3600)
local m = math.floor((timeDiff % 3600) / 60)
local s = timeDiff % 60
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply, string.format("Quest is on cooldown. Resets in %02d:%02d:%02d", h, m, s))
return
end
end
elseif cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsColddown(questname) then
if !cutta_quest_system:PlayerUserGroupAllowed(ply) then
if cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerOnQuestColddown(ply,questname) then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply,questname.." Is On Colddown For "..tostring(cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerQuestColddownTime(ply,questname)))
return
end
end
end
else
if !cutta_quest_system:PlayerUserGroupAllowed(ply) then
if cutta_quest_system:Player_HasCompletedQuest(ply,questname) then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply,"Quest Completed, Not Repeatable")
return
end
end
end
end

if notallowed then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply,"Not Allowed To Do Quest")
return
end

local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname)
if not questData then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply,"Quest Does Not Exist")
return
end
if questData and questData.GlobalQuest == true then
if cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuest_RequestStart then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_RequestStart(ply, questname)
else
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply, "Global quests are not loaded on the server.")
end
return
end
--cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply,"Started Quest "..questname)
cutta_quest_system:Player_StartQuest_Vars(ply,questname)
if cutta_quest_system.QuestGiver_AssignSourceToQuest then
cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_AssignSourceToQuest(ply, questname)
end
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Player_PlayStartQuestSound(ply)

end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply, force)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerState(ply) then return end
if cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then
local currentObjNumb = cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_Number(ply)
local currentObjective = cutta_quest_system:Objective_Name(ply)
local isInstantObjective = (currentObjective == "soundcue" or currentObjective == "musiccue" or currentObjective == "stopmusiccue")
local bypassGuards = force and true or false

if currentObjNumb and currentObjNumb > 0 then
local lastAdvancedObj = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["LastAdvancedObjNumb"]) or nil
if (not bypassGuards) and lastAdvancedObj and lastAdvancedObj == currentObjNumb then
return
end

local setAt = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjectiveSetAt"]) or 0
if (not bypassGuards) and (not isInstantObjective) and setAt > 0 and (CurTime() - setAt) < 0.2 then
return
end

ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["LastAdvancedObjNumb"] = currentObjNumb
cutta_quest_system:PlayerVariableTransfer(ply)
end

local globalIdKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"
local globalId = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[globalIdKey] or nil
if globalId and cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuest_AdvanceOnce then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_AdvanceOnce(globalId, currentObjNumb)
return
end
cutta_quest_system:Player_ResetQuestObjective(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_AddNumber(ply)
timer.Simple(0,function()
if ply:IsValid() then
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective_Ext(ply)
end
end)

end
end

local globalIdKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"

# Installing Addons

Installs a new addon to your game.

1. Open the Addons_Menu .
1. Open one of the catagory tabs (tools, weapons).
1. Find the addon you want.
1. Hover your mouse over the addon and click the install box.

# Uninstalling Addons
Removes addons from your Addons folder & subscriptions.

1. Open the Addons Menu.
1. Open the Subscriptions tab.
1. Find the addon you want to delete.
1. Hover your mouse over the addon and click the uninstall box.

# Enabling Addons
Enables addons so Garry's Mod will load them into the current game.

1. Open the Addons Menu.
1. Open the Subscriptions tab.
1. Find the addon you want to enable.
1. Hover your mouse over the addon and click the enable box.

# Disabling Addons
Disables addons so Garry's Mod will not load them into the current game.

1. Open the Addons Menu.
1. Open the Subscriptions tab.
1. Find the addon you want to disable.
1. Hover your mouse over the addon and click the disable box.

function FS_ClientUI.GetFramePlayerData()
local frameNumber = FrameNumber()
local cachedFrameData = FS_ClientUI.FramePlayerData
if cachedFrameData and cachedFrameData.frameNumber == frameNumber then
return cachedFrameData
end

local localPlayer = LocalPlayer()
cachedFrameData = {
frameNumber = frameNumber,
player = localPlayer,
position = nil,
eyeYaw = 0,
focusEntity = nil
}

if IsValid(localPlayer) then
cachedFrameData.position = localPlayer:GetPos()
cachedFrameData.eyeYaw = localPlayer:EyeAngles().y
local eyeTrace = localPlayer:GetEyeTrace()
cachedFrameData.focusEntity = eyeTrace and eyeTrace.Entity or nil
end

FS_ClientUI.FramePlayerData = cachedFrameData
return cachedFrameData
end

function FS_ClientUI.GetEntityDrawContext(entity, maxDrawDistance, requireFocus)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return nil
end

local frameData = FS_ClientUI.GetFramePlayerData()
if not IsValid(frameData.player) or not frameData.position then
return nil
end

local drawDistance = maxDrawDistance or FS_DrawDistance
if drawDistance and drawDistance > 0 and frameData.position:DistToSqr(entity:GetPos()) > (drawDistance * drawDistance) then
return nil
end

if requireFocus and frameData.focusEntity ~= entity then
return nil
end

return frameData
end

local function getDecorColor(value)
if isfunction(value) then
return value()
end

return value or color_white
end

function FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(colorValue, alpha)
if not colorValue then
return Color(255, 255, 255, alpha)
end

return Color(colorValue.r, colorValue.g, colorValue.b, math.Clamp(math.floor((colorValue.a or 255) * (alpha / 255)), 0, 255))
end

function FS_ClientUI.GetDistanceFadeAlpha(worldPosition, maxDrawDistance, fadeStartDistance)
local frameData = FS_ClientUI.GetFramePlayerData()
if not IsValid(frameData.player) or not frameData.position then
return 0
end

local maxDistance = maxDrawDistance or FS_DrawDistance
if not maxDistance or maxDistance <= 0 then
return 255
end

local distanceSqr = frameData.position:DistToSqr(worldPosition)
if distanceSqr >= (maxDistance * maxDistance) then
return 0
end

local fadeStart = fadeStartDistance or FS_ClientUI.FadeStartDistance or 250
if maxDistance <= fadeStart or distanceSqr <= (fadeStart * fadeStart) then
return 255
end

local distance = math.sqrt(distanceSqr)
local fadeFraction = 1 - ((distance - fadeStart) / (maxDistance - fadeStart))
return math.Clamp(math.floor(fadeFraction * 255), 0, 255)
end

for _, part in ipairs(entity.fsHarvestDecorModels) do

function FS_ClientUI.DrawSeedHarvestDecor(entity, maxDrawDistance)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return false
end

if entity:GetDTInt(1) ~= 2 then
FS_ClientUI.ClearSeedHarvestDecor(entity)
return false
end

local frameData = FS_ClientUI.GetEntityDrawContext(entity, maxDrawDistance, false)
if not frameData then
return false
end

local meta = FS_ClientUI.GetSeedPatchMeta(entity)
local harvestDecor = meta and meta.harvestDecor
if not harvestDecor or #harvestDecor == 0 then
return false
end

if not entity.fsHarvestDecorModels or #entity.fsHarvestDecorModels ~= #harvestDecor then
FS_ClientUI.ClearSeedHarvestDecor(entity)
entity.fsHarvestDecorModels = {}
for index, decor in ipairs(harvestDecor) do

if not isstring(jobCommand) then

end

local candidateCommands = {}
if jobLevelsAddon and isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.GetPlayerJobCommand) then
candidateCommands[#candidateCommands + 1] = jobLevelsAddon:GetPlayerJobCommand(playerEntity)
end

if istable(RPExtraTeams) then
local jobTable = RPExtraTeams[playerEntity:Team()]
if istable(jobTable) then
candidateCommands[#candidateCommands + 1] = jobTable.command
end
end

if jobLevelsAddon and istable(jobLevelsAddon.NWKeys) then
candidateCommands[#candidateCommands + 1] = playerEntity:GetNWString(jobLevelsAddon.NWKeys.CurrentCommand, "")
end

candidateCommands[#candidateCommands + 1] = playerEntity:GetNWString("cutta_darkrp_job_levels_command", "")

for _, candidateCommand in ipairs(candidateCommands) do
local normalizedCommand = normalizeJobLevelsJobCommand(jobLevelsAddon, candidateCommand)
if normalizedCommand ~= "" then
return normalizedCommand
end
end

return ""
end

end

local candidateNames = {}

end

if team and team.GetName then

end

if jobLevelsAddon and istable(jobLevelsAddon.NWKeys) then
candidateNames[#candidateNames + 1] = playerEntity:GetNWString(jobLevelsAddon.NWKeys.CurrentJobName, "")
end

if jobCommand ~= "" and jobLevelsAddon and isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.GetJobNameFromCommand) then
candidateNames[#candidateNames + 1] = jobLevelsAddon:GetJobNameFromCommand(jobCommand)
end

for _, candidateName in ipairs(candidateNames) do

if normalizedName ~= "" then

end
end

end

local function prepareJobLevelsEntry(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity, jobCommand)
if not jobLevelsAddon or jobCommand == "" then

end

local entry = nil
if isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.GetJobEntry) then
entry = jobLevelsAddon:GetJobEntry(playerEntity, jobCommand, true)
end

if not istable(entry) and isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.TouchCurrentJobEntry) then
entry = jobLevelsAddon:TouchCurrentJobEntry(playerEntity)
end

if istable(entry) then
local jobName = getJobLevelsCurrentJobName(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity, jobCommand)
if jobName ~= "" then
entry.name = jobName
end
end

return entry
end

local function finishDirectJobLevelsAward(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity, jobCommand, xpAmount, reason, entry, levelsGained)
if isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.UpdateNetworkedState) then
jobLevelsAddon:UpdateNetworkedState(playerEntity)
end

if isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.SendXPGainNotification) then
jobLevelsAddon:SendXPGainNotification(playerEntity, xpAmount, entry, jobCommand)
end

if isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.SavePlayerData) then
jobLevelsAddon:SavePlayerData(playerEntity)
end

if levelsGained <= 0 then
return true
end

local jobName = tostring(entry and entry.name or "")
if jobName == "" and isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.GetJobNameFromCommand) then
jobName = tostring(jobLevelsAddon:GetJobNameFromCommand(jobCommand) or jobCommand)
end

playerEntity:PrintMessage(
HUD_PRINTTALK,
"[Job Levels] " .. tostring(jobName ~= "" and jobName or jobCommand) .. " is now level " .. tostring(entry.level)
)

hook.Run("CuttaDarkRPJobLevels_LevelUp", playerEntity, jobCommand, entry.level, levelsGained, reason)
return true
end

local function awardCropHarvestJobXPNow(playerEntity, totalXP, reason)
if not IsValid(playerEntity) or not playerEntity:IsPlayer() then
return false
end

local jobLevelsAddon = getJobLevelsAddon()
if not jobLevelsAddon then
return false
end

local jobCommand = getJobLevelsCurrentJobCommand(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity)
if jobCommand == "" then
return false
end

prepareJobLevelsEntry(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity, jobCommand)

if isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.AddJobXP) then
local grantedXP = jobLevelsAddon:AddJobXP(playerEntity, totalXP, reason, jobCommand)
if grantedXP then
return true
end
end

local entry = prepareJobLevelsEntry(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity, jobCommand)
if not istable(entry) then
return false
end

entry.level = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(entry.level) or 1))
entry.xp = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(entry.xp) or 0)) + totalXP
entry.totalxp = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(entry.totalxp) or 0)) + totalXP

if not isfunction(jobLevelsAddon.GetXPToLevel) then
return false
end

local levelsGained = 0
while entry.xp >= jobLevelsAddon:GetXPToLevel(entry.level) do
entry.xp = entry.xp - jobLevelsAddon:GetXPToLevel(entry.level)
entry.level = entry.level + 1
levelsGained = levelsGained + 1
end

return finishDirectJobLevelsAward(jobLevelsAddon, playerEntity, jobCommand, totalXP, reason, entry, levelsGained)
end

local function queueCropHarvestJobXP(playerEntity, totalXP, reason, attempt)
attempt = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(attempt) or 0), 0)
if attempt >= FS_Utils.CropHarvestXPAwardRetryCount then
return false

end

if DarkRP and DarkRP.createMoneyBag then

end

end

function FS_Utils.TryTakeMoney(player, amount)
if not IsValid(player) or not player:IsPlayer() then
return 0
end

local requestedAmount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0)
if requestedAmount <= 0 then
return 0
end

local availableMoney = FS_Utils.GetPlayerMoney(player)
if availableMoney <= 0 then
return 0
end

local takenAmount = math.min(availableMoney, requestedAmount)
FS_Utils.AddMoney(player, -takenAmount)

end

local function traceSeedSurfacePoint(seed, localPoint)
if not IsValid(seed) then
return nil
end

local startPosition = seed:LocalToWorld(localPoint + Vector(0, 0, surfaceTraceStartOffset))
local endPosition = startPosition + Vector(0, 0, -surfaceTraceDepth)

return util.TraceLine({

endpos = endPosition,
filter = seed,
mask = seedGroundTraceMask
})
end

local function traceSeedSurfaceHull(seed)
if not IsValid(seed) then
return nil
end

local collisionMins, collisionMaxs = seed:GetCollisionBounds()
local minX, maxX = getInsetAxisRange(collisionMins.x, collisionMaxs.x)
local minY, maxY = getInsetAxisRange(collisionMins.y, collisionMaxs.y)
local hullTopZ = math.min(collisionMins.z + surfaceHullHeight, collisionMaxs.z)
local startPosition = seed:GetPos() + Vector(0, 0, surfaceTraceStartOffset)
local endPosition = startPosition + Vector(0, 0, -surfaceTraceDepth)

return util.TraceHull({
start = startPosition,
endpos = endPosition,
mins = Vector(minX, minY, collisionMins.z),
maxs = Vector(maxX, maxY, hullTopZ),
filter = seed,
mask = seedGroundTraceMask
})
end

local function getSeedSurfaceSamplePoints(seed)
local collisionMins, collisionMaxs = seed:GetCollisionBounds()
local minX, maxX = getInsetAxisRange(collisionMins.x, collisionMaxs.x)
local minY, maxY = getInsetAxisRange(collisionMins.y, collisionMaxs.y)
local bottomZ = collisionMins.z

return {
Vector(0, 0, bottomZ),
Vector(minX, minY, bottomZ),
Vector(minX, maxY, bottomZ),
Vector(maxX, minY, bottomZ),
Vector(maxX, maxY, bottomZ)
}
end

local function getSeedGroundTrace(seed)
local fallbackTrace = nil
local hullTrace = traceSeedSurfaceHull(seed)
if hullTrace and hullTrace.Hit then
fallbackTrace = hullTrace
if FS_Utils.IsPlantableTrace(hullTrace) then
return hullTrace
end
end

for _, localPoint in ipairs(getSeedSurfaceSamplePoints(seed)) do
local trace = traceSeedSurfacePoint(seed, localPoint)
if trace and trace.Hit then
fallbackTrace = fallbackTrace or trace
if FS_Utils.IsPlantableTrace(trace) then
return trace
end
end
end

return fallbackTrace
end

local function canPlayerSeeUsePoint(player, entity, usePoint)
if not IsValid(player) or not IsValid(entity) or not isvector(usePoint) then
return false
end

local traceFilter = {player, entity}
local parentEntity = entity:GetParent()
if IsValid(parentEntity) then
table.insert(traceFilter, parentEntity)
end

local dirtPatch = entity.fsDirtPatch
if IsValid(dirtPatch) and dirtPatch ~= parentEntity then
table.insert(traceFilter, dirtPatch)
end

local visibilityTrace = util.TraceLine({
start = player:EyePos(),
endpos = usePoint,
filter = traceFilter,
mask = MASK_SOLID
})

if not visibilityTrace.Hit then

end

local function getPlayerFarmUseTarget(player)
if not IsValid(player) or not player:IsPlayer() then
return nil, false, nil
end

local eyeTrace = getPlayerUseTrace(player)
local useDistance = math.max(tonumber(FS_Use_Distance) or 0, 24)
local useDistanceSqr = useDistance * useDistance
local eyePos = player:EyePos()
local aimVector = player:GetAimVector()
local bestEntity = nil
local bestScore = nil

local function considerEntity(entity, prioritizeEyeTrace)
if not isFarmUseCandidate(entity) then
return
end

if player:GetPos():DistToSqr(entity:GetPos()) > useDistanceSqr then
return
end

local entityAnchor = getEntityUseAnchor(entity)
if not isvector(entityAnchor) then
return
end

local alongAim = (entityAnchor - eyePos):Dot(aimVector)
if alongAim < 0 or alongAim > useDistance then
return
end

local closestAimPoint = eyePos + (aimVector * alongAim)
local usePoint = getEntityUsePoint(entity, closestAimPoint)
if not isvector(usePoint) then
return
end

local useTolerance = math.max(tonumber(entity.fsUseNearestPointTolerance) or 24, 24) + manualUseLineTolerancePadding
local lineDistanceSqr = usePoint:DistToSqr(closestAimPoint)
if lineDistanceSqr > (useTolerance * useTolerance) then
return
end

if not canPlayerSeeUsePoint(player, entity, usePoint) then
return
end

local score = lineDistanceSqr + alongAim
if prioritizeEyeTrace then
score = score - (useDistance * useDistance)
end

if not bestScore or score < bestScore then
bestEntity = entity
bestScore = score
end
end

if eyeTrace and IsValid(eyeTrace.Entity) then
considerEntity(eyeTrace.Entity, true)
end

for _, entity in ipairs(ents.FindInSphere(player:GetPos(), useDistance + manualUseFallbackSearchPadding)) do
if not (eyeTrace and entity == eyeTrace.Entity) then
considerEntity(entity, false)
end
end

return bestEntity, eyeTrace and bestEntity == eyeTrace.Entity or false, eyeTrace
end

if variationPercent <= 0 then

end

local variationAmount = roundedBaseTime * variationPercent
local randomizedTime = math.Round(math.Rand(roundedBaseTime - variationAmount, roundedBaseTime + variationAmount))
return math.max(randomizedTime, 1)
end

local function normalizeFertilizerTarget(entity)
if not IsValid(entity) then
