end

local className = entity:GetClass() or ""
if className == "fs_dirt_patch" then
return entity
end

if string.StartWith(className, "fs_") and string.EndsWith(className, "_seeds") then
if IsValid(entity.fsDirtPatch) then
return entity.fsDirtPatch
end

return entity
end

return nil
end

local function getFertilizerTargetScore(origin, entity)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return nil
end

local nearestPoint = entity.NearestPoint and entity:NearestPoint(origin) or entity:GetPos()
local offset = nearestPoint - origin
local horizontalDistanceSqr = (offset.x * offset.x) + (offset.y * offset.y)
if horizontalDistanceSqr > (FS_Utils.FertilizerSearchRadius * FS_Utils.FertilizerSearchRadius) then
return nil
end

if math.abs(offset.z) > FS_Utils.FertilizerVerticalTolerance then
return nil
end

return horizontalDistanceSqr + (offset.z * offset.z)
end

function FS_Utils.GetFertilizerTarget(fertilizer)
if not IsValid(fertilizer) then
return nil
end

local origin = fertilizer:GetPos()
local trace = util.TraceLine({
start = origin,
endpos = origin + Vector(0, 0, -FS_Utils.FertilizerTraceDepth),
filter = fertilizer,
mask = MASK_SOLID
})

local traceTarget = normalizeFertilizerTarget(trace.Entity)
if IsValid(traceTarget) then
return traceTarget
end

local bestTarget = nil
local bestScore = nil
local seenTargets = {}

for _, entity in ipairs(ents.FindInSphere(origin, FS_Utils.FertilizerSearchRadius)) do
if entity == fertilizer then
continue
end

local normalizedTarget = normalizeFertilizerTarget(entity)
if not IsValid(normalizedTarget) then
continue
end

local targetIndex = normalizedTarget:EntIndex()
if seenTargets[targetIndex] then
continue
end
seenTargets[targetIndex] = true

local targetScore = getFertilizerTargetScore(origin, normalizedTarget)
if targetScore and (not bestScore or targetScore < bestScore) then
bestTarget = normalizedTarget
bestScore = targetScore
end
end

return bestTarget
end

function FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizerToSeed(seed)
if not FS_Utils.IsSeedEntity(seed) then
return 4
end

if seed:GetDTBool(4) then
return 3
end

local state = seed:GetDTInt(1)
if state ~= 1 then
return 2
end

local remainingTime = math.max(seed:GetDTInt(2), 1)
seed:SetDTInt(2, math.max(math.ceil(remainingTime * 0.5), 1))
seed:SetDTBool(4, true)
seed.fsNextStageUpdate = CurTime() + FS_Utils.SlowThinkInterval
return 1
end

function FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizerToDirtPatch(dirtPatch)
if not FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(dirtPatch) then
return 4
end

local eligibleSeeds = {}
local hasSeed = false
local hasUnfertilizedSeed = false

for _, seed in pairs(dirtPatch.fsSeedSlots or {}) do
if IsValid(seed) and seed.fsDirtPatch == dirtPatch then
hasSeed = true
if not seed:GetDTBool(4) then
hasUnfertilizedSeed = true
end

local state = seed:GetDTInt(1)
if not seed:GetDTBool(4) and state == 1 then
table.insert(eligibleSeeds, seed)
end
end
end

if #eligibleSeeds > 0 then
for _, seed in ipairs(eligibleSeeds) do
FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizerToSeed(seed)
end
return 1, #eligibleSeeds
end

if hasSeed and hasUnfertilizedSeed then
return 2, 0
end

if hasSeed then
return 3, 0
end

return 4, 0
end

function FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizer(target)
if FS_Utils.IsSeedEntity(target) then
local result = FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizerToSeed(target)
return result, result == 1 and 1 or 0
end

if FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(target) then
return FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizerToDirtPatch(target)
end

return 4, 0
end

function FS_Utils.HarvestSeed(seed, activator, options)
local config = FS_Utils.GetSeedLifecycleConfig(seed)
if not config or seed:GetDTInt(1) ~= 2 then
return false
end

options = options or {}
local dirtPatch = seed.fsDirtPatch

local harvestCount = FS_Utils.GetSeedHarvestAmount(seed)
if harvestCount <= 0 then
return false
end

local basePosition = select(1, FS_Utils.GetSeedWorldTransform(seed)) or seed:GetPos()
local spawnOrigin = basePosition + Vector(0, 0, 24)
local groundDropBudget = math.max(FS_Utils.MaxGroundHarvestDrops - FS_Utils.CountGroundHarvestDrops(), 0)
local forceAutoCollect = options.forceAutoCollect == true

for index = 1, harvestCount do
local childSpawnPosition = spawnOrigin + Vector(math.Rand(-8, 8), math.Rand(-8, 8), index * 2)
local childAngles = config.produceAngles and config.produceAngles(seed, index) or Angle(0, math.random(0, 360), 0)
if forceAutoCollect and config.autoHarvest and config.autoHarvest(seed, activator, index, childSpawnPosition, childAngles, options) then
continue
end

if forceAutoCollect and config.produceClass and FS_Utils.TryAutoCollectHarvestItem(activator, config.produceClass) then
continue
end

if config.produceClass and groundDropBudget <= 0 and FS_Utils.TryAutoCollectHarvestItem(activator, config.produceClass) then
continue
end

local itemDefinition = config.produceClass and getHarvestInventoryItemData(config.produceClass) or nil
local worldDropClass = itemDefinition and itemDefinition.worldDropClass or config.produceClass
local shouldUseInventoryDrop = not (itemDefinition and itemDefinition.spawnWorldEntity == true)
local child = config.produceSpawner and config.produceSpawner(seed, childSpawnPosition, index, activator)
if not IsValid(child) and config.produceClass and shouldUseInventoryDrop then
child = FS_Utils.SpawnHarvestInventoryDrop(config.produceClass, childSpawnPosition, childAngles)
end
if not IsValid(child) and worldDropClass then
child = ents.Create(worldDropClass)
end
if IsValid(child) then
child:SetAngles(childAngles)

function FS_Utils.HandleSeedUse(seed, activator)
if not IsValid(seed) or not IsValid(activator) then
return false
end

local currentTime = CurTime()
if seed.nextUse and currentTime < seed.nextUse then
return false
end

if not FS_Utils.CanPlayerUseEntity(activator, seed) then
return false
end

local state = seed:GetDTInt(1)
local handled = false
if state == 0 and seed:GetDTBool(3) then
handled = FS_Utils.StartSeedGrowth(seed)
elseif state == 2 then
handled = FS_Utils.HarvestSeed(seed, activator)
end

if handled then
seed.nextUse = currentTime + 0.5
end

return handled
end

function FS_Utils.RunSeedLifecycle(seed)
local state = seed:GetDTInt(1)

if state == 0 then
seed:SetDTBool(3, FS_Utils.IsSeedPlantable(seed))
else
seed:SetDTBool(3, false)
end

if not IsValid(seed.fsDirtPatch)
and not (seed.IsPlayerHolding and seed:IsPlayerHolding())
and (state == 0 or state == 1) then
FS_Utils.WakeNearbyDirtPatches(seed:GetPos())
end

if state ~= 0 and (not seed.fsNextStageUpdate or CurTime() >= seed.fsNextStageUpdate) then
if state == 1 then
if seed:GetDTInt(2) > 0 then
seed:SetDTInt(2, seed:GetDTInt(2) - 1)
elseif seed:GetDTInt(2) == 0 then
FS_Utils.MakeSeedReadyToHarvest(seed)
end
end

seed.fsNextStageUpdate = CurTime() + FS_Utils.SlowThinkInterval
end

seed:NextThink(CurTime() + FS_Utils.GetSeedThinkDelay(seed:GetDTInt(1)))
return true
end

function FS_Utils.IsPlantableTrace(trace, seed)
if not trace or not trace.Hit or trace.HitSky or trace.HitNormal.z < 0.55 then
return false
end

local hitEntity = trace.Entity
if isPlantableEntity(hitEntity) then
if not IsValid(seed) or not hitEntity.CanAcceptSeed then
return true
end

return hitEntity:CanAcceptSeed(seed)
end

if IsValid(hitEntity) and not trace.HitWorld then
return false
end

if trace.HitNoDraw then
return false
end

if isPlantableTextureName(trace.HitTexture) then
return true
end

if isPlantableTextureName(getTraceSurfacePropName(trace)) then
return true
end

if plantableMaterialTypes[trace.MatType] then
return true
end

return false
end

function FS_Utils.GetTouchingWorldTexture(seed)
local trace = getSeedGroundTrace(seed)
if not trace then
return "", nil
end

local textureName = trace.HitTexture or ""
if textureName == "" and isPlantableEntity(trace.Entity) then
textureName = trace.Entity:GetClass()
end
if textureName == "" then
textureName = getTraceSurfacePropName(trace)
end

return textureName, trace
end

function FS_Utils.IsSeedPlantable(seed)
if not IsValid(seed) then
return false
end

local _, trace = FS_Utils.GetTouchingWorldTexture(seed)
if not trace then
return false
end

return FS_Utils.IsPlantableTrace(trace, seed)
end

function FS_Utils.WakeNearbyDirtPatches(origin, radius)
if not isvector(origin) then
return 0
end
local wakeRadius = math.max(tonumber(radius) or FS_Utils.DirtPatchWakeRadius or 144, 1)
local wokenPatchCount = 0
for _, entity in ipairs(ents.FindInSphere(origin, wakeRadius)) do
if FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) and entity.RequestManagementCheck then
entity:RequestManagementCheck(true)
wokenPatchCount = wokenPatchCount + 1
end
end

return wokenPatchCount
end

function FS_Utils.WakeOwnedAutoFarms(ownerOrIdentifier, origin, radius)
local ownerIdentifier = isstring(ownerOrIdentifier) and ownerOrIdentifier or getPlayerIdentifier(ownerOrIdentifier)
if ownerIdentifier == "" then
return 0
end

local ownedAutoFarms = ownedAutoFarmsByOwnerId[ownerIdentifier]
if not ownedAutoFarms then
for _, entity in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("fs_auto_farm")) do
if IsValid(entity) and entity:GetNWString("FSOwnerSteamID64", "") == ownerIdentifier then
registerOwnedAutoFarm(entity, ownerIdentifier)
end
end
ownedAutoFarms = ownedAutoFarmsByOwnerId[ownerIdentifier]
if not ownedAutoFarms then
return 0
end
end

local wakeRadius = math.max(tonumber(radius) or tonumber(FS_AutoFarm_LinkRange) or 384, 1)
local wakeRadiusSqr = wakeRadius * wakeRadius
local shouldCheckDistance = isvector(origin)
local wokenAutoFarmCount = 0
for entityIndex, entity in pairs(ownedAutoFarms) do
if IsValid(entity) then
if entity.RequestAutomationCheck and (not shouldCheckDistance or entity:GetPos():DistToSqr(origin) <= wakeRadiusSqr) then
registerOwnedAutoFarm(entity, ownerIdentifier)
entity:RequestAutomationCheck(true)
wokenAutoFarmCount = wokenAutoFarmCount + 1
end
else
ownedAutoFarms[entityIndex] = nil
end
end

if not next(ownedAutoFarms) then
ownedAutoFarmsByOwnerId[ownerIdentifier] = nil
end

return wokenAutoFarmCount
end

function FS_Utils.ProcessOwnedAutoFarmsForPatch(dirtPatch)
if not FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(dirtPatch) then
return 0
end

local ownerIdentifier = dirtPatch:GetNWString("FSOwnerSteamID64", "")
if ownerIdentifier == "" then
return 0
end

local autoFarmCandidates = FS_Utils.GetOwnedAutoFarms(ownerIdentifier)
if #autoFarmCandidates <= 0 then
for _, entity in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("fs_auto_farm")) do
if IsValid(entity) and entity:GetNWString("FSOwnerSteamID64", "") == ownerIdentifier then
registerOwnedAutoFarm(entity, ownerIdentifier)
autoFarmCandidates[#autoFarmCandidates + 1] = entity
end
end
end

local linkRange = math.max(tonumber(FS_AutoFarm_LinkRange) or 384, 1)
local linkRangeSqr = linkRange * linkRange
local dirtPatchPosition = dirtPatch:GetPos()
local processedAutoFarmCount = 0
for _, autoFarm in ipairs(autoFarmCandidates) do
if IsValid(autoFarm)
and autoFarm.GetNWBool
and autoFarm.ProcessAutomationCycle
and autoFarm:GetNWBool("FSAutoFarmActive", false)
and autoFarm:GetPos():DistToSqr(dirtPatchPosition) <= linkRangeSqr then
autoFarm:ProcessAutomationCycle()
processedAutoFarmCount = processedAutoFarmCount + 1
end
end

if processedAutoFarmCount <= 0 then
FS_Utils.WakeOwnedAutoFarms(ownerIdentifier, dirtPatchPosition, linkRange)
end

return processedAutoFarmCount
end

function FS_Utils.RegisterTrackedDamageEntity(entity)
local maxHealth, regenAmount = FS_Utils.GetDamageProfile(entity)
if not maxHealth then
return false
end

local currentHealth = entity:Health()
entity.fsDamageMaxHealth = maxHealth
entity.fsDamageRegenAmount = regenAmount
entity:SetMaxHealth(maxHealth)
if currentHealth <= 0 or currentHealth > maxHealth or not entity.fsDamageTrackingRegistered then
entity:SetHealth(maxHealth)
else
entity:SetHealth(currentHealth)
end

trackedDamageEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = entity
if entity.fsDamageNextRegenAt and entity:Health() > 0 and entity:Health() < maxHealth then
damageRegenEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = entity
else
damageRegenEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = nil
end
if FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) and (entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove or entity.fsDirtPatchHeld or entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil) then
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = entity
end
if not entity.fsDamageTrackingRegistered then
entity.fsDamageTrackingRegistered = true
entity:CallOnRemove("fs_damage_track_" .. entity:EntIndex(), function(removedEntity)
local entityIndex = removedEntity:EntIndex()
trackedDamageEntities[entityIndex] = nil
damageRegenEntities[entityIndex] = nil
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entityIndex] = nil
end)
end

return true
end

function FS_Utils.StopPhysicsMotion(entity)
local physicsObject = getPhysicsObject(entity)
if not physicsObject then
return false
end

if physicsObject.SetVelocityInstantaneous then
physicsObject:SetVelocityInstantaneous(zeroVector)
else
physicsObject:SetVelocity(zeroVector)
end

if physicsObject.GetAngleVelocity and physicsObject.AddAngleVelocity then
local angleVelocity = physicsObject:GetAngleVelocity()
if angleVelocity then
physicsObject:AddAngleVelocity(angleVelocity * -1)
end
end

return true
end

function FS_Utils.SetDirtPatchCarryState(entity, canMove)
if not FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) then
return false
end

entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove = canMove == true
FS_Utils.SetPhysicsMotion(entity, entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove)
if not entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove then
FS_Utils.StopPhysicsMotion(entity)
end
if entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove or entity.fsDirtPatchHeld or entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil then
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = entity
else
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = nil
end
if entity.RequestManagementCheck then
entity:RequestManagementCheck(true)
end
if not entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove then
FS_Utils.WakeOwnedAutoFarms(entity:GetNWString("FSOwnerSteamID64", ""), entity:GetPos())
end

return true
end

function FS_Utils.PrimeDirtPatchForCarry(entity)
if not FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) then
return false
end

entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil = CurTime() + 0.1
return FS_Utils.SetDirtPatchCarryState(entity, true)
end

function FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchReadyToFreeze(entity)
if not FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) then
return false
end

local physicsObject = FS_Utils.GetPhysicsObject(entity)
if not physicsObject then
return false
end

local velocity = physicsObject:GetVelocity()
if velocity:LengthSqr() > (FS_Utils.DirtPatchFreezeSpeedThreshold * FS_Utils.DirtPatchFreezeSpeedThreshold) then
return false
end

local angleVelocity = physicsObject:GetAngleVelocity()
if angleVelocity:LengthSqr() > (FS_Utils.DirtPatchFreezeAngleSpeedThreshold * FS_Utils.DirtPatchFreezeAngleSpeedThreshold) then
return false
end

if entity:GetUp().z < FS_Utils.DirtPatchFreezeFlatNormalThreshold then
return false
end

local mins, maxs = entity:OBBMins(), entity:OBBMaxs()
local trace = util.TraceHull({
start = entity:GetPos() + Vector(0, 0, 4),
endpos = entity:GetPos() + Vector(0, 0, -10),
mins = Vector(mins.x * 0.7, mins.y * 0.7, mins.z),
maxs = Vector(maxs.x * 0.7, maxs.y * 0.7, math.min(mins.z + 4, maxs.z)),
filter = entity,
mask = MASK_SOLID
})

return trace.Hit and not trace.HitSky and trace.HitNormal.z >= FS_Utils.DirtPatchFreezeFlatNormalThreshold
end

function FS_Utils.UpdateDirtPatchCarryState(entity, currentTime)
if not FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) then
return
end

if entity.fsDirtPatchHeld then
return
end

if entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil and currentTime < entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil then
return
end

if entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove and not FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchReadyToFreeze(entity) then
return
end

entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil = nil
if entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove then
FS_Utils.SetDirtPatchCarryState(entity, false)
end
if entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove or entity.fsDirtPatchHeld or entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil then
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = entity
else
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = nil
end
end

function FS_Utils.ApplyTrackedDamage(entity, dmginfo)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return false
end

if not entity.fsDamageMaxHealth then
if not FS_Utils.RegisterTrackedDamageEntity(entity) then
return false
end
end

if entity.TakePhysicsDamage then
entity:TakePhysicsDamage(dmginfo)
end

local damageAmount = math.max(math.ceil(dmginfo:GetDamage()), 0)
if damageAmount <= 0 then
return true
end

entity:SetHealth(math.max(entity:Health() - damageAmount, 0))
entity.fsDamageNextRegenAt = CurTime() + FS_Utils.DamageRegenDelay
damageRegenEntities[entity:EntIndex()] = entity
if entity:Health() > 0 then
return true
end

if FS_Utils.IsSeedEntity(entity) then
return FS_Utils.DestroySeed(entity)
end

if FS_Utils.IsDirtPatchEntity(entity) then
return FS_Utils.DestroyDirtPatch(entity)
end

if FS_Utils.IsAutoFarmEntity(entity) then
return FS_Utils.DestroyAutoFarm(entity)
end

return true
end

function FS_Utils.TickTrackedDamageRegen(currentTime)
for entityIndex, entity in pairs(damageRegenEntities) do
if not IsValid(entity) then
damageRegenEntities[entityIndex] = nil
elseif not entity.fsDamageMaxHealth
or not entity.fsDamageRegenAmount
or entity:Health() <= 0
or entity:Health() >= entity.fsDamageMaxHealth
or not entity.fsDamageNextRegenAt then
damageRegenEntities[entityIndex] = nil
else
if currentTime >= entity.fsDamageNextRegenAt then
entity:SetHealth(math.min(entity:Health() + entity.fsDamageRegenAmount, entity.fsDamageMaxHealth))
if entity:Health() < entity.fsDamageMaxHealth then
entity.fsDamageNextRegenAt = currentTime + FS_Utils.DamageRegenInterval
else
entity.fsDamageNextRegenAt = nil
damageRegenEntities[entityIndex] = nil
end
end
end
end
end

function FS_Utils.TickDirtPatchCarryEntities(currentTime)
for entityIndex, entity in pairs(dirtPatchCarryEntities) do
if not IsValid(entity) then
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entityIndex] = nil
else
FS_Utils.UpdateDirtPatchCarryState(entity, currentTime)
if not entity.fsDirtPatchCanMove and not entity.fsDirtPatchHeld and not entity.fsDirtPatchCarryPrimedUntil then
dirtPatchCarryEntities[entityIndex] = nil
end
end
end
end

function FS_Utils.TickTrackedDamageEntities(currentTime, shouldProcessRegen)
FS_Utils.TickDirtPatchCarryEntities(currentTime)
if shouldProcessRegen then
FS_Utils.TickTrackedDamageRegen(currentTime)
end
end

end

state = seed:GetDTInt(1)
end

if state == 1 then

end

return state == 2
end

end

concommand.Add("fs_finish_patch_growth", function(playerEntity)

end

return
end

local dirtPatch = resolveLookedAtDirtPatch(playerEntity)

return
end

local finishedCount = 0
local alreadyReadyCount = 0

for _, seed in pairs(dirtPatch.fsSeedSlots or {}) do

local function formatMoney(amount)
return "$" .. string.Comma(math.max(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0))
end

local function applyAlpha(colorValue, alpha)
if FS_ClientUI and FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha then
return FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(colorValue, alpha)
end

return Color(colorValue.r, colorValue.g, colorValue.b, math.Clamp(alpha, 0, 255))
end

local function getAutoFarmDrawDistance()
local drawDistance = math.max(FS_DrawDistance or 256, 320)
return drawDistance, drawDistance * drawDistance
end

local function getAutoFarmFadeAlpha(localPlayerPosition, worldPosition, drawDistance)
local drawDistanceSqr = drawDistance * drawDistance
local distanceSqr = localPlayerPosition:DistToSqr(worldPosition)
if distanceSqr >= drawDistanceSqr then
return 0
end

local fadeStart = FS_ClientUI and FS_ClientUI.FadeStartDistance or 250
if drawDistance <= fadeStart or distanceSqr <= (fadeStart * fadeStart) then
return 255
end

local distance = math.sqrt(distanceSqr)
local fadeFraction = 1 - ((distance - fadeStart) / (drawDistance - fadeStart))
return math.Clamp(math.floor(fadeFraction * 255), 0, 255)
end

local function ensureAutoFarmOverlayBounds(entity)
if entity.fsAutoFarmTextOffset then
return entity.fsAutoFarmTextOffset
end

local mins, maxs = entity:GetModelBounds()
entity.fsAutoFarmTextOffset = Vector(0, 0, maxs.z + 20)
entity:SetRenderBounds(mins - Vector(16, 16, 0), maxs + Vector(16, 16, 96))
return entity.fsAutoFarmTextOffset
end

local maxFertilizer = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(FS_AutoFarm_MaxFertilizer) or 25), 0)
if overlayCache.storedMoney ~= storedMoney or overlayCache.maxStoredMoney ~= maxStoredMoney then
overlayCache.storedMoney = storedMoney
overlayCache.maxStoredMoney = maxStoredMoney
overlayCache.storedMoneyText = "Stored: " .. formatMoney(storedMoney) .. " / " .. formatMoney(maxStoredMoney)
end

if overlayCache.fertilizerStock ~= fertilizerStock or overlayCache.maxFertilizer ~= maxFertilizer then
overlayCache.fertilizerStock = fertilizerStock
overlayCache.maxFertilizer = maxFertilizer
overlayCache.fertilizerText = "Fertilizer: " .. fertilizerStock .. " / " .. maxFertilizer
end

if overlayCache.linkedPatches ~= linkedPatches or overlayCache.statusText ~= statusText then
overlayCache.linkedPatches = linkedPatches
overlayCache.statusText = statusText
overlayCache.statusLineText = "Patches: " .. linkedPatches .. " Status: " .. statusText
end

if overlayCache.ownerName ~= ownerName then
overlayCache.ownerName = ownerName
overlayCache.ownerNameText = ownerName
end

return overlayCache
end

local function canEntityBeManaged(entity)
return IsValid(entity) and entity:GetClass() == "fs_auto_farm"
end

local function getLinkedPatchEntities(state)
local linkedEntities = {}
if not state or not istable(state.linkedPatchEntIndices) then
return linkedEntities
end

for _, entIndex in ipairs(state.linkedPatchEntIndices) do
local dirtPatch = Entity(math.floor(tonumber(entIndex) or -1))
if IsValid(dirtPatch) and dirtPatch:GetClass() == "fs_dirt_patch" then
linkedEntities[#linkedEntities + 1] = dirtPatch
end
end

return linkedEntities
end

local function getAutoFarmSuppressionKey(entity)
if not canEntityBeManaged(entity) then
return -1
end

return entity:EntIndex()
end

local function suppressAutoFarmOpen(entity, duration)
local suppressionKey = getAutoFarmSuppressionKey(entity)
if suppressionKey < 0 then
return
end

autoFarmOpenSuppressionByEntity[suppressionKey] = CurTime() + math.max(tonumber(duration) or autoFarmCloseCooldown, 0)
end

local function isAutoFarmOpenSuppressed(entity)
local suppressionKey = getAutoFarmSuppressionKey(entity)
if suppressionKey < 0 then
return false
end

local suppressionUntil = autoFarmOpenSuppressionByEntity[suppressionKey] or 0
if suppressionUntil <= CurTime() then
autoFarmOpenSuppressionByEntity[suppressionKey] = nil
return false
end

return true
end

local function buildSeedStateSignature(seedList)
if not istable(seedList) or #seedList == 0 then
return ""
end

local signatureParts = {}
for index, seedData in ipairs(seedList) do
signatureParts[index] = string.format("%s:%s:%s", tostring(seedData.class or ""), tostring(seedData.selected == true), tostring(math.floor(tonumber(seedData.price) or 0)))
end

return table.concat(signatureParts, "|")
end

local function sendAction(entity, actionName, payload)
if not canEntityBeManaged(entity) then
return
end

net.Start(actionMessageName)
net.WriteEntity(entity)
net.WriteString(actionName)
if actionName == "deposit" then
net.WriteUInt(math.max(math.floor(tonumber(payload) or 0), 0), 17)
elseif actionName == "buy_fertilizer" then
net.WriteUInt(math.max(math.floor(tonumber(payload) or 0), 0), 6)
elseif actionName == "toggle_seed" then
net.WriteString(tostring(payload or ""))
end
net.SendToServer()
end

local function getStatusColor(state)
if not state then
return palette.warning
end

if state.active and state.inRange and (state.linkedPatches or 0) > 0 then
return palette.success
end

if state.active then
return palette.warning
end

return palette.accent
end

if IsValid(dirtPatch) then
linkedPatchEntIndices[#linkedPatchEntIndices + 1] = dirtPatch:EntIndex()
end
end

local stateData = {

maxMoney = getAutoFarmMaxStoredMoney(),
treeMoney = self:GetHarvestedTreeMoney(),

}

for _, seedDefinition in ipairs(FS_Utils.GetAutoFarmSeedCatalog()) do
stateData.seeds[#stateData.seeds + 1] = {

function ENT:DepositFromPlayer(playerEntity, amount)
local remainingCapacity = math.max(getAutoFarmMaxStoredMoney() - self:GetStoredMoney(), 0)
if remainingCapacity <= 0 then
return 0
end

local requestedAmount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0)
if requestedAmount <= 0 then
return 0
end

local depositedAmount = FS_Utils.TryTakeMoney(playerEntity, math.min(requestedAmount, remainingCapacity))
if depositedAmount <= 0 then
return 0
end

self:SetStoredMoney(self:GetStoredMoney() + depositedAmount)
self:EmitSound("items/ammo_pickup.wav", 60, 110)
return depositedAmount
end

function ENT:CollectHarvestedTreeMoney(playerEntity)
if not IsValid(playerEntity) or not playerEntity:IsPlayer() then
return 0
end

local harvestedTreeMoney = self:GetHarvestedTreeMoney()
if harvestedTreeMoney <= 0 then
return 0
end

FS_Utils.AddMoney(playerEntity, harvestedTreeMoney)
self:SetHarvestedTreeMoney(0)
self:EmitSound("items/ammo_pickup.wav", 60, 100)
return harvestedTreeMoney
end

function ENT:WithdrawStoredMoney(playerEntity)
if not IsValid(playerEntity) or not playerEntity:IsPlayer() then
return 0
end

local storedMoney = self:GetStoredMoney()
if storedMoney <= 0 then
return 0
end

FS_Utils.AddMoney(playerEntity, storedMoney)
self:SetStoredMoney(0)
self:EmitSound("items/ammo_pickup.wav", 60, 105)
return storedMoney
end

function ENT:PurchaseFertilizerFromPlayer(playerEntity, requestedCount)
local remainingCapacity = math.max(getAutoFarmMaxFertilizer() - self:GetFertilizerStock(), 0)
if remainingCapacity <= 0 then
return 0
end

local requestedAmount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(requestedCount) or 0), 0)
local isMaxRequest = requestedAmount <= 0
local fertilizerCount = isMaxRequest and remainingCapacity or math.min(requestedAmount, remainingCapacity)
if fertilizerCount <= 0 then
return 0
end

local fertilizerPrice = getAutoFarmFertilizerPrice()
if fertilizerPrice > 0 then
local availableMoney = FS_Utils.GetPlayerMoney(playerEntity)
if availableMoney <= 0 then
return 0
end

if isMaxRequest then
fertilizerCount = math.min(fertilizerCount, math.floor(availableMoney / fertilizerPrice))
elseif availableMoney < (fertilizerCount * fertilizerPrice) then
return 0
end

if fertilizerCount <= 0 then
return 0
end

local takenAmount = FS_Utils.TryTakeMoney(playerEntity, fertilizerCount * fertilizerPrice)
fertilizerCount = math.floor(takenAmount / fertilizerPrice)
if fertilizerCount <= 0 then
return 0
end
end

self:SetFertilizerStock(self:GetFertilizerStock() + fertilizerCount)
self:EmitSound("items/ammo_pickup.wav", 60, 120)
return fertilizerCount
end

function ENT:RefundStoredMoney()
if self.fsRefundedMoney then
return 0
end

local storedMoney = self:GetStoredMoney()
local harvestedTreeMoney = self:GetHarvestedTreeMoney()
if storedMoney <= 0 and harvestedTreeMoney <= 0 then
return 0
end

-- Drop the seed-purchase budget and the uncollected money-tree balance separately.
local moneyEntity = storedMoney > 0 and FS_Utils.SpawnWorldMoney(self:GetPos() + (self:GetUp() * 24) + (self:GetRight() * 10), storedMoney) or nil
local harvestedMoneyEntity = harvestedTreeMoney > 0 and FS_Utils.SpawnWorldMoney(self:GetPos() + (self:GetUp() * 24) - (self:GetRight() * 10), harvestedTreeMoney) or nil
self.fsRefundedMoney = true
self:SetStoredMoney(0)
self:SetHarvestedTreeMoney(0)
if IsValid(moneyEntity) then
FS_Utils.SetPhysicsMotion(moneyEntity, true, (self:GetUp() * 36) + (VectorRand() * 18))
end
if IsValid(harvestedMoneyEntity) then
FS_Utils.SetPhysicsMotion(harvestedMoneyEntity, true, (self:GetUp() * 36) + (VectorRand() * 18))
end
return storedMoney + harvestedTreeMoney
end

function ENT:PickSeedDefinitionForPurchase()
local selectedSeeds = self:GetSelectedSeedDefinitions()
if #selectedSeeds <= 0 then
return nil, 0
end

local startIndex = ((self.fsSeedPurchaseCursor or 0) % #selectedSeeds) + 1
for offset = 0, #selectedSeeds - 1 do
local currentIndex = ((startIndex + offset - 1) % #selectedSeeds) + 1
local seedDefinition = selectedSeeds[currentIndex]
local seedPrice = FS_Utils.GetAutoFarmSeedPrice(seedDefinition.Class) or 0
if seedPrice <= self:GetStoredMoney() then
self.fsSeedPurchaseCursor = currentIndex
return seedDefinition, seedPrice
end
end

return nil, 0
end

function ENT:TryPlantSeedOnPatch(dirtPatch, owner, openSlotIndex)
if not IsValid(dirtPatch) or not dirtPatch.AssignSeedToSlot then
return false
end

local seedDefinition, seedPrice = self:PickSeedDefinitionForPurchase()
if not seedDefinition or seedPrice > self:GetStoredMoney() then
return false
end

local seedEntity = ents.Create(seedDefinition.Class)
if not IsValid(seedEntity) then
return false
end

local slotPosition = dirtPatch:GetSlotWorldPosition(openSlotIndex)
seedEntity:SetPos(slotPosition + Vector(0, 0, 24))
seedEntity:SetAngles(Angle(0, dirtPatch:GetAngles().y, 0))
seedEntity:Spawn()
seedEntity:Activate()
FS_Utils.SetEntityOwner(seedEntity, owner)

if not IsValid(seedEntity) or not dirtPatch:AssignSeedToSlot(seedEntity, openSlotIndex) then
if IsValid(seedEntity) then
seedEntity:Remove()
end
return false
end

self:SetStoredMoney(self:GetStoredMoney() - seedPrice)
self:EmitSound("physics/wood/wood_box_impact_hard3.wav", 55, 115)
return true
end

function ENT:TryFertilizePatch(dirtPatch)
if not self:IsAutoFertilizerEnabled() or self:GetFertilizerStock() <= 0 then
return false
end

if not IsValid(dirtPatch) or not FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizerToDirtPatch then
return false
end

local fertilizerResult = FS_Utils.ApplyFertilizerToDirtPatch(dirtPatch)
if fertilizerResult ~= 1 then
return false
end

self:SetFertilizerStock(self:GetFertilizerStock() - 1)
self:EmitSound("physics/cardboard/cardboard_box_break3.wav", 55, 120)
return true
end

function ENT:HarvestPatch(dirtPatch, owner)
local harvestedAnything = false

for _, seedEntity in pairs(dirtPatch.fsSeedSlots or {}) do
if IsValid(seedEntity) and seedEntity:GetDTInt(1) == 2 then
if FS_Utils.HarvestSeed(seedEntity, owner, { forceAutoCollect = true, autoFarm = self }) then
harvestedAnything = true
end
end
end

return harvestedAnything
end

function ENT:PlantPatch(dirtPatch, owner)
local plantedAnything = false

while IsValid(dirtPatch) do
local openSlotIndex = dirtPatch:GetOpenSlotIndex()
if not openSlotIndex then
break
end

if not self:TryPlantSeedOnPatch(dirtPatch, owner, openSlotIndex) then
break
end

plantedAnything = true
end

return plantedAnything
end

function ENT:RunAutomation(owner, linkedPatches)
for _, dirtPatch in ipairs(linkedPatches) do
if IsValid(dirtPatch) then
self:HarvestPatch(dirtPatch, owner)
end
end

for _, dirtPatch in ipairs(linkedPatches) do
if IsValid(dirtPatch) then
self:PlantPatch(dirtPatch, owner)
end
end

if self:IsAutoFertilizerEnabled() and self:GetFertilizerStock() > 0 then
for _, dirtPatch in ipairs(linkedPatches) do
if self:GetFertilizerStock() <= 0 then
break
end

if IsValid(dirtPatch) then
self:TryFertilizePatch(dirtPatch)
end
end
end
end

function ENT:Use(activator)
if not IsValid(activator) or not activator:IsPlayer() then
return
end

if not FS_Utils.CanPlayerUseEntity(activator, self) then
return
end

local owner = self:ResolveOwner()
if not IsValid(owner) then
owner = self:ClaimOwner(activator)
end

if not FS_Utils.EntityBelongsToPlayer(self, activator) then
return
end

if not self:CanPlayerOpenMenu(activator) then
return
end

self:SendState(activator, true)
end

function ENT:ProcessAutomationCycle()
if self.fsAutomationProcessing then
return false
end

self.fsAutomationProcessing = true

if not self:IsActive() then
self.fsAutomationProcessing = nil
self:StopAutomationTimer()
self:RefreshRuntimeState(true)
return false
end

local owner, linkedPatches = self:RefreshRuntimeState(true)
if not IsValid(owner) or #linkedPatches <= 0 then
self.fsAutomationProcessing = nil
self:StopAutomationTimer()
return false
end

local actionablePatches = self:GetActionableLinkedPatches(linkedPatches)
if #actionablePatches <= 0 then
self.fsAutomationProcessing = nil
self:StopAutomationTimer()
self:SyncRuntimeState(owner, linkedPatches)
return false
end

self:RunAutomation(owner, actionablePatches)
self:SyncRuntimeState(owner, self.fsLinkedPatches)

if #self:GetActionableLinkedPatches(self.fsLinkedPatches) <= 0 then
self.fsAutomationProcessing = nil
self:StopAutomationTimer()
return false
end

self.fsAutomationProcessing = nil
return true
end

self.nextS = CurTime() + FS_Utils.SlowThinkInterval;

function spawnSalesmanPos(ply, cmd, args)

if not IsValid(self) or self:GetDTBool(0) then

physicsObject:EnableMotion(true);

end;
end)

function ENT:Think()
if (FS_Rot_System) then
if (!self.nextS or CurTime() >= self.nextS) then
if (self.timer > 0) then
self.timer = self.timer - 1;
end;
if (self.timer <= 0) then
self:VisualEffect();
end;
self.nextS = CurTime() + FS_Utils.SlowThinkInterval;
end;
end;

local curTime = CurTime();
if (!self.nextUse or curTime >= self.nextUse) then
if FS_Utils.CanPlayerUseEntity(activator, self) then
if !activator:KeyDown(IN_SPEED) then
if FS_Hunger_Enabled then
if (GAMEMODE.Version == "2.4.3") then
activator:SetSelfDarkRPVar("Energy", math.Clamp(activator:getDarkRPVar("Energy")+FS_Tomato_Hunger, 0, 100));
else
activator:setSelfDarkRPVar("Energy", math.Clamp(activator:getDarkRPVar("Energy")+FS_Tomato_Hunger, 0, 100));
end;
end;
activator:SetHealth(math.Clamp(activator:Health()+FS_Tomato_Health, 0, 100));
self:EmitSound("npc/barnacle/barnacle_crunch"..math.random(2, 3)..".wav");
self:VisualEffect();
self.nextUse = curTime + 0.5;

Based on the code snippets you provided, here is a summary of the **Farm System** implementation. This includes the entity definitions, initialization logic, and sales mechanics.

### 1. Entity Definitions
The system uses a specific model named `box01a.mdl` for all seeds. This model is shared across different entities (Tomato, Watermelon, etc.).

* **Entity Types:**
* `fs_apple_seeds`
* `fs_baby_seeds`
* `fs_banana_seeds`
* `fs_cabbage_seeds`
* `fs_lemon_seeds`
* `fs_melon_seeds`
* `fs_money_seeds`
* `fs_orange_seeds`
* `fs_potato_seeds`
* `fs_tomato_seeds`
* `fs_watermelon_seeds`
* `fs_fertilizer`
* `fs_dirt_patch`
* `fs_auto_farm`
* `fs_box`

### 2. Initialization Logic (`cl_init.lua`)
Each entity file contains specific initialization steps:
1. **Model Setup:** Sets the model to `models/props_lab/box01a.mdl`.
2. **Physics:** Initializes the entity with `SOLID_VPHYSICS` (solid physics).
3. **Movement:** Sets the move type to `MOVETYPE_VPHYSICS`.
4. **Mass:** Assigns a mass of `105` to the entity.
5. **State:** Sets default values for `DTInt` (time) and `DTBool` (active status).
* *Note:* The `Timer` logic is handled separately in the `Think` function within the `Initialize` method.

### 3. Sales Mechanics (`fs_salesman.lua`)
This file handles the "Sell" action. It is triggered when the player reaches the maximum amount of a specific seed.

**Key Logic:**
* **Trigger:** The `Think` function checks `self.nextUse`. If the current time is greater than or equal to `self.nextUse`, the entity thinks and attempts to sell.
* **Condition:** The entity only sells if the player does not press the `S` key (to prevent spamming) and if the player is not in a `FS_Salesman_Enabled` state.
* **Calculation:**
* It calculates the price based on the seed type (`FS_Salesman_Selling_Seed`).
* It adds the calculated amount to `totalAmount`.
* It adds the money to the player's inventory (`AddMoney`).
* **UI Display:**
* Shows "You got [Amount] [Seed Name]".
* Shows the price in `Color(25,255,25)` (Yellow).
* Shows the count in `Color(255,255,255)` (White).
* **Special Case (Orange):** If the player has 1 item, it displays "Orange" instead of the price.
* **Special Case (Max Hold):** If the player has 2 or more items, it displays "Oranges" or "Watermelons" instead of the price.
* **Sound:** Uses specific sound files (`/npc/barnacle/barnacle_crunch.wav`) to indicate successful pickup.
* **Cleanup:** Removes the entity from the world after selling.

### 4. Price System
Prices are defined in the `Farm System - Entities.txt` file:
* **Prices:**
* Apple Seeds: `FS_Apple_Seed_Price`
* Baby Seeds: `FS_Baby_Seed_Price`
* Banana Seeds: `FS_Banana_Seed_Price`
* Cabbage Seeds: `FS_Cabbage_Seed_Price`
* Lemon Seeds: `FS_Lemon_Seed_Price`
* Melon Seeds: `FS_Melon_Seed_Price`
* Money Trees: `FS_Money_Seed_Price`
* Orange Seeds: `FS_Orange_Seed_Price`
* Potato Seeds: `FS_Potato_Seed_Price`
* Tomato Seeds: `FS_Tomato_Seed_Price`
* Watermelon Seeds: `FS_Watermelon_Seed_Price`
* Fertilizer: `FS_Fertilizer_Price`
* Farm Patch: `FS_FarmPatch_Price`
* Auto Farm Crate: `FS_AutoFarm_Price`
* Box: `FS_Box_Price`

### 5. Usage Example
To start the system, run the following commands in the game console:
```lua
-- Spawn a salesman for Tomato Seeds
```

How do I design a complex inventory or economy system in Garry's Mod Lua?

Use a server-owned state model.

Recommended structure
- Store player state in a plain Lua table keyed by SteamID64.
- Use item definitions for static metadata and a separate inventory table for per-player state.
- Validate every purchase, item use, and transfer on the server.
- Save the authoritative state periodically and on disconnect or shutdown.
- Send compact snapshots or diffs to clients for UI.

Avoid
- Storing the real inventory only on the client.
- Trusting net messages to contain valid prices or item counts.
- Mixing UI code directly into persistence logic.

This same pattern works for currencies, skill trees, housing ownership, loadouts, quest progress, and crafting systems.

local function CuttaCosmetic_GetHotloadItemEntries()
local entries = {}
local items = cutta_cosmetic_shop.NormalizeArrayTable
and cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeArrayTable(cutta_cosmetic_shop["Items"] or {})
or (cutta_cosmetic_shop["Items"] or {})

for _, item in ipairs(items) do
if istable(item) then
local workshopID = tostring(item.WorkshopID or cutta_cosmetic_shop:ExtractWorkshopID(item.WorkshopLink or "") or "")
local workshopLink = string.Trim(tostring(item.WorkshopLink or ""))

if workshopID ~= "" or workshopLink ~= "" then
if workshopLink == "" and workshopID ~= "" then
workshopLink = cutta_cosmetic_shop:BuildWorkshopLink(workshopID)
end

entries[#entries + 1] = {
ItemID = tostring(item.ID or ""),
ItemName = tostring(item.Name or item.ID or workshopID),
WorkshopID = workshopID,
WorkshopLink = workshopLink,
ItemType = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_TYPE_CHECK(item.ID) or "Unknown"
}
end
end
end

table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
if a.ItemName == b.ItemName then
return string.lower(tostring(a.WorkshopLink or a.WorkshopID or "")) < string.lower(tostring(b.WorkshopLink or b.WorkshopID or ""))
end

return string.lower(tostring(a.ItemName or "")) < string.lower(tostring(b.ItemName or ""))
end)

return entries
end

if istable(cutta_cosmetic_shop["WorkshopModelLookupTitleCache"]) then
workshopTitle = string.Trim(tostring(cutta_cosmetic_shop["WorkshopModelLookupTitleCache"][workshopID] or ""))

return CacheWorkshopTitle(workshopID, workshopTitle)
end
end

if istable(cutta_cosmetic_shop["WorkshopSoundLookupTitleCache"]) then
workshopTitle = string.Trim(tostring(cutta_cosmetic_shop["WorkshopSoundLookupTitleCache"][workshopID] or ""))
if workshopTitle ~= "" then

local function GetManualWorkshopLabel(entry, fallbackIndex)
if not istable(entry) then
return "Manual Link " .. tostring(fallbackIndex or "")
end

local workshopTitle = string.Trim(tostring(entry.WorkshopTitle or GetCachedWorkshopTitle(entry.WorkshopID) or ""))
if workshopTitle ~= "" then
return workshopTitle
end

local workshopID = tostring(entry.WorkshopID or "")
if workshopID ~= "" then
return "Workshop Addon " .. workshopID
end

return "Manual Link " .. tostring(fallbackIndex or "")
end

local function ResolveWorkshopTitle(workshopID, onComplete)
workshopID = tostring(workshopID or "")
if workshopID == "" then
if isfunction(onComplete) then
onComplete("")
end
return
end

local cachedTitle = GetCachedWorkshopTitle(workshopID)
if cachedTitle ~= "" then
if isfunction(onComplete) then
onComplete(cachedTitle)
end
return
end

if not steamworks or not isfunction(steamworks.FileInfo) then
if isfunction(onComplete) then
onComplete("")
end
return
end

steamworks.FileInfo(workshopID, function(result)
local workshopTitle = string.Trim(tostring(result and result.title or ""))
if workshopTitle ~= "" then
CacheWorkshopTitle(workshopID, workshopTitle)
end

if isfunction(onComplete) then
onComplete(workshopTitle)
end
end)
end

local function PersistHotloadConfig(successMessage)

cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"] or {}

net.SendToServer()

if successMessage and cutta_ui_library and isfunction(cutta_ui_library.Create_Notification) then
cutta_ui_library:Create_Notification(successMessage, "SUCCESS")
end

return true
end

local function HasManualWorkshopLink(workshopID)
workshopID = tostring(workshopID or "")
if workshopID == "" then return false end

for _, entry in ipairs(cutta_cosmetic_shop:GetManualWorkshopLinkEntries()) do
if tostring(entry.WorkshopID or "") == workshopID then
return true
end
end

return false
end

local function PersistManualWorkshopTitle(workshopID, workshopTitle)
workshopID = tostring(workshopID or "")
workshopTitle = string.Trim(tostring(workshopTitle or ""))
if workshopID == "" or workshopTitle == "" then return false end

local nextEntries = table.Copy(cutta_cosmetic_shop:GetManualWorkshopLinkEntries())
local changed = false

for index, entry in ipairs(nextEntries) do
if tostring(entry.WorkshopID or "") == workshopID then
if string.Trim(tostring(entry.WorkshopTitle or "")) ~= workshopTitle then
entry.WorkshopTitle = workshopTitle
nextEntries[index] = entry
changed = true
end
break
end
end

if not changed then return false end

cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"] or {}
cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"]["ManualWorkshopLinks"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeManualWorkshopLinkEntries(nextEntries)
PersistHotloadConfig()
return true
end

local function AddManualWorkshopLink(workshopID, workshopLink, successMessage, workshopTitle)
if not canManageManualLinks then return false end

workshopID = tostring(workshopID or "")
workshopLink = string.Trim(tostring(workshopLink or ""))
workshopTitle = string.Trim(tostring(workshopTitle or GetCachedWorkshopTitle(workshopID) or ""))

if workshopID == "" then
cutta_ui_library:Create_Notification("Enter a valid workshop URL or numeric ID.", "ERROR")
return false
end

if HasManualWorkshopLink(workshopID) then
cutta_ui_library:Create_Notification("That workshop link is already in the manual list.", "INFO")
return false
end

cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"] or {}
local nextEntries = table.Copy(cutta_cosmetic_shop:GetManualWorkshopLinkEntries())
nextEntries[#nextEntries + 1] = {
WorkshopID = workshopID,
WorkshopLink = workshopLink ~= "" and workshopLink or cutta_cosmetic_shop:BuildWorkshopLink(workshopID),
WorkshopTitle = workshopTitle ~= "" and workshopTitle or nil,
AutoMountOnJoin = false
}

cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"]["ManualWorkshopLinks"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeManualWorkshopLinkEntries(nextEntries)
PersistHotloadConfig(successMessage or "Added manual workshop hotload link.")
if isfunction(RebuildHotloadPanel) then
RebuildHotloadPanel()
end
return true
end

return started
end

How does prediction work in Garry's Mod Lua, and how do I avoid duplicated effects or logic?

Prediction means some gameplay code runs on both client and server so controls feel responsive.

Rules
- Keep authoritative game state on the server.
- Expect some weapon and movement code to run more than once.
- Use IsFirstTimePredicted for client-only visual or audio side effects.
- Do not duplicate server-only state mutations on the client.
- Separate visual feedback from secure gameplay logic.

Good uses for predicted client code
- View kick, muzzle flash, local animation cues, and temporary UI feedback.

Good uses for server code
- Damage, ammo correction, cooldown authority, inventory changes, and persistence.

If an effect appears twice or a sound plays twice, prediction is usually the first place to inspect.

How should I build larger VGUI interfaces in Garry's Mod without making them messy?

Treat VGUI as a view layer.

Good rules
- Keep panel creation separate from data fetching and validation.
- Build reusable panel classes instead of one giant frame function.
- Have the UI render client-side copies of state, not the authoritative server state itself.
- Use hooks or explicit refresh functions when network data changes.
- Keep layout, styling, and interaction callbacks readable and localized.

For large menus, split panels into purpose-built widgets such as item rows, category tabs, stat cards, and confirmation dialogs. Server logic should never depend on a button existing on the client.

return IsValid(trace.Entity) and trace.Entity == ent

local distanceSqr = ply:EyePos():DistToSqr(labelPos)
if distanceSqr > CIS_MERCHANT_LABEL_DISTANCE_SQR then return end

local distance = math.sqrt(distanceSqr)
local alpha = CIS_GetMerchantLabelAlpha(distance)

if CIS_PlayerLookingAtMerchant(ent, ply) then

alpha = math.max(alpha, 230)

end

if alpha <= 0 then return end

local textAlpha = math.Clamp(math.floor(alpha * 1.35), 0, 255)
if CIS_PlayerLookingAtMerchant(ent, ply) then

textAlpha = 255

end

local drawAngle = CIS_GetMerchantBillboardAngle(ply)

cam.End3D2D()

In Garry's Mod Lua, what does CLuaLocomotion:Approach do?

Moves the NextBot incrementally closer to the provided goal location.

Each time this function is called, the NextBot moves towards the goal position passed as an argument by the amount previously set by CLuaLocomotion:SetDesiredSpeed .

To achieve smooth movement, this function must be called frequently.
This is commonly accomplished by calling it in the ENTITY:Think hook.

Realms
- Server

Arguments
- goal: Vector. The vector we want to get to.
- goalWeight: number. How influential the movement should be, in case of this function being called multiple times in between physical movements of the entity.

If unsure then set this to `1`.

Example

A NextBot follows `Player 1` & shoots `Player 2` (if applicable). The NextBot doesn't require a navmesh .

Notice that `Approach` is in the ENTITY:Think hook while functions for controlling the bot's animation & orientation are in the NEXTBOT:RunBehaviour hook.

local function normalizeLanguageKey(lang)
if not isstring(lang) then return DefaultLanguage end

local lowered = string.lower(string.Trim(lang))
if lowered == "" then return DefaultLanguage end

local aliased = LanguageAliases[lowered]
if aliased then
if Languages[aliased] then return aliased end
return aliased
end

for short, _ in pairs(Languages) do
if string.lower(short) == lowered then
return short
end
end

local prefix = string.match(lowered, "^([a-z][a-z])[-_].+") or lowered
aliased = LanguageAliases[prefix]
if aliased then
if Languages[aliased] then return aliased end
return aliased
end

for short, _ in pairs(Languages) do
local shortLower = string.lower(short)
if shortLower == prefix or string.sub(shortLower, 1, 2) == prefix then
return short
end
end

return DefaultLanguage
end

return DefaultLanguage

local function getTranslationsForLanguage(short)
local normalized = normalizeLanguageKey(short)
local selected = Translations[normalized]
if istable(selected) then return selected end

local fallback = Translations[DefaultLanguage]
if istable(fallback) then return fallback end

return {}
end

local function applyLegacyLanguageTable(language)
table.Empty(LanguageTable)
local selected = getTranslationsForLanguage(language)
for key, value in pairs(selected) do
LanguageTable[key] = value
end
end

local function translateGetForLanguage(language, id)
if id == nil then return "" end
if not isstring(id) then id = tostring(id) end
if id == "" then return "" end

local selected = getTranslationsForLanguage(language)
if selected[id] ~= nil then
return tostring(selected[id])
end

local fallback = getTranslationsForLanguage(DefaultLanguage)
if fallback[id] ~= nil then
return tostring(fallback[id])
end

return "@" .. id .. "@"
end

local function translateFormatForLanguage(language, id, ...)
local formatString = translateGetForLanguage(language, id)
if select("#", ...) < 1 then return formatString end
if not isstring(formatString) or formatString == "" then return "" end
if not string.find(formatString, "%%[-+# 0]*[%d%.%*]*[cdeEfgGiouXxqs]") then return formatString end

local output = string.gsub(formatString, "%%%%", "\1")
for index = 1, select("#", ...) do
local value = tostring(select(index, ...))
output = string.gsub(output, "%%[-+# 0]*[%d%.%*]*[cdeEfgGiouXxqs]", value, 1)
end
output = string.gsub(output, "\1", "%%")
return output
end

Translate["AddLanguage"] = function(short, long)
if not isstring(short) then return end
short = string.Trim(short)
if short == "" then return end

if not isstring(long) then
long = tostring(long or short)
end

Languages[short] = long
Translations[short] = Translations[short] or {}
AddingLanguage = short
end

Translate["AddTranslation"] = function(id, text)
if id == nil then return end
if text == nil then return end
if not isstring(id) then id = tostring(id) end
if not isstring(text) then text = tostring(text) end
if not AddingLanguage or not istable(Translations[AddingLanguage]) then return end

Translations[AddingLanguage][id] = text
end

local function loadLanguages()
table.Empty(Languages)
table.Empty(Translations)
AddingLanguage = nil

local files = file.Find("cutta_quest_system/languages/*.lua", "LUA")
local connectSafeMode = cutta_quest_system and cutta_quest_system["ConnectSafeMode"] == true or false
local shipAllLanguages = cutta_quest_system and cutta_quest_system["ConnectSafeShipAllLanguages"] == true or false
table.sort(files, function(a, b)
a = tostring(a or "")
b = tostring(b or "")
if a == "english.lua" then return true end
if b == "english.lua" then return false end
return a < b
end)

for _, filename in ipairs(files or {}) do
if connectSafeMode and not shipAllLanguages and filename ~= "english.lua" then
continue
end

local path = "cutta_quest_system/languages/" .. filename
if SERVER then
AddCSLuaFile(path)
end

AddingLanguage = nil
table.Empty(LanguageTable)
include(path)
if isstring(AddingLanguage) and AddingLanguage ~= "" then
for key, value in pairs(LanguageTable) do
Translate["AddTranslation"](key, value)
end
else
print("[CuttaQS] Translation file missing AddLanguage call: " .. tostring(path))
table.Empty(LanguageTable)
end
end

table.Empty(LanguageTable)

if not Languages[DefaultLanguage] then
local firstKey = next(Languages)
if firstKey then
DefaultLanguage = firstKey
end
end

if not Languages[ActiveLanguage] then
ActiveLanguage = DefaultLanguage
end
applyLegacyLanguageTable(ActiveLanguage)

if CLIENT then
hook.Run("CuttaQS_LanguageLoaded", ActiveLanguage)
end

local translatedCount = 0
local activeTranslations = getTranslationsForLanguage(ActiveLanguage)
local defaultTranslations = getTranslationsForLanguage(DefaultLanguage)
for key, value in pairs(activeTranslations) do
if defaultTranslations[key] ~= nil and tostring(value) ~= tostring(defaultTranslations[key]) then
translatedCount = translatedCount + 1
end
end

print("[CuttaQS] Loaded translations: " .. tostring(table.Count(Languages)) .. " languages | active=" .. tostring(ActiveLanguage) .. " | translated_keys=" .. tostring(translatedCount))
if connectSafeMode and not shipAllLanguages then
print("[CuttaQS] ConnectSafeMode active: loading English translations only.")
end
end

In Garry's Mod Lua, what does cam.Start3D do?

Sets up a new 3D rendering context. Must be finished by cam.End3D .

For more advanced settings such as an orthographic view, use cam.Start instead, which this is an alias of basically.

All parameters are optional, and fall back parameters that of the "current" or "last" render operation.

Negative x/y values won't work.

This will not update current view properties.

Realms
- Client

Arguments
- pos: Vector. Render cam position.
- angles: Angle. Render cam angles.
- fov: number. Field of view.
- x: number. X coordinate of where to start the new view port.
- y: number. Y coordinate of where to start the new view port.
- w: number. Width of the new viewport.
- h: number. Height of the new viewport.
- zNear: number. Distance to near clipping plane.
Both `zNear` and `zFar` need a value before any of them work.

zNear also requires a value higher than 0.
- zFar: number. Distance to far clipping plane.

Notes
- Both `zNear` and `zFar` need a value before any of them work.

zNear also requires a value higher than 0.

Example

# Addons

Mods for Garry's Mod are called `Addons` and can
add various new content to your game such as:

- **Vehicles**
- **Weapons**
- **Models**
- **Tools**
- **NPCs**

## Installation

Addons can be downloaded from the Steam Workshop through the Addons_Menu ,
located in the Main Menu , or through the Steam Workshop website itself, which is
also accessible from the Steam Client.

Addons can also be downloaded from 3rd party websites in the form of a folder,
which then needs to be placed into your `garrysmod/addons/` folder manually.

Example

```lua
-- These are forward declarations while useful, are not needed for bitwise operations.
local band = bit.band
local bor = bit.bor
local lshift = bit.lshift
local rshift = bit.rshift

-- Packing the RGBA value
local function rgb_to_hex(r,g,b, a)
a = a or 255
return bor(lshift(r, 24), lshift(g, 16), lshift(b, 8), a)
end

-- Unpacking the RGBA value
local function hex_to_rgb(hex)
return rshift(hex, 24), rshift(band(hex, 0x00ff0000), 16), rshift(band(hex, 0x0000ff00), 8), band(hex, 0x000000ff)
end
```

local CuttaCosmetic_BulkStateQueue = CuttaCosmetic_BulkStateQueue or {}
local bulkApplyTimerName = "CuttaCosmetic_BulkStateApply"
local bulkApplyInterval = 1
local bulkApplyPerTick = 1
local maxBulkApplyRetries = 120
local nearbyCosmeticStateDistanceSqr = 800 * 800

local EnsureBulkStateTimer

local function BuildReceivedCosmeticsStateSignature(data, equippedModelID, equippedModelPath)
return util.TableToJSON({
Props = istable(data) and data or {},
EquippedModelID = tostring(equippedModelID or ""),
EquippedModelPath = tostring(equippedModelPath or "")
})
end

local function HasCharacterPropApplyMismatch(ply, data)
if not IsValid(ply) then return true end

local savedProps = istable(data) and data or {}
local attachedProps = ply.Cutta_AttachedProps or {}

for cosmeticID, ent in pairs(attachedProps) do
local propData = savedProps[cosmeticID]
if not istable(propData) or propData.added ~= true or not IsValid(ent) then
return true
end
end

for cosmeticID, propData in pairs(savedProps) do
if istable(propData) and propData.added == true and not IsValid(attachedProps[cosmeticID]) then
return true
end
end

return false
end

local function ApplyCosmeticsStateToPlayer(ply, data, equippedModelID, equippedModelPath)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end

local nextProps = istable(data) and data or {}
local nextEquippedModelID = equippedModelID ~= "" and equippedModelID or nil
local nextEquippedModelPath = equippedModelPath ~= "" and equippedModelPath or nil
local stateSignature = BuildReceivedCosmeticsStateSignature(nextProps, nextEquippedModelID or "", nextEquippedModelPath or "")
local shouldSkipApply = isstring(stateSignature)
and stateSignature ~= ""
and ply.CuttaCosmetic_LastAppliedStateSignature == stateSignature
and not HasCharacterPropApplyMismatch(ply, nextProps)

ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"] = nextProps
ply.CuttaCosmetics_EquippedModelID = nextEquippedModelID
ply.CuttaCosmetics_EquippedModelPath = nextEquippedModelPath

if isfunction(cutta_cosmetic_shop.TryWorkshopDownloadForPlayer)
and cutta_cosmetic_shop.Client_WorkshopAutoDownloadEnabled
and cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_WorkshopAutoDownloadEnabled() then
local localPly = LocalPlayer()
if IsValid(localPly) then
if ply == localPly then
cutta_cosmetic_shop:TryWorkshopDownloadForPlayer(ply, false)
elseif localPly:GetPos():DistToSqr(ply:GetPos()) <= nearbyCosmeticStateDistanceSqr then
cutta_cosmetic_shop:TryWorkshopDownloadForPlayer(ply, false)
end
end
end

if shouldSkipApply then
return
end

ply.CuttaCosmetic_LastAppliedStateSignature = stateSignature

local function ProcessBulkStateQueue()
if #CuttaCosmetic_BulkStateQueue == 0 then
timer.Remove(bulkApplyTimerName)
return
end

local processed = 0
while processed < bulkApplyPerTick and #CuttaCosmetic_BulkStateQueue > 0 do
local entry = table.remove(CuttaCosmetic_BulkStateQueue, 1)
if entry then
local ply = Entity(tonumber(entry.EntIndex) or -1)
if IsValid(ply) and ply:IsPlayer() then
ApplyCosmeticsStateToPlayer(
ply,
entry.Props,
entry.EquippedModelID or "",
entry.EquippedModelPath or ""
)
processed = processed + 1
else
entry.Retries = (tonumber(entry.Retries) or 0) + 1
if entry.Retries < maxBulkApplyRetries then
CuttaCosmetic_BulkStateQueue[#CuttaCosmetic_BulkStateQueue + 1] = entry
end
end
end
end

if #CuttaCosmetic_BulkStateQueue == 0 then
timer.Remove(bulkApplyTimerName)
end
end

EnsureBulkStateTimer = function()
if timer.Exists(bulkApplyTimerName) then return end
timer.Create(bulkApplyTimerName, bulkApplyInterval, 0, ProcessBulkStateQueue)
end

local CuttaCosmetic_AnimLoopState = CuttaCosmetic_AnimLoopState or {}

local function CuttaCosmetic_SetLocalZoomForPlayer(ply)
if ply ~= LocalPlayer() then return end
LocalPlayer().CuttaCosmetic_AnimZoomActive = true
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_StopLoopForPlayer(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
local key = ply:EntIndex()
CuttaCosmetic_AnimLoopState[key] = nil
if ply == LocalPlayer() then
ply.CuttaCosmetic_AnimZoomActive = nil
end
if ply.AnimResetGestureSlot then
pcall(function() ply:AnimResetGestureSlot(GESTURE_SLOT_CUSTOM) end)
else
pcall(function() ply:ResetSequenceInfo() end)
end
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_PlayLoopStep(ply, state)
if not IsValid(ply) or not state then return false end
local seq = state.seq
if not seq or seq < 0 then return false end

if ply.AddVCDSequenceToGestureSlot then
ply:AddVCDSequenceToGestureSlot(GESTURE_SLOT_CUSTOM, seq, 0)
if ply.SetLayerPlaybackRate then
pcall(function() ply:SetLayerPlaybackRate(GESTURE_SLOT_CUSTOM, 1) end)
end
else
ply:ResetSequence(seq)
ply:SetPlaybackRate(1)
end

local dur = ply:SequenceDuration(seq) or 0.5
if dur <= 0 then dur = 0.5 end
state.nextPlay = CurTime() + math.max(dur * 0.95, 0.08)
CuttaCosmetic_SetLocalZoomForPlayer(ply)
return true
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_FindSequence(ply, animString)
if not IsValid(ply) then return nil end
local seq = ply:LookupSequence(animString)
if seq and seq >= 0 then return seq end

local findNeedle = string.lower(animString or "")
for i = 0, math.max((ply:GetSequenceCount() or 0) - 1, -1) do
local sname = ply:GetSequenceName(i)
if sname and string.find(string.lower(sname), findNeedle, 1, true) then
return i
end
end
return nil
end

local function CuttaCosmetic_StartLocalAnimationLoop(ply, seq, animString)
if not IsValid(ply) or not seq or seq < 0 then return false end

local key = ply:EntIndex()
CuttaCosmetic_AnimLoopState[key] = {
ply = ply,
seq = seq,
animString = animString,
nextPlay = 0
}
CuttaCosmetic_PlayLoopStep(ply, CuttaCosmetic_AnimLoopState[key])
return true
end

net.Receive("CuttaCosmetic_PlayAnimation_Local", function()
local ply = net.ReadEntity()
local animString = net.ReadString()
if not IsValid(ply) or not isstring(animString) or animString == "" then return end

local function tryStartLoop()
local seq = CuttaCosmetic_FindSequence(ply, animString)
if not seq then return false end

return CuttaCosmetic_StartLocalAnimationLoop(ply, seq, animString)
end

tryStartLoop()
end)

hook.Add("Think", "CuttaCosmetic_AnimationLoopThink", function()
local now = CurTime()
for key, state in pairs(CuttaCosmetic_AnimLoopState) do
local ply = state.ply
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:Alive() then
if ply == LocalPlayer() then
ply.CuttaCosmetic_AnimZoomActive = nil
end
CuttaCosmetic_AnimLoopState[key] = nil
continue
end

-- Stop looping as soon as movement starts.
local vel = ply:GetVelocity()
local moving = vel:Length2DSqr() > 64 or math.abs(vel.z) > 20
if moving then
CuttaCosmetic_StopLoopForPlayer(ply)
continue
end

if now >= (state.nextPlay or 0) then
if not CuttaCosmetic_PlayLoopStep(ply, state) then
CuttaCosmetic_StopLoopForPlayer(ply)
end
end
end
end)

Show an example of how to use Concepts - BaseClasses in Garry's Mod Lua.

Example

The following example demonstrates how an Entity can be used as a Base Class for multiple Child Entities.

The Parent Class (`sent_parentclass.lua`) handles all of the logic for setting up the Entity's model and physics, as well as the logic behind the Entity's unique behavior. In this case, the unique behavior is that some arbitrary visual effect is enabled before the entity draws and is disabled after it draws. In the Parent Class, this visual effect simply turns the Entity blue.

Because the Child Classes (`sent_childclass_1.lua` and `sent_childclass_2.lua`) retain the logic of their Base Class (`sent_parentclass.lua`), they only need to include a very small amount of code to create different visual effects.

`sent_childclass_1.lua` overrides the function to enable the visual effect and replaces the Parent Class's blue color effect with a rainbow color effect.
`sent_childclass_2.lua` overrides both the enable and disable functions of the visual effect. They are replaced by functions that make the Entity (Which now looks like a tire) appear to always be rolling, even when stationary.
```lua
AddCSLuaFile()

-- All Entities must have a Base Class.
-- In this case, the "base_anim" Class is being used.
-- This is one of the default Entity Classes available in Garry's Mod.
DEFINE_BASECLASS( "base_anim" )

ENT.PrintName = "Parent Class"
ENT.Category = "BaseClass Example"
ENT.RenderGroup = RENDERGROUP_TRANSLUCENT
ENT.Spawnable = true

-- This variable exists to demonstrate that a Base Class provides both
-- functions and variables to their children.
-- This is a regular-width crate model.
ENT.ModelToSpawnWith = "models/props_junk/wood_crate001a_damaged.mdl"

-- Set up the Entity
function ENT:Initialize()
if SERVER then
self:SetModel( self.ModelToSpawnWith )
self:PhysicsInit( SOLID_VPHYSICS )
self:SetMoveType( MOVETYPE_VPHYSICS )
self:SetSolid( SOLID_VPHYSICS )
end
end

-- This is a custom function we'll be using to demonstrate that children can
-- override functions from their Base Class.
function ENT:EnableVisualEffects()
-- Modify upcoming rendering to make it look blue.
render.SetColorModulation( 0, 0, 1 )
end

-- This custom function won't be overridden by the child Entity, but that is
-- purely for demonstration purposes. Any function from the Base Class can
-- be overridden by its children.
function ENT:DisableVisualEffects()
-- Reset the color of the rendering system.
render.SetColorModulation( 1, 1, 1 )
end

-- Here we use the custom functions above to change how the entity draws.
-- Because we do not override this function in the child, this will be the
-- Draw function for the child Entity.
function ENT:Draw()
self:EnableVisualEffects()
self:DrawModel()
self:DisableVisualEffects()
end
```

local function BuildPuzzleWallAngle(hitNormal, eyeYaw)
if not isvector(hitNormal) then return nil end

local normal = hitNormal:GetNormalized()
local ang = (-normal):Angle()
ang:RotateAroundAxis(ang:Right(), 90)
local yawDiff = math.AngleDifference(tonumber(eyeYaw) or 0, ang.y)
ang:RotateAroundAxis(normal, yawDiff)
return ang
end

local function GetAngleTableFromData(data)
if not istable(data) and not isangle(data) then return nil end
local p = tonumber(data.p)
local y = tonumber(data.y)
local r = tonumber(data.r)
if p == nil or y == nil or r == nil then return nil end
return { p = p, y = y, r = r }
end

local function ResolveActiveAngleData(objData)
if not istable(objData) then return nil end
if objData["aim_wall"] then
return GetAngleTableFromData(objData["wall_ang"])
end
return GetAngleTableFromData(objData["angle"])
end

local function SetActiveAngleData(objData, p, y, r)
if not istable(objData) then return end
local angData = {
p = tonumber(p) or 0,
y = tonumber(y) or 0,
r = tonumber(r) or 0,
}

if objData["aim_wall"] then
objData["wall_ang"] = angData
else
objData["angle"] = angData
end
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:EnsureAdminSettingsDefaults()
cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"] or {}

local defaults = {
SoundBind_Volume = 50,
SoundBind_Cooldown = 10,
AnimationBind_Cooldown = 10,
Admin_Access = false,
Enable_WorkshopAutoMountPrompt = true,
Enable_SoundBinds = true,
Enable_AnimationBinds = true,
Enable_BindWheel = true,
CreatorUserGroups = {superadmin = true, owner = true},
ManualWorkshopLinks = {},
TimedGiveaway_Enabled = false,
TimedGiveaway_MinPlayers = 5,
TimedGiveaway_IntervalMinutes = 30,
}

local changed = false
for key, value in pairs(defaults) do
if cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"][key] == nil then
if istable(value) then
cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"][key] = table.Copy(value)
else
cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"][key] = value
end
changed = true
end
end

if isfunction(cutta_cosmetic_shop.NormalizeManualWorkshopLinkEntries) then
local currentManualLinks = cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"]["ManualWorkshopLinks"] or {}
local normalizedManualLinks = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeManualWorkshopLinkEntries(cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"]["ManualWorkshopLinks"])
local currentManualLinksSignature = util.TableToJSON(currentManualLinks) or "[]"
local normalizedManualLinksSignature = util.TableToJSON(normalizedManualLinks) or "[]"
if currentManualLinksSignature ~= normalizedManualLinksSignature then
cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"]["ManualWorkshopLinks"] = normalizedManualLinks
changed = true
end
end

return changed
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:Init_AdminSettings()
cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"] = {}

cutta_cosmetic_shop:Save_Admin_Settings()

In Garry's Mod Lua, what does cam.PushModelMatrix do?

Pushes the specified matrix onto the render matrix stack. Each pushed matrix must be popped via cam.PopModelMatrix .

When used in PANEL:Paint , if you want to rely on the top-left position of the panel, you must use VMatrix:Translate with the (0, 0) position of the panel relative to the screen.

If trying to use it with with cam.Start3D2D , set `multiply` to `true`, since **cam.Start3D2D** pushes its own model matrix.

Realms
- Client

Arguments
- matrix: VMatrix. The matrix to push.
- multiply: boolean. If set, multiplies given matrix with currently active matrix ( cam.GetModelMatrix ) before pushing.

Example

Simple function to draw rotated and/or scaled text.
```lua
local vector_one = Vector( 1, 1, 1 )
function draw.RotatedText( text, font, x, y, color, ang, scale )
render.PushFilterMag( TEXFILTER.ANISOTROPIC )
render.PushFilterMin( TEXFILTER.ANISOTROPIC )

local m = Matrix()
m:Translate( Vector( x, y, 0 ) )
m:Rotate( Angle( 0, ang, 0 ) )
m:Scale( vector_one * ( scale or 1 ) )

surface.SetFont( font )
local w, h = surface.GetTextSize( text )

m:Translate( Vector( -w / 2, -h / 2, 0 ) )

cam.PushModelMatrix( m, true )
draw.DrawText( text, font, 0, 0, color )
cam.PopModelMatrix()

render.PopFilterMag()
render.PopFilterMin()
end

hook.Add("HUDPaint", "2d rotation test", function()
local w, h = ScrW(), ScrH()
local ang = RealTime() * 50
local scale = ( math.sin( ang / 10 ) + 2 ) * 0.5
draw.RotatedText( "My fancy Rotating Text", "DermaLarge", w / 2, h / 2, color_white, ang, scale )
end)
```

Rotating a box while keeping it's matrix positions relative to the panel.
```lua
concommand.Add("test_matrix", function()
local menu = vgui.Create( "DFrame" )
menu:SetSize( 200, 200 )
menu:SetTitle("Matrix rotation example")
menu:SetPos( 200, 200 )

local panel = menu:Add( "DPanel" )
panel:SetSize( 100, 100 )
panel:Center()

local grin = Material("icon16/emoticon_evilgrin.png", "smooth noclamp")
local angle = 0
function panel:Paint(w, h)
draw.RoundedBox( 8, 0, 0, w, h, color_white )

-- time to draw our matrix
local m = Matrix()

-- to keep the matrix relative to the panel, we get the center of it relative to the screen
local x, y = self:LocalToScreen( w / 2, h / 2 )
local center = Vector( x, y, 0 )

m:Translate( center )
m:Rotate( Angle( 0, angle, 0 ) )
m:Translate( -center )

-- rotate the angle after drawing for next time
angle = angle + FrameTime() * 60

-- push a filter mag to take away the crispiness
render.PushFilterMag( TEXFILTER.ANISOTROPIC )
render.PushFilterMin( TEXFILTER.ANISOTROPIC )

cam.PushModelMatrix( m )
draw.RoundedBox( 8, 0, 0, w, h, color_black )
surface.SetDrawColor( 255, 255, 255, 255 )
surface.SetMaterial( grin )
surface.DrawTexturedRect( w/2-16, h/2-16, 32, 32 )
cam.PopModelMatrix()

render.PopFilterMag()
render.PopFilterMin()
end

end)
```

local function ease_in_out_cubic(fraction)
fraction = math.Clamp(tonumber(fraction) or 0, 0, 1)

if fraction < 0.5 then
return 4 * fraction * fraction * fraction
end

local offset = (-2 * fraction) + 2
return 1 - ((offset * offset * offset) * 0.5)
end

local function sanitize_collapse_snapshot(collapse_data)
if not istable(collapse_data) or collapse_data.active ~= true then
return {
active = false,
remaining_seconds = 0,
duration_seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(ADDON.Config.CollapseCountdownSeconds) or 0))
}
end

return {
active = true,
remaining_seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(collapse_data.remaining_seconds) or 0)),
duration_seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(collapse_data.duration_seconds) or ADDON.Config.CollapseCountdownSeconds or 0))
}
end

local function build_vector_from_snapshot(raw_value)
if isvector(raw_value) then
return Vector(raw_value.x, raw_value.y, raw_value.z)
end

if not istable(raw_value) then
return nil
end

local x = tonumber(raw_value.x or raw_value[1])
local y = tonumber(raw_value.y or raw_value[2])
local z = tonumber(raw_value.z or raw_value[3])

if x == nil or y == nil or z == nil then
return nil
end

return Vector(x, y, z)
end

local function sanitize_escape_snapshot(escape_data)
if not istable(escape_data) or escape_data.active ~= true then
return {
active = false,
safe_radius = math.max(96, math.floor(tonumber(ADDON.Config.EscapePointSafeRadius) or 320))
}
end

local position = build_vector_from_snapshot(escape_data.position or escape_data.pos)

if not isvector(position) then
return {
active = false,
safe_radius = math.max(96, math.floor(tonumber(ADDON.Config.EscapePointSafeRadius) or 320))
}
end

return {
active = true,
id = ADDON:NormalizeString(escape_data.id, ""),
source_id = ADDON:NormalizeString(escape_data.source_id, ADDON:NormalizeString(escape_data.id, "")),
model = ADDON:NormalizeString(escape_data.model, ADDON.Config.EscapePointDefaultModel),
position = {
x = position.x,
y = position.y,
z = position.z
},
angle = {
p = tonumber(escape_data.angle and (escape_data.angle.p or escape_data.angle[1])) or 0,
y = tonumber(escape_data.angle and (escape_data.angle.y or escape_data.angle[2])) or 0,
r = tonumber(escape_data.angle and (escape_data.angle.r or escape_data.angle[3])) or 0
},
safe_radius = math.max(96, math.floor(tonumber(escape_data.safe_radius) or ADDON.Config.EscapePointSafeRadius or 320))
}
end

local function sanitize_escape_point_list(raw_points)
local sanitized_points = {}

if not istable(raw_points) then
return sanitized_points
end

for index, raw_point in ipairs(raw_points) do
local sanitized_point = sanitize_escape_snapshot(table.Merge({active = true}, raw_point))

if sanitized_point.active == true then
sanitized_point.active = nil

if sanitized_point.id == "" then
sanitized_point.id = string.format("escape_%d", index)
end

sanitized_points[#sanitized_points + 1] = sanitized_point
end
end

return sanitized_points
end

local function get_active_escape_snapshot()
local active_escape = sanitize_escape_snapshot(ADDON.Client.ActiveEscape)

if active_escape.active ~= true then
local snapshot = ADDON.Client.Snapshot or {}
active_escape = sanitize_escape_snapshot(snapshot.active_escape)
end

ADDON.Client.ActiveEscape = active_escape

return active_escape.active == true and active_escape or nil
end

local function get_escape_position(escape_snapshot)
return build_vector_from_snapshot(escape_snapshot and (escape_snapshot.position or escape_snapshot.pos))
end

local function format_escape_point_position(escape_point)
local position = get_escape_position(escape_point)

if not isvector(position) then
return "UNKNOWN"
end

return string.format("%.0f, %.0f, %.0f", position.x, position.y, position.z)
end

local function format_escape_distance(distance_units)

return string.format("%03dm", meters)
end

local function reset_collapse_clock_state(current_time)
current_time = tonumber(current_time) or CurTime()

ADDON.Client.Collapse = {
active = false,
duration_seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(ADDON.Config.CollapseCountdownSeconds) or 0)),
remaining_at_sync = 0,
synced_at = current_time,
last_display_seconds = 0,
last_minute_bucket = nil,
transition_started_at = 0,
transition_from_seconds = 0,
transition_to_seconds = 0
}

return ADDON.Client.Collapse
end

local function sync_collapse_clock(collapse_data, current_time)
current_time = tonumber(current_time) or CurTime()

local sanitized = sanitize_collapse_snapshot(collapse_data)

if sanitized.active ~= true then
return reset_collapse_clock_state(current_time)
end

ADDON.Client.Collapse = {
active = true,
duration_seconds = sanitized.duration_seconds,
remaining_at_sync = sanitized.remaining_seconds,
synced_at = current_time,
last_display_seconds = sanitized.remaining_seconds,
last_minute_bucket = math.floor(sanitized.remaining_seconds / 60),
transition_started_at = 0,
transition_from_seconds = sanitized.remaining_seconds,
transition_to_seconds = sanitized.remaining_seconds
}

return ADDON.Client.Collapse
end

local function format_collapse_clock_parts(total_seconds)
total_seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(total_seconds) or 0))

local hours = math.floor(total_seconds / 3600)
local minutes = math.floor((total_seconds % 3600) / 60)
local seconds = total_seconds % 60

return {
hours = string.format("%02d", hours),
minutes = string.format("%02d", minutes),
seconds = string.format("%02d", seconds),
compact = string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", hours, minutes, seconds)
}
end

local function get_collapse_clock_display(current_time)
local collapse = ADDON.Client.Collapse

if not istable(collapse) or collapse.active ~= true then
return nil
end

current_time = tonumber(current_time) or CurTime()

local synced_at = tonumber(collapse.synced_at) or current_time
local elapsed = math.max(0, current_time - synced_at)
local remaining_seconds = math.max(0, math.ceil((tonumber(collapse.remaining_at_sync) or 0) - elapsed))
local minute_bucket = math.floor(remaining_seconds / 60)
local previous_display_seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(collapse.last_display_seconds) or remaining_seconds))

if collapse.last_minute_bucket == nil then
collapse.last_minute_bucket = minute_bucket
end

if minute_bucket ~= collapse.last_minute_bucket then
collapse.transition_started_at = current_time
collapse.transition_from_seconds = previous_display_seconds
collapse.transition_to_seconds = remaining_seconds
collapse.last_minute_bucket = minute_bucket
end

local transition_fraction = 1
local transition_active = false

if (tonumber(collapse.transition_started_at) or 0) > 0 then
transition_fraction = math.Clamp((current_time - collapse.transition_started_at) / COLLAPSE_CLOCK_ANIMATION_SECONDS, 0, 1)
transition_active = transition_fraction < 1

if not transition_active then
collapse.transition_started_at = 0
collapse.transition_from_seconds = remaining_seconds
collapse.transition_to_seconds = remaining_seconds
end
end

collapse.last_display_seconds = remaining_seconds

return {
remaining_seconds = remaining_seconds,
duration_seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(collapse.duration_seconds) or 0)),
transition_fraction = transition_fraction,
transition_active = transition_active,
transition_from_seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(collapse.transition_from_seconds) or remaining_seconds)),
transition_to_seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(collapse.transition_to_seconds) or remaining_seconds))
}
end
