local function activate_utility_warning(warning, current_time, expires_at, should_play_sound)
if not istable(warning) then
return nil
end

current_time = tonumber(current_time) or CurTime()
should_play_sound = should_play_sound ~= false
warning.started_at = current_time
warning.ends_at = math.max(current_time + 0.1, tonumber(expires_at) or tonumber(warning.ends_at) or (current_time + UTILITY_WARNING_DURATION))
warning.total_duration = math.max(0.1, warning.ends_at - current_time)

local effect_name = ADDON:NormalizeString(warning.effect_name, "")

if effect_name == "" then
return nil
end

ADDON.Client.UtilityWarnings[effect_name] = warning

local has_order_entry = false

for _, ordered_effect_name in ipairs(ADDON.Client.UtilityWarningOrder or {}) do
if ordered_effect_name == effect_name then
has_order_entry = true
break
end
end

if not has_order_entry then
ADDON.Client.UtilityWarningOrder[#ADDON.Client.UtilityWarningOrder + 1] = effect_name
end

local style_data = warning.style or get_timed_effect_style(warning.effect_name)

if should_play_sound then
play_local_warning_sound(
style_data.warning_sound or style_data.sound_start,
style_data.warning_pitch,
style_data.warning_volume
)
end

return warning
end

local function get_utility_warning_count_text(warning)
local style_data = warning and warning.style or nil
local stack_count = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(warning and warning.stack_count) or 1))
local singular = style_data and style_data.warning_count_singular or "ITEM"
local plural = style_data and style_data.warning_count_plural or (singular .. "S")
local noun = stack_count == 1 and singular or plural

return string.format("%d %s USED", stack_count, noun)
end

local function update_utility_warning_math_text(warning)
if not istable(warning) then
return warning
end

local stack_count = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(warning.stack_count) or 1))
local base_delta = tonumber(warning.base_delta) or 0
local tick_interval = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(warning.tick_interval) or 5))
local delta_prefix = base_delta > 0 and "+" or ""

warning.metric = string.format("%s%d OUTBREAK", delta_prefix, base_delta)
warning.detail = string.format("%s%d outbreak every %ds", delta_prefix, base_delta, tick_interval)
warning.metric_detail = get_utility_warning_count_text(warning)

return warning
end

local function merge_utility_warning(existing_warning, incoming_warning, current_time)
if not istable(existing_warning) or not istable(incoming_warning) then
return existing_warning
end

current_time = tonumber(current_time) or CurTime()
existing_warning.style = incoming_warning.style or existing_warning.style
existing_warning.theme = incoming_warning.theme or existing_warning.theme
existing_warning.title = incoming_warning.title or existing_warning.title
existing_warning.label = incoming_warning.label or existing_warning.label
existing_warning.subtitle = incoming_warning.subtitle or existing_warning.subtitle
existing_warning.detail = incoming_warning.detail or existing_warning.detail
existing_warning.metric = incoming_warning.metric or existing_warning.metric
existing_warning.base_delta = tonumber(incoming_warning.base_delta) or tonumber(existing_warning.base_delta) or 0
existing_warning.tick_interval = tonumber(incoming_warning.tick_interval) or tonumber(existing_warning.tick_interval) or 5
existing_warning.tick_count = math.max(tonumber(existing_warning.tick_count) or 0, tonumber(incoming_warning.tick_count) or 0)
existing_warning.stack_count = math.max(tonumber(existing_warning.stack_count) or 1, tonumber(incoming_warning.stack_count) or 1)
existing_warning.ends_at = math.max(tonumber(existing_warning.ends_at) or current_time, tonumber(incoming_warning.ends_at) or current_time)
existing_warning.total_duration = math.max(0.1, existing_warning.ends_at - current_time)

return update_utility_warning_math_text(existing_warning)
end

local function remove_utility_warning(effect_name)
effect_name = ADDON:NormalizeString(effect_name, "")

if effect_name == "" then
return
end

ADDON.Client.UtilityWarnings[effect_name] = nil

local warning_order = ADDON.Client.UtilityWarningOrder or {}

for index = #warning_order, 1, -1 do
if warning_order[index] == effect_name then
table.remove(warning_order, index)
end
end

ADDON.Client.UtilityWarningOrder = warning_order
end

local function cleanup_utility_warnings(current_time)
current_time = tonumber(current_time) or CurTime()

for effect_name, warning in pairs(ADDON.Client.UtilityWarnings or {}) do
if not istable(warning) or current_time >= ((tonumber(warning.ends_at) or 0) + 0.05) then
remove_utility_warning(effect_name)
end
end
end

local function enqueue_utility_warning(effect_name, expires_at, stack_count)
effect_name = ADDON:NormalizeString(effect_name, "")

if effect_name == "" then
return
end

local item_data = ADDON:GetUtilityItemData(effect_name)
local style_data = get_timed_effect_style(effect_name)

if not item_data or not istable(style_data) then
return
end

local delta_prefix = item_data.delta > 0 and "+" or ""
local warning = {
effect_name = effect_name,
style = style_data,
theme = style_data.warning_theme or "UTILITY EVENT",
title = style_data.warning_title or string.upper(item_data.label or effect_name),
label = string.upper(item_data.label or effect_name),
subtitle = style_data.warning_subtitle or "Outbreak utility activated nearby",
detail = string.format("%s%d outbreak every %ds for %ds", delta_prefix, item_data.delta, item_data.tick_interval, item_data.total_duration),
metric = string.format("%s%d OUTBREAK", delta_prefix, item_data.delta),
metric_detail = "",
base_delta = item_data.delta,
tick_interval = item_data.tick_interval,
tick_count = item_data.tick_count,
stack_count = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(stack_count) or 1)),
ends_at = tonumber(expires_at) or (CurTime() + item_data.total_duration)
}

warning.total_duration = math.max(0.1, warning.ends_at - CurTime())
update_utility_warning_math_text(warning)

local active_warning = ADDON.Client.UtilityWarnings[effect_name]

if istable(active_warning) then
activate_utility_warning(merge_utility_warning(active_warning, warning, CurTime()), CurTime(), warning.ends_at, false)
return
end

activate_utility_warning(warning, CurTime(), warning.ends_at, true)
end

for effect_key, effect_data in pairs(ADDON.Client.TimedEffects or {}) do

end

local function get_timed_effect_pulse(effect_data, current_time)
local pulse_until = tonumber(effect_data.pulse_until) or 0

if current_time >= pulse_until then
return 0
end

local fraction = math.Clamp((pulse_until - current_time) / TIMED_EFFECT_PULSE_SECONDS, 0, 1)
return ease_in_out_cubic(fraction) * math.Clamp(tonumber(effect_data.pulse_power) or 0, 0, 1)
end

local function get_timed_effect_visibility(effect_data, current_time, eye_position, radius_scale)
if not istable(effect_data) or not isvector(effect_data.origin) then
return 0, 0, 0, 0
end

local radius = math.max(128, tonumber(effect_data.radius) or ADDON.Config.TimedUtilityEffectRadius)
local visible_radius = radius * math.max(0.5, tonumber(radius_scale) or 1)
local distance_sqr = eye_position:DistToSqr(effect_data.origin)

if distance_sqr > (visible_radius * visible_radius) then
return 0, radius, distance_sqr, 0
end

local remaining = math.max(0, (tonumber(effect_data.ends_at) or 0) - current_time)
local fade_fraction = remaining <= TIMED_EFFECT_FADE_SECONDS and math.Clamp(remaining / TIMED_EFFECT_FADE_SECONDS, 0, 1) or 1
local distance_fraction = 1 - math.Clamp(math.sqrt(distance_sqr) / visible_radius, 0, 1)
local pulse = get_timed_effect_pulse(effect_data, current_time)
local visibility = math.Clamp((distance_fraction * distance_fraction * 1.05) + (pulse * 0.22), 0, 1) * ease_in_out_cubic(fade_fraction)

return visibility, radius, distance_sqr, pulse
end

local function play_timed_effect_sound(style_data, phase, origin, radius)
if not istable(style_data) or not isvector(origin) then return end

local player_entity = get_local_player()

if not IsValid(player_entity) then return end

local audible_radius = math.max(128, tonumber(radius) or ADDON.Config.TimedUtilityEffectRadius)

if player_entity:GetPos():DistToSqr(origin) > (audible_radius * audible_radius) then
return
end

local sound_name = style_data["sound_" .. tostring(phase or "")]

if not isstring(sound_name) or sound_name == "" then
return
end

surface.PlaySound(sound_name)
end

local function sample_gradient_color(progress)
progress = math.Clamp(tonumber(progress) or 0, 0, 1)

if #STAGE_PALETTE <= 0 then
return 255, 255, 255
end

if #STAGE_PALETTE == 1 then
local color_data = STAGE_PALETTE[1]
return color_data.r, color_data.g, color_data.b
end

local segment_count = #STAGE_PALETTE - 1
local scaled_progress = progress * segment_count
local left_index = math.Clamp(math.floor(scaled_progress) + 1, 1, #STAGE_PALETTE)

if left_index >= #STAGE_PALETTE then
local color_data = STAGE_PALETTE[#STAGE_PALETTE]
return color_data.r, color_data.g, color_data.b
end

local local_fraction = scaled_progress - math.floor(scaled_progress)
local left_color = STAGE_PALETTE[left_index]
local right_color = STAGE_PALETTE[left_index + 1]

return Lerp(local_fraction, left_color.r, right_color.r), Lerp(local_fraction, left_color.g, right_color.g), Lerp(local_fraction, left_color.b, right_color.b)
end

local function draw_gradient_strip(x, y, width, height, alpha)
if width <= 0 or height <= 0 then return end

for segment = 0, HUD_BAR_SEGMENTS - 1 do
local start_fraction = segment / HUD_BAR_SEGMENTS
local end_fraction = (segment + 1) / HUD_BAR_SEGMENTS
local segment_x = math.floor(x + (width * start_fraction))
local next_segment_x = math.ceil(x + (width * end_fraction))
local segment_width = math.max(1, next_segment_x - segment_x)
local red, green, blue = sample_gradient_color((start_fraction + end_fraction) * 0.5)

surface.SetDrawColor(red, green, blue, alpha)
surface.DrawRect(segment_x, y, segment_width, height)
end
end

elseif stage_index == 2 then
prefix = "OUTBREAK"
elseif stage_index == 3 then

return string.format("%s // %s", prefix, string.upper(tostring(stage_label or "OUTBREAK")))

local function draw_caution_stripe_layer(y, height, alpha, stripe_color, stripe_width, slant, scroll_offset)
if height <= 0 or alpha <= 0 then return end

local screen_width = ScrW()
local travel_width = stripe_width + math.abs(slant)
local start_x = -travel_width - scroll_offset
local stripe_alpha = math.floor(alpha)

draw.NoTexture()
surface.SetDrawColor(stripe_color.r, stripe_color.g, stripe_color.b, stripe_alpha)

for x_position = start_x, screen_width + travel_width, travel_width do
surface.DrawPoly({
{x = x_position, y = y + height},
{x = x_position + slant, y = y},
{x = x_position + slant + stripe_width, y = y},
{x = x_position + stripe_width, y = y + height}
})
end
end

local function draw_warning_stripe_band(x, y, width, height, alpha, stripe_color, stripe_width, slant, scroll_offset)

local travel_width = stripe_width + math.abs(slant)
local start_x = x - travel_width - scroll_offset
local stripe_alpha = math.floor(alpha)

draw.NoTexture()
surface.SetDrawColor(stripe_color.r, stripe_color.g, stripe_color.b, stripe_alpha)

for x_position = start_x, x + width + travel_width, travel_width do
surface.DrawPoly({
{x = x_position, y = y + height},
{x = x_position + slant, y = y},
{x = x_position + slant + stripe_width, y = y},
{x = x_position + stripe_width, y = y + height}
})
end
end

local function get_warning_render_state(current_time)
local warning = ADDON.Client.Warning
if not istable(warning) then return nil, 0, 0, 0 end

local started_at = tonumber(warning.started_at) or 0
local ends_at = tonumber(warning.ends_at) or 0

if current_time >= ends_at then
ADDON.Client.Warning = nil
return nil, 0, 0, 0
end

local fade_in_fraction = math.Clamp((current_time - started_at) / CAUTION_FADE_IN, 0, 1)
local fade_out_fraction = math.Clamp((ends_at - current_time) / CAUTION_FADE_OUT, 0, 1)
local visibility = math.min(fade_in_fraction, fade_out_fraction)

if visibility <= 0 then
return nil, 0, 0, 0
end

local eased_visibility = ease_in_out_cubic(visibility)
local alpha = math.floor(255 * visibility)
local y = CAUTION_MARGIN_TOP - math.floor((1 - eased_visibility) * (CAUTION_HEIGHT + CAUTION_MARGIN_TOP + 2))
local push_offset = math.floor((CAUTION_HEIGHT + CAUTION_PUSH_GAP) * eased_visibility)

return warning, alpha, y, push_offset
end

local function get_utility_warning_render_states(current_time, offset_y)
cleanup_utility_warnings(current_time)

local render_states = {}
local total_push_offset = 0
local warning_order = ADDON.Client.UtilityWarningOrder or {}

for _, effect_name in ipairs(warning_order) do
local warning = ADDON.Client.UtilityWarnings[effect_name]

if istable(warning) then
local started_at = tonumber(warning.started_at) or 0
local ends_at = tonumber(warning.ends_at) or 0

if current_time >= ends_at then
remove_utility_warning(effect_name)
else
local fade_in_fraction = math.Clamp((current_time - started_at) / UTILITY_WARNING_FADE_IN, 0, 1)
local fade_out_fraction = math.Clamp((ends_at - current_time) / UTILITY_WARNING_FADE_OUT, 0, 1)
local visibility = math.min(fade_in_fraction, fade_out_fraction)

if visibility > 0 then
local eased_visibility = ease_in_out_cubic(visibility)
local alpha = math.floor(255 * visibility)
local y = CAUTION_MARGIN_TOP + math.max(0, tonumber(offset_y) or 0) + total_push_offset - math.floor((1 - eased_visibility) * (UTILITY_WARNING_HEIGHT + UTILITY_WARNING_PUSH_GAP + 2))
local push_offset = math.floor((UTILITY_WARNING_HEIGHT + UTILITY_WARNING_PUSH_GAP) * eased_visibility)

render_states[#render_states + 1] = {
warning = warning,
alpha = alpha,
y = y,
push_offset = push_offset
}

total_push_offset = total_push_offset + push_offset
end
end
end
end

return render_states, total_push_offset
end

local function draw_stage_warning_ribbon(warning, current_time, alpha, y)
if not istable(warning) or alpha <= 0 then return end

local stage_color = ADDON:NormalizeColorTable(warning.color)
local style = get_caution_style(warning.stage_index)
local screen_width = ScrW()
local pulse = 0.82 + (math.abs(math.sin(current_time * (1.1 + (warning.stage_index * 0.15)))) * style.pulse)
local base_alpha = math.floor(alpha * pulse)
local label_text = get_stage_warning_text(warning.stage_label, warning.stage_index)
local label_drift = math.sin(current_time * (1 + (warning.stage_index * 0.25))) * style.label_drift
local scroll_primary = (current_time * math.abs(style.speed)) % (style.stripe_width + math.abs(style.slant))

if style.speed < 0 then
scroll_primary = (style.stripe_width + math.abs(style.slant)) - scroll_primary
end

draw.RoundedBox(0, 0, y, screen_width, CAUTION_HEIGHT, Color(stage_color.r, stage_color.g, stage_color.b, math.floor(base_alpha * 0.92)))
draw_caution_stripe_layer(y, CAUTION_HEIGHT, math.floor(alpha * 0.84), {r = 12, g = 12, b = 12}, style.stripe_width, style.slant, scroll_primary)

if style.secondary_speed then
local scroll_secondary = (current_time * math.abs(style.secondary_speed)) % math.max(12, math.floor((style.stripe_width * 0.65) + math.abs(style.slant * 0.5)))

if style.secondary_speed < 0 then
scroll_secondary = math.max(12, math.floor((style.stripe_width * 0.65) + math.abs(style.slant * 0.5))) - scroll_secondary
end

draw_caution_stripe_layer(y, CAUTION_HEIGHT, math.floor(alpha * 0.18), {r = 255, g = 225, b = 96}, math.max(16, math.floor(style.stripe_width * 0.42)), math.floor(style.slant * 0.5), scroll_secondary)
end

surface.SetDrawColor(255, 221, 82, math.floor(alpha * 0.82))
surface.DrawRect(0, y, screen_width, 2)
surface.DrawRect(0, y + CAUTION_HEIGHT - 2, screen_width, 2)

surface.SetDrawColor(0, 0, 0, math.floor(alpha * 0.24))
surface.DrawRect(0, y + CAUTION_HEIGHT, screen_width, 1)

draw.SimpleTextOutlined(label_text, "OutbreakSystem.Ribbon", (screen_width * 0.5) + label_drift, y + 4, Color(248, 248, 244, alpha), TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP, 1, Color(0, 0, 0, math.floor(alpha * 0.75)))
end

local function draw_utility_warning_ribbon(warning, current_time, alpha, y)
if not istable(warning) or alpha <= 0 then return end

local style = warning.style or get_timed_effect_style(warning.effect_name)
local remaining_seconds = math.max(0, (tonumber(warning.ends_at) or current_time) - current_time)
local total_duration = math.max(0.1, tonumber(warning.total_duration) or remaining_seconds)
local remaining_fraction = math.Clamp(remaining_seconds / total_duration, 0, 1)
local countdown_text = string.format("REMAINING %s", ADDON:FormatDuration(remaining_seconds))
local stripe_width = math.max(24, math.floor((tonumber(style.warning_stripe_width) or 56) * 0.48))
local slant = math.max(8, math.floor((tonumber(style.warning_slant) or 16) * 0.7))
local card_width = math.min(760, ScrW() - 48)
local card_x = math.floor((ScrW() - card_width) * 0.5)
local pulse = 0.88 + (math.abs(math.sin(current_time * ((style.wave_speed or 2) * 0.7))) * 0.08)
local base_alpha = math.floor(alpha * pulse)
local accent_width = math.max(156, math.floor(card_width * 0.24))
local body_x = card_x + accent_width
local body_width = math.max(180, card_width - accent_width)
local segment_count = math.Clamp(tonumber(warning.tick_count) or 6, 3, 8)
local scroll_primary = (current_time * math.abs((style.rotation_speed or 16) * 4.4)) % (stripe_width + math.abs(slant))
local scan_fraction = (math.sin(current_time * ((style.wave_speed or 2) * 1.25)) * 0.5) + 0.5
local scan_width = math.max(34, math.floor(body_width * 0.18))
local scan_x = body_x + 12 + math.floor(math.max(0, body_width - scan_width - 24) * scan_fraction)
local segment_gap = 6
local segment_width = math.max(14, math.floor((body_width - 32 - ((segment_count - 1) * segment_gap)) / segment_count))
local highlighted_segments = math.Clamp(math.ceil(segment_count * remaining_fraction), 0, segment_count)

if (style.rotation_speed or 16) < 0 then
scroll_primary = (stripe_width + math.abs(slant)) - scroll_primary

draw.RoundedBox(12, card_x, y, card_width, UTILITY_WARNING_HEIGHT, Color(style.shadow.r, style.shadow.g, style.shadow.b, math.floor(base_alpha * 0.92)))

draw.RoundedBoxEx(12, card_x, y, accent_width, UTILITY_WARNING_HEIGHT, Color(style.primary.r, style.primary.g, style.primary.b, math.floor(alpha * 0.78)), true, false, true, false)
draw_warning_stripe_band(card_x, y, accent_width, UTILITY_WARNING_HEIGHT, math.floor(alpha * 0.17), style.shadow, stripe_width, slant, scroll_primary)

surface.SetDrawColor(style.overlay.r, style.overlay.g, style.overlay.b, math.floor(alpha * 0.14))

surface.SetDrawColor(style.primary.r, style.primary.g, style.primary.b, math.floor(alpha * 0.92))
surface.DrawRect(card_x, y, card_width, 2)
surface.SetDrawColor(style.overlay.r, style.overlay.g, style.overlay.b, math.floor(alpha * 0.9))
surface.DrawRect(card_x, y + UTILITY_WARNING_HEIGHT - 2, card_width, 2)
surface.SetDrawColor(255, 255, 255, math.floor(alpha * 0.08))
surface.DrawRect(body_x + 1, y + 2, body_width - 3, 1)

draw.SimpleTextOutlined(warning.theme or "UTILITY EVENT", "OutbreakSystem.UtilityRibbonSmall", card_x + 16, y + 10, Color(248, 249, 250, alpha), TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP, 1, Color(0, 0, 0, math.floor(alpha * 0.62)))
draw.SimpleTextOutlined(warning.title or warning.label or "UTILITY ITEM USED", "OutbreakSystem.UtilityRibbon", card_x + 16, y + 28, Color(250, 251, 252, alpha), TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP, 1, Color(0, 0, 0, math.floor(alpha * 0.7)))

draw.SimpleTextOutlined(warning.subtitle or "Outbreak utility activated nearby", "OutbreakSystem.UtilityRibbonSmall", body_x + 16, y + 10, Color(style.secondary.r, style.secondary.g, style.secondary.b, math.floor(alpha * 0.96)), TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP, 1, Color(0, 0, 0, math.floor(alpha * 0.58)))
draw.SimpleTextOutlined(warning.detail or "", "OutbreakSystem.UtilityRibbonSmall", body_x + 16, y + 29, Color(228, 233, 238, alpha), TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP, 1, Color(0, 0, 0, math.floor(alpha * 0.52)))
draw.SimpleTextOutlined(warning.metric_detail or "", "OutbreakSystem.UtilityRibbonMeta", body_x + 16, y + 50, Color(216, 223, 229, math.floor(alpha * 0.92)), TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP, 1, Color(0, 0, 0, math.floor(alpha * 0.52)))
draw.SimpleTextOutlined(warning.metric or "", "OutbreakSystem.UtilityRibbonMetric", card_x + card_width - 16, y + 10, Color(style.overlay.r, style.overlay.g, style.overlay.b, alpha), TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP, 1, Color(0, 0, 0, math.floor(alpha * 0.65)))
draw.SimpleTextOutlined(countdown_text, "OutbreakSystem.UtilityRibbonMeta", card_x + card_width - 16, y + 36, Color(216, 223, 229, math.floor(alpha * 0.92)), TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP, 1, Color(0, 0, 0, math.floor(alpha * 0.52)))

for segment_index = 1, segment_count do

local segment_alpha = segment_index <= highlighted_segments and math.floor(alpha * 0.82) or math.floor(alpha * 0.24)

local function draw_escape_vector_indicator(current_time)
local active_escape = get_active_escape_snapshot()
local player_entity = get_local_player()

if not active_escape or not IsValid(player_entity) then
return
end

local target_position = get_escape_position(active_escape)

if not isvector(target_position) then
return
end

local world_target = target_position + Vector(0, 0, 112)
local screen_data = world_target:ToScreen()
local screen_width = ScrW()
local screen_height = ScrH()
local center_x = screen_width * 0.5
local center_y = screen_height * 0.5
local direction_x = screen_data.x - center_x
local direction_y = screen_data.y - center_y
local to_target = world_target - EyePos()

if to_target:LengthSqr() > 1 then
local forward = EyeAngles():Forward()

if forward:Dot(to_target:GetNormalized()) < 0 then
direction_x = -direction_x
direction_y = -direction_y
end
end

if math.abs(direction_x) < 0.001 and math.abs(direction_y) < 0.001 then
direction_y = -1
end

local on_screen = screen_data.visible == true
and screen_data.x > 92
and screen_data.x < screen_width - 92
and screen_data.y > 92
and screen_data.y < screen_height - 92

local panel_center_x = screen_data.x
local panel_center_y = screen_data.y - 92
local direction_length = math.max(1, math.sqrt((direction_x * direction_x) + (direction_y * direction_y)))
local unit_x = direction_x / direction_length
local unit_y = direction_y / direction_length
local panel_half_width = ESCAPE_INDICATOR_PANEL_WIDTH * 0.5
local panel_half_height = ESCAPE_INDICATOR_PANEL_HEIGHT * 0.5

if not on_screen then
local half_width = (screen_width * 0.5) - panel_half_width - ESCAPE_INDICATOR_EDGE_MARGIN
local half_height = (screen_height * 0.5) - panel_half_height - ESCAPE_INDICATOR_EDGE_MARGIN
local scale_x = unit_x ~= 0 and math.abs(half_width / unit_x) or math.huge
local scale_y = unit_y ~= 0 and math.abs(half_height / unit_y) or math.huge
local scale = math.min(scale_x, scale_y)

panel_center_x = center_x + (unit_x * scale)
panel_center_y = center_y + (unit_y * scale)
end

panel_center_x = math.Clamp(panel_center_x, panel_half_width + ESCAPE_INDICATOR_EDGE_MARGIN, screen_width - panel_half_width - ESCAPE_INDICATOR_EDGE_MARGIN)
panel_center_y = math.Clamp(panel_center_y, panel_half_height + ESCAPE_INDICATOR_EDGE_MARGIN, screen_height - panel_half_height - ESCAPE_INDICATOR_EDGE_MARGIN)

local panel_x = math.floor(panel_center_x - panel_half_width)
local panel_y = math.floor(panel_center_y - panel_half_height)
local distance_text = format_escape_distance(player_entity:GetPos():Distance(target_position))
local safe_radius_text = string.format("SAFE RADIUS %s", format_escape_distance(active_escape.safe_radius))
local pulse = 0.78 + (math.abs(math.sin(current_time * 2.2)) * 0.22)
local accent_alpha = math.floor(235 * pulse)

draw.RoundedBox(14, panel_x, panel_y, ESCAPE_INDICATOR_PANEL_WIDTH, ESCAPE_INDICATOR_PANEL_HEIGHT, Color(4, 5, 8, 238))
draw.RoundedBox(12, panel_x + 2, panel_y + 2, ESCAPE_INDICATOR_PANEL_WIDTH - 4, ESCAPE_INDICATOR_PANEL_HEIGHT - 4, Color(13, 14, 18, 232))
surface.SetDrawColor(255, 182, 64, accent_alpha)
surface.DrawRect(panel_x, panel_y, ESCAPE_INDICATOR_PANEL_WIDTH, 2)
surface.SetDrawColor(255, 182, 64, math.floor(accent_alpha * 0.34))
surface.DrawRect(panel_x, panel_y + ESCAPE_INDICATOR_PANEL_HEIGHT - 3, ESCAPE_INDICATOR_PANEL_WIDTH, 2)

draw.SimpleTextOutlined(on_screen and "ESCAPE POINT" or "ESCAPE VECTOR", "OutbreakSystem.EscapeVectorTitle", panel_x + 14, panel_y + 8, Color(255, 216, 134, 255), TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP, 1, Color(0, 0, 0, 220))
draw.SimpleText(safe_radius_text, "OutbreakSystem.EscapeVectorMeta", panel_x + ESCAPE_INDICATOR_PANEL_WIDTH - 14, panel_y + 11, Color(255, 188, 92, 220), TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP)
draw.SimpleTextOutlined(distance_text, "OutbreakSystem.EscapeVectorDigits", panel_x + 14, panel_y + 30, Color(255, 176, 64, 255), TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP, 1, Color(28, 12, 0, 220))
draw.SimpleText(on_screen and "BUNKER IN SIGHT" or "FOLLOW THE VECTOR", "OutbreakSystem.EscapeVectorMeta", panel_x + ESCAPE_INDICATOR_PANEL_WIDTH - 14, panel_y + 42, Color(236, 239, 243, 230), TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP)

if not on_screen then
draw_escape_indicator_arrow(panel_center_x - (unit_x * (panel_half_width + 12)), panel_center_y - (unit_y * (panel_half_height + 8)), math.atan2(unit_y, unit_x), 255)
end
end

local function get_hud_display_points(current_time)
local hud = ADDON.Client.HUD

if not istable(hud) then
return clamp_points_float(get_snapshot_points())
end

local start_points = clamp_points_float(hud.start_points)
local target_points = clamp_points_float(hud.target_points ~= nil and hud.target_points or hud.points)
local started_at = tonumber(hud.animation_started_at) or 0
local finished_at = tonumber(hud.animation_ends_at) or 0

if finished_at <= started_at then
hud.display_points = target_points
return target_points
end

local fraction = math.Clamp(((current_time or CurTime()) - started_at) / (finished_at - started_at), 0, 1)
local displayed_points = Lerp(ease_in_out_cubic(fraction), start_points, target_points)

if fraction >= 1 then
displayed_points = target_points
end

displayed_points = clamp_points_float(displayed_points)
hud.display_points = displayed_points

return displayed_points
end

local function get_event_points_text(points_amount)
local numeric_points = math.floor(tonumber(points_amount) or 0)

if numeric_points > 0 then
return string.format("+%d POINTS", numeric_points)
end

if numeric_points < 0 then
return string.format("-%d POINTS", math.abs(numeric_points))
end

return "0 POINTS"
end

local function get_event_points_color(last_event_amount, alpha)
local numeric_points = math.floor(tonumber(last_event_amount) or 0)

if numeric_points > 0 then
return Color(222, 92, 92, alpha)
end

if numeric_points < 0 then
return Color(110, 218, 142, alpha)
end

return Color(214, 220, 228, alpha)
end

local function is_zombie_event_reason(reason)
return tostring(reason or "") == "zombie_kill"
end

local function reset_zombie_hud_session(hud)
if not istable(hud) then return end

hud.zombie_session_started_at = 0

if hud.visibility_source_reason == "zombie_kill" then
hud.visibility_source_reason = ""
end
end

local function finalize_zombie_hud_session(hud, current_time)
if not istable(hud) then return end

local session_started_at = tonumber(hud.zombie_session_started_at) or 0
if session_started_at <= 0 then return end

local visible_duration = math.max(0, (tonumber(hud.expires_at) or current_time) - session_started_at)

if visible_duration >= (ADDON.Config.ZombieHudMaxVisibleSeconds - 0.05) then
hud.zombie_cooldown_until = math.max(tonumber(hud.zombie_cooldown_until) or 0, current_time + ADDON.Config.ZombieHudCooldownSeconds)
end

reset_zombie_hud_session(hud)
end

local function update_zombie_hud_limit(hud, current_time)
if not istable(hud) then return end

local session_started_at = tonumber(hud.zombie_session_started_at) or 0
if session_started_at <= 0 then return end

local session_deadline = session_started_at + ADDON.Config.ZombieHudMaxVisibleSeconds
local active_visibility = current_time < (tonumber(hud.expires_at) or 0)

if hud.visibility_source_reason ~= "zombie_kill" then
reset_zombie_hud_session(hud)
return
end

if not active_visibility then
finalize_zombie_hud_session(hud, current_time)
return
end

if current_time >= session_deadline then
hud.expires_at = current_time
finalize_zombie_hud_session(hud, current_time)
end
end

local function find_assignment_by_command(command)
command = tostring(command or "")
if command == "" then return nil end

local snapshot = ADDON.Client.Snapshot or {}

for _, assignment in ipairs(snapshot.assignments or {}) do
if tostring(assignment.command or "") == command then
return assignment
end
end

return nil
end

return combo_box.SelectedData or combo_box:GetOptionData(combo_box:GetSelectedID())
end

local function set_combo_selection(combo_box, option_id, data)
if not IsValid(combo_box) then return nil end
if not isnumber(option_id) then return nil end

local option_text = combo_box:GetOptionText(option_id)
if option_text == nil then return nil end

combo_box:CloseMenu()
combo_box.selected = option_id
combo_box:SetText(tostring(option_text or ""))
combo_box.SelectedData = data or combo_box:GetOptionData(option_id)

return combo_box.SelectedData
end

local function select_combo_by_value(combo_box, field_name, wanted_value)
if not IsValid(combo_box) then return end

wanted_value = tostring(wanted_value or "")
if wanted_value == "" then return end

local selected_data = get_job_combo_data(combo_box)

if istable(selected_data) and tostring(selected_data[field_name] or "") == wanted_value then
combo_box.SelectedData = selected_data
return selected_data
end

for index, data in pairs(combo_box.Data or {}) do
if istable(data) and tostring(data[field_name] or "") == wanted_value then
return set_combo_selection(combo_box, index, data)
end
end
end

local function rebuild_job_choices(state)
if not state or not IsValid(state.JobCombo) then return end

local snapshot = ADDON.Client.Snapshot or {}
local selected = get_job_combo_data(state.JobCombo)
local selected_command = istable(selected) and tostring(selected.command or "") or ""

state.JobCombo:Clear()
state.JobCombo.SelectedData = nil

for _, job in ipairs(snapshot.jobs or {}) do
local label = string.format("%s [%s]", job.name or job.command or "Unknown", job.command or "")
state.JobCombo:AddChoice(label, job)
end

if selected_command ~= "" then
select_combo_by_value(state.JobCombo, "command", selected_command)
end
end

local function populate_assignment_list(list_view, assignments)
if not IsValid(list_view) then return end

list_view:Clear()

for _, assignment in ipairs(assignments or {}) do
local line = list_view:AddLine(
assignment.name or assignment.command or "Unknown",
tostring(assignment.player_kill_value or 0),
tostring(assignment.npc_kill_value or 0),
assignment.command or ""
)

line.AssignmentData = assignment
end
end

local function set_editor_from_assignment(state, assignment)
if not istable(state) or not istable(assignment) then return end

state.SelectedAssignment = assignment

select_combo_by_value(state.JobCombo, "command", assignment.command)
select_combo_by_value(state.FactionCombo, "key", assignment.faction)

if IsValid(state.PlayerDelta) then
state.PlayerDelta:SetValue(tonumber(assignment.player_kill_value) or ADDON.Config.DefaultPlayerDelta)
end

if IsValid(state.NPCDelta) then
state.NPCDelta:SetValue(tonumber(assignment.npc_kill_value) or ADDON.Config.DefaultNPCDelta)
end
end

local function set_editor_defaults(state)
if not istable(state) then return end

state.SelectedAssignment = nil

if IsValid(state.PlayerDelta) then
state.PlayerDelta:SetValue(ADDON.Config.DefaultPlayerDelta)
end

if IsValid(state.NPCDelta) then
state.NPCDelta:SetValue(ADDON.Config.DefaultNPCDelta)
end
end

local function rebuild_assignment_lists(state)
if not state then return end

local snapshot = ADDON.Client.Snapshot or {}

populate_assignment_list(state.GoodAssignmentList, snapshot.good_assignments or {})
populate_assignment_list(state.BadAssignmentList, snapshot.bad_assignments or {})
end

local function populate_escape_point_list(list_view, escape_points, active_escape_id)
if not IsValid(list_view) then return end

list_view:Clear()

for _, escape_point in ipairs(escape_points or {}) do
local is_active = tostring(active_escape_id or "") ~= "" and tostring(escape_point.id or "") == tostring(active_escape_id or "")
local line = list_view:AddLine(
is_active and "ACTIVE" or "READY",
escape_point.model or ADDON.Config.EscapePointDefaultModel,
format_escape_point_position(escape_point)
)

line.EscapePointData = escape_point
end
end

function ADDON:RefreshAdminPanel()
local state = self.Client.PanelState
if not istable(state) then return end
if not IsValid(state.Panel) then return end

local snapshot = self.Client.Snapshot or {}
local points = get_snapshot_points()
local stage_data = self:GetStageData(points)
local can_manage = snapshot.can_manage == true
local collapse_snapshot = sanitize_collapse_snapshot(snapshot.collapse)
local active_escape = sanitize_escape_snapshot(snapshot.active_escape)
local escape_points = sanitize_escape_point_list(snapshot.escape_points)
local live_collapse_display = get_collapse_clock_display(CurTime())
local collapse_default_seconds = math.max(60, math.floor(tonumber(self.Config.CollapseCountdownSeconds) or 60))
local collapse_remaining_seconds = live_collapse_display and math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(live_collapse_display.remaining_seconds) or 0)) or math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(collapse_snapshot.remaining_seconds) or 0))
local collapse_slider_minutes = collapse_snapshot.active and math.max(1, math.ceil(collapse_remaining_seconds / 60)) or math.max(1, math.ceil(collapse_default_seconds / 60))
local can_set_current_collapse = can_manage and collapse_snapshot.active
local selected_escape_id = istable(state.SelectedEscapePoint) and tostring(state.SelectedEscapePoint.id or "") or ""
local selected_escape_point = nil

for _, escape_point in ipairs(escape_points) do
if tostring(escape_point.id or "") == selected_escape_id then
selected_escape_point = escape_point
break
end
end

state.SelectedEscapePoint = selected_escape_point

if IsValid(state.StatusLabel) then
state.StatusLabel:SetText(string.format(
"Current status: %s | Points: %d / %d | Passive increase: +%d every %d seconds | Default collapse timer: %s%s | Escape points: %d | Active escape: %s",
stage_data.label,
stage_data.points,
stage_data.max_points,
tonumber(snapshot.passive_increase_amount) or self.Config.PassiveIncreaseAmount,
tonumber(snapshot.passive_increase_interval) or self.Config.PassiveIncreaseInterval,
self:FormatDuration(collapse_default_seconds),
collapse_snapshot.active and string.format(" | Current countdown: %s", self:FormatDuration(collapse_remaining_seconds)) or " | Current countdown: inactive",
#escape_points,
active_escape.active and format_escape_point_position(active_escape) or "inactive"
))
state.StatusLabel:SizeToContentsY()
end

if IsValid(state.ReadOnlyLabel) then
state.ReadOnlyLabel:SetVisible(not can_manage)
end

if IsValid(state.LevelSlider) then
state.LevelSlider:SetEnabled(can_manage)
end

if IsValid(state.ApplyButton) then
state.ApplyButton:SetEnabled(can_manage)
end

if IsValid(state.AdjustAmount) then
state.AdjustAmount:SetEnabled(can_manage)
end

if IsValid(state.AddButton) then
state.AddButton:SetEnabled(can_manage)
end

if IsValid(state.SubtractButton) then
state.SubtractButton:SetEnabled(can_manage)
end

if IsValid(state.ResetButton) then
state.ResetButton:SetEnabled(can_manage)
end

if IsValid(state.CollapseTimerSlider) then
state.CollapseTimerSlider:SetEnabled(can_set_current_collapse)

if math.floor(tonumber(state.CollapseTimerSlider:GetValue()) or 0) ~= collapse_slider_minutes then
state.CollapseTimerSlider:SetValue(collapse_slider_minutes)
end
end

if IsValid(state.CollapseTimerButton) then
state.CollapseTimerButton:SetEnabled(can_set_current_collapse)
end

if IsValid(state.EscapeModelEntry) and ADDON:NormalizeString(state.EscapeModelEntry:GetValue(), "") == "" then
state.EscapeModelEntry:SetValue(ADDON.Config.EscapePointDefaultModel)
end

if IsValid(state.AddEscapePointButton) then
state.AddEscapePointButton:SetEnabled(can_manage)
end

if IsValid(state.RemoveEscapePointButton) then
state.RemoveEscapePointButton:SetEnabled(can_manage and state.SelectedEscapePoint ~= nil)
end

if IsValid(state.EscapeModelEntry) then
state.EscapeModelEntry:SetEnabled(can_manage)
end

if IsValid(state.EscapePointList) then
state.EscapePointList:SetEnabled(can_manage)
populate_escape_point_list(state.EscapePointList, escape_points, active_escape.active and active_escape.id or "")
end

if IsValid(state.JobCombo) then
state.JobCombo:SetEnabled(can_manage)
end

if IsValid(state.FactionCombo) then
state.FactionCombo:SetEnabled(can_manage)
end

if IsValid(state.PlayerDelta) then
state.PlayerDelta:SetEnabled(can_manage)
end

if IsValid(state.NPCDelta) then
state.NPCDelta:SetEnabled(can_manage)
end

if IsValid(state.SaveJobButton) then
state.SaveJobButton:SetEnabled(can_manage)
end

if IsValid(state.RemoveJobButton) then
state.RemoveJobButton:SetEnabled(can_manage)
end

rebuild_job_choices(state)
rebuild_assignment_lists(state)

local selected_job = get_job_combo_data(state.JobCombo)
local selected_command = istable(selected_job) and tostring(selected_job.command or "") or ""

if selected_command ~= "" then
local assignment = find_assignment_by_command(selected_command)

if assignment then
set_editor_from_assignment(state, assignment)
elseif not istable(state.SelectedAssignment) or tostring(state.SelectedAssignment.command or "") ~= selected_command then
set_editor_defaults(state)
select_combo_by_value(state.JobCombo, "command", selected_command)
end
end

if IsValid(state.StatusCard) then
state.StatusCard:SetTall(collapse_snapshot.active and 188 or 96)
state.StatusCard:InvalidateLayout(true)
end
end

net.Receive(ADDON.Net.StateUpdate, function()
local points = ADDON:ClampPoints(net.ReadUInt(14))
local delta = net.ReadInt(16)
local reason = net.ReadString()
local collapse_active = net.ReadBool()
local collapse_remaining = net.ReadUInt(16)
local collapse_duration = net.ReadUInt(16)
local current_time = CurTime()
local hud = ADDON.Client.HUD

update_zombie_hud_limit(hud, current_time)

local previous_points = get_hud_display_points(current_time)
local previous_actual_points = clamp_points_float(points - delta)
local previous_stage = ADDON:GetStageData(previous_actual_points)
local current_stage = ADDON:GetStageData(points)
local is_active = current_time < (hud.expires_at or 0)
local event_origin_points = is_active and clamp_points_float(hud.event_origin_points) or previous_actual_points
local zombie_reason = is_zombie_event_reason(reason)
local zombie_cooldown_active = zombie_reason and current_time < (tonumber(hud.zombie_cooldown_until) or 0)

if not is_active then
event_origin_points = previous_actual_points
end

ADDON.Client.Snapshot = ADDON.Client.Snapshot or {}
ADDON.Client.Snapshot.points = points
ADDON.Client.Snapshot.collapse = sanitize_collapse_snapshot({
active = collapse_active,
remaining_seconds = collapse_remaining,
duration_seconds = collapse_duration
})

if collapse_active ~= true then
ADDON.Client.Snapshot.active_escape = sanitize_escape_snapshot(nil)
ADDON.Client.ActiveEscape = ADDON.Client.Snapshot.active_escape
end

sync_collapse_clock(ADDON.Client.Snapshot.collapse, current_time)

if zombie_cooldown_active then
ADDON:RefreshAdminPanel()
return
end

if zombie_reason then
local zombie_owned_visibility = is_active and hud.visibility_source_reason == "zombie_kill"
local non_zombie_visibility = is_active and not zombie_owned_visibility

if zombie_owned_visibility then
local zombie_deadline = (tonumber(hud.zombie_session_started_at) or current_time) + ADDON.Config.ZombieHudMaxVisibleSeconds

if current_time >= zombie_deadline then
hud.expires_at = current_time
finalize_zombie_hud_session(hud, current_time)
ADDON:RefreshAdminPanel()
return
end

hud.expires_at = math.min(zombie_deadline, math.max(tonumber(hud.expires_at) or 0, current_time + ADDON.Config.HudVisibleSeconds))
elseif non_zombie_visibility then
event_origin_points = clamp_points_float(hud.event_origin_points)
else
hud.zombie_session_started_at = current_time
hud.visibility_source_reason = "zombie_kill"
hud.shown_at = current_time
hud.expires_at = math.min(current_time + ADDON.Config.HudVisibleSeconds, current_time + ADDON.Config.ZombieHudMaxVisibleSeconds)
event_origin_points = previous_actual_points
end
else
reset_zombie_hud_session(hud)
hud.visibility_source_reason = reason ~= "" and reason or "generic"
hud.shown_at = current_time
hud.expires_at = current_time + ADDON.Config.HudVisibleSeconds
end

hud.points = points
hud.delta = delta
hud.last_event_delta = delta
hud.last_event_reason = reason
hud.event_origin_points = event_origin_points
hud.start_points = previous_points
hud.target_points = points
hud.display_points = previous_points
hud.animation_started_at = current_time
hud.animation_ends_at = current_time + HUD_ANIMATION_DURATION

if previous_stage.index ~= current_stage.index and not zombie_cooldown_active then
ADDON:StartStageWarning(current_stage, current_time)
end

ADDON:RefreshAdminPanel()
end)

net.Receive(ADDON.Net.TimedEffect, function()
local effect_name = ADDON:NormalizeString(net.ReadString(), "")
local phase = ADDON:NormalizeString(net.ReadString(), "pulse")
local origin = net.ReadVector()
local expires_at = net.ReadFloat()
local radius = net.ReadUInt(12)
local intensity = math.Clamp((net.ReadUInt(8) or 0) / 255, 0, 1)
local stack_count = math.max(1, net.ReadUInt(8) or 1)

if effect_name == "" or not isvector(origin) then
return
end

local current_time = CurTime()
local effect_key = make_timed_effect_key(effect_name, origin)
local style_data = get_timed_effect_style(effect_name)
local effect_data = ADDON.Client.TimedEffects[effect_key]

if not istable(effect_data) then
effect_data = {
key = effect_key,
effect_name = effect_name,
origin = origin,
radius = math.max(128, tonumber(radius) or ADDON.Config.TimedUtilityEffectRadius),
style = style_data,
started_at = current_time,
ends_at = current_time + 0.1,
total_duration = 0.1,
stack_count = stack_count,
pulse_until = 0,
pulse_power = 0
}

ADDON.Client.TimedEffects[effect_key] = effect_data
end

effect_data.effect_name = effect_name
effect_data.origin = origin
effect_data.radius = math.max(128, tonumber(radius) or ADDON.Config.TimedUtilityEffectRadius)
effect_data.style = style_data
effect_data.stack_count = stack_count

if phase == "start" then
effect_data.started_at = current_time
effect_data.ends_at = math.max(current_time + 0.1, tonumber(expires_at) or (current_time + 0.1))
effect_data.total_duration = math.max(0.1, effect_data.ends_at - current_time)
effect_data.pulse_until = current_time + TIMED_EFFECT_PULSE_SECONDS
effect_data.pulse_power = math.max(0.35, intensity)
enqueue_utility_warning(effect_name, effect_data.ends_at, stack_count)
elseif phase == "stop" then
effect_data.ends_at = math.max(tonumber(effect_data.ends_at) or current_time, current_time + 0.6)
effect_data.total_duration = math.max(0.1, effect_data.ends_at - (tonumber(effect_data.started_at) or current_time))
effect_data.pulse_until = current_time + 0.4
effect_data.pulse_power = math.max(0.25, intensity)
else
effect_data.ends_at = math.max(tonumber(effect_data.ends_at) or current_time, current_time + 0.15)
effect_data.total_duration = math.max(0.1, (tonumber(effect_data.ends_at) or current_time) - (tonumber(effect_data.started_at) or current_time))
effect_data.pulse_until = current_time + TIMED_EFFECT_PULSE_SECONDS
effect_data.pulse_power = math.max(0.18, intensity)
end

cleanup_timed_effects(current_time)
end)

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Musiccue_StopActive()
local ply = LocalPlayer()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end

local timerId = cutta_quest_system:Objective_Musiccue_GetLoopTimerId()
if timer.Exists(timerId) then
timer.Remove(timerId)
end

ply.CUTTAQS_MusiccueToken = (tonumber(ply.CUTTAQS_MusiccueToken) or 0) + 1

if ply.CUTTAQS_Musiccue and ply.CUTTAQS_Musiccue.Stop then
ply.CUTTAQS_Musiccue:Stop()
end

ply.CUTTAQS_Musiccue = nil
ply.CUTTAQS_Musiccue_path = nil
end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Musiccue_StartLoop(duration, loopFn)
local ply = LocalPlayer()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end

local timerId = cutta_quest_system:Objective_Musiccue_GetLoopTimerId()
if timer.Exists(timerId) then
timer.Remove(timerId)
end

duration = tonumber(duration) or 0
if duration <= 0 or not isfunction(loopFn) then return end

timer.Create(timerId, duration, 0, function()
local localPly = LocalPlayer()
if not IsValid(localPly) then
timer.Remove(timerId)
return
end

if not localPly.CUTTAQS_Musiccue then
timer.Remove(timerId)
return
end

if loopFn(localPly.CUTTAQS_Musiccue) == false then
timer.Remove(timerId)
end
end)
end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Musiccue_playsound(objdata)
local soundPath = objdata and (objdata.sound or objdata["sound"]) or nil
if not soundPath then return end
if not IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then return end

cutta_quest_system:Objective_Musiccue_StopActive()

local playbackToken = LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_MusiccueToken

if cutta_quest_system:Objective_Musiccue_urlcheck(soundPath) then
sound.PlayURL(tostring(soundPath), "noblock", function(station)
local ply = LocalPlayer()
if not IsValid(ply) then
if IsValid(station) then
station:Stop()
end
return
end

function npcVisuals:GetDisplayModel(ent)

local displayModel = ent:GetNWString(self.DisplayModelKey, "")
displayModel = string.Trim(tostring(displayModel or ""))
if displayModel ~= "" then
return displayModel

function npcVisuals:GetDisplaySequence(ent)

function npcVisuals:ResolveSequenceId(clientModel, sequenceName)
if not IsValid(clientModel) then return -1 end
if not isstring(sequenceName) or sequenceName == "" then return -1 end

local asNumber = tonumber(sequenceName)
if isnumber(asNumber) and asNumber >= 0 then
return math.floor(asNumber)
end

local direct = clientModel:LookupSequence(sequenceName)
if isnumber(direct) and direct >= 0 then
return direct
end

local targetLower = string.lower(sequenceName)
for _, seqName in ipairs(clientModel:GetSequenceList() or {}) do
local seqLower = string.lower(seqName)
if seqLower == targetLower then
return clientModel:LookupSequence(seqName)
end
end

for _, seqName in ipairs(clientModel:GetSequenceList() or {}) do
local seqLower = string.lower(seqName)
if string.find(seqLower, targetLower, 1, true) or string.find(targetLower, seqLower, 1, true) then
return clientModel:LookupSequence(seqName)
end
end

return -1
end

function npcVisuals:ApplySequence(ent, clientModel, sequenceName)
if not IsValid(ent) or not IsValid(clientModel) then return end

local targetSequence = string.Trim(tostring(sequenceName or ""))
local cacheKey = targetSequence ~= "" and targetSequence or "__idle__"
if ent.CUTTAQS_ClientSequenceName == cacheKey then return end

local sequenceId = self:ResolveSequenceId(clientModel, targetSequence)
if not (isnumber(sequenceId) and sequenceId >= 0) then
sequenceId = self:ResolveSequenceId(clientModel, "idle_all")
end

if not (isnumber(sequenceId) and sequenceId >= 0) then
for _, seqName in ipairs(clientModel:GetSequenceList() or {}) do
if string.find(string.lower(seqName), "idle", 1, true) then
sequenceId = clientModel:LookupSequence(seqName)
break
end
end
end

if isnumber(sequenceId) and sequenceId >= 0 then
clientModel:ResetSequence(sequenceId)
clientModel:ResetSequenceInfo()
clientModel:SetCycle(0)
clientModel:SetPlaybackRate(1)
end

ent.CUTTAQS_ClientSequenceName = cacheKey
end

local function TruncateText(text, font, maxWidth)
if not isstring(text) then text = tostring(text or "") end
if text == "" then return "" end
surface.SetFont(font)
local w = select(1, surface.GetTextSize(text))
if w <= maxWidth then return text end

local ellipsis = "..."
local low, high = 1, #text
while low < high do
local mid = math.floor((low + high) / 2)
local candidate = string.sub(text, 1, mid) .. ellipsis
local cw = select(1, surface.GetTextSize(candidate))
if cw <= maxWidth then
low = mid + 1
else
high = mid
end
end
local finalLen = math.max(1, low - 1)
return string.sub(text, 1, finalLen) .. ellipsis
end

local function WrapTextLines(text, font, maxWidth, maxLines)
if not isstring(text) then text = tostring(text or "") end
text = string.Trim(text)
if text == "" then return {}, 0 end
if not isnumber(maxWidth) or maxWidth <= 0 then return { text }, 0 end
if not isnumber(maxLines) or maxLines <= 0 then maxLines = 999 end

surface.SetFont(font)
local _, lineH = surface.GetTextSize("Ag")

local lines = {}
local current = ""

local function pushLine(s)
s = string.Trim(s or "")
if s ~= "" then
table.insert(lines, s)
end
end

local function fits(s)
local w = select(1, surface.GetTextSize(s))
return w <= maxWidth
end

local function chunkWord(word)
if fits(word) then
return { word }
end

local parts = {}
local remaining = word
while #remaining > 0 do
local low, high = 1, #remaining
while low < high do
local mid = math.ceil((low + high) / 2)
local candidate = string.sub(remaining, 1, mid)
if fits(candidate) then
low = mid
else
high = mid - 1
end
end
local take = math.max(1, low)
table.insert(parts, string.sub(remaining, 1, take))
remaining = string.sub(remaining, take + 1)
end
return parts
end

for word in string.gmatch(text, "%S+") do
local wordParts = chunkWord(word)
for _,part in ipairs(wordParts) do
local candidate = current ~= "" and (current .. " " .. part) or part
if fits(candidate) then
current = candidate
else
pushLine(current)
current = part
end
end
end
pushLine(current)

if #lines > maxLines then
lines = { unpack(lines, 1, maxLines) }
local ellipsis = "..."
local last = lines[maxLines] or ""
if not fits(last) then
last = TruncateText(last, font, maxWidth)
end
if not string.EndsWith(last, ellipsis) then
last = TruncateText(last .. ellipsis, font, maxWidth)
end
lines[maxLines] = last
end

return lines, lineH
end

local function QuestPassesChecks(ply_, questname)
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_CanQuest(ply_) then
return false
end

if cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerNeedQuestsRequired(ply_, questname) then
local questrequiredtable = cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerQuestsRequired(ply_, questname)
for requiredQuestName,_ in pairs(questrequiredtable) do
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_HasCompletedQuest(ply_, requiredQuestName) then
return false
end
end
end

if cutta_quest_system:Quests_QuestRestrictionsCheck(questname) then
local restictionstable = cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerQuestRestrictionsTable(ply_, questname)
local playerfound = false
for k,v in pairs(restictionstable) do
for _,p in pairs(v) do
if cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestRestrictTo(ply_, k, p) then
playerfound = true
end
end
end
if not playerfound then
return false
end
end

if cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsRepeatable(questname, ply_) then
local questData = nil
for k,v in pairs(cutta_quest_system["Quests"]) do
if v[questname] then questData = v[questname] break end
end

if questData and (questData.ResetMonth or questData.ResetDay or questData.ResetTime) then
local resetMonth = questData.ResetMonth or 0
local resetDay = questData.ResetDay or 0
local resetTimeStr = questData.ResetTime or "00:00"

local resetHour, resetMin = string.match(resetTimeStr, "(%d+):(%d+)")
resetHour = tonumber(resetHour) or 0
resetMin = tonumber(resetMin) or 0

local now = os.time()
local date = os.date("*t", now)

local checkDate = {
year = date.year,
month = date.month,
day = date.day,
hour = resetHour,
min = resetMin,
sec = 0
}

if resetMonth ~= 0 then checkDate.month = resetMonth end
if resetDay ~= 0 then checkDate.day = resetDay end

local resetTimestamp = os.time(checkDate)

local lastResetTimestamp = resetTimestamp
if resetTimestamp > now then
local prevDate = table.Copy(checkDate)
if resetMonth ~= 0 then
prevDate.year = prevDate.year - 1
elseif resetDay ~= 0 then
prevDate.month = prevDate.month - 1
if prevDate.month == 0 then
prevDate.month = 12
prevDate.year = prevDate.year - 1
end
else
prevDate.day = prevDate.day - 1
end
lastResetTimestamp = os.time(prevDate)
end

local lastComplete = ply_.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes and ply_.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes[questname] or 0

if lastComplete > lastResetTimestamp then
return false
end
elseif cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsColddown(questname) then
if cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerOnQuestColddown(ply_, questname) then
return false
end
end
else
if cutta_quest_system:Player_HasCompletedQuest(ply_, questname) then
return false
end
end

return true
end

ang:RotateAroundAxis( self:GetForward(), 0 )

local pos = self:GetPos()
-- Change these numbers to position the screen on your model

pos = pos + self:GetRight() * 9.69
pos = pos + self:GetUp() * 11.8

-- Paint the background. Effectively a 388x320 pixel screen

surface.DrawRect( 0, 0, 388 * resolution, 320 * resolution )

local function sanitize_requested_conversion_count(requestedCount)
return math.min(math.max(math.floor(tonumber(requestedCount) or 1), 1), 65535)
end

local function format_exchange_suffix(exchangeCount)
exchangeCount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(exchangeCount) or 0), 0)
if exchangeCount <= 1 then
return ""
end

return " across " .. string.Comma(exchangeCount) .. " exchanges"
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:ConvertDarkRPMoneyToCoins(ply, requestedCount)
if not IsValid(ply) then
return false, "Player is not valid."
end

if not DarkRP then
return false, "DarkRP is not active on this server."
end

if not isfunction(ply.getDarkRPVar) or not isfunction(ply.addMoney) then
return false, "DarkRP money is unavailable right now."
end

local moneyCost, coinReward = self:GetDarkRPMoneyCoinExchangeRate()
if moneyCost <= 0 or coinReward <= 0 then
return false, "The exchange rate is invalid."
end

local currentMoney = self:GetDarkRPMoney(ply)
local affordableCount = math.floor(math.max(currentMoney, 0) / moneyCost)
if affordableCount < 1 then
return false, "You need $" .. string.Comma(moneyCost) .. " DarkRP money to convert."
end

local convertCount = math.min(sanitize_requested_conversion_count(requestedCount), affordableCount)
local totalMoneyCost = moneyCost * convertCount
local totalCoinReward = coinReward * convertCount

if isfunction(ply.canAfford) and not ply:canAfford(totalMoneyCost) then
return false, "You need $" .. string.Comma(totalMoneyCost) .. " DarkRP money to convert."
end

local removedMoney = pcall(function()
ply:addMoney(-totalMoneyCost)
end)
if not removedMoney then
return false, "Failed to remove DarkRP money."
end

self:COINS_ADD(ply, totalCoinReward)
return true, "Converted $" .. string.Comma(totalMoneyCost) .. " DarkRP money into " .. string.Comma(totalCoinReward) .. " cosmetic coins" .. format_exchange_suffix(convertCount) .. "."
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:ConvertInventoryMoneyToCoins(ply, requestedCount)
if not IsValid(ply) then
return false, "Player is not valid."
end

if not cutta_inventory_system or not isfunction(cutta_inventory_system.Get_PlayerMoney) or not isfunction(cutta_inventory_system.Player_MoneyGive) then
return false, "Cutta Inventory money is unavailable on this server."
end

if DarkRP then
return false, "Cutta Inventory is currently using DarkRP money. Use the DarkRP conversion instead."
end

local moneyCost, coinReward = self:GetInventoryMoneyCoinExchangeRate()
if moneyCost <= 0 or coinReward <= 0 then
return false, "The exchange rate is invalid."
end

local currentMoney = self:GetInventoryMoney(ply)
local affordableCount = math.floor(math.max(currentMoney, 0) / moneyCost)
if affordableCount < 1 then
return false, "You need $" .. string.Comma(moneyCost) .. " Cutta Inventory money to convert."
end

local convertCount = math.min(sanitize_requested_conversion_count(requestedCount), affordableCount)
local totalMoneyCost = moneyCost * convertCount
local totalCoinReward = coinReward * convertCount

local removedMoney = pcall(function()
cutta_inventory_system:Player_MoneyGive(ply, -totalMoneyCost, "Cosmetic coin conversion")
end)
if not removedMoney then
return false, "Failed to remove Cutta Inventory money."
end

self:COINS_ADD(ply, totalCoinReward)
return true, "Converted $" .. string.Comma(totalMoneyCost) .. " Cutta Inventory money into " .. string.Comma(totalCoinReward) .. " cosmetic coins" .. format_exchange_suffix(convertCount) .. "."
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:ConvertCoinsToPremium(ply, requestedCount)
if not IsValid(ply) then
return false, "Player is not valid."
end

local coinCost, premiumReward = self:GetCoinsPremiumExchangeRate()
if coinCost <= 0 or premiumReward <= 0 then
return false, "The exchange rate is invalid."
end

local currentCoins = self:COINS_GET(ply)
local affordableCount = math.floor(math.max(currentCoins, 0) / coinCost)
if affordableCount < 1 then
return false, "You need " .. string.Comma(coinCost) .. " cosmetic coins to convert."
end

local convertCount = math.min(sanitize_requested_conversion_count(requestedCount), affordableCount)
local totalCoinCost = coinCost * convertCount
local totalPremiumReward = premiumReward * convertCount

ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"] = ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"] or {}
ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"]["C_COINS"] = math.max(currentCoins - totalCoinCost, 0)
ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"]["C_PREMIUM_COINS"] = self:PREMIUM_COINS_GET(ply) + totalPremiumReward
self:Transfer(ply)

return true, "Converted " .. string.Comma(totalCoinCost) .. " cosmetic coins into " .. string.Comma(totalPremiumReward) .. " premium coins" .. format_exchange_suffix(convertCount) .. "."
end
